findings.description: Wait without expectations becomes do not wait.
findings.sourceReading: 期待しないで待っててね asks him to wait while not expecting her, matching the deliberately coy conditional offer.
findings.explanation: Wait without expectations becomes do not wait.

contexts.japanese: 期待しないで待っててね
contexts.english: Don't wait for me, though.

findings.description: Judging a Master’s good or evil becomes determining intent.
findings.sourceReading: その善悪を見極める explicitly names moral character as the purpose of finding Lancer’s unseen Master.
findings.explanation: Judging a Master’s good or evil becomes determining intent.

contexts.japanese: その善悪を見極めなくては
contexts.english: determine their intent.

findings.description: Feigning indifference until sensing an enemy becomes feigning helplessness to lure one out.
findings.sourceReading: 敵の気配を察するまでは無関心を装う keeps a collective indifferent appearance until detecting enemy presence.
findings.explanation: Feigning indifference until sensing an enemy becomes feigning helplessness to lure one out.

contexts.japanese: 敵の気配を察するまでは無関心を装おう
contexts.english: I'll act helpless until we lure out an enemy.

findings.description: Physical depletion becomes despondency.
findings.sourceReading: 眠気にも似た虚脱感 follows reconsideration of bodily recovery and motivates resting, then lethargic bedding preparation.
findings.explanation: Physical depletion becomes despondency.

contexts.japanese: 眠気にも似た虚脱感
contexts.english: a sense of despondency that feels similar to drowsiness.

findings.description: The explanation that distance gives him no safe zone is omitted.
findings.sourceReading: 今の貴方の実力では間合いの外も内もない explains why withdrawing out of reach cannot justify relaxation at his current ability.
findings.explanation: The explanation that distance gives him no safe zone is omitted.

contexts.japanese: 今の貴方の実力では間合いの外も内もない
contexts.english: You must not let your guard down just because you've retreated out of your opponent's reach.

findings.description: The English keeps the imagined errand but drops Shirou's alternative guess that Taiga wants to share a spontaneous comic story.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou guesses that Taiga might want a forgotten item delivered or might want to tell him a little comic story she has just thought of.
findings.explanation: The English keeps the imagined errand but drops Shirou's alternative guess that Taiga wants to share a spontaneous comic story.

contexts.japanese: 唐突に思いついた小噺を聞かせようとか
contexts.english: expecting her to ask me to bring her something she left at home.

findings.description: Sakura's lowered face becomes her standing in Shirou's way. His ensuing question about her health loses its stated visual cue.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou notices that Sakura has lowered her face for some unexplained reason, then asks whether she feels unwell.
findings.explanation: Sakura's lowered face becomes her standing in Shirou's way. His ensuing question about her health loses its stated visual cue.

contexts.japanese: なぜか、桜は俯いていた
contexts.english: Sakura is in my way.

findings.description: That is precisely why disappears from her answer to his anger denial.
findings.sourceReading: だから、です follows his I’m angry and makes that lively anger part of why he looked happy; 自分で気付いてない then names his unawareness.
findings.explanation: That is precisely why disappears from her answer to his anger denial.

contexts.japanese: ……だから、です。先輩、自分で気付いてない
contexts.english: You didn't notice, then.

findings.description: Shirou's meal as repayment for the morning porridge becomes porridge with an accompaniment, removing the stated return of care.
findings.sourceReading: After putting the feverish Sakura to bed, Shirou must make something in return for the morning porridge.
findings.explanation: Shirou's meal as repayment for the morning porridge becomes porridge with an accompaniment, removing the stated return of care.

contexts.japanese: 朝のお粥のお返しを作らないといけない
contexts.english: make okayu and something to accompany it.

findings.description: Only preparing Strengthened weapons ahead of time becomes only Strengthening something into a weapon.
findings.sourceReading: 武器を用意しておく specifies advance preparation because forming circuits takes a minute and surprise counterattack is impossible.
findings.explanation: Only preparing Strengthened weapons ahead of time becomes only Strengthening something into a weapon.

contexts.japanese: 武器を用意しておく事しかできない
contexts.english: All I can do is Strengthen something into a weapon.

findings.description: The offer loses its specific reason: Sakura may be wide awake after resting so much. Shirou still offers her companionship.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou offers conversation if all her resting has left Sakura wide awake.
findings.explanation: The offer loses its specific reason: Sakura may be wide awake after resting so much. Shirou still offers her companionship.

contexts.japanese: 寝てばっかりで目が冴えてるんなら
contexts.english: If you want someone to talk to before you go back to bed

findings.description: The English keeps the broken-VCR joke but changes “I'd sooner fix that” into “this is like fixing that,” softening the heater's exaggerated difficulty.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou had complained that he would sooner repair Taiga's bisected VCR than tackle the heater.
findings.explanation: The English keeps the broken-VCR joke but changes “I'd sooner fix that” into “this is like fixing that,” softening the heater's exaggerated difficulty.

contexts.japanese: あんなの直すぐらいなら藤ねえが真っ二つにしたビデオデッキを直すぞ
contexts.english: This is like asking me to fix the VCR that Fuji-nee cut in half!

findings.description: Sakura’s remorse for her own action becomes asking Shirou to realize he was out of line.
findings.sourceReading: 迷惑をかけてばかりですけど……反省したんですよ continues her first-person acknowledgment of troubling him and reflecting she truly did something bad earlier.
findings.explanation: Sakura’s remorse for her own action becomes asking Shirou to realize he was out of line.

contexts.japanese: さっきのは、ほんとに悪いコトをしたんだなあって反省したんですよ
contexts.english: I hope you realize that you were out of line earlier.

findings.description: Helping the weak and defeating the strong becomes being strong and helping the weak.
findings.sourceReading: 弱きを助け強きをくじく pairs protection with resistance to the strong.
findings.explanation: Helping the weak and defeating the strong becomes being strong and helping the weak.

contexts.japanese: 弱きを助け強きをくじく
contexts.english: someone strong who helps the weak.

findings.description: Reflecting on himself in embarrassment becomes regretting everything he ever did.
findings.sourceReading: 我が身を振り返っちまう and 恥ずかしい say praise makes him look back at himself and feel embarrassed.
findings.explanation: Reflecting on himself in embarrassment becomes regretting everything he ever did.

contexts.japanese: 我が身を振り返っちまう
contexts.english: regret everything I've ever done.

findings.description: Sitting formally in the dojo becomes meditating.
findings.sourceReading: 道場で正座したり imagines the physical formal sitting alongside riverbank running.
findings.explanation: Sitting formally in the dojo becomes meditating.

contexts.japanese: 道場で正座したり
contexts.english: meditated in the dojo.

findings.description: An unresolved search for the meaning of his solitary survival becomes an achieved sense of purpose through helping others. This changes why Shirou says he kept himself constantly occupied.
findings.sourceReading: He ran around town searching for meaning in having been the only one saved.
findings.explanation: An unresolved search for the meaning of his solitary survival becomes an achieved sense of purpose through helping others. This changes why Shirou says he kept himself constantly occupied.

contexts.japanese: 一人だけ助かった意味を探して
contexts.english: found meaning in helping as many people as I could

findings.description: Many times angrier becomes exactly twice as angry.
findings.sourceReading: 何倍も intensifies anger beyond ordinary people without assigning a fixed multiplier.
findings.explanation: Many times angrier becomes exactly twice as angry.

contexts.japanese: 他のヤツより何倍も怒る
contexts.english: twice as mad

findings.description: Being liable to mistake her for a model student despite knowing her nature becomes immunity to being fooled because he knows.
findings.sourceReading: 本性を知ってるのに、優等生だって騙されかねない says the disguise is so convincing it might fool even him.
findings.explanation: Being liable to mistake her for a model student despite knowing her nature becomes immunity to being fooled because he knows.

contexts.japanese: 遠坂の本性を知ってるのに、優等生だって騙されかねない
contexts.english: I know who you really are, so you can't fool me with that overachiever image.

findings.description: His present relief that Sakura is not pushing herself becomes only a past worry.
findings.sourceReading: 心配していたが、桜は無茶をしていないようだ contrasts previous worry with the reassuring current inference, explaining relief at Rider’s refusal to protect him.
findings.explanation: His present relief that Sakura is not pushing herself becomes only a past worry.

contexts.japanese: 桜は無茶をしていないようだ
contexts.english: I was worried that Sakura might be pushing herself too hard.

findings.description: Being dangerously precarious becomes being unreliable.
findings.sourceReading: 危なっかしい describes Shirou’s vulnerability and risk after offering rescue despite his condition.
findings.explanation: Being dangerously precarious becomes being unreliable.

contexts.japanese: 本当に貴方は危なっかしい
contexts.english: you are so unreliable.

findings.description: Belatedly noting an obvious height becomes a thought coming out of nowhere.
findings.sourceReading: 今さらだけど marks very belated recognition or mention of her evident height.
findings.explanation: Belatedly noting an obvious height becomes a thought coming out of nowhere.

contexts.japanese: ほんっとーに今さらだけど
contexts.english: This thought just came out of nowhere

findings.description: Shirou freezing because he did not understand the reason becomes him wondering why Rider froze.
findings.sourceReading: 理由が分からなくて固まってた is his answer that he was stalled by not understanding her concern.
findings.explanation: Shirou freezing because he did not understand the reason becomes him wondering why Rider froze.

contexts.japanese: 理由が分からなくて固まってた
contexts.english: I just wasn't sure why you froze up.

findings.description: Knowing why she is insecure becomes feeling the same negative judgment.
findings.sourceReading: 貴方とて判っている筈 says he should understand the evident reason she is about to explain.
findings.explanation: Knowing why she is insecure becomes feeling the same negative judgment.

contexts.japanese: 貴方とて判っている筈
contexts.english: Surely, you must feel the same way.

findings.description: His actions containing much wasted motion becomes spending time on trivial matters.
findings.sourceReading: 貴方の行動は無駄が多い criticizes inefficiency before the overdue morning greeting.
findings.explanation: His actions containing much wasted motion becomes spending time on trivial matters.

contexts.japanese: 貴方の行動は無駄が多い
contexts.english: You waste time on trivial matters.

findings.description: Anticipated reproach for daytime intimacy becomes a new future living-room encounter.
findings.sourceReading: He fears next-door witnesses despising what they are doing in broad daylight.
findings.explanation: Anticipated reproach for daytime intimacy becomes a new future living-room encounter.

contexts.japanese: 昼間っから何してるんだって軽蔑される
contexts.english: the next time we're in the living room.

findings.description: Shirou’s stunned observation becomes Illya staring at him.
findings.sourceReading: The first-person narrator watches Illya before describing her; she has also separately observed him, mentioned in12.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s stunned observation becomes Illya staring at him.

contexts.japanese: 呆然と、目の前にいるイリヤを観察する
contexts.english: Illya is staring at me.

findings.description: An involuntary stirring of his chest becomes feeling ashamed.
findings.sourceReading: 不覚にも胸が is interrupted by her teasing, which brakes his racing heart.
findings.explanation: An involuntary stirring of his chest becomes feeling ashamed.

contexts.japanese: 不覚にも胸が
contexts.english: feel ashamed

findings.description: The room’s occupant becomes the person in charge of the house.
findings.sourceReading: 部屋の主 refers to the adolescent whose room she entered.
findings.explanation: The room’s occupant becomes the person in charge of the house.

contexts.japanese: 部屋の主たる思春期の少年
contexts.english: adolescent young man who's in charge of this house.

findings.description: That is why I warned you becomes anyway, it is dangerous.
findings.sourceReading: He reuses his earlier dangerous warning as a strained excuse after hitting his head.
findings.explanation: That is why I warned you becomes anyway, it is dangerous.

contexts.japanese: だから、危ないって、言ったんだ
contexts.english: Anyway, it's dangerous.

findings.description: Limited Western-sweets competence becomes broader Western-food competence.
findings.sourceReading: 洋菓子 singles out sweets, with pancakes about the one thing he can manage.
findings.explanation: Limited Western-sweets competence becomes broader Western-food competence.

contexts.japanese: 洋菓子は……そうだな、ホットケーキぐらいなら、なんとか
contexts.english: As for Western food... I can manage pancakes and stuff.

findings.description: Skimming scum becomes blanching chicken.
findings.sourceReading: アク取り is removal of scum, not blanching as a cooking operation.
findings.explanation: Skimming scum becomes blanching chicken.

contexts.japanese: アク取りは済んだ
contexts.english: just finished blanching them.

findings.description: Timing and determination disappear into doing his best with what he has.
findings.sourceReading: タイミングと気合 explains how one-handed preparation is possible rather than calling it a learned special skill.
findings.explanation: Timing and determination disappear into doing his best with what he has.

contexts.japanese: これはタイミングと気合の問題
contexts.english: I'm just doing the best I can with what I got.

findings.description: Absentminded cooking becomes looking up at the sky.
findings.sourceReading: 上の空 means distracted, while familiar movements are automatic.
findings.explanation: Absentminded cooking becomes looking up at the sky.

contexts.japanese: 上の空でやってのける
contexts.english: so I start looking up at the sky.

findings.description: Illya’s own difficulty becomes difficulty for Shirou dealing with her.
findings.sourceReading: イリヤはイリヤで、やっぱり大変なんだ recognizes her separate predicament; he finds responding to that difficult.
findings.explanation: Illya’s own difficulty becomes difficulty for Shirou dealing with her.

contexts.japanese: イリヤはイリヤで、やっぱり大変なんだ
contexts.english: Illya is who she is, and this isn't easy for me.

findings.description: Belief it had not directly killed people becomes lack of a need to kill.
findings.sourceReading: 直接、人間を殺すなんて事はなかった筈だ concerns prior behavior as Shirou understood it.
findings.explanation: Belief it had not directly killed people becomes lack of a need to kill.

contexts.japanese: 直接、人間を殺すなんて事はなかった筈だ
contexts.english: It didn't need to murder them like this.

findings.description: The shadow being the greater priority becomes another equal concern.
findings.sourceReading: それ以上に explicitly ranks the shadow above Zouken in urgency.
findings.explanation: The shadow being the greater priority becomes another equal concern.

contexts.japanese: それ以上にあの影は放っておけない
contexts.english: we can't ignore the Shadow, either.

findings.description: A private wish formed since choosing Sakura’s side becomes the wish to choose her side.
findings.sourceReading: と決めた時から抱いた makes the earlier decision the onset of the private Grail wish, not the wish’s entire object.
findings.explanation: A private wish formed since choosing Sakura’s side becomes the wish to choose her side.

contexts.japanese: 桜の味方をすると決めた時から抱いた
contexts.english: my selfish desire to be on Sakura's side

findings.description: The current palm on his abdomen becomes the earlier palm on his chest, with added digging around.
findings.sourceReading: 腹に当てられた手 is current abdominal contact, already hard to bear; a small rodlike object passes through skin into his body.
findings.explanation: The current palm on his abdomen becomes the earlier palm on his chest, with added digging around.

contexts.japanese: 腹に当てられた遠坂の手の平だけでも耐えられない
contexts.english: Tohsaka's palm on my chest was unbearable enough, but now something small and stick-like is under my skin, digging around inside my body...!

findings.description: Fleeing revealing his own attraction becomes making Rin more self-conscious.
findings.sourceReading: Running away would make it look even more as though HE is conscious of Rin, leaving him no excuse.
findings.explanation: Fleeing revealing his own attraction becomes making Rin more self-conscious.

contexts.japanese: そんなコトをしたらますます遠坂を意識しているようで
contexts.english: it'll just make Tohsaka more self-conscious

findings.description: Her gaze painful to him becomes her looking hurt.
findings.sourceReading: 桜の視線が痛かった recalls the gaze that made him uncomfortable in6 and11; he now identifies her sulking as its reason.
findings.explanation: Her gaze painful to him becomes her looking hurt.

contexts.japanese: 桜の視線がさっきから痛かった
contexts.english: Sakura's been looking so hurt

findings.description: Illya's suggestion that Shirou should have cooked instead becomes a suggestion that he should help mediate while the sisters cook.
findings.sourceReading: Illya says Shirou could have cooked himself as the compromise instead of assigning Rin and Sakura together.
findings.explanation: Illya's suggestion that Shirou should have cooked instead becomes a suggestion that he should help mediate while the sisters cook.

contexts.japanese: 間をとるんだったらシロウが作ればよかった
contexts.english: shouldn't you be there to bridge the gap between them?

findings.description: A large serving dish becomes a pot.
findings.sourceReading: 大皿 is the shared serving platter in the table’s middle.
findings.explanation: A large serving dish becomes a pot.

contexts.japanese: 真ん中に盛り付けられた大皿
contexts.english: the pot in the middle of the table.

findings.description: Neither having room for serious discussion becomes Shirou not being in the mood.
findings.sourceReading: お互い……余裕なんてない concerns their mutual lack of room to discuss amid danger.
findings.explanation: Neither having room for serious discussion becomes Shirou not being in the mood.

contexts.japanese: お互い真剣に話し合う余裕なんてない
contexts.english: I'm not in the mood even for a serious talk

findings.description: Head pressed to tatami becomes head tucked into his stomach.
findings.sourceReading: 頭を畳に押し付けたまま maintains contact with the floor after the actual head impact in11.
findings.explanation: Head pressed to tatami becomes head tucked into his stomach.

contexts.japanese: 頭を畳に押し付けたまま
contexts.english: tuck my head into my stomach

findings.description: Awareness fragmenting becomes a mental ordeal.
findings.sourceReading: 意識がボロボロと欠けた describes disintegrating consciousness after only slight loosening and shoulder exposure.
findings.explanation: Awareness fragmenting becomes a mental ordeal.

contexts.japanese: 意識がボロボロと欠けた
contexts.english: was enough of mental ordeal.

findings.description: Forgetting how to look back one second becomes forgetting how he felt then.
findings.sourceReading: He cannot recall the METHOD of directing his thought one second backward, not merely the contents of a feeling.
findings.explanation: Forgetting how to look back one second becomes forgetting how he felt then.

contexts.japanese: 一秒前に思いを馳せる、という方法が思い出せなかった
contexts.english: I can't remember how I was feeling just a second ago.

findings.description: A head intrusively worked on by others becomes a head devoted to helping others.
findings.sourceReading: 人の手が入りまくった頭 describes his mind having other people’s intervention throughout, echoing invasive/cooking reconstruction imagery.
findings.explanation: A head intrusively worked on by others becomes a head devoted to helping others.

contexts.japanese: お節介なまでに人の手が入りまくった頭
contexts.english: My useless head, that only knows how to help other people so much it's a nuisance

findings.description: Paired left-arm distress and right-arm loss become the first being drowned out.
findings.sourceReading: The two sides are separately assigned pain/fear and pleasure/loss; 喪失 supplies depletion alongside sensation.
findings.explanation: Paired left-arm distress and right-arm loss become the first being drowned out.

contexts.japanese: 左手は苦痛と恐怖に、右手は快感と喪失に
contexts.english: the discomfort and fear of my left arm is drowned out by the pleasure in my right.

findings.description: The one person she wishes happy becomes the one person who wishes her happy.
findings.sourceReading: 彼女が幸せになってほしいと願う modifies the person whose happiness SHE wishes, whom she fears ruining for her own happiness.
findings.explanation: The one person she wishes happy becomes the one person who wishes her happy.

contexts.japanese: 彼女が幸せになってほしいと願うただ一人の人間
contexts.english: the one and only person who wants her to become happy.

findings.description: Not relaxing his guard becomes not forgiving.
findings.sourceReading: 気を許す concerns letting his vigilance/trust loosen toward Sakura’s tormentor.
findings.explanation: Not relaxing his guard becomes not forgiving.

contexts.japanese: 少しでも気を許すものか
contexts.english: I don't have an ounce of forgiveness

findings.description: Expecting him to have heard the previous ending becomes asking him about it.
findings.sourceReading: 聞いていよう presumes his knowledge before recounting the end.
findings.explanation: Expecting him to have heard the previous ending becomes asking him about it.

contexts.japanese: 十年前の聖杯戦争の終わりは聞いていよう
contexts.english: Let me ask you something about the end of the war ten years ago.

findings.description: His head cooling rapidly becomes his brain grinding to a halt.
findings.sourceReading: 冷めていく describes anger/heat cooling as the realization takes shape.
findings.explanation: His head cooling rapidly becomes his brain grinding to a halt.

contexts.japanese: 頭が急速に冷めていく
contexts.english: My brain grinds to a halt.

findings.description: A sarcastic glare becomes a suspicious glare.
findings.sourceReading: 皮肉をこめて identifies the ironic force of asking the allied controller to request defeating his own shadow.
findings.explanation: A sarcastic glare becomes a suspicious glare.

contexts.japanese: 皮肉をこめて臓硯を睨む
contexts.english: I shoot Zouken a suspicious glare.

findings.description: Must acknowledge responsibility reaches Sakura becomes cannot recognize the sins as anything.
findings.sourceReading: 認めなく、て、は is the broken delivery of must acknowledge, not a simple inability to acknowledge. The object is that guilt extends to Sakura whatever the shadow is.
findings.explanation: Must acknowledge responsibility reaches Sakura becomes cannot recognize the sins as anything.

contexts.japanese: その罪は、桜に及ぶのだと認めなく、て、は
contexts.english: I can't recognize its sins as...

findings.description: Candy-like contorting hallway becomes Shirou moving like molasses.
findings.sourceReading: 飴のようにぐにゃぐにゃに曲がりくねった modifies the perceived hallway.
findings.explanation: Candy-like contorting hallway becomes Shirou moving like molasses.

contexts.japanese: 飴のようにぐにゃぐにゃに曲がりくねった廊下
contexts.english: feeling like molasses oozing through the meandering hallways.

findings.description: Their discovering the meeting being bad for them becomes the meeting being unfair to them.
findings.sourceReading: それを知られるのは……良くはない specifically concerns the girls learning of it, explaining why he must return unnoticed.
findings.explanation: Their discovering the meeting being bad for them becomes the meeting being unfair to them.

contexts.japanese: それを知られるのは遠坂にも
contexts.english: It isn't fair to Tohsaka or the sleeping Sakura.

findings.description: What sustained Shirou becomes something he rejects, instead of something that now rejects him. The change alters the direction of his internal accusation.
findings.sourceReading: What has sustained him would turn against and negate him if he allowed the tragedy to recur.
findings.explanation: What sustained Shirou becomes something he rejects, instead of something that now rejects him. The change alters the direction of his internal accusation.

contexts.japanese: 今までおまえを支えてきたモノが、おまえ自身を否定する
contexts.english: you'd be rejecting everyone and everything that's supported you this far.

findings.description: Not killing the cause becomes not stopping the perpetrator.
findings.sourceReading: 原因を殺さない explicitly demands killing the cause, the lethal moral dilemma he is internalizing.
findings.explanation: Not killing the cause becomes not stopping the perpetrator.

contexts.japanese: その原因を殺さない
contexts.english: you don't stop the perpetrator

findings.description: A knife already taken from the kitchen is picked up from a kitchen counter now.
findings.sourceReading: 台所から持ち出した modifies the knife he takes in hand before leaving his own room.
findings.explanation: A knife already taken from the kitchen is picked up from a kitchen counter now.

contexts.japanese: 台所から持ち出したナイフを手にして、部屋を後にした
contexts.english: I pick up a knife from the kitchen counter and leave the room.

findings.description: Having no way to defeat the shadow directly becomes choosing the most direct method.
findings.sourceReading: 直接倒す手段がないのなら is a conditional lack of a direct means, leading to the obscured action against Sakura.
findings.explanation: Having no way to defeat the shadow directly becomes choosing the most direct method.

contexts.japanese: 直接、あの影を倒す手段がないのなら
contexts.english: The most direct way to defeat it

findings.description: People who failed to prevent the deaths become innocent victims unable to resist.
findings.sourceReading: それを防げなかった人間 includes the preventers whose failure also wounds them, contrasted with actual victims in the prior clause.
findings.explanation: People who failed to prevent the deaths become innocent victims unable to resist.

contexts.japanese: それを防げなかった人間も
contexts.english: Innocent people, unable to resist.

findings.description: An answer already fatally fixed becomes a conscious choice made with fatal conviction.
findings.sourceReading: 答えは決まっていた locates the settled answer from the earlier embrace; his inability to act has only now made him realize it.
findings.explanation: An answer already fatally fixed becomes a conscious choice made with fatal conviction.

contexts.japanese: 致命的なまでに、この答えは決まっていた
contexts.english: It was a choice I made with fatal conviction

findings.description: Leaving people to die becomes killing them directly.
findings.sourceReading: 見殺し identifies failure to save in his self-accusation.
findings.explanation: Leaving people to die becomes killing them directly.

contexts.japanese: 多くの人間を見殺しにした正義の味方
contexts.english: A "hero" who will kill many people tonight

findings.description: Saving from personal feelings becomes saving only for his satisfaction.
findings.sourceReading: 私情 contrasts with Kiritsugu discarding personal feelings; it does not specify gratification as the motive.
findings.explanation: Saving from personal feelings becomes saving only for his satisfaction.

contexts.japanese: 私情だけで誰かを助ける無力な人間
contexts.english: A powerless human who saves others only for his own satisfaction.

findings.description: The self standing still becomes a stopped self.
findings.sourceReading: 立ち止まる自分 means the present self hesitating/standing at the decision.
findings.explanation: The self standing still becomes a stopped self.

contexts.japanese: 立ち止まる自分の胸を打つ
contexts.english: hammer my stopped self in the chest.

findings.description: The Japanese names the victims' voices as something he could betray. The English asks only about betraying himself, although the following page still states his obligation to the dead.
findings.sourceReading: He asks whether he will betray both the dying people's voices and his former self struggling to survive alone.
findings.explanation: The Japanese names the victims' voices as something he could betray. The English asks only about betraying himself, although the following page still states his obligation to the dead.

contexts.japanese: 死んでいった人々の声を
contexts.english: Will I betray myself, who lived through the burning ruins, crying while everyone else died around me?

findings.description: Things he believed and upheld become everyone who helped him.
findings.sourceReading: 信じ、支えてきたモノ concerns what he has believed and supported, in the abandonment of his own prior self.
findings.explanation: Things he believed and upheld become everyone who helped him.

contexts.japanese: 今まで信じ、支えてきたモノをなくして
contexts.english: leaving everything I've believed in, everyone who's helped me.

findings.description: Her interruption while he withdraws the raised knife becomes while he leaves the room.
findings.sourceReading: ナイフを戻そうとした瞬間 locates her speech at the attempted safe return of the blade, before departure.
findings.explanation: Her interruption while he withdraws the raised knife becomes while he leaves the room.

contexts.japanese: ナイフを戻そうとした瞬間
contexts.english: Just as I try to leave the room...

findings.description: Continuing regret becomes always having regretted.
findings.sourceReading: ずっと後悔する promises enduring regret for past failure, contrasted with regretting the coming commitment.
findings.explanation: Continuing regret becomes always having regretted.

contexts.japanese: 桜を守れなかった今までのことを、ずっと後悔する
contexts.english: I've always regretted the fact that I couldn't protect you before.

findings.description: Repeating his promise as the only way to forgive becomes repeated forgiveness itself.
findings.sourceReading: そう繰り返す refers to the just-spoken promise to protect; this repetition is their present means of forgiving each other.
findings.explanation: Repeating his promise as the only way to forgive becomes repeated forgiveness itself.

contexts.japanese: 今はそう繰り返すしか、互いを許す術がなかった
contexts.english: All we can do is forgive each other, over and over.

findings.description: Single-minded purity becomes a simpler life.
findings.sourceReading: 純粋 praises the purity of dedicating oneself without calculating outcomes.
findings.explanation: Single-minded purity becomes a simpler life.

contexts.japanese: どんなに純粋な事なんだろう
contexts.english: Life would probably be a lot simpler

findings.description: Cannot promise and wanted nothing become no prior promises and Illya asking nothing.
findings.sourceReading: Both clauses continue Shirou: no promise he can make, no desired thing prompting the hug.
findings.explanation: Cannot promise and wanted nothing become no prior promises and Illya asking nothing.

contexts.japanese: 何も約束なんて出来ないし、何がほしかったワケでもない
contexts.english: I never made her any promises, nor did she ask for anything.

findings.description: Ordinarily achievable April wish becomes a categorical pledge to grant it repeatedly.
findings.sourceReading: 幾らでも叶えられる modifies the wish’s ordinary attainability in April; it is also his own wish.
findings.explanation: Ordinarily achievable April wish becomes a categorical pledge to grant it repeatedly.

contexts.japanese: 四月にさえなれば幾らでも叶えられる願い
contexts.english: Once April comes, I'll grant it as many times as it takes.

findings.description: Something he promised to protect becomes someone who protects her.
findings.sourceReading: 守ると言ってくれたモノ refers to what he has promised to protect, followed by its remaining shape even if dirty/cowardly.
findings.explanation: Something he promised to protect becomes someone who protects her.

contexts.japanese: 守ると言ってくれたモノがある
contexts.english: Even she has someone willing to protect her.

findings.description: Sensing his current intent becomes general knowledge of what a killer feels like.
findings.sourceReading: 自分を殺す為にやってきた事は空気でわかる identifies why this visitor came from the atmosphere.
findings.explanation: Sensing his current intent becomes general knowledge of what a killer feels like.

contexts.japanese: 自分を殺す為にやってきた事は空気でわかる
contexts.english: She knows what it feels like when someone comes to kill her.

findings.description: Empty murderous intent becomes empty bloodlust.
findings.sourceReading: 殺意 means intent to kill, not relish or lust for blood, explicitly hollow yet painful.
findings.explanation: Empty murderous intent becomes empty bloodlust.

contexts.japanese: その殺意は空っぽだった
contexts.english: it was an empty bloodlust.

findings.description: Her current and future sins become combining their sins.

findings.explanation: Her current and future sins become combining their sins.

findings.description: Why they ended this way becomes why she did it to him.

contexts.japanese: 間桐桜が衛宮士郎を敵と認識してしまえば

findings.explanation: Already too late becomes overdue.

contexts.japanese: もう手遅れだけど
contexts.english: It's overdue

findings.description: His mistaken reading of her question becomes her belief about his ability.

findings.explanation: His mistaken reading of her question becomes her belief about his ability.

contexts.japanese: てっきりアーチャーの腕を使えるかって話だと思った
contexts.english: Does she think I can use Archer's arm already...?

findings.description: His Projection exceeds ordinary level becomes his problem being more basic.

findings.explanation: His Projection exceeds ordinary level becomes his problem being more basic.

contexts.english: your problem is more basic than that.

findings.description: Strengthening an existing object by Projection becomes Strengthening a Projection.
findings.sourceReading: 元からあるものを is the object; 投影で is the means; 強化する the operation.
findings.explanation: Strengthening an existing object by Projection becomes Strengthening a Projection.

contexts.japanese: 元からあるものを“投影”で“強化”する
contexts.english: 'strengthen' a Projection of something that already exists.

findings.description: Poorly performing pupil becomes naughty pupil.
findings.sourceReading: 出来の悪い refers to his poor attainment/aptitude for instruction.
findings.explanation: Poorly performing pupil becomes naughty pupil.

contexts.english: a naughty student.

findings.description: No complaint if it can defeat Zouken becomes the only way to defeat him.
findings.sourceReading: 臓硯が倒せるなら文句はない is conditional agreement based on usefulness.
findings.explanation: No complaint if it can defeat Zouken becomes the only way to defeat him.

contexts.japanese: 臓硯が倒せるなら文句はない
contexts.english: it's the only way to defeat Zouken.

findings.description: Agreement if it helps becomes a promise to make it work.
findings.sourceReading: それでどうにかなるんなら conditions his assent on the plan offering a way forward.
findings.explanation: Agreement if it helps becomes a promise to make it work.

contexts.english: I'll make it work.

findings.explanation: Unexpected ease of assent becomes unexpected assent itself.

contexts.english: It was a needless warning, Shirou.

findings.explanation: Denial of yielding to happy atmosphere becomes avoiding spoiling the mood.

findings.explanation: Apparently roughness is okay gains with cooking.

contexts.english: It's okay to be a bit rough with cooking.

contexts.english: The story they're talking about should have happened a long time ago

contexts.english: because they can't come directly after us.

findings.description: Making Shirou do more becomes doing more to him.

contexts.english: to do even more things to him

findings.explanation: Predicted eventual cloth removal becomes repeated completed removal.

contexts.english: he's already been taking the shroud off, even though I haven't told him to.

contexts.english: he just ends up doing it anyway like it's no big deal.

findings.explanation: If failure is discovered becomes once failure is discovered.

contexts.english: Once you realize that your method can't defeat Grandfather

contexts.english: It's the obvious choice to make, since all it will cost is his life.

findings.description: Shirou has no right to speak becomes Rin has no right to order him.

contexts.english: nor do I have the right to order him around.

findings.explanation: Supporting his wish and borrowing reciprocally becomes wanting him to fight and borrowing.

findings.description: Now ingredients fragment becomes why we are talking about food.

findings.explanation: Now ingredients fragment becomes why we are talking about food.

contexts.japanese: いまから食材を
contexts.english: why are we talking about food

findings.description: White arm becomes white-hot pain.

findings.explanation: White arm becomes white-hot pain.

contexts.english: that white-hot pain in my arm

findings.description: Dizziness has subsided becomes dizziness is going away.

findings.explanation: Dizziness has subsided becomes dizziness is going away.

contexts.japanese: 目眩は治まってくれている
contexts.english: the dizziness is going away.

findings.explanation: Remembering the decision becomes claiming he only wanted to double-check.

contexts.japanese: ま、決まってるならハッキリしてていい。
contexts.english: I just wanted to double check.

findings.description: Stopping running to stay close becomes stopping and turning to him.

findings.explanation: Stopping running to stay close becomes stopping and turning to him.

contexts.japanese: イリヤは走るのを止めてピッタリとついて来た。
contexts.english: Illya stops and turns to me.

findings.description: Simple and gentle therefore lonely becomes simple and gentle yet lonely.

findings.explanation: Simple and gentle therefore lonely becomes simple and gentle yet lonely.

contexts.english: The tune is simple and gentle, yet lonely.

findings.description: Nothing remarkable becomes nothing else to say.

findings.explanation: Nothing remarkable becomes nothing else to say.

contexts.japanese: なんていうことはない。
contexts.english: There's nothing else to say.

findings.description: Calling to stop her becomes holding his breath.

contexts.english: I hold my breath.

contexts.japanese: イリヤはある事をずっと押し殺している。
contexts.english: she's become sullen at times.

findings.explanation: As we are now becomes only starting now.

contexts.english: even if we're only starting now?

findings.explanation: Either cook becomes both cooks.

findings.description: Sakura’s surprise at Rin’s surprise disappears.

findings.explanation: Sakura’s surprise at Rin’s surprise disappears.

contexts.japanese: 俺と桜が驚くぐらい
contexts.english: more surprise than I expected.

findings.explanation: Anxiety at inability becomes defeat at stopping.

contexts.japanese: 桜の喜びの前では、これっぽっちも気にならなかった。
contexts.english: It was hard to be negative in front of that much enthusiasm.

findings.description: Deep bow becomes quiet bow.

findings.explanation: Deep bow becomes quiet bow.

contexts.japanese: 深々とお辞儀をして
contexts.english: I make a quiet bow

findings.explanation: Expected shock becomes observed shock.

findings.description: Chopsticks dropping becomes food dropping.

findings.explanation: Chopsticks dropping becomes food dropping.

contexts.japanese: その度に箸は落ちて
contexts.english: only to drop it each time

findings.sourceReading: 桜には俺たちが見えていない makes Sakura the impaired perceiver, absorbed in her repeated effort.
findings.explanation: Sakura does not register observers becomes observers not seeing her.

contexts.japanese: 桜には俺たちが見えていない。
contexts.english: we don't see it.

contexts.japanese: ……見えていない。
contexts.english: We're not looking.

findings.description: Her repeated normality claim becomes his internal reassurance about dinner.
findings.sourceReading: 自分はいつも通りだ、と訴えるように follows Sakura as subject repeating gestures as if insisting she is normal.
findings.explanation: Her repeated normality claim becomes his internal reassurance about dinner.

contexts.japanese: 自分はいつも通りだ、と訴えるように
contexts.english: I tell myself it's just dinner as usual

findings.description: As in the preceding observed struggle becomes as she mentioned earlier.

findings.explanation: As in the preceding observed struggle becomes as she mentioned earlier.

contexts.japanese: さっきのように
contexts.english: as she mentioned earlier.

findings.explanation: Unfinished recovery reassurance becomes completed explanation judged nonsensical.

contexts.english: It doesn't make much sense, even to me.

contexts.english: I basically tell her that if she lies down and keeps her body from moving, she'll be able to move her fingers again.

findings.explanation: Denial of anything wrong becomes admission everything wrong.

findings.explanation: Claimed present normality becomes perfect past conduct.

contexts.english: I've never done anything to make you worry before

findings.description: Trying energetically becomes pride in finished work.
findings.sourceReading: 張り切る describes eagerness/exertion in trying to perform her role.
findings.explanation: Trying energetically becomes pride in finished work.

contexts.japanese: 張り切るのはいいけど
contexts.english: It's fine to be proud of your work

findings.description: Thinking herself healthy becomes wanting recovery.
findings.sourceReading: 元気なつもり acknowledges her belief she is well while Shirou asserts lingering fever.
findings.explanation: Thinking herself healthy becomes wanting recovery.

contexts.japanese: 桜は元気なつもりでも
contexts.english: I know you want to get better

findings.description: Knowing futility becomes possible futility.
findings.sourceReading: 無駄と判ってはいる states he knows the patrol is useless yet goes.
findings.explanation: Knowing futility becomes possible futility.

contexts.japanese: 無駄と判ってはいるが
contexts.english: even if it might be a waste of time.

findings.description: The prior oath’s superior priority disappears.
findings.sourceReading: その誓いより places his other protection oath above his pledge about uninvolved casualties; object slips from memory.
findings.explanation: The prior oath’s superior priority disappears.

contexts.japanese: その誓いより、何を守ると誓ったんだっけ
contexts.english: What exactly did I swear to protect again

findings.description: An intended three-day lesson becomes regret that it should have been three days.

findings.explanation: An intended three-day lesson becomes regret that it should have been three days.

contexts.japanese: 三日に分けて習得してもらう筈だった
contexts.english: I should have had you learn today's Projection over three days.

findings.description: Heartburn-like potential residue becomes actual chest ache.

findings.explanation: Heartburn-like potential residue becomes actual chest ache.

contexts.japanese: 胸焼けがしそうな魔力の残滓
contexts.english: magical energy that made my chest ache.

findings.description: Nauseating chest and near vomiting gain irritation.

findings.explanation: Nauseating chest and near vomiting gain irritation.

contexts.japanese: 胸がムカついて吐きそうだ。
contexts.english: I'm irritatingly nauseous.

findings.description: Asking whom it resembles becomes denying it resembles anyone.

contexts.english: It doesn't look like anyone.

findings.explanation: Because no proof intuition seems true becomes despite no proof it seems true.

contexts.english: I don't have any proof at all, but my mind tells me this hunch is true.

findings.description: Denial of depletion becomes explanation of being tired and literal disgust.

findings.explanation: Denial of depletion becomes explanation of being tired and literal disgust.

contexts.japanese: 体力がなくなったとかそういうんじゃない。

contexts.english: I was just feeling literally disgusted.

contexts.english: Before, I wouldn't have expected to find its muddy dregs on each and every house.

contexts.english: we have no reason to pursue it now.

findings.description: Trying not to hate the world becomes trying to save it.

findings.explanation: Trying not to hate the world becomes trying to save it.

contexts.japanese: この肉はな、健気にも世界を嫌おうとせぬ。
contexts.english: This meat nobly tries to save the world.

findings.sourceReading: 標的 rubyこのおれ names boy, preceding111–112 precise threatened temple/head.
findings.explanation: Stopped before target becomes stopped at neck.

contexts.japanese: 死の一撃は標的まで落とされない。
contexts.english: The executioner's axe stops short of my neck.

findings.description: How to stop becomes whether to stop.
findings.sourceReading: どう止めるべきか uncertainty about means, first line says emerged to stop him.
findings.explanation: How to stop becomes whether to stop.

contexts.japanese: どう止めるべきか一息だけ迷って
contexts.english: if she should stop him

findings.description: Estimated under ten seconds becomes stated interval.
findings.sourceReading: 十秒もなかったと思う explicitly qualified estimate.
findings.explanation: Estimated under ten seconds becomes stated interval.

contexts.japanese: 十秒もなかったと思う。
contexts.english: Less than ten seconds had passed.

findings.description: Not due to Heroic Spirit arm’s power becomes arm no longer Heroic Spirit’s.
findings.sourceReading: 英霊の腕の力などではない rejects merely crediting arm’s power; his own victory against death follows.
findings.explanation: Not due to Heroic Spirit arm’s power becomes arm no longer Heroic Spirit’s.

contexts.japanese: 英霊の腕の力などではない。
contexts.english: The arm is no longer a Heroic Spirit's arm.

findings.description: Electrical snake thrashing becomes coiling eel.
findings.sourceReading: Electric-made snakeはねまくる in every direction describes violent chaotic internal motion.
findings.explanation: Electrical snake thrashing becomes coiling eel.

contexts.japanese: 縦横無尽にはねまくっている。
contexts.english: An electric eel coils its way through my body.

findings.description: Restrain arm becomes put arm down.
findings.sourceReading: 押さえつける is holding down/restraining graft, alongside sitting/resting; first line cannotbindyet.
findings.explanation: Restrain arm becomes put arm down.

contexts.japanese: 左腕を押さえつけるのも
contexts.english: put down this arm

findings.description: Separating Sakura from Shadow becomes already escaping them.
findings.sourceReading: 桜と影を引き離すにしても is prospective rescue by separating them, Zouken interferes.
findings.explanation: Separating Sakura from Shadow becomes already escaping them.

contexts.japanese: 桜とあの影を引き離すにしても
contexts.english: We might have gotten away from Sakura and the Shadow

findings.description: Cannot maintain awareness becomes would already have lost mind.
findings.sourceReading: 意識を保っていられなくなっている says without current pain cannot sustain consciousness, lapsing records17–18.
findings.explanation: Cannot maintain awareness becomes would already have lost mind.

contexts.japanese: 今みたいに痛みがなければ、意識を保っていられなくなっている
contexts.english: If not for this pain, I'd have lost my mind by now.

findings.description: Cannot expect cooperation becomes does not want help.
findings.sourceReading: 協力は望めない impossibility of hoping for cooperation, usual stance restored after rescue.
findings.explanation: Cannot expect cooperation becomes does not want help.

contexts.japanese: どのみち協力は望めないが
contexts.english: I don't want his help

findings.description: Before entering forest becomes after leaving forest.
findings.sourceReading: 森に行く前 prior rescue expedition visit desired.
findings.explanation: Before entering forest becomes after leaving forest.

contexts.japanese: 森に行く前にわたしの家に寄っていってほしかった
contexts.english: stopped by my house after you left the forest.

findings.description: Defiant direct gaze becomes making up mind.
findings.sourceReading: 挑むように俺と遠坂を正視 explicit looks both squarely as challenge.
findings.explanation: Defiant direct gaze becomes making up mind.

contexts.japanese: 挑むように俺と遠坂を正視する。
contexts.english: seems to make up her mind about something.

findings.description: Final Masters status grammatically attaches to speaking I.
findings.sourceReading: シロウとリンには最後のマスターとして addressed as last Masters, she presents facts.
findings.explanation: Final Masters status grammatically attaches to speaking I.

contexts.japanese: シロウとリンには聖杯戦争に関わった最後のマスターとして
contexts.english: As the final Masters in this Holy Grail War, I'll let you hear the facts.

findings.description: Fewer than four becomes exactly four.
findings.sourceReading: 四人足らず fewer than four users reported.
findings.explanation: Fewer than four becomes exactly four.

contexts.japanese: 四人足らずしかいないと聞く。
contexts.english: only four people who can use them.

findings.description: Command be evil becomes judgment he was evil.
findings.sourceReading: 魔であれと定めた socialmandate constitutedrole.
findings.explanation: Command be evil becomes judgment he was evil.

contexts.japanese: 周りの人間がそいつに魔であれと定めたのだ。
contexts.english: the people around him decided that he was evil anyway.

findings.description: Painful right hand becomes right arm.
findings.sourceReading: 右手 is the right hand supporting painful awareness here.
findings.explanation: Painful right hand becomes right arm.

contexts.japanese: ジクジクと右手が痛む。
contexts.english: My right arm throbs in pain.

findings.description: Command not to lose heart becomes report of feeling unwell.
findings.sourceReading: 弱気になるな is self-directed resistance to discouragement.
findings.explanation: Command not to lose heart becomes report of feeling unwell.

contexts.japanese: ……弱気になるな。
contexts.english: ...I don't feel so good.

findings.description: Creeping killing intent becomes Rider physically moving closer.
findings.sourceReading: 忍び寄ってくる modifies the sensed murderous intent, not Rider’s bodily movement.
findings.explanation: Creeping killing intent becomes Rider physically moving closer.

contexts.japanese: ……ぞわり、と忍び寄ってくる殺気。
contexts.english: She inches closer, her murderous intent clear.

findings.description: Backward leap into yard becomes running.
findings.sourceReading: 庭に跳び退く continues the specified backward leap used to escape the faster pursuer.
findings.explanation: Backward leap into yard becomes running.

contexts.japanese: かすかに興奮しながら庭に跳び退く。
contexts.english: I feel a little excited as I run into the yard.

findings.description: No expectation Rider will return becomes bloodlust will never return.
findings.sourceReading: 戻ってくる予感もなかった refers to Rider’s anticipated return after her presence recedes.
findings.explanation: No expectation Rider will return becomes bloodlust will never return.

contexts.japanese: 殺気はもう届かず、戻ってくる予感もなかった。
contexts.english: Her bloodlust is gone, and it doesn't seem like it'll ever return.

findings.description: Cannot get past Rider becomes cannot allow her to act.
findings.sourceReading: 俺ではライダーをやり過ごせない states his inability to overcome or evade this obstacle with his current means.
findings.explanation: Cannot get past Rider becomes cannot allow her to act.

contexts.japanese: 俺ではライダーをやり過ごせない。
contexts.english: I can't let Rider do this.

findings.description: Rider’s anticipated nonreturn becomes permanent bloodlust nonreturn.
findings.sourceReading: No intuition of her coming back after sensed withdrawal.
findings.explanation: Rider’s anticipated nonreturn becomes permanent bloodlust nonreturn.

contexts.japanese: 殺気はもう届かず、戻ってくる予感もなかった。
contexts.english: Her bloodlust is gone, and it doesn't seem like it'll ever return.

findings.description: Possible future help becomes missed past opportunity.
findings.sourceReading: きっかけさえあれば彼女も力を貸してくれるかもしれない leaves future cooperation possible if an opening arises, conditional on his interpretation being right.
findings.explanation: Possible future help becomes missed past opportunity.

contexts.japanese: それが俺の思い違いでなければ、きっかけさえあれば彼女も力を貸してくれるかもしれない—
contexts.english: Unless I'm imagining it, she might have offered to help me if I'd given her a chance...

findings.description: Earlier question remembered becomes foreknowledge of a future question.
findings.sourceReading: いつか、彼女に問われた事がある says she asked him something at a prior time; next lines struggle to recall what.
findings.explanation: Earlier question remembered becomes foreknowledge of a future question.

contexts.japanese: いつか、彼女に問われた事がある。
contexts.english: I knew this question was coming eventually.

findings.description: Explicit fight against Sakura loses its target.
findings.sourceReading: 桜を取り戻す為に桜と戦う explicitly combines fighting Sakura with recovering her.
findings.explanation: Explicit fight against Sakura loses its target.

contexts.japanese: ……俺は桜を取り戻す為に桜と戦う。おまえがその邪魔をするなら、全力で排除するだけだ」
contexts.english: ...I'll fight to bring Sakura back. If you're going to stop me, then I'll do everything I can to eliminate you."

findings.description: Fighting Sakura to recover her loses the opponent.
findings.sourceReading: 桜を取り戻す為に桜と戦う explicitly combines fighting against Sakura with recovering her.
findings.explanation: Fighting Sakura to recover her loses the opponent.

contexts.japanese: ……俺は桜を取り戻す為に桜と戦う。おまえがその邪魔をするなら、全力で排除するだけだ」
contexts.english: ...I'll fight to bring Sakura back. If you're going to stop me, then I'll do everything I can to eliminate you."

findings.description: Cloth-wrapped sword held at side becomes kept on waist.
findings.sourceReading: 脇に抱える is holding the wrapped Azoth sword under or beside the arm.
findings.explanation: Cloth-wrapped sword held at side becomes kept on waist.

contexts.japanese: アゾット剣を布で覆い、脇に抱える。
contexts.english: I wrap up the Azoth Blade and keep it on my waist.

findings.description: Barely fitting opening becomes finally discovering one.
findings.sourceReading: 人間一人がようやく入れる程度 describes a gap barely large enough for one person.
findings.explanation: Barely fitting opening becomes finally discovering one.

contexts.japanese: 流れの源では幾つもの岩が折り重なり、人間一人がようやく入れる程度の隙間がある。
contexts.english: It's flowing from several piles of rocks, and we finally come across an opening that one person can fit through.

findings.description: Visible hypothetical obstruction becomes enacted near collision.
findings.sourceReading: At a glance one can tell entering would immediately meet rock, so an ordinary person would not even try.
findings.explanation: Visible hypothetical obstruction becomes enacted near collision.

contexts.japanese: 中に入ったところですぐに岩にぶつかると一目で判り、まっとうな人間なら入ろうとすら思わない。
contexts.english: When I go inside, I nearly run into a big stone, and it doesn't look big enough to fit a person.

findings.description: Why make the sword for Rin becomes how it was made.
findings.sourceReading: なんで作ってくれたの asks motive for making it for her; she then explains her intent to kill Sakura.
findings.explanation: Why make the sword for Rin becomes how it was made.

contexts.japanese: 「宝石剣。なんで作ってくれたの」
contexts.english: "The Jeweled Sword. How did you make it?"

contexts.japanese: 「なんでって、なんでさ」
contexts.english: "How? Why are you asking?"

findings.description: Saber’s absolute killing intent is omitted.
findings.sourceReading: She waits wrapped in 絶対の殺気.
findings.explanation: Saber’s absolute killing intent is omitted.

contexts.japanese: 絶対の殺気を纏って、セイバーが待っていた。
contexts.english: stands Saber, waiting for us.

findings.description: Rin holding Sakura off becomes settling the score.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou reads her encouragement as come while she can keep Sakura stopped or contained.
findings.explanation: Rin holding Sakura off becomes settling the score.

contexts.japanese: 要するにあいつは、自分が桜を止めておけるうちに来いと、遠まわしに応援してくれたのだ。
contexts.english: In other words, telling me to come before she settles the score with Sakura was her roundabout way of cheering me on.

findings.description: Not beginning as sword-skill contest becomes no such contest at all.
findings.sourceReading: He must first find an opening; the fight does not start from straightforward competition of sword skill.
findings.explanation: Not beginning as sword-skill contest becomes no such contest at all.

contexts.japanese: ……この戦いは、剣技を競うところからなど始まらない。
contexts.english: ...This battle isn't a contest of sword skills at all.

findings.description: Shirou’s compulsion to reach Sakura becomes Saber refusing access.
findings.sourceReading: 貴方は桜の下に行くしかない explains why he cannot wait indefinitely and must attack.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s compulsion to reach Sakura becomes Saber refusing access.

contexts.japanese: ですが、それもじき終わる。貴方は桜の下に行くしかない。私が動くまでもなく、貴方の方が耐えられずに仕掛けてくる」
contexts.english: But it will end there. I will not let you go to Sakura. I don't need to move. You will run out of patience and attack me."

findings.description: Whose surprise is unresolved becomes Saber’s surprise.
findings.sourceReading: どちら asks which of the two owns the astonishment.
findings.explanation: Whose surprise is unresolved becomes Saber’s surprise.

contexts.japanese: 驚きはどちらのものか。
contexts.english: What is she surprised at?

contexts.japanese: 衛宮士郎では放てぬ一撃、衛宮士郎では防げぬ一撃は如何なる奇跡か。
contexts.english: Does she find it miraculous that Shirou Emiya unleashed an attack he should not have been capable of, and blocked a counter-strike that he shouldn't have been able to block?

findings.description: Shirou’s defensive struggle becomes Saber under his assault.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou is wholly on defense; only his opening attack was allowed, after which he keeps blocking Saber.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s defensive struggle becomes Saber under his assault.

contexts.japanese: 防戦一方。
contexts.english: I have her on the defense.

contexts.japanese: 攻め手が許されたのは初撃のみ、後はひたすらセイバーの剣を防ぐだけ。
contexts.english: I only allowed her to attack during the first exchange, and now Saber can only defend against my assault.

findings.description: Deliberate backward jump becomes planting feet.
findings.sourceReading: After being strongly knocked back, he jumps farther back to reset the exchange.
findings.explanation: Deliberate backward jump becomes planting feet.

contexts.japanese: セイバーの一撃に大きく弾かれた俺は、仕切り直す為に背後に跳んだ。
contexts.english: Saber's attack hurls me backward, and I have to plant my feet behind me to regain my footing.

findings.description: Against Sakura alone conditional becomes Sakura is alone.
findings.sourceReading: 逆に桜一人なら gives the conditional contrast: if Rin only faces Sakura.
findings.explanation: Against Sakura alone conditional becomes Sakura is alone.

contexts.japanese: けど、逆に—桜一人なら、遠坂は必ず—
contexts.english: But Sakura's alone, Tohsaka will definitely...

findings.description: Separate lives or fates become sharing a life in sword verse.
findings.sourceReading: 別命 and later 命ヲ別ツ retain separation or parting of life/fate in the two-hero line.
findings.explanation: Separate lives or fates become sharing a life in sword verse.

contexts.japanese: 両雄倶別命
contexts.english: Let Two Great Men Share a Life

contexts.japanese: —両雄、共ニ命ヲ別ツ……！
contexts.english: Neither of us will embrace Heaven. (Let two great men share a life.)

findings.description: Enemy closes on weaponless Shirou becomes Shirou closing.
findings.sourceReading: 敵が間合いを詰めてくる after he throws away the weapons.
findings.explanation: Enemy closes on weaponless Shirou becomes Shirou closing.

contexts.japanese: 唯一の武器を手放したオレに、敵が間合いを詰めてくる。
contexts.english: I close in on the enemy, having thrown my only weapons.

findings.description: One rear ambush becomes multiple in the first simultaneous defense.
findings.sourceReading: At this stage the original thrown Kanshou returns from behind while frontal Bakuya is broken; the second rear Bakuya arrives on135.
findings.explanation: One rear ambush becomes multiple in the first simultaneous defense.

contexts.japanese: 背後からの奇襲と、全力で放った一撃を同時に敵は防いだ。
contexts.english: She just blocked ambushes from behind and a full-power frontal attack, all at the same time.

findings.description: Enemy has no further movement becomes boy has nothing else.
findings.sourceReading: Paragraph explains the enemy’s limit and exposed state: she has nothing beyond that defense at this instant.
findings.explanation: Enemy has no further movement becomes boy has nothing else.

contexts.japanese: つまり、その先はない。
contexts.english: I have nothing else.

findings.description: Not sharing one heaven becomes neither person embracing Heaven.
findings.sourceReading: Ruby われら、ともにてんをいだかず invokes mutual noncoexistence under one heaven, alongside the separating-lives base line.
findings.explanation: Not sharing one heaven becomes neither person embracing Heaven.

contexts.japanese: —両雄、共ニ命ヲ別ツ……！
contexts.english: Neither of us will embrace Heaven. (Let two great men share a life.)

findings.description: Those staying at limit versus going beyond become one man’s progression.
findings.sourceReading: 限界に留まったものと、その先に行ったもの contrasts two conditions or parties, naturally Saber versus Shirou in this ending.
findings.explanation: Those staying at limit versus going beyond become one man’s progression.

contexts.japanese: ……限界に留まったものと、その先に行ったもの。
contexts.english: ...He reached his limits, and stepped beyond them.

findings.description: Cannot remain uninjured becomes cannot avoid being flanked.
findings.sourceReading: 無傷では済まされない says even a great warrior cannot escape the two powerful simultaneous attacks unscathed.
findings.explanation: Cannot remain uninjured becomes cannot avoid being flanked.

contexts.japanese: 鉄塊をも撃ち砕く宝具の一刀を左右同時に見舞われては、いかな豪傑であろうと無傷では済まされない。
contexts.english: Even the greatest swordsman can't escape being flanked on both sides by steel-shattering Noble Phantasms.

findings.description: Losing the arm becomes its being different.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou recalls having lost this arm during the previous forest encounter.
findings.explanation: Losing the arm becomes its being different.

contexts.japanese: 俺はあの時、この腕を失った。
contexts.english: It's completely different since the last time I was here.

findings.description: Bringing Sakura to the Emiya home becomes restoring her former identity.
findings.sourceReading: He wonders how to bring Sakura back to the Emiya house.
findings.explanation: Bringing Sakura to the Emiya home becomes restoring her former identity.

contexts.japanese: 俺はどうやって桜を、衛宮の家まで連れ帰るのか。
contexts.english: How can I turn her back into the Sakura I used to know?

findings.description: Power to oppose Sakura becomes Sakura possessing power.
findings.sourceReading: The head noun is the power needed to confront Sakura, who possessed extraordinary mana.
findings.explanation: Power to oppose Sakura becomes Sakura possessing power.

contexts.japanese: あの、とんでもない魔力を誇っていた桜に対抗する力。
contexts.english: Um, Sakura has an incredible amount of magical energy.

contexts.japanese: 「今回は諦めろ。イリヤスフィールをこちらで保護すれば、まだ猶予は出来る。間桐桜と話がしたいのなら、彼女に対抗できる力を用意してからだ」
contexts.english: "Give up on her this time. If we can secure Illyasviel, it will buy us more time. If you want to speak to Sakura Matou, do so once you have a way to resist her."

contexts.japanese: ……そんなもの、用意できるとしたら遠坂だけだ。
contexts.english: ...The only one who might be able to do that is Tohsaka.

findings.description: The accusation against Kotomine changes from exploiting Sakura to deceiving her, and the thing's unknown nature becomes Sakura's ignorance. This belongs with Kotomine and Sakura rather than serving as proof of Zouken's methods.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou accuses Kotomine of using Sakura to create something uncanny or unidentified and then appropriating it.
findings.explanation: The accusation against Kotomine changes from exploiting Sakura to deceiving her, and the thing's unknown nature becomes Sakura's ignorance. This belongs with Kotomine and Sakura rather than serving as proof of Zouken's methods.

contexts.japanese: 「……ふざけんな。アンタも臓硯と同じだ。桜を利用して得体の知れないモノを作って、それを自分のものにしようとしているじゃないか」
contexts.english: "Yeah, sure. You're just like him. You're trying to trick Sakura into making something she doesn't understand so you can take it for yourself."

findings.description: Known death becomes the possibility of death.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou challenges Kirei for knowing that he too will be killed yet wanting Sakura changed into that being.
findings.explanation: Known death becomes the possibility of death.

contexts.japanese: そこまで判っていて、自分だって殺されるって判っていて、桜をそんなものにしたいのか……！」
contexts.english: You know all that, including the possibility that you might be killed, and you still want Sakura to go through with it!?"

findings.description: Suggested address from Sakura's look becomes audible speech.
findings.sourceReading: The eyes turn toward Shirou with the vulnerable suggestion Senpai; the surrounding quotation brackets remain silence and the first actual utterance follows on6.
findings.explanation: Suggested address from Sakura's look becomes audible speech.

contexts.japanese: 先輩、と。
contexts.english: "Senpai," it says.

contexts.japanese: その瞳が、確かに俺に向けられた。
contexts.english: Its eyes are definitely looking at me.

findings.description: Rin's declared killing intention is assigned to both her and Shirou.
findings.sourceReading: Rin says she will go and assuredly kill Sakura; Shirou has just rejected abandonment and mutual self-destruction and later explicitly calls his intention the opposite of Rin's.
findings.explanation: Rin's declared killing intention is assigned to both her and Shirou.

contexts.japanese: 「行くわ。行って、確実にアンタを殺す」
contexts.english: "We're going over there. We're coming to kill you."

contexts.japanese: 「ああ、遠坂の逆だよ。俺は桜を助ける事で戦いを終わらせる。俺は、桜にとっての正義の味方になるって決めたからな」
contexts.english: "Yeah, I'm the opposite of you. I'm going to save Sakura and end this war. I promised that I'd be her hero."

findings.description: Shirou trusting Rin becomes Rin trusting Shirou.
findings.sourceReading: After thinking that Rin nevertheless wants to save Sakura, the narrator concludes that he can entrust the task to her with confidence.
findings.explanation: Shirou trusting Rin becomes Rin trusting Shirou.

contexts.japanese: なら—安心して任せられる。
contexts.english: And she feels comfortable trusting me to do it.

contexts.japanese: それでも、なんだかんだと遠坂は、桜を助けたがっている。
contexts.english: But Tohsaka still wants to help Sakura.

findings.description: Shirou's two permitted Projection sources become Archer's habits.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou says he can Project only what he personally saw or weapons Archer has previously made; a blueprint and imitated dagger alone are insufficient.
findings.explanation: Shirou's two permitted Projection sources become Archer's habits.

contexts.japanese: 「けどイリヤ。俺は自分で見たものか、アーチャーが作った事のある武器しか投影できない。宝石剣とやらの情報は皆無だ。いくら宝石剣に真似た短剣と元になる設計図があっても、宝石剣は複製できないぞ」
contexts.english: "But Illya, from what I've seen, Archer only Projects specific weapons. I don't have any information about the Jeweled Sword. Even if I have blueprints and a similar example, I can't replicate it."

contexts.japanese: 「分かってるわ。シロウにはまず、わたしの記録に入ってもらう。わたしだって見た事はないけど、わたしの中には宝石剣の記録があるわ。
contexts.english: "I know. I'm going to have you search the records inside me. I haven't personally seen it, but there's a record of the Jeweled Sword inside my mind.

findings.description: Damage beyond the concept of pain becomes mismatched bodily pain perception.
findings.sourceReading: Boy falls into layered revolving pain while self-damage eats him, damage to which even recognition as pain no longer applies.
findings.explanation: Damage beyond the concept of pain becomes mismatched bodily pain perception.

contexts.japanese: 痛みのない、痛みという認識はもはや該当しない自己の損傷に蝕まれながら、何重にも回転する痛みの中に落ちていく。
contexts.english: There's no pain. My pain perception plunges into layers of spinning pain, but it's eroded by damage to my body which doesn't correspond to the pain.

findings.description: The circuit's resemblance to a huge rotating observatory becomes a view of Arizona through a telescope, changing the image used to describe the ritual structure.
findings.sourceReading: The enormous circuit resembles an enormous observation apparatus rotating alone in the Arizona wilderness.
findings.explanation: The circuit's resemblance to a huge rotating observatory becomes a view of Arizona through a telescope, changing the image used to describe the ritual structure.

contexts.japanese: アリゾナの荒野に独りきりで回る、大きな大きな観測装置に酷似している。
contexts.english: It's like I'm looking out across the landscape of Arizona through a huge telescope.

findings.description: Diverting attention to extraneous matters becomes cutting attention away from them.
findings.sourceReading: He gave part of his attention to unnecessary things; because attention was divided, his perceived body halved.
findings.explanation: Diverting attention to extraneous matters becomes cutting attention away from them.

contexts.japanese: 余分な事に意識を割いた。意識を割いたから、体が半分になった。
contexts.english: I cut my consciousness off from the excess. Because I cut my mind, my body becomes half its size.

findings.description: Need to use another Projection becomes should not try.
findings.sourceReading: Boy corrects can manage another to must use it, to save Sakura by a method different from Rin's.
findings.explanation: Need to use another Projection becomes should not try.

contexts.japanese: —いや、使わなくてはいけない。
contexts.english: Not that I should try.

contexts.japanese: これなら、あと一回ぐらいはなんとか投影が使える。
contexts.english: I should be able to manage one more Projection.

contexts.japanese: 遠坂とは違う方法で桜を救う。
contexts.english: I'm going to save Sakura using a different way than Tohsaka.

findings.description: Involuntary consciousness interruption becomes deliberate disconnection.
findings.sourceReading: Consciousness breaks, and before he knows it Rin has taken his bloody hand despite seeming slow.
findings.explanation: Involuntary consciousness interruption becomes deliberate disconnection.

contexts.japanese: 意識が断線して、いつのまにか血塗れの右手を掴まれていた。
contexts.english: I disconnect my mind and realize that she's holding my bloody right hand.

findings.description: Unassuming accessory becomes everyday sight.
findings.sourceReading: Pendant is small or modest for a jewel-user like Rin and can accent her beauty.
findings.explanation: Unassuming accessory becomes everyday sight.

contexts.japanese: 宝石使いである遠坂にはこじんまりとした物だが、遠坂は美人なんだから、こういう小物の方が本人を引き立たせていいと思う。
contexts.english: To a jewel-user like Tohsaka, this is probably an everyday sight. But she's so pretty, I bet an accessory like this would really liven her up.

findings.description: Negligible remaining amount becomes below every use threshold.
findings.sourceReading: Boy's pendant retains a little insignificant mana, and its having been used is meaningful.
findings.explanation: Negligible remaining amount becomes below every use threshold.

contexts.japanese: 「違うわ。わたしのは空っぽだけど、士郎のは少しだけ残ってる。取るに足りない量だけど、それでも、使われたからには意味があるんだわ」
contexts.english: "No, they're not. Mine's empty, but yours still has a little left in it. It isn't enough to use for anything, but... It has meaning because it was used."

findings.description: Arm-side carrying becomes on waist in separate departure variant.
findings.sourceReading: He wraps Azoth in cloth and carries it under or beside his arm.
findings.explanation: Arm-side carrying becomes on waist in separate departure variant.

contexts.japanese: アゾット剣を布で覆い、脇に抱える。
contexts.english: I wrap up the Azoth Blade and keep it on my waist.

findings.description: Around dawn becomes before dawn.
findings.sourceReading: Illya asks him to return with Sakura and Rin around when night gives way to dawn.
findings.explanation: Around dawn becomes before dawn.

contexts.japanese: 「いってらっしゃいシロウ。夜が明ける頃に、サクラとリンと三人で帰ってきてね」
contexts.english: "Good luck, Shirou. Come home with Sakura and Rin before dawn, okay?"

findings.description: Oversleeping becomes simply falling asleep.
findings.sourceReading: He remembers sometimes being woken when he overslept in the storehouse.
findings.explanation: Oversleeping becomes simply falling asleep.

contexts.japanese: 寝坊した時、たまに起こされるコトもあった。
contexts.english: When I fell asleep here, sometimes she would come to wake me up.

findings.description: Prepare a trump card before departure becomes save trump card for battle.
findings.sourceReading: Repeated guidance is to prepare the trump card before heading to final battle, then asks why the player failed to do their best.
findings.explanation: Prepare a trump card before departure becomes save trump card for battle.

contexts.japanese: その通り！　最終決戦に向かう時は『切り札』を用意してから行けと、毎回毎回言っているのに何故ベストをつくさないのか！
contexts.english: Exactly! They've told you over and over to save your trump card for the final battle, so why aren't you bringing your best to this fight!?

findings.description: Only one available Servant loses uniqueness.
findings.sourceReading: In this situation exactly one Servant plausibly can join, as hint to required partner.
findings.explanation: Only one available Servant loses uniqueness.

contexts.japanese: この状況において、一人だけ仲間になってくれそうなサーヴァントがいる筈である！
contexts.english: There should be a Servant willing to help you out!

findings.description: Offense preventing Saber attack becomes Saber stopping Rider with attacks.
findings.sourceReading: Rider keeps attacking in order to prevent Saber taking initiative; if Saber attacks both Rider and boy die immediately.
findings.explanation: Offense preventing Saber attack becomes Saber stopping Rider with attacks.

contexts.japanese: ライダーは攻め続ける事で、セイバーの攻撃を防いでいる。
contexts.english: Rider keeps attacking, while Saber stops her with attacks of her own.

contexts.japanese: セイバーが攻撃に転ずれば、自分はおろか主である少年まで瞬殺されるだろう。
contexts.english: Rider knows that she and the boy she calls Master will be killed instantly if Saber goes on the offense.

findings.description: Dying throughout body becomes every part already dead.
findings.sourceReading: At this moment portions throughout his body are dying, in ongoing erasure.
findings.explanation: Dying throughout body becomes every part already dead.

contexts.japanese: いや、この瞬間、体のいたるところが死んでいる。
contexts.english: No, in this moment, every part of my body is dead.

findings.description: Boy cannot complain becomes Rider is not whining.
findings.sourceReading: Because Rider fights desperately for him, boy says he cannot offer complaints and must fight by his own means.
findings.explanation: Boy cannot complain becomes Rider is not whining.

contexts.japanese: 泣き言はいえない。
contexts.english: She isn't whining.

contexts.japanese: ライダーは決死で戦ってくれている。
contexts.english: Rider is fighting for her life.

contexts.japanese: 俺は　　俺も　　自分にできる事で、たたか、
contexts.english: I     I too    need to do what I can, I can figh—

findings.description: Right lung cut open becomes torn out.
findings.sourceReading: Right lung is cut or torn open from within.
findings.explanation: Right lung cut open becomes torn out.

contexts.japanese: 右の肺が、内側から切り裂かれた。
contexts.english: My right lung is torn out from inside.

findings.description: Potential centimeters to heart become enacted thrust depth.
findings.sourceReading: Blade at his back needs only a further push of a few centimeters to pierce heart.
findings.explanation: Potential centimeters to heart become enacted thrust depth.

contexts.japanese: わずか数センチ、一押しするだけで心臓を穿つ、冷酷な死の重み。
contexts.english: The cold weight of death pushes in only a few centimeters, stopping just short of my heart.

findings.description: Unknown perception becomes unknown knowledge.
findings.sourceReading: Stripped of objective/subjective orientation, he is ruled by unfamiliar perception.
findings.explanation: Unknown perception becomes unknown knowledge.

contexts.japanese: 客観と主観を剥ぎ取られ、未知の知覚に支配される。
contexts.english: The objective and subjective are stripped away. Unknown knowledge dominates me.

findings.description: Not actually generated from nothing becomes no longer from nothing.
findings.sourceReading: Apparent ex-nihilo manifestation is explained instead as multiple similarities becoming apparent through expansion.
findings.explanation: Not actually generated from nothing becomes no longer from nothing.

contexts.japanese: 空想は混濁と化しながら法則を持ち、無より生じるソレは無より生じたのではなく拡大する事で浮かび上がる多くの類似。
contexts.english: Fantasy becomes chaos with laws. That which came from nothingness no longer comes from nothingness, and many similarities arise through its expansion.

findings.description: Saber's involuntary staggering becomes a planted stance. The resulting opening for Rider remains, but its physical cause changes.
findings.sourceReading: Saber staggers after deflecting the sword and cannot pursue Rider, creating the two-second opening.
findings.explanation: Saber's involuntary staggering becomes a planted stance. The resulting opening for Rider remains, but its physical cause changes.

contexts.japanese: 放たれた螺旋の剣を弾いたセイバーは、ライダーを追えずにたたらを踏んでいる。
contexts.english: Saber repels my loosed spiral sword and plants her feet instead of pursuing Rider.

findings.description: Petals shattered by black light become petals scattering black light.
findings.sourceReading: Four wings/petals have been shattered by black aurora and scatter as the chamber fills white.
findings.explanation: Petals shattered by black light become petals scattering black light.

contexts.japanese: 黒い極光に打ち砕かれた四枚羽を撒き散らしながら、
contexts.english: Four petals scatter the black light,

findings.description: Broken shield petals become black-light-scattering petals in other branch.
findings.sourceReading: Four petals broken by black aurora scatter before white light wins.
findings.explanation: Broken shield petals become black-light-scattering petals in other branch.

contexts.japanese: 黒い極光に打ち砕かれた四枚羽を撒き散らしながら、
contexts.english: Four petals scatter the black light,

findings.description: Only eight days becomes fewer than eight days.
findings.sourceReading: まだ八日しか is only eight elapsed days; the next self-correction says already eight.
findings.explanation: Only eight days becomes fewer than eight days.

contexts.japanese: 彼女を失ったあの夜から、まだ八日しか経っていない。
contexts.english: Less than eight days have passed since the night I lost her.

contexts.japanese: ……いや、もう八日と言うべきか。
contexts.english: ...No, I guess it's already been that long.

findings.description: Apparent pity becomes apparent disappointment.
findings.sourceReading: He perceives Sakura as pitying him for not even understanding that.
findings.explanation: Apparent pity becomes apparent disappointment.

contexts.japanese: 桜は、まるで—そんな事も判らないのか、と哀れんでいるようだ。
contexts.english: It's as if she's disappointed that I don't know.

findings.description: Instruction to go and hold Rin's hand becomes Sakura's placement and permission.
findings.sourceReading: After reporting Rin's repeated pleas, Sakura tells Shirou to go beside her and hold her hand.
findings.explanation: Instruction to go and hold Rin's hand becomes Sakura's placement and permission.

contexts.japanese: 「姉さんったら、さっきから先輩に助けを求めてばっかりなんだもの。すぐ傍にいって、手でも握ってあげてくださいね」
contexts.english: "Silly Nee-san. She started begging you for help. I'll put you right next to her, where you can even hold hands."

findings.description: Irrecoverable body and another day of meaningful self become sluggishness and a worthwhile current day.
findings.sourceReading: Body is beyond saving, but stopping now might preserve meaningful selfhood for about a day; the next line calls this one-day life extension.
findings.explanation: Irrecoverable body and another day of meaningful self become sluggishness and a worthwhile current day.

contexts.japanese: この体は手遅れだけど、ここで止めておけば一日ぐらいは意味を失わずに済む。
contexts.english: This body is sluggish, but if I can stop it all here, this day won't have been for nothing.

contexts.japanese: 一日だけの延命。
contexts.english: A one-day lease on life.

findings.description: Specified nucleus accumbens becomes generic forebrain.
findings.sourceReading: An internal crack is located specifically in 大脳の側座核, with motivation/pleasure gloss following.
findings.explanation: Specified nucleus accumbens becomes generic forebrain.

contexts.japanese: 外ではなく内、大脳の側座核が割れた。
contexts.english: Not outside, but inside my forebrain.

contexts.japanese: 行動原理、即ち快楽の連動を司るところ。
contexts.english: The part that controls my behavior principles and sense of pleasure.

findings.description: Pain cannot stop memory loss becomes he cannot stop both pain and memory loss.
findings.sourceReading: Even the pain of loss cannot halt disappearing memories.
findings.explanation: Pain cannot stop memory loss becomes he cannot stop both pain and memory loss.

contexts.japanese: 失み欠う苦痛も、記憶の消失を止められない。
contexts.english: I can't stop the agony of loss and the disappearance of my memories.

findings.description: Fortunately becomes absence of happiness.
findings.sourceReading: Fortunately he does not suffer, because sensation has nearly turned to iron.
