findings.explanation: Fortunately becomes absence of happiness.

contexts.japanese: 幸い、苦しいなんて事はなかった。
contexts.english: I don't feel happiness or suffering.

findings.description: Nearly all sensation becomes all five senses.
findings.sourceReading: Most of his senses have turned to iron.
findings.explanation: Nearly all sensation becomes all five senses.

contexts.japanese: 五感は、そのほとんどが鉄になっている。
contexts.english: My five senses have already turned to iron.

findings.description: Interruption before sword creation becomes before sword use.
findings.sourceReading: He would have his skull smashed before creating Saber's sword if he exposed the Projection opening.
findings.explanation: Interruption before sword creation becomes before sword use.

contexts.japanese: そんな隙を見せれば、セイバーの剣を作る前に頭蓋を砕かれている。
contexts.english: If I give him an opening, he'll pulverize my brain before I can use Saber's sword.

contexts.japanese: 投影には時間を要する。
contexts.english: I need time to do it.

findings.description: Baby has no sin becomes baby cannot commit sins.
findings.sourceReading: The recalled teaching says an infant has no guilt even if evil.
findings.explanation: Baby has no sin becomes baby cannot commit sins.

contexts.japanese: 「—ああ。たとえそれが悪であろうと、赤ん坊に、罪はない、と」
contexts.english: "Yeah. You said that a baby can't commit sins even if it's evil."

findings.description: No wish returning benefit to oneself becomes no wish to return to oneself.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou has no wish whose satisfaction returns something to himself; Kirei's opposite yet similar desire concerns himself.
findings.explanation: No wish returning benefit to oneself becomes no wish to return to oneself.

contexts.japanese: 自身に還る望みを持たぬおまえと対極に位置する、同質の願望だ」
contexts.english: It is a wish of the same nature, yet the antithesis to you, who has no wish to return to yourself.

contexts.japanese: ソイツが出て来たところで、アンタに返るものなんてないんだろう。なのに、どうして」
contexts.english: You're not going to get anything out of it being born. So why?"

findings.description: Acquiring only a death-bearing way of life becomes killing anything he acquired.
findings.sourceReading: What he gained was only a way of living that brings death; next he cannot abandon that one possession.
findings.explanation: Acquiring only a death-bearing way of life becomes killing anything he acquired.

contexts.japanese: そうして得たものは死を運ぶという生き方のみ。
contexts.english: His life brought only death to anything he obtained.

contexts.japanese: なら—その、たった一つだけ在った生き方を、どうしてここで放棄る事が出来るだろう。
contexts.english: If it's the only way he ever lived, how could he ever abandon it now?

findings.description: Kirei's charge assigned to Shirou.
findings.sourceReading: The enemy charges straight in; Shirou lacks that leg power and lowers himself for a counter against the approaching opponent.
findings.explanation: Kirei's charge assigned to Shirou.

contexts.japanese: 地を蹴り、一直線に“敵”は敵を討ちに迫る。
contexts.english: I run and make a beeline at my opponent.

contexts.japanese: こっちにはそれだけの足がない。
contexts.english: My legs don't have much power left.

contexts.japanese: 腰を落とし、正面から襲いくる敵の胸元を見据え、
contexts.english: I drop my hips, eye the chest of my approaching opponent, and...

findings.description: Enemy who attacked at speed becomes enemy Shirou attacked.
findings.sourceReading: The enemy who assaulted him with that speed disappears from view, folds to his left, and strikes.
findings.explanation: Enemy who attacked at speed becomes enemy Shirou attacked.

contexts.japanese: あの速度。あの勢いで襲撃した敵は、一瞬で視界から消え去り、
contexts.english: The enemy I attacked with such speed and power disappears from sight.

contexts.japanese: 長身を折り畳むよう俺の左横に屈み、拳で腹を殴りつけ、
contexts.english: He bends his tall body to my left flank, drives a fist into my stomach,

findings.description: Body beyond saving and another day of meaningful self become sluggishness and worthwhile current day.
findings.sourceReading: Stopping now could preserve meaningful selfhood for about one day although body is already beyond saving; next calls it one-day extension.
findings.explanation: Body beyond saving and another day of meaningful self become sluggishness and worthwhile current day.

contexts.japanese: この体は手遅れだけど、ここで止めておけば一日ぐらいは意味を失わずに済む。
contexts.english: This body is sluggish, but if I can stop it all here, this day won't have been for nothing.

contexts.japanese: 一日だけの延命。
contexts.english: A one-day lease on life.

findings.description: Nucleus accumbens loses its specified location.
findings.sourceReading: Internal crack specifically affects 大脳の側座核, followed by motivation/pleasure gloss.
findings.explanation: Nucleus accumbens loses its specified location.

contexts.japanese: 外ではなく内、大脳の側座核が割れた。
contexts.english: Not outside, but inside my forebrain.

contexts.japanese: 行動原理、即ち快楽の連動を司るところ。
contexts.english: The part that controls my behavior principles and sense of pleasure.

findings.description: Right-hand biting pain unable to stop memory loss becomes boy unable to stop agony of loss and memories.
findings.sourceReading: Even pain from biting fingers of right hand cannot stop disappearing memory.
findings.explanation: Right-hand biting pain unable to stop memory loss becomes boy unable to stop agony of loss and memories.

contexts.japanese: 右手の指を食べる痛みも、記憶の消失を止められない。
contexts.english: I can't stop the agony of loss and the disappearance of my memories.

contexts.japanese: 自分が自分のままでいる事に、指を食うほど執着している。
contexts.english: I bite my fingers to remind myself that I'm still me.

findings.description: Want to Sakura to live is malformed.
findings.sourceReading: Broken Sakura object gives way to explicit desire to live together with her.
findings.explanation: Want to Sakura to live is malformed.

contexts.japanese: 桜を—桜と一緒に、生きていきたい。
contexts.english: I want to Sakura to live—I want to live with Sakura.

findings.description: Small remaining reach to sky becomes momentary enacted arm lift.
findings.sourceReading: Sky is just a little farther, reachable merely by extending arm, before he realizes there is no power left and sinks.
findings.explanation: Small remaining reach to sky becomes momentary enacted arm lift.

contexts.japanese: ほんの少し、ただ腕を伸ばすだけで、空へ抜ける。
contexts.english: For just a moment, I lift my arm up and reach into the sky.

contexts.japanese: この体には、一欠片の魔力も残っていない。
contexts.english: There isn't a single bit of power left in this body.

contexts.japanese: 彼女が救ってくれた命が、沈んでいく。
contexts.english: The life she saved is sinking.

contexts.japanese: 手を伸ばす。
contexts.english: I reach out.

findings.description: Pendant enabling hand extension becomes guarantee of external rescue conditional on reach.
findings.sourceReading: Tiny pendant has just one breath of mana; insufficient for much, but helps him extend his hand.
findings.explanation: Pendant enabling hand extension becomes guarantee of external rescue conditional on reach.

contexts.japanese: 何の役にも立たない、けれど、手を伸ばすぐらいは助けてくれる、小さな小さなペンダント。
contexts.english: It's completely useless, but the small, small pendant will make sure that someone saves me if I reach out with my hand.

contexts.japanese: ほんの一呼吸分の魔力。
contexts.english: One breath of magical energy.

findings.description: Almost cliff-like slope becomes mostly descending small cliffs.
findings.sourceReading: Pathless mountain sometimes even requires descent over rock almost like a sheer cliff; ほとんど modifies cliff likeness, not frequency.
findings.explanation: Almost cliff-like slope becomes mostly descending small cliffs.

contexts.japanese: 山には獣道さえなく、ほとんど絶壁じみた岩肌を降りる事さえあった。
contexts.english: There aren't even any game trails out here, and we mostly have to drop down small cliffs and rock walls.

findings.description: Possible luminous moss becomes established glow source.
findings.sourceReading: He tentatively wonders whether it is a kind of luminous moss producing green light.
findings.explanation: Possible luminous moss becomes established glow source.

contexts.japanese: 光苔の一種か、洞窟はぼんやりとした緑色に照らされている。
contexts.english: Some sort of luminescent moss suffuses the cavern with a green glow.

findings.description: Absolute killing intent omitted from first sight of Saber.
findings.sourceReading: Saber waits clothed in absolute killing intent.
findings.explanation: Absolute killing intent omitted from first sight of Saber.

contexts.japanese: 絶対の殺気を纏って、セイバーが待っていた。
contexts.english: stands Saber, waiting for us.

findings.description: Three intruders become both.
findings.sourceReading: Saber could face all three: Rin, Shirou and Rider, alone.
findings.explanation: Three intruders become both.

contexts.japanese: 桜を守る最強のサーヴァントであるセイバーなら、一人きりで俺たち三人の相手が出来る。
contexts.english: She's the strongest Servant protecting Sakura, and she could take us both alone.

contexts.japanese: 「士郎、貴方は後ろに。指示通り、セイバーの相手は私がします」
contexts.english: "Shirou, get behind me. I will engage Saber, as planned."

findings.description: Rin holding Sakura off becomes Rin settling score.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou takes encouragement as telling him to arrive while Rin can still keep Sakura held off.
findings.explanation: Rin holding Sakura off becomes Rin settling score.

contexts.japanese: 要するにあいつは、自分が桜を止めておけるうちに来いと、遠まわしに応援してくれたのだ。
contexts.english: In other words, telling me to come before she settles the score with Sakura was her roundabout way of cheering me on.

findings.description: Remaining Shirou and Rider become Shirou alone.
findings.sourceReading: After Rin goes on, boy and Rider remain.
findings.explanation: Remaining Shirou and Rider become Shirou alone.

contexts.japanese: 遠坂が奥に進み、残されたのは俺とライダーだけだ。
contexts.english: Tohsaka's gone, leaving only me.

contexts.japanese: 「殺す、とは聞き捨てなりませんね。貴方が手にかけるのはこの道を通る者のみ。彼がこの場に留まるのなら、貴方に襲われる事はない筈ですが」
contexts.english: "Did I hear you correctly? You said that you would only kill those who attempt to pass. If he stays here, you should not attack him."

contexts.japanese: 違いますか、ライダー」
contexts.english: Am I wrong, Rider?"

findings.description: Going murder omits infinitive to.
findings.sourceReading: Rin asks whether Sakura intends to kill Shirou too.
findings.explanation: Going murder omits infinitive to.

contexts.japanese: 「……そ。で、目に付くものなら片っ端から八つ当たりするワケか。けど士郎はどうなの。あいつは今でもアンタを助けられると信じてる。それでも関係なく、アンタはあいつをやっちゃう気？」
contexts.english: "...Okay. So you're going to take your anger out on anyone you see. But what about Shirou? He still thinks that he can save you. Are you going murder him, too?"

findings.description: Settling postponed decision becomes earlier determination to keep holding out.
findings.sourceReading: Rin now firms the decision she had postponed, ending wait for Shirou at limit.
findings.explanation: Settling postponed decision becomes earlier determination to keep holding out.

contexts.japanese: 先延ばしにしていた決意を固める。
contexts.english: She's been determined to hold out as long as possible.

contexts.japanese: 限界まで衛宮士郎を待とうとしたが、これ以上は延ばせない。
contexts.english: She waited for Shirou Emiya until the last possible moment, but she can't go on any longer.

findings.description: Critical moment realization becomes judgment that this was best thing to do.
findings.sourceReading: In the crucial last moment she suddenly realizes she cannot kill Sakura up close.
findings.explanation: Critical moment realization becomes judgment that this was best thing to do.

contexts.japanese: ようするにさっきの瞬間、ここ一番っていう時に気付いてしまった。
contexts.english: In that last moment, she just felt that this was the best thing to do.

contexts.japanese: 間桐桜を間近で見た途端、自分には桜を殺せないなー、などと、当たり前のように感じてしまった。
contexts.english: Once she saw Sakura up close, she felt like, "I can't kill Sakura, huh..."

findings.description: Fetus's glaring motion becomes boy looking around.
findings.sourceReading: ぎょろり introduces eyeless distorted fetus looking at him in next clause.
findings.explanation: Fetus's glaring motion becomes boy looking around.

contexts.japanese: ぎょろり、と。
contexts.english: I look around.

contexts.japanese: 目玉もないクセに、歪な胎児が俺を見る。
contexts.english: The eyeless, twisted fetus is looking at me.

findings.description: Threatened refusal to restrain herself becomes inability.
findings.sourceReading: わたしだって我慢しません threatens that she too will stop restraining herself if he comes closer.
findings.explanation: Threatened refusal to restrain herself becomes inability.

contexts.japanese: 先輩、先輩がそれ以上近寄るなら、わたしだって我慢しません。先輩に殺される前に、わたしが先輩を殺しちゃうんだから……！」
contexts.english: I-if you come any closer, I won't be able to hold it back. I'll kill you before you can kill me...!"

contexts.japanese: 今のは桜が、自分の意志で俺を押しのけようとしたものだ。
contexts.english: Sakura did it out of her own will, to push me away.

findings.description: Answering why he advances becomes denial that the threatened event will happen.
findings.sourceReading: どうしても何もない dismisses her why-question and repeats his already stated purpose: take her out and save Rin.
findings.explanation: Answering why he advances becomes denial that the threatened event will happen.

contexts.japanese: 「どうしても何もない。桜をここから連れ出して、遠坂を助ける。さっきそう言っただろう、桜」
contexts.english: "That won't happen at all. I'm going to get you out of here and save Tohsaka. I already told you that, Sakura."

contexts.japanese: 「どうして言うこと聞いてくれないんですか……！？
contexts.english: "Why won't you do what I ask you to!?

findings.description: Faintness becomes completed loss of consciousness.
findings.sourceReading: 気が遠くなる describes consciousness receding/faintness while he still moves, speaks and projects before self disappears.
findings.explanation: Faintness becomes completed loss of consciousness.

contexts.japanese: ……気が遠くなる。
contexts.english: ...I lose consciousness.

contexts.japanese: 自分が無くなる前に、前へ。
contexts.english: Before I'm gone, I need to go forward.

findings.description: Right leg becomes left leg.
findings.sourceReading: Shadow strikes target shoulder, chest, right leg and abdomen; the next line explicitly denies penetration.
findings.explanation: Right leg becomes left leg.

contexts.japanese: 肩と胸、右足と腹に影が突き刺さる。
contexts.english: Shadows strike at my shoulder, chest, left leg, and stomach.

contexts.japanese: 影は突き刺さらず、火花をこぼしてズレていく。
contexts.english: They get deflected and fail to pierce me, throwing up a shower of sparks.

findings.description: Hope that the strike will constitute punishment becomes a comparison with final punishment.
findings.sourceReading: これが、桜に下される罰になるように is a wish/purpose: may this become the punishment imposed on Sakura.
findings.explanation: Hope that the strike will constitute punishment becomes a comparison with final punishment.

contexts.japanese: これが、桜に下される罰になるように。
contexts.english: Like this is going to be her final punishment.

contexts.japanese: 「帰ろう桜。—そんなヤツとは縁を切れ」
contexts.english: "Let's go home, Sakura. Cut your ties with that guy."

findings.description: Sword/iron dual layer reduced to steel alone.
findings.sourceReading: Base 剣 says sword while ruby てつ says iron/metal: only his face has not become sword/iron yet.
findings.explanation: Sword/iron dual layer reduced to steel alone.

contexts.japanese: 顔だけはまだ剣になっていない。
contexts.english: My face alone hasn't turned to steel yet.

findings.description: Arm's frantic autonomous repair becomes Shirou working the arm.
findings.sourceReading: Left arm itself becomes frantic trying to repair his pulverized frame, causing whitening and mental erosion.
findings.explanation: Arm's frantic autonomous repair becomes Shirou working the arm.

contexts.japanese: それを修復しようと左腕が躍起になり、結果—
contexts.english: I work my left arm to try and repair it, and—

contexts.japanese: それは敵によるダメージではなく、傷ついた体を直し、書き換えようとする、左腕からの痛みだった。
contexts.english: It isn't the damage from his attacks, but from the pain of my left arm repairing and overwriting my injured body.

findings.description: Consciousness becomes memories.
findings.sourceReading: Both visual images and consciousness become white beyond return.
findings.explanation: Consciousness becomes memories.

contexts.japanese: 映像も意識も、戻れないところまで白く。
contexts.english: Images and memories become irreturnably white.

findings.description: Left flank becomes left armpit.
findings.sourceReading: 左わき腹 is the left side/flank of the abdomen.
findings.explanation: Left flank becomes left armpit.

contexts.japanese: 同時に左わき腹に衝撃。脳を切りきざむ刃に堪えて、もう一撃。
contexts.english: There's a simultaneous impact to my left armpit. I endure the blades stabbing my brain and attack again.

findings.description: Questions about the oath and its object become statements that an oath existed.
findings.sourceReading: What did you swear? Whom did you swear to protect? Internal questions summon the particular remembered commitment.
findings.explanation: Questions about the oath and its object become statements that an oath existed.

contexts.japanese: 何を誓った。
contexts.english: You swore an oath.

contexts.japanese: おまえは、誰を守ると誓ったんだ。
contexts.english: You swore to protect someone.

findings.description: Questions about cost become unspecified loss assertions.
findings.sourceReading: What did you lose? What did you lose for that purpose? Again an internal question about the chosen price.
findings.explanation: Questions about cost become unspecified loss assertions.

contexts.japanese: その為におまえは何を失った。
contexts.english: You lost something for that purpose.

findings.description: Missing an opportunity becomes letting Kirei go.
findings.sourceReading: ここを逃したら refers to losing this final chance, explicit この奇跡、この好機.
findings.explanation: Missing an opportunity becomes letting Kirei go.

contexts.japanese: これが最後、ここを逃したら本当に後がない、この奇跡、この好機に、残った命を全てつぎ込む—！
contexts.english: This is the end, if I let him go there's no future, I need to put everything I have left into this miracle, this chance...!

findings.description: Duty/wish double layer reduced to wish alone.
findings.sourceReading: Written 責務 is responsibility/duty, with spoken ruby のぞみ wish. Last Master must fulfill both superimposed senses before the Grail.
findings.explanation: Duty/wish double layer reduced to wish alone.

contexts.japanese: 聖杯を前にし、その責務を果たすがいい」
contexts.english: Go before the Holy Grail and fulfill your wish."

findings.description: Frame ready sometime today becomes whole-day work.
findings.sourceReading: Somehow frame will be ready within today, then Projection tonight.
findings.explanation: Frame ready sometime today becomes whole-day work.

contexts.japanese: 「だから、例の切り札の作成。なんとか今日中に骨組みが出来るから、今夜“投影”を実行するわ。
contexts.english: "Because you're going to make our secret weapon. We'll spend the entire day making the frame, and then Project it tonight.

findings.description: Sick Sakura worrying about pale caregiver becomes Rin doing Shirou a favor.
findings.sourceReading: If his face is pale/ringed, even Sakura receiving care will feel obliged to worry about him.
findings.explanation: Sick Sakura worrying about pale caregiver becomes Rin doing Shirou a favor.

contexts.japanese: ……まったく、嘘だと思うなら鏡を見てきなさい。顔面蒼白で目にクマ作ってたら、看病される桜だって気を遣うわ」
contexts.english: ...If you think I'm lying, go take a look in the mirror. You're deathly pale and got rings around your eyes like a raccoon. I'm doing you a favor by taking care of Sakura."

findings.description: Around a day unconscious becomes favor regretted next day.
findings.sourceReading: Imitating Rider can make him insensible for roughly a full day.
findings.explanation: Around a day unconscious becomes favor regretted next day.

contexts.japanese: ライダーの真似事でいいなら、まる一日前後不覚にしてあげられるけど？」
contexts.english: If you're okay with me copying what Rider did, I'll do you a favor that you'll regret the next day."

findings.description: Sleeping for entire day becomes passing out in middle of day.
findings.sourceReading: If laid up asleep for a full day, cannot wake until tomorrow morning; conflicts with tonight's plan.
findings.explanation: Sleeping for entire day becomes passing out in middle of day.

contexts.japanese: 「やるかバカ！　そんな物騒な実験には付き合えないし、だいたい丸一日寝込んだら明日の朝まで起きられない」
contexts.english: "Hell no! I won't play along with your scary experiments, plus if I pass out in the middle of the day, I won't wake up until tomorrow."

findings.description: As soon as possible becomes as much as possible.
findings.sourceReading: Wants two girls back as sisters at earliest possible time.
findings.explanation: As soon as possible becomes as much as possible.

contexts.japanese: だからあの二人には少しでも早く姉妹に戻ってもらいたい。
contexts.english: That's why I want them to return to being sisters as much as possible.

findings.description: Power-providing main source becomes projector Sakura.
findings.sourceReading: Repeats 本体 from preceding alternative: main entity supplying mana/electricity to projector, distinct from Sakura projector.
findings.explanation: Power-providing main source becomes projector Sakura.

contexts.english: "The person projecting it..."

contexts.japanese: もしアレを消せるとしたら、それは投影機である桜本人を消すか、投影機に魔力を送っている本体を消すしかないのではないか。
contexts.english: Even if I could erase it somehow, would that mean erasing the person projecting it—Sakura—or erasing whoever's providing power to the projector?

findings.description: Disbelief in existence becomes hope no such person exists.
findings.sourceReading: そんなものがいるとは思えない says he cannot think such main source exists.
findings.explanation: Disbelief in existence becomes hope no such person exists.

contexts.japanese: ……そんなものがいるとは思えない。
contexts.english: ...I hope nobody like that exists.

findings.description: Eyes darting become blinking.
findings.sourceReading: Caught off guard he lets gaze dart/swim at sudden illumination.
findings.explanation: Eyes darting become blinking.

contexts.japanese: 不意打ちに視線を泳がす。
contexts.english: I blink at the sudden illumination.

findings.description: Unwilling to kill becomes afraid to kill.
findings.sourceReading: Even so is killing Sakura something you dislike/refuse, she asks.
findings.explanation: Unwilling to kill becomes afraid to kill.

contexts.japanese: それでも—サクラを殺すのはイヤなの、シロウ？」
contexts.english: Are you still afraid to kill her, Shirou?"

findings.description: No matter how altered becomes no matter how it ends.
findings.sourceReading: However radically she is transformed, if Illya remains inside he recognizes known person.
findings.explanation: No matter how altered becomes no matter how it ends.

contexts.japanese: 「……たとえ、どんなに変わり果ててしまっても。
contexts.english: "No matter how this ends...

contexts.japanese: その中にイリヤがいるのなら、それは、俺の知っているイリヤだと思う」
contexts.english: If you're still somewhere in there, then you're the Illya I know."

findings.description: Difficulty because boy is unaware becomes competitive danger accusation.
findings.sourceReading: What's troublesome is that he doesn't realize his weakened state, fool.
findings.explanation: Difficulty because boy is unaware becomes competitive danger accusation.

contexts.japanese: 「……なにが厄介かって、本人が気付いてないあたりが厄介なのよ、ばか」
contexts.english: "...And he calls me dangerous? You're the biggest danger because you're so clueless, dummy."

findings.description: Easy catch if running becomes urgent requirement.
findings.sourceReading: Anyway if she runs she can immediately catch up.
findings.explanation: Easy catch if running becomes urgent requirement.

contexts.japanese: ともあれ、走ればすぐに追いつける。
contexts.english: Anyway, she needs to catch up to him right away.

findings.description: Shirou helping Sakura and Sakura going alone become Rin helping Shirou and Shirou going alone.
findings.sourceReading: Sakura couldn't resolve it alone, so that guy tried to help; yet she went alone to resolve it after all. Conversation concerns Rider holding Rin until Sakura returns.
findings.explanation: Shirou helping Sakura and Sakura going alone become Rin helping Shirou and Shirou going alone.

contexts.japanese: 「—ほんとに頭きた。一人じゃ出来ないからあいつが助けようとしたのに、結局、一人で解決しにいくなんてね」
contexts.english: "I'm so annoyed. I was trying to help him because he can't do this on his own, but he's going to end up trying anyway."

findings.description: Success credited as already achieved becomes future final success.
findings.sourceReading: This ritual's success was possible only because Shirou was here, Zouken's malicious credit for present result.
findings.explanation: Success credited as already achieved becomes future final success.

contexts.japanese: そう、ワシは感謝しておるよ衛宮士郎。此度の儀はおぬしがいてこその成功だった。
contexts.english: I thank you, Shirou Emiya. The ritual will finally succeed thanks to you.

findings.description: Not trusting to the end becomes never putting faith in protector.
findings.sourceReading: Failed to trust the man wanting to protect Sakura through to the end, by leaving.
findings.explanation: Not trusting to the end becomes never putting faith in protector.

contexts.japanese: 「あったりまえじゃない。この家を出た時点で救いきれない大馬鹿よ。アンタは間桐桜を守りたがってたヤツを、最後まで信じてやらなかったんだから」
contexts.english: "Obviously. You're a huge moron, beyond saving from the moment you left this house, because you never put any faith in the one guy who wanted to protect Sakura Matou."

findings.description: Know conclusion becomes tell me conclusion.
findings.sourceReading: Internal demand 結論を知れ follows 結論を言え: know conclusion as well as get it stated, before boy confronts feared implications.
findings.explanation: Know conclusion becomes tell me conclusion.

contexts.japanese: 結論を知れ。
contexts.english: Tell me the conclusion.

contexts.japanese: 結論を言え。
contexts.english: Get to the point.

findings.description: Kirei's argument shifts from predicting a child's future criminality to accusing it of its parent's crimes. The change concerns his analogy, not Shirou's stated principles.
findings.sourceReading: Kirei asks whether a criminal's son is certain to become a criminal, making prenatal killing the consequence of that prediction.
findings.explanation: Kirei's argument shifts from predicting a child's future criminality to accusing it of its parent's crimes. The change concerns his analogy, not Shirou's stated principles.

contexts.japanese: それともなにか？　おまえは犯罪者の息子は間違いなく犯罪者になるとでも言うのか？　それ故に、生まれる前に殺してしまえと？」
contexts.english: Or are you saying that you would condemn the child of a criminal and accuse it of the same crimes? Would you execute it before it is even born?"

findings.description: Even odds become partial solution.
findings.sourceReading: There is a method but chance roughly half and half, then narrow mental survival window.
findings.explanation: Even odds become partial solution.

contexts.japanese: 「手はある。だが半々というところだ。
contexts.english: "There is a way, though it is only a partial solution.

findings.description: Control within seconds becomes holding control for seconds, impossibility becomes miracle.
findings.sourceReading: Gaining Grail control within merely seconds is madness; alone boy cannot accomplish it under any circumstances.
findings.explanation: Control within seconds becomes holding control for seconds, impossibility becomes miracle.

contexts.japanese: それだけではない。わずか数秒で聖杯を制御するなど狂気の沙汰だ。おまえ一人では、どうあっても成しえない奇跡だぞ」
contexts.english: That's not all. It would be a mind-shattering task to control the Holy Grail for even a few seconds. Such a feat would be a miracle for you alone."

findings.description: Even without her will becomes regardless of her feelings alone.
findings.sourceReading: No matter if taking lives wasn't her own will, in boy's inward punitive reasoning.
findings.explanation: Even without her will becomes regardless of her feelings alone.

contexts.japanese: 本人の意思でなかろうと関係ない。
contexts.english: It doesn't matter how she alone feels about it.

findings.description: Perpetrator must be punished becomes victims entitled to witness punishment.
findings.sourceReading: Whatever reasons, offender must be punished; then equally valuable return will appease those deprived.
findings.explanation: Perpetrator must be punished becomes victims entitled to witness punishment.

contexts.japanese: どんな理由があろうと、加害者は罰せられなくてはならない。
contexts.english: No matter what the circumstances were, the victims deserve to see some kind of punishment.

findings.description: Many tens of times becomes ten times.
findings.sourceReading: More than now, deaths many tens of times, 何十倍.
findings.explanation: Many tens of times becomes ten times.

contexts.japanese: 今よりもっと、何十倍もの命が失われる。
contexts.english: There will be ten times as many deaths.

findings.description: Humanity expanding limits becomes Kiritsugu loving more than anyone.
findings.sourceReading: He loved humans reaching higher/farther/broader, endlessly opening limits; made self evil for their sake.
findings.explanation: Humanity expanding limits becomes Kiritsugu loving more than anyone.

contexts.japanese: より高く、より遠く、より広く。際限なく限界を切り開く人間を愛し、その為に、自身を絶対の悪とした。
contexts.english: His love for humanity was higher, further, and broader than any other. That is why he turned himself into absolute evil.

findings.description: Kiritsugu's suffering displeases Kotomine in the Japanese. The English instead says it makes Kiritsugu unhappy, removing one specific source of Kotomine's resentment.
findings.sourceReading: Kotomine finds both Kiritsugu's existence and his anguish offensive, continuing his comparison between what Kiritsugu could abandon and what he himself never possessed.
findings.explanation: Kiritsugu's suffering displeases Kotomine in the Japanese. The English instead says it makes Kiritsugu unhappy, removing one specific source of Kotomine's resentment.

contexts.japanese: ヤツの存在はあまりにも不愉快だった。ヤツの苦悩は明らかに不快だった。
contexts.english: I found his existence extremely unpleasant. His suffering clearly made him unhappy.

findings.description: As if correct human conduct becomes conceded correct conduct.
findings.sourceReading: Kiritsugu recovered discarded feeling as if this were right human way.
findings.explanation: As if correct human conduct becomes conceded correct conduct.

contexts.japanese: そこまでして切り捨てるというのなら、初めから持たねばよい。だというのにヤツは苦悩を持ち、切り捨てた後でさえ拾い上げた。それが人間の正しい営みだというように」
contexts.english: If he was going to abandon everything, then he never should have had it to begin with. Yet, he suffered and abandoned things, only to pick them up again. Even though it was the right, human thing to do."

findings.description: Surprise despite lack of self becomes fixation caused by lack of self.
findings.sourceReading: No concept of self, yet surprisingly such boy attached to a single life; then revises toward all lives.
findings.explanation: Surprise despite lack of self becomes fixation caused by lack of self.

contexts.japanese: おまえには自分という概念がない。だがそのおまえが、まさか一つの命に拘るとはな。いや、それとも—」
contexts.english: You have no concept of self. That is why you obsess over a single life. Or perhaps..."

findings.description: The English increases the distance between the two men's objectives from somewhat better to a lot better. Shirou still rejects Kotomine's objective in the next line.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou regards Kotomine's objective as somewhat preferable to Zouken's, while still rejecting it.
findings.explanation: The English increases the distance between the two men's objectives from somewhat better to a lot better. Shirou still rejects Kotomine's objective in the next line.

contexts.japanese: だが、それでも臓硯に比べれば幾分マシだ。
contexts.english: But that's still a lot better than anything Zouken has planned.

findings.description: The speaker's ability to touch Rin becomes the mud's ability to touch her.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou can touch Rin although he cannot remove her mud covering; 俺 understood from the voiced attempt and lifted Rin at page3.
findings.explanation: The speaker's ability to touch Rin becomes the mud's ability to touch her.

contexts.japanese: 「っ……！　なんだこれ、遠坂には触れるのに、どうして……！」
contexts.english: "Rrgh...! What it this!? It can touch Tohsaka, so why can't I...!?"

contexts.japanese: 抱き上げても返事はない。
contexts.english: I lift her up, but she doesn't respond.

findings.description: Present normal conversation becomes a conditional future restoration.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou tries to maintain that Sakura is unchanged: she is thus talking properly to him as usual, before her refusal interrupts.
findings.explanation: Present normal conversation becomes a conditional future restoration.

contexts.japanese: こうして、ちゃんと俺と話をして、いつも通り—
contexts.english: So if we can just talk, she'll go back to—

contexts.japanese: 桜は桜のままだ。
contexts.english: Sakura is still Sakura.

findings.description: Denial of a cause becomes a not-yet absorption event.
findings.sourceReading: His paralysis is not because he was overwhelmed by her enormous magical energy; the next sentences identify her intent to kill him as its cause.
findings.explanation: Denial of a cause becomes a not-yet absorption event.

contexts.japanese: その膨大すぎる魔力に呑まれた訳じゃない。
contexts.english: I haven't been swallowed by this titanic magical energy yet.

contexts.japanese: 体を凍らせるのはただ一つ。
contexts.english: There's only one reason I can't move:

contexts.japanese: 桜は本気で—俺に、殺意を向けていた。
contexts.english: Sakura's boundless bloodlust is directed at me.

findings.description: Disappear from his life becomes disappear in front of him.
findings.sourceReading: 先輩の前から消える is to disappear from his presence/leave him, because being together burdens him; the source departure and following inability to relinquish him establish sense.
findings.explanation: Disappear from his life becomes disappear in front of him.

contexts.japanese: だからわたし、先輩の前から消えないといけなかった」
contexts.english: That's why I needed to disappear in front of you."

contexts.japanese: 先輩にとって、わたしがどれだけ重荷なのかよく分かっています。先輩はわたしといるかぎり、ずっと苦しみ続けてしまう。
contexts.english: I know how much of a burden I am to you. You'll keep suffering as long as I'm here.

findings.description: Failure even to conceive of evasion becomes merely not trying.
findings.sourceReading: He did not think of himself evading, while his thoughts are in pieces.
findings.explanation: Failure even to conceive of evasion becomes merely not trying.

contexts.japanese: 自分が避ける事は考えつけなかった。
contexts.english: I don't even try to evade it.

contexts.japanese: ボロボロの思考のまま、遠坂を弾き飛ばした。
contexts.english: In my battered mental state, I shove Tohsaka away.

findings.description: The English reverses who takes whom away. Illya presents herself as taking responsibility for Sakura's departure; the English makes Sakura lead Illya away.
findings.sourceReading: Illya says she will take Sakura away, identifying herself as the agent.
findings.explanation: The English reverses who takes whom away. Illya presents herself as taking responsibility for Sakura's departure; the English makes Sakura lead Illya away.

contexts.japanese: 後の始末はわたしの役目だもん。サクラはわたしが連れて行くから、シロウはもう休んでいいよ」
contexts.english: It's my duty to take care of the rest. Sakura's going to take me away, so you can rest now."

findings.description: Lead-heavy whole-body impairment disappears during renewed pursuit.
findings.sourceReading: His whole body feels like lead, and nausea/chills make his brain spin, as he chases the girls.
findings.explanation: Lead-heavy whole-body impairment disappears during renewed pursuit.

contexts.japanese: 全身鉛、吐き気と悪寒で脳みそがぐるんぐるんの状態で、遠ざかっていく二人を追いかける。
contexts.english: I chase after them with reckless abandon, pushing through the nausea, the chill, and my soup-like brain.

findings.description: Darkening vision becomes an invented question about whether only vision is darkening.
findings.sourceReading: Within his darkening vision is a setting fragment following inability to keep consciousness.
findings.explanation: Darkening vision becomes an invented question about whether only vision is darkening.

contexts.japanese: 暗くなっていく視界のなか。
contexts.english: Is it just my vision that's going dark?

findings.description: Eat a lot becomes eat it all.
findings.sourceReading: Sakura made plenty and encourages Shirou to eat a lot.
findings.explanation: Eat a lot becomes eat it all.

contexts.japanese: 「はい、御代わりですね！　いっぱい作りましたから、たくさん食べてください」
contexts.english: "Oh, you want seconds! I made a lot, so be sure to eat it all!"

findings.description: Shirou's acceptance of his wandering attention becomes an effort not to be flustered. The change concerns his handling of attraction.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou accepts his involuntary attention to Sakura and will not make excuses for it.
findings.explanation: Shirou's acceptance of his wandering attention becomes an effort not to be flustered. The change concerns his handling of attraction.

contexts.japanese: 一人で顔を赤くしてるのも我慢するし、桜の一挙一動に目がいってしまうのも言い訳しない。
contexts.english: I'm already the only one blushing, so I can't let every single thing Sakura does throw me for a loop.

findings.description: Already discovered fact becomes a future revelation.
findings.sourceReading: 今回判明した事実 is fact discovered this time; it will continue into the future.
findings.explanation: Already discovered fact becomes a future revelation.

contexts.japanese: 今回判明した事実は、この先ずっと続いていく。
contexts.english: Once the truth comes out, it'll hound me for a while to come.

findings.description: Explicit retraction of attack threat becomes generic amendment.
findings.sourceReading: Rider withdraws the statement about attacking him, then gives conditional cooperation as long as he protects Sakura.
findings.explanation: Explicit retraction of attack threat becomes generic amendment.

contexts.japanese: 「……そうですね。貴方を襲う、というのは撤回します。
contexts.english: "...All right. Allow me to amend that statement.

contexts.japanese: 貴方がサクラを守るかぎり、私たちは協力者です。今後ともよろしくお願いします」
contexts.english: As long as you protect Sakura, I will cooperate with you. I hope you will find that satisfactory."

findings.description: Best healing method becomes the only healing method.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou thinks Sakura should know obtaining Grail is best way of healing body.
findings.explanation: Best healing method becomes the only healing method.

contexts.japanese: 聖杯を得る事が体を治す一番の方法だと判っているだろうに、それを考えようとしていない。
contexts.english: She should know that the Holy Grail is the only way to heal herself, but she doesn't even consider it as an option.

findings.description: Shirou's stated atonement for Saber's death becomes repayment for her cooperation. 'Also' becomes 'the only way,' changing both the expressed cost of following him and his reason for continuing.
findings.sourceReading: Continuing the fight is also atonement toward Saber, whom Shirou understands to have died after going along with his selfishness.
findings.explanation: Shirou's stated atonement for Saber's death becomes repayment for her cooperation. 'Also' becomes 'the only way,' changing both the expressed cost of following him and his reason for continuing.

contexts.japanese: ……それが俺の我が侭につき合い、命を落としたセイバーへの償いでもある。
contexts.english: ...It's the only way I can repay Saber for going along with my selfishness.

findings.description: Sakura's warning about accidental exposure becomes a warning that Rider might attack on impulse. Rider's next lines still explain that she cannot reliably prevent her eyes from affecting Shirou.
findings.sourceReading: Sakura warns that Shirou might inadvertently fall under the eyes' effect. Rider explains that even limiting her magical energy would not reliably exclude him.
findings.explanation: Sakura's warning about accidental exposure becomes a warning that Rider might attack on impulse. Rider's next lines still explain that she cannot reliably prevent her eyes from affecting Shirou.

contexts.japanese: 「こ、困りませんっ！　だいたいですね、ライダーの目は魔眼なんですよ？　ちょっとした弾みで魔術にかかっちゃったらどうするんですか！」
contexts.english: "I-it doesn't bother me at all! Besides, Rider's eyes are Mystic Eyes. What if she hits you with her magecraft on impulse!?"

contexts.japanese: 私本人が魔力をセーブしたところで、貴方を対象外にするのは難しい」
contexts.english: Even if I conserve my magical energy, it would be difficult to stop them from affecting you."

findings.description: Deepening distress becomes realizing the situation.
findings.sourceReading: The fact sinks her heart yet deeper: boy risks danger while she rests as its cause.
findings.explanation: Deepening distress becomes realizing the situation.

contexts.japanese: その事実が、彼女の心を一層深く沈ませる。
contexts.english: The reality sinks in.

findings.description: Wanting Shirou alone to survive becomes living her remaining time for him.
findings.sourceReading: Since she has little time, at least she wants him alone to go on living.
findings.explanation: Wanting Shirou alone to survive becomes living her remaining time for him.

contexts.japanese: それならせめて、彼にだけは生きていてほしい。
contexts.english: She'd prefer to live the rest of it for him.

contexts.japanese: どうせ自分は長くない。
contexts.english: She doesn't have much time left, anyway.

findings.description: Apparent week since farewell becomes week during farewell.
findings.sourceReading: Though she saw him off this morning it feels a week has passed since doing so.
findings.explanation: Apparent week since farewell becomes week during farewell.

contexts.japanese: ……今朝だって。なんか、先輩を見送ってから、一週間ぐらい経ってる気がするの」
contexts.english: ...Even this morning, when I watched Senpai leave, it felt like a whole week went by."

findings.description: Excluding last night's activity as cause becomes not tired at bedtime.
findings.sourceReading: A lot happened yesterday, but he thinks fatigue isn't due to last night's events, with embarrassed hesitation.
findings.explanation: Excluding last night's activity as cause becomes not tired at bedtime.

contexts.japanese: たしかに昨日は色々あったが、別に、その、昨夜のことで疲れたワケじゃないと思う。
contexts.english: A lot happened yesterday, but I didn't go to bed particularly exhausted.

findings.description: Shallow sleep becomes insufficient quantity of sleep.
findings.sourceReading: He supposes sluggishness from shallow/light sleep.
findings.explanation: Shallow sleep becomes insufficient quantity of sleep.

contexts.japanese: この気だるさは眠りが浅かったせいだろう。
contexts.english: I probably feel this way because I didn't sleep enough.

findings.description: The English changes a warning that silence could cause irreparable harm into an expectation that speaking will change things. This belongs in a review of Shirou's decision to warn Illya.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou expects irreparable consequences unless he tells Illya about both dangers.
findings.explanation: The English changes a warning that silence could cause irreparable harm into an expectation that speaking will change things. This belongs in a review of Shirou's decision to warn Illya.

contexts.japanese: 間桐臓硯の暗躍と、あの、正体不明の影についても話しておかないと、取り返しのつかない事になるだろう。
contexts.english: I have a feeling that everything will change once I bring up Zouken's schemes and that unknown Shadow.

findings.description: Acceptance of embarrassing protective reason becomes understanding his embarrassment.
findings.sourceReading: He infers Rider has accepted the reason just given, one embarrassing to state to another person's face.
findings.explanation: Acceptance of embarrassing protective reason becomes understanding his embarrassment.

contexts.japanese: ……どうやら今の、人様に面と向かって言うのには気恥ずかしい理由に納得してくれたようだ。
contexts.english: ...Maybe now she knows why I'm embarrassed to say this out loud.

findings.description: Agreement to grant possible request becomes agreement to hear it.
findings.sourceReading: Rider says if within her power she will 聞き届ける, accept/grant the request.
findings.explanation: Agreement to grant possible request becomes agreement to hear it.

contexts.japanese: 「え、ええ。私にできる範囲でなら聞き届けますが」
contexts.english: "Y-yes. If it's within my power, I will hear you out."

findings.description: Whoever enters is recast as any number of people Shirou brings.
findings.sourceReading: Today, no person whatsoever will return alive; imagined trees voice an absolute warning.
findings.explanation: Whoever enters is recast as any number of people Shirou brings.

contexts.japanese: —今日だけは、何人たりとも生きては帰れん。
contexts.english: No matter how many people you bring, none will return alive.

contexts.japanese: 風で揺れる木々が、そう囁いている気さえする。
contexts.english: Even the trees seem to whisper that as their branches sway in the wind.

findings.description: Rin still ends the deadlock first, but break the ice omits her release of her fighting stance. Both versions keep Shirou lowering his wooden sword after her request.
findings.sourceReading: Rin asks Shirou to lower the sword and is the first to release her stance; he then lowers his wooden sword. The omitted detail is her physical de-escalation, not all of her initiative.
findings.explanation: Rin still ends the deadlock first, but break the ice omits her release of her fighting stance. Both versions keep Shirou lowering his wooden sword after her request.

contexts.japanese: ……先に構えを解いたのは遠坂だった。
contexts.english: Tohsaka's the first to break the ice.

contexts.japanese: 「……ちょっと。いいかげん、それ下げてくれない？　お化け屋敷じゃないんだから」
contexts.english: "...Hold on. Would you put that down? We're not in a haunted house."

contexts.japanese: 釣られて木刀を下げる。
contexts.english: I lower the wooden sword as asked.

findings.description: Shirou's objection to either girl being injured becomes a warning that Rin will be hurt. His explicit concern for Illya within this appeal disappears.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou objects because either Rin or Illya will be injured if they fight.
findings.explanation: Shirou's objection to either girl being injured becomes a warning that Rin will be hurt. His explicit concern for Illya within this appeal disappears.

contexts.japanese: 「それもあるけど。遠坂、イリヤと戦ったらただじゃ済まないぞ。始めたらどっちかが必ず傷を負う。そういうのは嫌だ。俺は、もともと」
contexts.english: "That too. But Tohsaka, you won't get out unscathed if you fight her. You're bound to get hurt once you start. I don't want that to happen. To begin with—"

findings.description: Rin prioritizing Shirou while he guides becomes her doing him a favor.
findings.sourceReading: As long as he serves as guide, Rin will give his plan priority; taking her keeps her from challenging Illya independently.
findings.explanation: Rin prioritizing Shirou while he guides becomes her doing him a favor.

contexts.japanese: けどまあ、案内をする分には、遠坂は俺を優先してくれる。
contexts.english: Still, Tohsaka's doing me a favor by letting me guide her.

contexts.japanese: 放っておけばイリヤに戦いを挑む遠坂だが、ここで連れて行くと言えば、遠坂は大人しくしてくれるのだ。
contexts.english: If I let her go, she might fight Illya, but if she comes with me, then she'll behave.

findings.description: The swordsman's cut through Berserker's unguarded body disappears.
findings.sourceReading: Black armor passes through greatsword and debris, then flashes a cut across the exposed body.
findings.explanation: The swordsman's cut through Berserker's unguarded body disappears.

contexts.japanese: 吹き荒ぶ風の元凶はあの黒い剣士なのか、黒い甲冑はバーサーカーの大剣と土塊をすり抜け、無防備な体を一閃する。
contexts.english: The black-armored Servant breezes past Berserker's greatsword and earthen assault, as if it's the source of this raging wind.

contexts.japanese: それを、黒い剣士は苦もなく切断する。
contexts.english: And the black swordsman easily slices it open.

findings.description: Something familiar in the Shadow becomes someone personally known.
findings.sourceReading: For an instant the Shadow seems like some familiar thing, association unfinished.
findings.explanation: Something familiar in the Shadow becomes someone personally known.

contexts.japanese: 何か、よく知っているモノに見えた、気がする。
contexts.english: I feel like I'm looking at someone I know well.

contexts.japanese: アレは間違いなくあの“黒い影”だ。
contexts.english: They definitely belong to the Shadow.

findings.description: The kick's location becomes less precise, while Archer's protective intervention remains clear.
findings.sourceReading: Assassin is knocked away by a kick to his flank.
findings.explanation: The kick's location becomes less precise, while Archer's protective intervention remains clear.

contexts.japanese: 俺たちの真横に並走していたアサシンは、そのわき腹に蹴りを食らって弾かれたのだ。
contexts.english: Assassin was running next to us, until someone kicked him in the stomach.

findings.description: The forest's present death becomes a future prediction.
findings.sourceReading: As the Shadow surges and drains surrounding magical energy, the forest dies.
findings.explanation: The forest's present death becomes a future prediction.

contexts.japanese: 森が死ぬ。
contexts.english: This forest will die.

contexts.japanese: 周囲にある全ての魔力があの影に吸われていく。
contexts.english: All of the surrounding mana is being sucked into the Shadow.

findings.description: Perception becomes spirit.
findings.sourceReading: The burst dyes Shirou's field of vision and perception entirely black as he covers Illya.
findings.explanation: Perception becomes spirit.

contexts.japanese: 視界と知覚が、黒一色に染め上げられた。
contexts.english: my sight and spirit are dyed jet black.

findings.description: A black sun falling upon the scene becomes Shirou falling into it.
findings.sourceReading: Seeing clear blackness makes him wonder whether a black sun has fallen/come down.
findings.explanation: A black sun falling upon the scene becomes Shirou falling into it.

contexts.japanese: こんなにハッキリ見えているのに暗いってコトは、黒い太陽でも落ちてきたのか。
contexts.english: It's so dark, even though I can see clearly. I must have fallen into a black sun.

findings.description: Loss of touch becomes loss of every sense.
findings.sourceReading: Absence of tactile sensation feels more revolting than pain.
findings.explanation: Loss of touch becomes loss of every sense.

contexts.japanese: 痛みより、触覚がない喪失感が気色悪い。
contexts.english: The complete sensory loss is more revolting than any pain.

findings.description: The sizzling instant of the left-side disappearance vanishes.
findings.sourceReading: Everything beyond left shoulder disappears cleanly with a brief sizzling sound.
findings.explanation: The sizzling instant of the left-side disappearance vanishes.

contexts.japanese: じゅっ、と音をたててキレイさっぱり消え去った。
contexts.english: It's all gone.

findings.description: The Shadow disappearing becomes Shirou disappearing.
findings.sourceReading: After the burst, the black Shadow melts away without trace, perhaps having exhausted its power.
findings.explanation: The Shadow disappearing becomes Shirou disappearing.

contexts.japanese: ……消えていく。
contexts.english: ...I'm disappearing.

contexts.japanese: 今ので力を使い果たしたのか、“黒い影”は跡形もなく溶けていった。
contexts.english: The Shadow melts away without a trace, as if it's expended all its power.

findings.description: A mistaken tactical estimate becomes belief that he could change anything.
findings.sourceReading: His error was judging that the planned dash, hand-grab and sideways jump could somehow work.
findings.explanation: A mistaken tactical estimate becomes belief that he could change anything.

contexts.japanese: —どうにかなると、判断した事が間違いだった。
contexts.english: I was wrong to think I could change anything.

findings.description: A single prey in a web becomes every last prey.
findings.sourceReading: The Shadow mercilessly swallows prey caught in a spiderweb-like situation; metaphor does not enumerate victims.
findings.explanation: A single prey in a web becomes every last prey.

contexts.japanese: 蜘蛛の巣にかかった獲物を、容赦なく呑み込んだ。
contexts.english: swallowing every last prey within its web.

findings.description: Kirei questions whether Sakura is worth Shirou's life. The English instead questions whether sacrifice exhausts what she means to him, changing the provocation.
findings.sourceReading: Having called life-sacrificing devotion beautiful, Kirei questions whether Sakura is worth that much to Shirou.
findings.explanation: Kirei questions whether Sakura is worth Shirou's life. The English instead questions whether sacrifice exhausts what she means to him, changing the provocation.

contexts.japanese: あの娘は衛宮士郎にとって、果たしてそれだけの価値があるのかどうか」
contexts.english: I wonder if that is all the girl really means to you."

contexts.japanese: 「—そうか。命を捧げるほどの献身は美しいがな。
contexts.english: "I see. Self-sacrifice is indeed a beautiful ideal.

findings.description: Keeping someone alive as satisfying desire becomes an act of greed.
findings.sourceReading: Kirei provocatively equates causing/allowing life with fulfilling desire, leaving the desire's owner and moral implication open.
findings.explanation: Keeping someone alive as satisfying desire becomes an act of greed.

contexts.japanese: 生かすという事は欲望を満たすという事。
contexts.english: Letting her live is an act of greed.

findings.description: The shared objective survives, but the English leaves out Rin's explicit limit: cooperating until Zouken is defeated.
findings.sourceReading: Rin offers cooperation until their shared objective of defeating Zouken is achieved.
findings.explanation: The shared objective survives, but the English leaves out Rin's explicit limit: cooperating until Zouken is defeated.

contexts.japanese: だいたいね、貴方だけじゃ心許ないでしょ。臓硯を倒すって目的は一緒なんだし、それまで手を組んであげてもいいってコト！」
contexts.english: I bet you aren't feeling great about fighting alone, either. We both want to take down Zouken, so I'll team up with you if that's what you want!"

contexts.japanese: 「そうよ、協力してあげてもいいって言ってるのっ！
contexts.english: "Yeah, I'm saying that I'll work together with you!

findings.description: The hammer-blow shock becomes a moment of understanding. That changes Shirou's reaction, but these pages do not establish a lost joke mechanism.
findings.sourceReading: Rin's offer hits Shirou like a hammer blow; he then recognizes his extraordinary good fortune.
findings.explanation: The hammer-blow shock becomes a moment of understanding. That changes Shirou's reaction, but these pages do not establish a lost joke mechanism.

contexts.japanese: ガン、とあたまをハンマーで叩かれた感じ。
contexts.english: Finally, a light bulb goes off in my head.

contexts.japanese: 突然の申し出は、これ以上ない程の幸運だった。
contexts.english: This sudden proposal is the best that could happen to me right now.

findings.description: The women deciding argument cannot settle becomes Shirou thinking so.
findings.sourceReading: Seeing their verbal fight won't produce a decision, both women hand final choice to him.
findings.explanation: The women deciding argument cannot settle becomes Shirou thinking so.

contexts.japanese: 言い合いでは決着がつかないと見たのか、二人は最後の選択をこっちに振ってきた。
contexts.english: Just when I thought the argument was going nowhere, they both decide to turn the last choice over to me.

findings.description: Shirou still protests Rin's silence, but the English drops his reminder that she asked for his answer in the first place.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou complains that Rin has prompted his response and then fallen silent when he gives it.
findings.explanation: Shirou still protests Rin's silence, but the English drops his reminder that she asked for his answer in the first place.

contexts.japanese: 「遠坂？　おい、人に話ふっといて無視するな」
contexts.english: "Tohsaka? Hey, don't ignore me when I'm talking to you."

findings.description: Rin's sarcasm about Shirou's attentiveness becomes a direct accusation that he is childish.
findings.sourceReading: Rin sarcastically remarks on the trouble Shirou takes to please Illya.
findings.explanation: Rin's sarcasm about Shirou's attentiveness becomes a direct accusation that he is childish.

contexts.japanese: 「……ふん。お子様のご機嫌とりをするなんて、随分とマメなのね衛宮くんは。なに、もしかして小さい子が好きとか、そういう趣味？」
contexts.english: "...Hmph. You like making children happy, huh? You're pretty childish yourself, Emiya. Don't tell me you're into little girls?"

findings.description: A look like one used to blame the socially vulnerable becomes a look reserved for society's dregs.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou feels Rin's gaze resembles one condemning a socially disadvantaged or weak person.
findings.explanation: A look like one used to blame the socially vulnerable becomes a look reserved for society's dregs.

contexts.japanese: その目がこう、いかにも社会的弱者を責めるようで胃が痛い。
contexts.english: She's giving me a wince-inducing look reserved for the utter dregs of society.

findings.description: Illya's second emphatic embrace disappears.
findings.sourceReading: Illya clings to Shirou with the biggest possible smile after promising to protect him from Rin.
findings.explanation: Illya's second emphatic embrace disappears.

contexts.japanese: にぱっ、とこれ以上ない笑顔で抱きついてくるイリヤ。
contexts.english: Illya beams.

findings.description: Shirou's criticism of his tangled reasoning becomes a joke about protesting too much. It makes the denial sound suspicious without establishing that Rin's insinuation is true.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou recognizes that his explanation has lurched from instinctive choice to a claim about being Illya's guardian.
findings.explanation: Shirou's criticism of his tangled reasoning becomes a joke about protesting too much. It makes the denial sound suspicious without establishing that Rin's insinuation is true.

contexts.japanese: あう、我ながらメチャクチャな論理展開。
contexts.english: Aargh. The man doth protest too much, methinks.

findings.description: Rin accusing Shirou of brazenly doubling down becomes saying his fighting spirit returned.
findings.sourceReading: Rin says he has opened up/brazened it out and stopped trying to excuse the position.
findings.explanation: Rin accusing Shirou of brazenly doubling down becomes saying his fighting spirit returned.

contexts.japanese: 「…………開き直ったわね。まあ、そこまで言うなら認めてあげてもいいけど、桜も大変ね」
contexts.english: "...Looks like you've got your fighting spirit back. If you're going to insist on it that hard, I'll respect your choice, but I feel bad for Sakura."

findings.description: A limit to Shirou's own thinking becomes being out of ideas at this point.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou says what he can devise alone is limited and Rin's ideas would make the plan surer.
findings.explanation: A limit to Shirou's own thinking becomes being out of ideas at this point.

contexts.japanese: 俺の考えじゃ限界があるし、遠坂が知恵を出してくれるならその方が確実だ」
contexts.english: I'm out of ideas at this point, so any knowledge you can spare would give me a surer idea of what to do."

findings.description: An overwhelming explosion entering numbed ears becomes wind and roars physically buffeting Shirou blind.
findings.sourceReading: Through stress-numbed hearing come Berserker's roar, strong wind noise, and an explosive sound so great it overwhelms even vision.
findings.explanation: An overwhelming explosion entering numbed ears becomes wind and roars physically buffeting Shirou blind.

contexts.japanese: 視覚すら覆うほどの、爆音が流れ込んだ。
contexts.english: buffet me so violently I can't even see.

contexts.japanese: ……緊張で麻痺した耳には、狂戦士の咆哮と、強い風鳴りと、
contexts.english: ...In my ears gone numb from stress, the fierce howling of the wind and the mad warrior's roars

findings.description: Many Noble Phantasms exceeding the sword in craftsmanship becomes few being able to rival it.
findings.sourceReading: Numerous Noble Phantasms surpass the sword in fine modeling and skilled ironwork; its superiority lies elsewhere.
findings.explanation: Many Noble Phantasms exceeding the sword in craftsmanship becomes few being able to rival it.

contexts.japanese: 造型の細やかさ、鍛え上げられた鉄の巧みさで言えば、上回る宝具は数あろう。
contexts.english: Few Noble Phantasms can rival its elegant design and fine worksmanship.

findings.description: A sword outside nonhuman craft becomes not a work of mankind.
findings.sourceReading: The sword relies neither on myth nor on inhuman/nonhuman art; it is forged from human thought alone.
findings.explanation: A sword outside nonhuman craft becomes not a work of mankind.

contexts.japanese: 神話に寄らず、人ならざる業にも属さず、ただ想いだけで鍛え上げられた結晶だからこそ—あの剣は空想の身で、最強の座に在り続ける。
contexts.english: Neither a relic of myth nor a work of mankind, it is a crystallization crafted from our feelings alone—a sword of pure fantasy, sitting at the apex.

findings.description: The explanation of Illya's fear loses the immediate threat to her own life. It describes her witnessing Berserker's death instead of facing both his defeat and approaching death herself.
findings.sourceReading: Illya faces both her Servant's defeat and death immediately threatening her.
findings.explanation: The explanation of Illya's fear loses the immediate threat to her own life. It describes her witnessing Berserker's death instead of facing both his defeat and approaching death herself.

contexts.japanese: 自らのサーヴァントの敗北と、目前に迫った死。
contexts.english: Illya just watched her Servant die in battle.

findings.description: A broken helm implying prior head injury becomes an opportunity to inflict head damage.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou infers that because the helm was broken, Saber must already have sustained some damage to the head, and chooses that point.
findings.explanation: A broken helm implying prior head injury becomes an opportunity to inflict head damage.

contexts.japanese: 兜を砕かれた、という事は頭部になんらかのダメージを負っている筈だ。
contexts.english: Now that her helmet is broken, I should be able to do some damage if I go for the head.

findings.description: A precise absolute image of surviving and defeating Saber becomes generic full commitment.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou believes he cannot even contest Saber unless he fights under an absolute image in which he himself survives and defeats the enemy.
findings.explanation: A precise absolute image of surviving and defeating Saber becomes generic full commitment.

contexts.japanese: その、絶対のイメージの下で斬り合わなければ、セイバーとは勝負にもなり得ない—！
contexts.english: Unless I imagine myself fully committing to this, I don't have a chance against her...!

contexts.japanese: 自分は生き延びて敵を倒す。
contexts.english: I'll defeat my enemy and survive.

findings.description: A slash sharp enough to reap rice stalks becomes one precise enough to cut a grain of rice.
findings.sourceReading: The blade sweeps Shirou's exposed neck with the sharpness used to reap ears/stalks of rice.
findings.explanation: A slash sharp enough to reap rice stalks becomes one precise enough to cut a grain of rice.

contexts.japanese: 稲穂を刈る鋭さで、衛宮士郎の無防備な首を薙ぎ払う。
contexts.english: It's a slash precise enough to cut a grain of rice, coming for Shirou Emiya's head.

findings.description: Saber's blade stopping at a single layer of skin becomes stopping shy of the neck.
findings.sourceReading: The sword has reached Shirou and stops at the thin skin of his neck, leaving his head attached.
findings.explanation: Saber's blade stopping at a single layer of skin becomes stopping shy of the neck.

contexts.japanese: セイバーの剣は、俺の薄皮一枚で止まっている。
contexts.english: Saber's sword stops just shy of my neck.

findings.description: Understanding the mechanism of pain becomes getting used to it.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou thinks he has more or less grasped how the pain works, then explains his cooling/heat-transfer model.
findings.explanation: Understanding the mechanism of pain becomes getting used to it.

contexts.japanese: ……痛みの仕組みがどんなモノなのかはだいたい呑み込めた。
contexts.english: ...I've more or less gotten used to how the pain works.

findings.description: An illusion of a blade stirring inside his body becomes almost hearing grinding sounds.
findings.sourceReading: During red vertigo Shirou feels as though a long blade enters at the shoulder and grinds/stirs violently around inside his body.
findings.explanation: An illusion of a blade stirring inside his body becomes almost hearing grinding sounds.

contexts.japanese: この赤い目眩が起きるたび、肩から長い刃物を突き刺され、体ん中をギチギチとかき回される錯覚がする。
contexts.english: Every time the red vertigo comes, I feel a long blade stab me in the shoulder, and I almost think I hear grinding sounds inside my body.

findings.description: Making room or yielding a place in the house becomes surrendering the entire home.
findings.sourceReading: Rin jokes that until the debt is repaid Shirou must obey, including giving up space for her and providing three meals.
findings.explanation: Making room or yielding a place in the house becomes surrendering the entire home.

contexts.japanese: その借りを返すまで、士郎はわたしの言うコトを聞くしかないの。居場所を明け渡せって言えば明け渡してくれるし、ちゃんと三食付きにしてって言ったらしてくれるのよねぇ？」
contexts.english: Until Shirou repays that debt, he has to do what I say. If I order him to surrender his home or cook me three meals a day, he'll gladly comply, won't he?"

findings.description: A guest room Rin noticed inside the detached annex on a prior visit becomes a separate guesthouse seen on the way here.
findings.sourceReading: Rin asks to be shown to the guest room in the detached annex, which she had marked out when previously admitted into the house.
findings.explanation: A guest room Rin noticed inside the detached annex on a prior visit becomes a separate guesthouse seen on the way here.

contexts.japanese: ほら士郎、客間に案内して。前に上がった時、離れの客間に目をつけてたんだから。あ、イリヤはどこがいい？」
contexts.english: Come on, Shirou, take me to a guestroom. I saw a separate guesthouse on the way here. Oh, where do you want to sleep, Illya?"

findings.description: The detached-annex guest room Rin noticed on an earlier visit again becomes a separate guesthouse seen on the way there.
findings.sourceReading: Rin asks for the guest room in the detached annex that she marked out when previously admitted into the house.
findings.explanation: The detached-annex guest room Rin noticed on an earlier visit again becomes a separate guesthouse seen on the way there.

contexts.japanese: 「決まりね。それじゃあがらせてもらうわよ。ほら士郎、客間に案内して。前に上がった時、離れの客間に目をつけてたんだから。あ、イリヤはどこがいい？」
contexts.english: "That settles it then. I'm coming in. Come on, Shirou, take me to a guestroom. I saw a separate guesthouse on the way here. Oh, where do you want to sleep, Illya?"

contexts.japanese: 「？　いや、桜の部屋は離れの客間だけど」
contexts.english: "Huh? Sakura's room is in the separate guesthouse."

findings.description: Illya's sudden emergence from listlessness becomes a loss of enthusiasm. Her hostility toward Sakura is still visible, so the error primarily concerns Illya's changing mood.
findings.sourceReading: Illya's immediately preceding listlessness abruptly disappears as she glares at Sakura.
findings.explanation: Illya's sudden emergence from listlessness becomes a loss of enthusiasm. Her hostility toward Sakura is still visible, so the error primarily concerns Illya's changing mood.

contexts.japanese: さっきまでの元気のなさは何処にいったのか、イリヤは一変して桜を睨んだ。
contexts.english: Illya glares at Sakura, all of her earlier enthusiasm gone.

findings.description: Covers already kicked away during sleep become Shirou kicking them off after waking.
findings.sourceReading: He wakes from difficult sleep with sweat-heavy pajamas and the quilt already kicked away.
findings.explanation: Covers already kicked away during sleep become Shirou kicking them off after waking.

contexts.japanese: 寝巻きは汗を吸って重く、掛け布団は蹴り飛ばされている。
contexts.english: My pajamas are heavy with sweat. I kick off the covers.

findings.description: Iron becomes steel in Shirou's denial about the arm.
findings.sourceReading: As part of his tempting rationalization, Shirou insists his arm is certainly not iron.
findings.explanation: Iron becomes steel in Shirou's denial about the arm.

contexts.japanese: 俺の腕は決して鉄なんかじゃない。
contexts.english: It can't possibly be made of steel.

findings.description: Actually undoing the cloth becomes merely trying to undo it.
findings.sourceReading: On impulse Shirou removes/undoes the cloth for an instant, experiences the fragmented recoil, and rewinds it.
findings.explanation: Actually undoing the cloth becomes merely trying to undo it.

contexts.japanese: 一瞬、思いつきのまま布を解いた。
contexts.english: For a second, I tried undoing the cloth wrap.

findings.description: The English treats Saber becoming Zouken's Servant as established and leaves only the mechanism unknown. The Japanese leaves the relationship itself uncertain.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou does not know whether Saber has become Zouken's Servant; only her hostility is established.
findings.explanation: The English treats Saber becoming Zouken's Servant as established and leaves only the mechanism unknown. The Japanese leaves the relationship itself uncertain.

contexts.japanese: あの“黒い影”がなんなのか、セイバーが臓硯のサーヴァントになったのかも判らない。
contexts.english: I have no idea what that black Shadow is, nor how Saber became Zouken's Servant.

findings.description: Minimizing an immobile arm as no serious problem becomes claiming he still has options.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou orders himself that an arm not moving is nothing serious and to think about something else.
findings.explanation: Minimizing an immobile arm as no serious problem becomes claiming he still has options.

contexts.japanese: 「……大丈夫だ。ただ腕が動かないだけで、どうって事はない。悩むならもっと別のことを考えろ」
contexts.english: "...It'll be okay. I can't move the arm, but I still have options. There's plenty of other stuff to worry about."

findings.description: Thinking about how to save Sakura becomes postponing concern for himself. The surrounding English still establishes her urgent need for help.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou directs his present thinking toward how to defeat Zouken and obtain the Grail before Sakura collapses.
findings.explanation: Thinking about how to save Sakura becomes postponing concern for himself. The surrounding English still establishes her urgent need for help.

contexts.japanese: 悩むのならその方法だ。
contexts.english: I can worry about myself after that.

findings.description: The refusal branch repeats the presupposition that Saber became Zouken's Servant.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou does not know whether Saber entered a contract with Zouken.
findings.explanation: The refusal branch repeats the presupposition that Saber became Zouken's Servant.

contexts.japanese: あの“黒い影”がなんなのか、セイバーが臓硯のサーヴァントになったのかも判らない。
contexts.english: I have no idea what that black Shadow is, nor how Saber became Zouken's Servant.

findings.description: Rider carrying the group becomes carrying Shirou alone.
findings.sourceReading: Rider confirms that she transported Shirou and the others from the forest to the church under Sakura's order.
findings.explanation: Rider carrying the group becomes carrying Shirou alone.

contexts.japanese: 「……そうですね。貴方たちを運んだのは私です。サクラは貴方を守れと言った。私はサーヴァントとして、彼女の命に従ったまでです」
contexts.english: "...Yes. I carried you there. Sakura told me to protect you. I merely obeyed her order, as her Servant."

findings.description: Shirou being Sakura's salvation becomes him having already saved her.
findings.sourceReading: Rider says the trustworthy core beneath his immaturity is why he was/is a source of salvation for Sakura.
findings.explanation: Shirou being Sakura's salvation becomes him having already saved her.

contexts.japanese: 貴方は未熟で不器用ですが、その芯にあるものは信用に足ります。だからこそ、サクラにとって貴方は救いだったのでしょう」
contexts.english: You are clumsy and inexperienced, but trustworthy at your core. That is how you have saved Sakura."

findings.description: Rider's words being true becomes Rider being sincere.
findings.sourceReading: Because Rider shares Sakura's sensations, Shirou treats what she says as unmistakable truth.
findings.explanation: Rider's words being true becomes Rider being sincere.

contexts.japanese: ただ、マスターである桜と感覚を共有するライダーの言葉は紛れもない真実だ。
contexts.english: But her words are utterly sincere, coming from someone who shares her senses with her Master.

findings.description: Two years that constituted happiness become the happiest time of Sakura's life.
findings.sourceReading: Rider says those two years themselves were happiness for Sakura.
findings.explanation: Two years that constituted happiness become the happiest time of Sakura's life.

contexts.japanese: サクラにとっては、この二年間こそが幸福だった」
contexts.english: these last two years have been the happiest times of her life."

findings.description: Rider's claim that Sakura wants Shirou alive beside her omits alive.
findings.sourceReading: Rider defines Sakura's happiness as Shirou living and remaining at her side, and claims she wants nothing else.
findings.explanation: Rider's claim that Sakura wants Shirou alive beside her omits alive.

contexts.japanese: サクラの幸福は、貴方が生きて傍にいてくれる、という事。それ以外に彼女が望むものなどない」
contexts.english: What makes Sakura happy is having you by her side. She does not wish for anything else."

findings.description: Shirou gripping his immobile left arm becomes trying to clench the immobile left hand.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou uses his other hand to grip/clutch the left arm that will not move.
findings.explanation: Shirou gripping his immobile left arm becomes trying to clench the immobile left hand.

contexts.japanese: ……動かない左腕を握り締める。
contexts.english: ...I try to clench my unmoving left hand.

findings.description: Becoming nobody becomes merely having nothing left.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou believes that if he stops the Sakura-only fight he has chosen, he will become no one at all.
findings.explanation: Becoming nobody becomes merely having nothing left.

contexts.japanese: だから—ここでそれを止めてしまったら、俺は何者でもなくなってしまう。
contexts.english: That's why...if I stop here, then I'll have nothing left.

findings.description: Shirou realizing the condition's implication becomes Rider noticing his inability to answer.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou could not answer because he himself had noticed what Rider's no-matter-what condition points toward.
findings.explanation: Shirou realizing the condition's implication becomes Rider noticing his inability to answer.

contexts.japanese: 答えを言えなかったのは、気付いてしまったからだ。
contexts.english: She noticed that I couldn't give her a clear answer.

findings.description: The expanding Shadow avoiding Shirou's depression becomes Shirou evading it in a ditch.
findings.sourceReading: Uneven ground shelters Shirou in a hollow: the Shadow passes around/avoids him, except for the exposed left arm.
findings.explanation: The expanding Shadow avoiding Shirou's depression becomes Shirou evading it in a ditch.

contexts.japanese: 広がった黒い影は窪みにいた衛宮士郎を避けて通った。
contexts.english: Shirou Emiya evaded the Shadow in a ditch.

contexts.japanese: 森の地面が凹凸だった事が幸いしたのだ。
contexts.english: He was fortunate that the forest terrain is filled with crags and valleys.

findings.description: The English makes Sakura imagine injuring Shirou herself. The Japanese gives her a disturbing wish that he be injured, while leaving its cause unspecified.
findings.sourceReading: Sakura recalls wishing that Shirou would sustain an injury severe enough to keep him indoors. The thought does not specify who would cause it.
findings.explanation: The English makes Sakura imagine injuring Shirou herself. The Japanese gives her a disturbing wish that he be injured, while leaving its cause unspecified.

contexts.japanese: 衛宮士郎が外に出られないぐらいの怪我をすれば、もう危ない目にあわなくてすむ、と。
contexts.english: If she injured Shirou Emiya so that he couldn't go outside, then he wouldn't be in danger anymore.

findings.description: A reckless wish becomes a fickle wish.
findings.sourceReading: Sakura recognizes how careless and rash it was to wish for an incapacitating injury.
findings.explanation: A reckless wish becomes a fickle wish.

contexts.japanese: 外に出られないぐらいの怪我がいい、なんて、どれほど軽率な願いだったのか。
contexts.english: How fickle of her to wish that he'd get hurt enough not to go outside.

findings.description: The Japanese says Shirou suffered an injury independently of Sakura’s wish. The English explicitly says she hurt him. This adds an agent to the clause without settling the wider cause of the injury.
findings.sourceReading: 彼女の願いとは関係なく separates the actual injury from her earlier wish; 衛宮士郎は傷を負った does not explicitly name Sakura as the actor who inflicted it.
findings.explanation: The Japanese says Shirou suffered an injury independently of Sakura’s wish. The English explicitly says she hurt him. This adds an agent to the clause without settling the wider cause of the injury.

contexts.japanese: 彼女の願いとは関係なく、衛宮士郎は傷を負った。
contexts.english: And now, she'd hurt Shirou Emiya in a way that had nothing to do with her wish.

findings.description: No meaningful difference between incapacitating and life-threatening injury becomes both events actually happening.
findings.sourceReading: Sakura realizes that wishing for injury sufficient to confine him and confronting a life-threatening wound are not safely separable categories: injury can mean this.
findings.explanation: No meaningful difference between incapacitating and life-threatening injury becomes both events actually happening.

contexts.japanese: その二つに違いなどない。
contexts.english: Both of these things actually happened.

findings.description: Archer creating projected weapons becomes him forging the original paired swords too.
findings.sourceReading: Because Archer is a forging-associated Heroic Spirit, he creates; anything seen and understood can be reproduced through Projection.
findings.explanation: Archer creating projected weapons becomes him forging the original paired swords too.

contexts.japanese: だから作る。
contexts.english: So he forged them, too.

findings.description: A frantic warning not to disrupt time and order becomes losing track of time and getting out of order.
findings.sourceReading: In overloaded internal protest, Shirou insists time must not be thrown out of joint and order must not be disturbed.
findings.explanation: A frantic warning not to disrupt time and order becomes losing track of time and getting out of order.

contexts.japanese: 時間を狂わせてはいけない秩序を乱してはいけないおまえが俺に手を貸すなんて、そんな事をされても俺には扱える技量がない—
contexts.english: Can't lose track of time, can't get out of order, even if you help me, I don't have the skill to handle it—

findings.description: Slightly controlling the foreign element becomes controlling the pain.
findings.sourceReading: Once Shirou identifies the foreign body's source, he can exert some control over it and build a barrier preventing mixture with his core body.
findings.explanation: Slightly controlling the foreign element becomes controlling the pain.

contexts.japanese: 痛みの元、異物がなんであるか判れば多少はコントロールできる。
contexts.english: If I know the source of the pain, the foreign element, then I can slightly control the pain.

findings.description: Being unable to remove the restraining garment alone becomes being unable to change clothes.
findings.sourceReading: All but the right arm is fixed, and Shirou cannot take off the restraint by himself.
findings.explanation: Being unable to remove the restraining garment alone becomes being unable to change clothes.

contexts.japanese: その証拠に、動かせるのは右腕だけ。それ以外の個所はがっちり固定されていて、一人では脱げないようになっている。
contexts.english: The fact I can only move my right arm is proof enough. Everything else is fixed tightly in place. I can't even change my own clothes like this.

findings.description: The English supplies a lobby as Illya's destination. It preserves the dismissal and her refusal to leave Shirou alone, so this detail does not support the character dossier.
findings.sourceReading: Kotomine tells Illya to leave the room if she has no business there.
findings.explanation: The English supplies a lobby as Illya's destination. It preserves the dismissal and her refusal to leave Shirou alone, so this detail does not support the character dossier.

contexts.japanese: 「あちらも持ち直した。こちらは事後説明だけだからな、用がなければ退室したまえ」
contexts.english: "She's recovering as well. I'm only going to debrief him, so if you don't have any business here, go wait in the lobby."

findings.description: Kirei stripping Shirou naked becomes merely exposing some skin.
findings.sourceReading: He undoes the restraint belts and readily leaves Shirou naked, revealing the wrapped foreign arm.
findings.explanation: Kirei stripping Shirou naked becomes merely exposing some skin.

contexts.japanese: 神父は拘束着のベルトを解いて、あっさりと俺を裸にした。
contexts.english: The priest undoes the belt, exposing my skin.

findings.description: Archer being brought to the church near death becomes Archer bringing Shirou there.
findings.sourceReading: After the completed transplant Archer vanishes; he was already moribund when he himself was transported there, and endured through the procedure via Independent Action.
findings.explanation: Archer being brought to the church near death becomes Archer bringing Shirou there.

contexts.japanese: 「移植が済んだ後、消滅した。ここに運ばれた時点で死に体だったのだが、よくも終わるまで保ったものだ。アーチャーの持つ単独行動故だろうがな」
contexts.english: "After the transplant, he disappeared. He was already on the verge of death when he brought you here. I'm surprised he lasted so long. It must be thanks to his Independent Action ability."

findings.description: Pain and attempted activation become alternatives.
findings.sourceReading: Even ordinary magical-energy circulation will cause both pain in the left arm and recoil as it tries to activate.
findings.explanation: Pain and attempted activation become alternatives.

contexts.japanese: だが安心はするなよ。魔術行使をせずとも、生きている限り魔力は肉体に通るものだ。その度に左腕には痛みと、起動しようとする反動が起きるだろう。
