counterexamples.sourceReading: Air-like-water weight signals Sakura and sends them to the courtyard.
counterexamples.explanation: Shadow pressure arrives before yard run.

contexts.japanese: 空気が水になったような重圧が屋敷を覆う。
contexts.english: A heavy pressure that makes it feel as though the air has turned to water covers the building.

counterexamples.description: Orientation conditional on attention retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He can still recognize his situation if he avoids spacing out.
counterexamples.explanation: Orientation conditional on attention retained.

contexts.japanese: 気を抜かなければ今まで通り状況を認識できる。
contexts.english: As long as I don't space out, I can be aware of my situation, like I have been so far.

counterexamples.description: Sakura says flee and Rin says fight retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Two characters advocate opposing immediate responses.
counterexamples.explanation: Sakura says flee and Rin says fight retained.

contexts.japanese: 逃げろという桜と、戦うといった遠坂。
contexts.english: Sakura told us to run. Tohsaka said that she'd fight.

counterexamples.description: Unexplained prone position retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He comes to sprawled in the shed without knowing how or why.
counterexamples.explanation: Unexplained prone position retained.

contexts.japanese: 気がつくと、だらしなく土蔵に寝っころがっていた。
contexts.english: When I came to, I was sprawled out in the shed.

counterexamples.description: Until-dawn ability remains his forecast.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He thinks he should be able to fight as before until morning despite loss.
counterexamples.explanation: Until-dawn ability remains his forecast.

contexts.japanese: 少なくとも夜が明けるまでは、今まで通りに戦える筈だ。
contexts.english: I should be able to fight like I have so far until morning, at least.

counterexamples.description: Rider tests recognition.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She asks whether he recognizes her after observing his bad appearance.
counterexamples.explanation: Rider tests recognition.

contexts.japanese: 「酷い顔色ですね。私が認識できますか、士郎」
contexts.english: "You look awful. Do you recognize me, Shirou?"

counterexamples.description: Unlit rear appearance retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Black-clothed Servant stands where moonlight does not reach.
counterexamples.explanation: Unlit rear appearance retained.

contexts.japanese: 月光の届かない闇の中、黒い装束のサーヴァントが立っていた。
contexts.english: a black-clothed Servant stands in the dark.

counterexamples.description: Waiting until alone stays an impression.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Narrator thinks Rider waited for him to be alone.
counterexamples.explanation: Waiting until alone stays an impression.

contexts.japanese: ライダーは俺が一人になるのを待っていたかのようだ。
contexts.english: It seems that she was waiting for me to be alone.

counterexamples.description: Explicit kill threat blocks access to Sakura.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rider calls them Sakura’s enemies and says she came to kill him.
counterexamples.explanation: Explicit kill threat blocks access to Sakura.

contexts.japanese: 「貴方を殺す為ですね。貴方たちはサクラの敵です。なら、このままサクラの下になど行かせるワケにはいかない」
contexts.english: "To kill you. You are Sakura's enemies. I cannot let you go to her."

counterexamples.description: Unfinished response remains unfinished.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Scene ends at I— rather than a completed decision.
counterexamples.explanation: Unfinished response remains unfinished.

contexts.japanese: 俺は—

counterexamples.description: Relative speed obstacle retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rider can close faster than Shirou can leap back.
counterexamples.explanation: Relative speed obstacle retained.

contexts.japanese: 問題は、俺の跳び退くスピードより、ライダーの詰め寄ってくるスピードの方が速いという事。
contexts.english: The problem is that Rider can close in on me faster than I can leap back.

counterexamples.description: Snake image retained as simile.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Darkness makes Rider resemble a huge snake waiting for prey.
counterexamples.explanation: Snake image retained as simile.

contexts.japanese: ……土蔵の暗さの為か、闇に佇み、獲物を狙う姿は巨大な蛇のようでもある。
contexts.english: Maybe it's just the poor lighting in the shed, but standing in the dark, she reminds me of a giant snake about to strike its prey.

counterexamples.description: Dodge precedes backward jump.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He avoids the weapon before retreating.
counterexamples.explanation: Dodge precedes backward jump.

contexts.japanese: 後ろに跳び退く前に、振るわれた短剣を回避した。
contexts.english: I dodge a dagger before I jump back.

counterexamples.description: Exhilaration from escaping stronger opponent retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Avoiding her attack and using the opening to escape raises his heartbeat.
counterexamples.explanation: Exhilaration from escaping stronger opponent retained.

contexts.japanese: 実力で勝るライダーの短剣を躱せた事と、隙をついて土蔵から脱出できた喜びで心拍数が上昇する。
contexts.english: My heartbeat rises with the exhilaration of avoiding Rider's daggers and taking the opportunity to escape, when she's stronger than me.

counterexamples.description: Beating Rider still an unfinished objective.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He thinks he must somehow win after escaping.
counterexamples.explanation: Beating Rider still an unfinished objective.

contexts.japanese: 戦いは始まったばかりだ、ここからなんとかライダーを打ち負かさない、と—
contexts.english: The fight has just begun. I need to find some way to beat Rider, or else...

counterexamples.description: Skill-based reason for sparing him retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rider says his ability cannot kill Sakura, so killing him here is unnecessary.
counterexamples.explanation: Skill-based reason for sparing him retained.

contexts.japanese: 「……興が冷めました。貴方の技量ではサクラを殺す事は出来ない。ここで、私が手を下すまでもありません」
contexts.english: "...You have lost my interest. You cannot kill Sakura with your meager skills. I don't even need to finish you off."

counterexamples.description: Departure remains inferred.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Fading presence leads him to suppose she has left.
counterexamples.explanation: Departure remains inferred.

contexts.japanese: 屋敷から外に出たのだろう。
contexts.english: She must have left the house.

counterexamples.description: Tentative spared interpretation survives on held page.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He wonders whether Rider let him go.
counterexamples.explanation: Tentative spared interpretation survives on held page.

contexts.japanese: 見逃して、くれたんだろうか。
contexts.english: Did she...let me go?

counterexamples.description: Circuits activate before any materialized weapon.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He starts Magic Circuits while watching Rider.
counterexamples.explanation: Circuits activate before any materialized weapon.

contexts.japanese: ライダーを見据えたまま、魔術回路を立ち上げる。
contexts.english: I start up my Magic Circuits, keeping my eyes on Rider.

counterexamples.description: Weapon withheld until last instant.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Projection with weapon ruby is not released yet.
counterexamples.explanation: Weapon withheld until last instant.

contexts.japanese: ……投影はギリギリまで出さない。
contexts.english: ...I won't Project my weapons until the last possible second.

counterexamples.description: Instant counterattack remains prospective.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He intends to form a sword when Rider steps in and intercept her.
counterexamples.explanation: Instant counterattack remains prospective.

contexts.japanese: ライダーが俺に踏み込んできた瞬間、ゼロ秒で剣を作り上げ全力で迎撃する—！
contexts.english: The instant Rider moves towards me, I'll create a sword in zero seconds flat and intercept her with all my might!

counterexamples.description: Person-as-Noble-Phantasm use direction retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rider cannot fully employ Shirou, while a skilled swordsman could.
counterexamples.explanation: Person-as-Noble-Phantasm use direction retained.

contexts.japanese: 「…………投影魔術。私では貴方を使いこなせませんが、優れた剣士なら、貴方という宝具を最大限に発揮できるのでしょうね」
contexts.english: "...Projection magecraft. I cannot use you to your full potential, but an excellent swordsman might be able to best utilize you as a Noble Phantasm."

counterexamples.description: Apparent mind reading remains comparison.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Narrator thinks she withdrew as if reading his intention.
counterexamples.explanation: Apparent mind reading remains comparison.

contexts.japanese: こっちの考えを読んだのか、ライダーはあっさりと引き下がった。
contexts.english: She withdraws, as if she's read my mind.

counterexamples.description: Explicit sparing declaration retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rider says she will let him go and cannot use him.
counterexamples.explanation: Explicit sparing declaration retained.

contexts.japanese: 「見逃してあげます。私では貴方を使えない。
contexts.english: "I will let you go. I cannot use you.

counterexamples.description: Shirou still tentatively interprets being spared.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He questions her purpose despite her words.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou still tentatively interprets being spared.

contexts.japanese: 見逃して、くれたんだろうか。
contexts.english: Did she...let me go?

counterexamples.description: Self-command to remember retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: After failing to retrieve what she asked, he commands himself to remember.
counterexamples.explanation: Self-command to remember retained.

contexts.japanese: 思い出せ。
contexts.english: Remember.

counterexamples.description: Earlier resolve question remains attempted recollection.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He thinks she asked if he could fight to the end whatever happened.
counterexamples.explanation: Earlier resolve question remains attempted recollection.

contexts.japanese: 何があっても、最後まで戦えるか、と問われたのではなかったか。
contexts.english: I think she asked me whether I would keep fighting until the end, no matter what.

counterexamples.description: Rescue aim and unknown result retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He wants to save Sakura as Rider protects her and cannot run, without knowing result.
counterexamples.explanation: Rescue aim and unknown result retained.

contexts.japanese: 「……ライダー。俺は最後まで戦う。おまえが桜を守ろうとするように、俺だって桜を助けたい。それがどんな結果になるかは判らないけど、逃げる事は出来ない。
contexts.english: "...Rider. I'll fight until the very end. I want to save Sakura, just like you want to protect her. I don't know how it'll turn out, but I can't run from this.

counterexamples.description: Resolve accepted while method rejected.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rider understands his determination but says that cannot save Sakura.
counterexamples.explanation: Resolve accepted while method rejected.

contexts.japanese: 「貴方の覚悟は分かりました。ですが、それではサクラは救えない」
contexts.english: "I understand your conviction. But that cannot save Sakura."

counterexamples.description: Separate means rather than secured alliance retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She says each should pursue their own fight and she will use her own means to save Sakura.
counterexamples.explanation: Separate means rather than secured alliance retained.

contexts.japanese: 「貴方は貴方の戦いをすればいい。私は私に出来る手段でサクラを救います」
contexts.english: "Fight your war. I will do whatever I can to save Sakura."

counterexamples.description: Distant voice and nonreturn expectation retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Voice recedes and he has no impression of her coming back.
counterexamples.explanation: Distant voice and nonreturn expectation retained.

contexts.japanese: 声は遠く、返ってくる気配はない。
contexts.english: Her voice is distant, and it doesn't sound like she's coming back.

counterexamples.description: Not giving up recollection differs from fighting variant.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He tentatively recalls a question about refusing to give up; EN keep trying preserves this alternative to script17 keep fighting.
counterexamples.explanation: Not giving up recollection differs from fighting variant.

contexts.japanese: 何があっても、最後まで諦めないか、と問われたのではなかったか。
contexts.english: I think she asked me whether I would keep trying until the end, no matter what.

counterexamples.description: Rider accepts resolve but rejects proposed method.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She understands conviction yet says that approach cannot save Sakura.
counterexamples.explanation: Rider accepts resolve but rejects proposed method.

contexts.japanese: 「貴方の覚悟は分かりました。ですが、それではサクラは救えない」
contexts.english: "I understand your conviction. But that cannot save Sakura."

counterexamples.description: Distant voice nonreturn remains intact on held unit.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He senses no return while her voice recedes.
counterexamples.explanation: Distant voice nonreturn remains intact on held unit.

contexts.japanese: 声は遠く、返ってくる気配はない。
contexts.english: Her voice is distant, and it doesn't sound like she's coming back.

counterexamples.description: Allegiance answer preserves decisive distinction.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Earlier recalled question concerns being on Sakura’s side whatever happens.
counterexamples.explanation: Allegiance answer preserves decisive distinction.

contexts.japanese: どんな事になろうと、最後まで桜の味方が出来るのか、と。
contexts.english: She wanted to know whether I would be on Sakura's side until the very end, no matter what.

counterexamples.description: Shirou explicitly rejects killing motive.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He says he is going to save her, not kill her.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou explicitly rejects killing motive.

contexts.japanese: 「殺す為じゃない。救う為に行くんだ。
contexts.english: "I'm not going to kill her. I'm going to save her.

counterexamples.description: Choosing Sakura whatever happens retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Protect to end and choose her regardless of result.
counterexamples.explanation: Choosing Sakura whatever happens retained.

contexts.japanese: ライダー。俺は最後まで桜を守る。どんな事になろうと桜を選ぶ」
contexts.english: Rider, I'll protect Sakura until the very end. No matter what happens, I will always choose her."

counterexamples.description: Need for Rider acknowledged.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Shirou says he and Rin cannot rescue Sakura alone and asks help.
counterexamples.explanation: Need for Rider acknowledged.

contexts.japanese: 「その為に—アンタの力を貸してくれ。俺と遠坂だけじゃ桜を助けられない。桜を本当に大切に思ってくれるなら、今だけでも手を貸してくれ」
contexts.english: "But to do that...I need your help. Tohsaka and I can't save her alone. If you really care about Sakura, then please help me, just this once."

counterexamples.description: Rider recognizes earlier-question answer.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She explicitly asks whether his response answers what she asked before.
counterexamples.explanation: Rider recognizes earlier-question answer.

contexts.japanese: いつぞやの質問の回答、という事ですか」
contexts.english: ...your answer to the question I asked before?"

counterexamples.description: Alliance conditional on chance of success.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rider refuses a hopeless battle and asks expected role.
counterexamples.explanation: Alliance conditional on chance of success.

contexts.japanese: ですが私は勝算のない戦いには赴きません。貴方は私に何を期待するのですか、士郎」
contexts.english: But I will not participate in a battle with no chance of victory. What do you expect me to do, Shirou?"

counterexamples.description: One-on-one Saber task retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Shirou assigns Rider to defeat Saber individually before whispering details.
counterexamples.explanation: One-on-one Saber task retained.

contexts.japanese: ライダー。アンタには一対一でセイバーを倒してもらう。具体的に言うとだな—」
contexts.english: Rider, I want you to beat Saber one-on-one. To be specific..."

counterexamples.description: Precaution does not certify eavesdropper.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He whispers despite no one actually listening.
counterexamples.explanation: Precaution does not certify eavesdropper.

contexts.japanese: ……誰が聞いている訳でもないが、一応用心というヤツだ。
contexts.english: ...It's not like anyone's listening to us, but I'm just being safe.

counterexamples.description: Skill and trust remain unresolved conditions.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Method depends on his skill and her trust in it.
counterexamples.explanation: Skill and trust remain unresolved conditions.

contexts.japanese: 「貴方の技量と、貴方の技量を私がどこまで信頼できるか、ですね」
contexts.english: "Your skills, and how much I can trust them."

counterexamples.description: Temporary master recognition retained on intact entry.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She recognizes him temporarily through trust.
counterexamples.explanation: Temporary master recognition retained on intact entry.

contexts.japanese: 「承知しました。貴方を信頼し、一時の主人と認めましょう」
contexts.english: "I understand. I will trust you and temporarily recognize you as my Master."

counterexamples.description: Midnight agreed departure retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Clock reaches agreed midnight.
counterexamples.explanation: Midnight agreed departure retained.

contexts.japanese: 午前零時、約束の時間になった。
contexts.english: It's midnight, the time we agreed on.

counterexamples.description: Both reasons Illya stays retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Zouken targets her and Shirou also wants her to remain.
counterexamples.explanation: Both reasons Illya stays retained.

contexts.japanese: 臓硯がイリヤを狙っている、という事もあるが、イリヤに残ってもらうのは俺の希望でもあるからだ。
contexts.english: It's true that Zouken's targeting Illya, but it's also my wish for her to stay here.

counterexamples.description: Pain cessation is deterioration, not recovery.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Biological functions are being eroded.
counterexamples.explanation: Pain cessation is deterioration, not recovery.

contexts.japanese: 生物としての機能が少しずつこそぎ落ちているだけだ。
contexts.english: My functions as a living creature are just slowly being eroded.

counterexamples.description: Stopping threatens awareness retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He loses track of what he is doing if he stops.
counterexamples.explanation: Stopping threatens awareness retained.

contexts.japanese: 立ち止まっていると、自分が何をしているか判らなくなる。
contexts.english: If I stop, I won't know what I'm doing.

counterexamples.description: Night-search complaint and reversal retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He complains about visibility despite stars, then realizes he can see.
counterexamples.explanation: Night-search complaint and reversal retained.

contexts.japanese: 「……無茶言うなあ。星が出てるからって、夜の森で周りが見通せるかって—」
contexts.english: "...Don't be ridiculous. You think I can see in the forest at night just because the stars are out?"

counterexamples.description: Stream source directs entrance search.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Water comes from rocky ground rather than upper mountain.
counterexamples.explanation: Stream source directs entrance search.

contexts.japanese: ……小川は山の上からではなく、岩が重なりあった地面から涌いていた。
contexts.english: ...The stream isn't flowing from up the mountain, but from a patch of earth covered in rocks.

counterexamples.description: Rin directs touch-through test.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She identifies right site and tells him to touch back rock to pass through.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin directs touch-through test.

contexts.japanese: 「—いいえ、ここで当たりよ士郎。奥の岩に触ってみなさい。簡単にすり抜けるから」
contexts.english: "No, this is the right place. Try touching the rock furthest in the back. You'll be able to slip through easily."

counterexamples.description: Back-down cramped descent retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He must descend on his back to avoid tumbling.
counterexamples.explanation: Back-down cramped descent retained.

contexts.japanese: 背中をつけて下っていかなければ、すぐさま無限の闇へ転がり落ちていきそうだ。
contexts.english: I'll tumble down into the infinite darkness unless I slowly go down on my back.

counterexamples.description: Rin’s declared intention to kill Sakura remains explicit.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She explains why entrusting her a weapon is troubling.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin’s declared intention to kill Sakura remains explicit.

contexts.japanese: 「—だから。わたしは桜を殺すって言ってるのよ。
contexts.english: "Because. I said I was going to kill Sakura.

counterexamples.description: Shirou still needs Rin despite conflict.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He dislikes the weapon-risk situation but cannot rescue Sakura without her.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou still needs Rin despite conflict.

contexts.japanese: 「よくない。よくないけど、遠坂がいないと桜は助けられない。桜を助けたいんなら、一人より二人の方が確実だろ。
contexts.english: "I'm not okay with it. But I can't save Sakura without you, and we have a better chance together than alone.

counterexamples.description: Unfulfillable war-victor promise remains identified.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He promised Rin victory in Holy Grail War.
counterexamples.explanation: Unfulfillable war-victor promise remains identified.

contexts.japanese: 聖杯戦争の勝者を遠坂にすると約束した。
contexts.english: I promised to make Tohsaka the victor of the Holy Grail War.

counterexamples.description: Retrospective affection retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She is the girl he liked then, who believed in him when he had nothing.
counterexamples.explanation: Retrospective affection retained.

contexts.japanese: 何も無かった俺を信じてくれた、遠坂凛っていう、好きだった女の子の為に。
contexts.english: For Rin Tohsaka, the girl I liked at the time, who believed in me when I had nothing left.

counterexamples.description: Excess life causes nausea retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Too much raw vitality disgusts him.
counterexamples.explanation: Excess life causes nausea retained.

contexts.japanese: その、あまりの生々しさに吐き気がする。
contexts.english: It's so raw that it makes me nauseous.

counterexamples.description: Blood trail prompts unnamed predecessor question.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He asks whether someone arrived before them.
counterexamples.explanation: Blood trail prompts unnamed predecessor question.

contexts.japanese: 俺たちより先に来た者がいるのか。
contexts.english: Did someone get here before us?

counterexamples.description: Painful pendant is right-hand anchor.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He squeezes it tightly in his right hand to retain himself.
counterexamples.explanation: Painful pendant is right-hand anchor.

contexts.japanese: 右手に持ったペンダントを強く握る。
contexts.english: I grip the pendant tightly in my right hand.

counterexamples.description: Only Saber visible in cavern retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Sakura, Zouken, and Assassin are absent from sight here.
counterexamples.explanation: Only Saber visible in cavern retained.

contexts.japanese: 空洞には彼女しかいない。
contexts.english: She's the only one in the cave.

counterexamples.description: Secret weapon preservation retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He knows ways to counter Saber and wants jeweled sword hidden from remaining enemies.
counterexamples.explanation: Secret weapon preservation retained.

contexts.japanese: 手の内が判っているセイバーなら、こっちにも対抗策がある。まだ臓硯とアサシンが控えている状況で、唯一“秘密”である宝石剣を使うのは—
contexts.english: I know Saber, so there are ways to deal with her. We shouldn't reveal our only secret weapon while Zouken and Assassin could still be waiting—

counterexamples.description: Former quiet Saber voice retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Narration explicitly connects this voice to her former one.
counterexamples.explanation: Former quiet Saber voice retained.

contexts.japanese: セイバーは静かな、以前と同じ声で、戦おうとする遠坂を諌める。
contexts.english: Saber's quiet voice is the same as ever. It stops Rin in her tracks.

counterexamples.description: Rin states trust despite unknown outcome.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She does not know what will happen but trusts him to meet expectations.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin states trust despite unknown outcome.

contexts.japanese: 「士郎。アンタがどうなるかは知らないけど、わたしは信頼してるんだから。ちゃんと期待に応えてよね」
contexts.english: "Shirou. I don't know what will happen to you, but I trust you. Make sure you live up to that."

counterexamples.description: Saber predicts he cannot leave.
counterexamples.sourceReading: His attachment to Sakura makes departure impossible for him in this situation.
counterexamples.explanation: Saber predicts he cannot leave.

contexts.japanese: 「—それは時間の問題だ。この局面で貴方が立ち去れる筈がない」
contexts.english: "It is only a matter of time. You're not going to leave."

counterexamples.description: Fraction of Saber’s sparring strength correctly retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: 一分以下 means below one tenth here, not less than a minute.
counterexamples.explanation: Fraction of Saber’s sparring strength correctly retained.

contexts.japanese: 道場で試合をした時、セイバーは一分以下の力で俺と打ち合い、俺は彼女に一撃も与えられなかった。
contexts.english: When we sparred in the dojo, Saber used less than a tenth of her strength against me, and I never managed to land a single blow.

counterexamples.description: Saber waits without moving from position.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She expects his approach rather than charging first.
counterexamples.explanation: Saber waits without moving from position.

contexts.japanese: あいつはあの場所から一歩も動かず、俺が踏み込むのを待っている。
contexts.english: She's waiting for me to approach, and she isn't going to move from her position.

counterexamples.description: Previous Projection approach already insufficient.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He knows the Berserker solution alone cannot beat Saber.
counterexamples.explanation: Previous Projection approach already insufficient.

contexts.japanese: その方法では彼女には敵わないと、とうに結論は出ているのだが。
contexts.english: I've already concluded that this won't be enough to beat her.

counterexamples.description: Low-burden sword choice retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: These projected master swords burden him least.
counterexamples.explanation: Low-burden sword choice retained.

contexts.japanese: 投影の中でも、最も負担の少ない名剣。
contexts.english: They're the master-crafted swords that burden my Projection the least.

counterexamples.description: Initial tactical calculation discarded retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He abandons first-move prediction and evasion planning to charge.
counterexamples.explanation: Initial tactical calculation discarded retained.

contexts.japanese: 一手目の選択、セイバーの迎撃の予測、その対応と回避方法、一切を切り捨てて地面を蹴った。
contexts.english: Choosing my first move, predicting Saber's interception, countering and evading—I push it all aside and charge at her.

counterexamples.description: Archer’s skill copied along with swords.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Projection includes combat skill, not only objects.
counterexamples.explanation: Archer’s skill copied along with swords.

contexts.japanese: 俺はアーチャーの腕から、ヤツの戦闘技術ごと双剣を複製した。
contexts.english: I've copied Archer's skills with the dual swords from his arm.

counterexamples.description: Joy accepts borrowed knowledge and skill.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He delights in keeping up regardless of borrowing.
counterexamples.explanation: Joy accepts borrowed knowledge and skill.

contexts.japanese: 借り物の知識、借り物の技量だろうと構わない。
contexts.english: I don't care that it's with borrowed knowledge and skills.

counterexamples.description: Holy-sword power withheld with motive uncertain.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Context contrasts swordsmanship with using holy sword’s power; cave collapse or other motive remains speculative.
counterexamples.explanation: Holy-sword power withheld with motive uncertain.

contexts.japanese: こんな洞窟で聖剣を使えば天井を崩すからか、それとも別の理由か、とにかくセイバーは剣技だけで俺と戦っている。
contexts.english: Maybe it's because the ceiling will cave in if she uses her sword, or maybe it's some other reason, but for now, Saber's fighting me with her swordsmanship only.

counterexamples.description: Two steps at ten-meter gap retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Even Saber needs a couple steps to cover reset distance.
counterexamples.explanation: Two steps at ten-meter gap retained.

contexts.japanese: いかにセイバーといえど、接近するには二歩必要とする距離だ。
contexts.english: Even Saber would need a couple steps to close the distance.

counterexamples.description: Five more blows remain estimated.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He thinks he can withstand five more, then cannot predict.
counterexamples.explanation: Five more blows remain estimated.

contexts.japanese: これならあと五回はセイバーの剣を受けられる。
contexts.english: I should be able to take five more of Saber's attacks.

counterexamples.description: Bloodlessness and sword innards do not prevent limit.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Saber warns his body is still at its end despite those altered features.
counterexamples.explanation: Bloodlessness and sword innards do not prevent limit.

contexts.japanese: 「その体でよく吠える。……いえ、その体だからこそ無謀な策を強行する。いかに血が出ず、いかに中身が剣になろうと、貴方の肉体は限界だ。このまま打ち合えば、次はその剣ごと粉砕する」
contexts.english: "You would still howl that, with that body? ...No, you attempt such reckless ploys because of that very body. You may not bleed, and your innards may be made of swords, but your body is at its limit. If you continue this, my next strike will destroy you, swords and all."

counterexamples.description: Reserved rescue Projection useless without reaching Sakura.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Saving a final use is pointless if Saber blocks access.
counterexamples.explanation: Reserved rescue Projection useless without reaching Sakura.

contexts.japanese: それも、桜に到達できないのでは何の意味もない。
contexts.english: It won't mean anything if I can't even reach her.

counterexamples.description: Rin rescue assurance stays Saber’s claim.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Saber says without her Rin will save Sakura.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin rescue assurance stays Saber’s claim.

contexts.japanese: 「そういう事です。私さえいなければ、彼女は必ず桜を救う」
contexts.english: "Exactly. She will assuredly save Sakura if I am not there."

counterexamples.description: Shirou’s immediate job is preventing reunion.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He must keep Saber from returning and overwhelming Rin.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou’s immediate job is preventing reunion.

contexts.japanese: だから、ここで俺がするべき事は、絶対にセイバーを桜の下に行かさない事。
contexts.english: Which means that what I need to do now is make absolutely sure that Saber can't rejoin Sakura.

counterexamples.description: Stopped-heart perception coexists with later living heartbeat.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Collapsing first-person thought says heart had stopped; later actual beat remains in text.
counterexamples.explanation: Stopped-heart perception coexists with later living heartbeat.

contexts.japanese: いや、そんなもの数秒前から止まっていた。
contexts.english: No, it's been stopped for several seconds.

contexts.japanese: 心臓は動いている。
contexts.english: My heart is moving.

contexts.japanese: 少年の心臓は動いているし、呼吸もしている。
contexts.english: His heart is moving and he's breathing.

counterexamples.description: Self-sacrifice can have purpose retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He realizes dying here need not be meaningless if it opens Rin’s route.
counterexamples.explanation: Self-sacrifice can have purpose retained.

contexts.japanese: 「……なんだ。ここで死んだら何にもならない、なんて事はなかったんだな」
contexts.english: "...Oh. I guess I'm not dying for nothing after all."

counterexamples.description: Self-awareness fractions retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Remaining awareness/self goes from forty to twenty percent, then ten.
counterexamples.explanation: Self-awareness fractions retained.

contexts.japanese: アーチャーの腕に意識を接続した瞬間、残っていた四割の意識が二割に減った。
contexts.english: As soon as I connect my consciousness to the arm, the remaining forty percent of my mind drops to twenty.

contexts.japanese: 残り一割。
contexts.english: Ten percent left.

counterexamples.description: Names of many things disappear.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He loses object names and even his own.
counterexamples.explanation: Names of many things disappear.

contexts.japanese: 色々なものの名称が失われた。
contexts.english: I forget what so many things are called.

counterexamples.description: Pair attraction is part of tactic.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Yin and yang attract, alongside serial Projection and basic swordsmanship.
counterexamples.explanation: Pair attraction is part of tactic.

contexts.japanese: 引かれあう陰と陽。
contexts.english: Attraction between yin and yang.

counterexamples.description: First verse line keeps ruby and base layers.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Ruby spirit/technique and firmness are paired with crane-wing base line.
counterexamples.explanation: First verse line keeps ruby and base layers.

contexts.japanese: 「—鶴翼、欠落ヲ不ラズ」
contexts.english: "Spirit and technique must be flawless and firm. (Crane wings, ever intact.)"

counterexamples.description: Neck target retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Thrown arcs target enemy neck.
counterexamples.explanation: Neck target retained.

contexts.japanese: 狙いは敵の首。
contexts.english: I target the enemy's neck.

counterexamples.description: Saber intercepts both trajectories easily.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She changes Kanshou/Bakuya arcs with ease.
counterexamples.explanation: Saber intercepts both trajectories easily.

contexts.japanese: まったく同時に、左右から襲いかかる干将と莫耶を迎撃し、その軌道を容易くずらした。
contexts.english: She intercepts Kanshou and Bakuya's arcs with ease.

counterexamples.description: Replacement Projection already prepared.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Projection is done and advance-prepared paired swords are made again.
counterexamples.explanation: Replacement Projection already prepared.

contexts.japanese: 投影は済んでいる。
contexts.english: My Projection is already done.

counterexamples.description: Frontal Bakuya breaks after first returning Kanshou.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Attack exploits rear distraction but sword is shattered against her sword.
counterexamples.explanation: Frontal Bakuya breaks after first returning Kanshou.

contexts.japanese: 敵の剣の前に砕かれた。
contexts.english: It shatters against the enemy's sword.

counterexamples.description: Second return belongs to originally thrown pair.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Bakuya from the first pair is the next rear attack.
counterexamples.explanation: Second return belongs to originally thrown pair.

contexts.japanese: 言うまでもない、それは投擲し、敵に弾かれた一度目の双剣だ。
contexts.english: It goes without saying that this is part of the first pair I threw and she blocked.

counterexamples.description: Held mate calls counterpart back.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Holding Kanshou automatically attracts Bakuya like the married swords’ magnet property.
counterexamples.explanation: Held mate calls counterpart back.

contexts.japanese: つまり—この手に干将がある限り、莫耶は自動的にオレの手元へと戻ってくる—！
contexts.english: In other words...as long as I'm holding Kanshou, Bakuya will automatically return to my hand!

counterexamples.description: Four-blade attack and no weapons left follow source.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Source says both pairs/four blades defended and all weapons broken.
counterexamples.explanation: Four-blade attack and no weapons left follow source.

contexts.japanese: 二つの干将莫耶、四つの刃による前後からの同時攻撃を防がれ、全ての武器を砕かれては策は無い。
contexts.english: She just defended against two pairs of Kanshou and Bakuya—four swords attacking from front and back at the same time. I don't have anything else after she destroyed all my weapons.

counterexamples.description: Further prepared move retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He has another step ready beyond apparent mutual stalemate.
counterexamples.explanation: Further prepared move retained.

contexts.japanese: この手には、その先が用意されている。
contexts.english: I still have more plans up my sleeve.

counterexamples.description: Saber’s name called at final strike.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He cries the name despite progressive name loss.
counterexamples.explanation: Saber’s name called at final strike.

contexts.english: "SABERRR!!!"

counterexamples.description: Unresolved pride versus regret retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He cannot decide how to judge final memory of her name.
counterexamples.explanation: Unresolved pride versus regret retained.

contexts.japanese: それが誇っていい事なのか、悔いるべき事なのか、今の自分には判らない。
contexts.english: I don't know if I should be proud that I remember, or regret it.

counterexamples.description: First-person defeat claim remains subjective.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He thinks enemy defeated and expects rest.
counterexamples.explanation: First-person defeat claim remains subjective.

contexts.japanese: ともあれ敵は倒した。
contexts.english: In any case, I defeated the enemy.

counterexamples.description: Foresight cannot overcome body response limit.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She foresaw final strike but could not defend, because body cannot follow thought.
counterexamples.explanation: Foresight cannot overcome body response limit.

contexts.japanese: それを予知していながら、彼女には防ぐ事が出来なかった。
contexts.english: She foresaw the attack, but she can't defend against it.

counterexamples.description: Always strong correction retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Saber corrects became strong to strong from beginning.
counterexamples.explanation: Always strong correction retained.

contexts.japanese: 「……いえ、それは違いましたね。貴方は、初めから強かった」
contexts.english: "...No, that's not quite true. You were always strong."

counterexamples.description: Finishing request conditional on imminent regeneration.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She asks him to finish before body regenerates.
counterexamples.explanation: Finishing request conditional on imminent regeneration.

contexts.japanese: 「さあ、決着をつけてください。急がなければ、私の体は再生する」
contexts.english: "Now, finish me. I will regenerate unless you hurry."

counterexamples.description: Living body despite absent person retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Heart beats, breath continues, open eyes stare while will is gone.
counterexamples.explanation: Living body despite absent person retained.

contexts.japanese: 少年の心臓は動いているし、呼吸もしている。
contexts.english: His heart is moving and he's breathing.

counterexamples.description: Saber declares final victory after failed finishing.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Her win declaration reverses initial defeated expectation.
counterexamples.explanation: Saber declares final victory after failed finishing.

contexts.japanese: 「—では、私の勝ちですね、シロウ」
contexts.english: "Then... I win, Shirou."

counterexamples.description: Shared hostility creates a limited alliance.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Both find Zouken objectionable and cooperate for the present objective.
counterexamples.explanation: Shared hostility creates a limited alliance.

contexts.japanese: 「………勝手にしろ。アンタが何を考えてるかは知らないが、臓硯を良く思っていない事だけは同じだからな」
contexts.english: "...Do what you want. I don't know what you're thinking, but I don't like Zouken either."

counterexamples.description: Travel timing retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Driver waits until date change and approach is arranged for dawn.
counterexamples.explanation: Travel timing retained.

contexts.japanese: ハイヤーを飛ばして森に着く頃、夜は明け始めていた。
contexts.english: By the time the hired car takes us to the forest, the sun is starting to come up.

contexts.japanese: 「ここで待て。日付が変わるまでに私たちが戻ってこなければ帰っていい」
contexts.english: "Wait here. If we don't return before tomorrow, you can leave."

counterexamples.description: Possible sole returning boy retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Plans contemplate only Shirou returning.
counterexamples.explanation: Possible sole returning boy retained.

contexts.japanese: 「戻ってくる者がそこの少年だけ、という事もある。
contexts.english: "The boy may be the only one to return.

counterexamples.description: Rapier comparison is qualified.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Boy likens thin weapon to a rapier within his own knowledge, then notes its unusual blade.
counterexamples.explanation: Rapier comparison is qualified.

contexts.japanese: 知っている中では西洋の細剣に近い。
contexts.english: From what I know, it's similar to a Western rapier.

counterexamples.description: Submachine gun is considered unsuitable rather than equipped.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Priest has only that gun option and gives the boy the sword instead.
counterexamples.explanation: Submachine gun is considered unsuitable rather than equipped.

contexts.japanese: 「切嗣は銃を好んだがな。あいにく今は短機関銃しかない。幽霊どもに鉛弾は効かんし、おまえには扱い辛いものだ。魔術使いのおまえには、そちらの方がらしいだろう」
contexts.english: "Kiritsugu preferred firearms. Unfortunately, I only have submachine guns. Lead bullets won't affect ghosts, and you wouldn't know how to use them. This is more suitable for a spellcaster like yourself."

counterexamples.description: Weight and tip distribution preserved.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Approximate less-than-one-kilo weight and tip-heavy balance both remain.
counterexamples.explanation: Weight and tip distribution preserved.

contexts.japanese: 重さは一キロ弱程だろうが、明らかに切っ先の重さが違う。
contexts.english: The sword is less than a kilo, but it's obviously weighted towards the tip.

counterexamples.description: Limited efficacy requires a hit.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Some effect against Servants depends on successfully hitting them.
counterexamples.explanation: Limited efficacy requires a hit.

contexts.japanese: もっとも当てられればの話だが、と余計な一言を足す言峰。
contexts.english: "Only if you hit them, of course," he adds unnecessarily.

contexts.japanese: 霊体を相手にするのは我々の専売特許だからな。その刀身におまえの魔術を載せれば、サーヴァントと言えど多少は有効だろう」
contexts.english: We specialize in dealing with spiritual entities. If you imbue its blade with your magecraft, it would even have some effect on Servants."

counterexamples.description: Previous castle not reached.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Earlier route ended at meeting Illya fleeing the Shadow before the castle.
counterexamples.explanation: Previous castle not reached.

contexts.japanese: ……以前ここに来た時は、城には辿り着けなかった。
contexts.english: ...I couldn't reach it the last time I was here.

counterexamples.description: Current helplessness retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Near-death from Shadow and lack of effective response still apply.
counterexamples.explanation: Current helplessness retained.

contexts.japanese: それは今も変わらない。
contexts.english: That hasn't changed.

counterexamples.description: Immediate plan is unnoticed retrieval.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Boy seeks Illya back without Sakura noticing.
counterexamples.explanation: Immediate plan is unnoticed retrieval.

contexts.japanese: 桜に気付かれず、イリヤを連れ戻す。
contexts.english: I need to retrieve Illya without Sakura noticing me.

counterexamples.description: Illya rescue buys preparation time.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Priest limits present objective and postpones Sakura confrontation until resistance is prepared.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya rescue buys preparation time.

contexts.japanese: 「今回は諦めろ。イリヤスフィールをこちらで保護すれば、まだ猶予は出来る。間桐桜と話がしたいのなら、彼女に対抗できる力を用意してからだ」
contexts.english: "Give up on her this time. If we can secure Illyasviel, it will buy us more time. If you want to speak to Sakura Matou, do so once you have a way to resist her."

counterexamples.description: Protecting both potential victim and killer retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Boy will prevent Illya's death and Sakura's killing her.
counterexamples.explanation: Protecting both potential victim and killer retained.

contexts.japanese: ……イリヤは殺させないし、桜にそんな事はさせない。
contexts.english: I won't let Illya die, and I won't let Sakura kill her.

counterexamples.description: More than two hours retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Travel in forest has taken a little over two hours.
counterexamples.explanation: More than two hours retained.

contexts.japanese: 森に入ってから二時間強。
contexts.english: It's been a little over two hours since we entered the forest.

counterexamples.description: Normality expectation is challenged.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Priest repeats the boy's anticipated quick return and requires severance.
counterexamples.explanation: Normality expectation is challenged.

contexts.japanese: 「すぐに正常になる、か。
contexts.english: "Quickly return to normal?

counterexamples.description: Boy's current limit retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He cannot defeat the Shadow now and can only sustain Sakura's mind until birth.
counterexamples.explanation: Boy's current limit retained.

contexts.japanese: 今のおまえに影を倒す術はない。おまえに出来る事は、影がこの世に生まれ落ちるまで、間桐桜の精神を繋ぎとめる事だけだ」
contexts.english: You have no way to defeat it now. All you can do is ground Sakura Matou's mind and wait for the Shadow to be birthed into the world."

counterexamples.description: Priest will oppose root destruction.
counterexamples.sourceReading: His objective is activation formula fulfillment and he will not allow boy to destroy it.
counterexamples.explanation: Priest will oppose root destruction.

contexts.japanese: 「とっくに起動式を壊していたか？　そう上手くいかんさ。なにしろ私の目的は起動式の成就だ。おまえに起動式を壊させる訳にはいかん」
contexts.english: "You would have destroyed the activation formula already? That won't do. My objective is the successful activation of the formula. I will not allow you to destroy it."

counterexamples.description: Alliance expires after rescue.
counterexamples.sourceReading: They return to enemy status once Illya is rescued.
counterexamples.explanation: Alliance expires after rescue.

contexts.japanese: 「言っただろう。イリヤスフィールを助け出した後は敵同士だと。私の目的はおまえたちとは違う。
contexts.english: "I told you, we will be enemies once Illyasviel is rescued. My goals are different than yours.

counterexamples.description: Ownership accusation rejected.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Priest denies interest in aftermath and doubts human control of the born entity.
counterexamples.explanation: Ownership accusation rejected.

contexts.japanese: 「自分のもの……？　まさか。生まれた後のことなど興味はないし、そもそも人の手で御しえるものではなかろう。
contexts.english: "For myself...? Perish the thought. I have no interest in the aftermath of its birth. It is not something human hands can control.

counterexamples.description: Help recognized without accepting ideology.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Priest really seeks Illya's rescue and Sakura's freedom from Zouken.
counterexamples.explanation: Help recognized without accepting ideology.

contexts.japanese: が—イリヤを助けようとし、臓硯から桜を解放させようとしているのは本当だった。
contexts.english: Still, it's true that he's helping me rescue Illya, and that he's trying to set Sakura free from Zouken.

counterexamples.description: Present shared goal amid incompatibility.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Only now do they hold the same objective despite incompatible thought and coexistence.
counterexamples.explanation: Present shared goal amid incompatibility.

contexts.japanese: だが今この時だけは、同じ目的を抱いている。
contexts.english: But right now, we have the same objective.

counterexamples.description: Entrusting his back retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Priest reaffirms co-fighting and relies on the boy to watch his back.
counterexamples.explanation: Entrusting his back retained.

contexts.japanese: 「共闘すると言った。私の背中はおまえに任せる」
contexts.english: "I said that I would fight alongside you. I will ask you to watch my back."

counterexamples.description: Best ally for current operation.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He feels he has the strongest available ally now and must still rescue and escape.
counterexamples.explanation: Best ally for current operation.

contexts.japanese: この場において何よりも勝る味方を得た。
contexts.english: I've gained the best ally I could ask for right now.

counterexamples.description: Disparity deters enemies in Zouken's view.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He thinks the surviving boy and Tohsaka girl dare not challenge after seeing the power gap.
counterexamples.explanation: Disparity deters enemies in Zouken's view.

contexts.japanese: 衛宮の小倅と遠坂の小娘が生きておるのは意外じゃったが、どうという事もなかろう。あれほどの力の差を見せられ、歯向かうような馬鹿者はおらぬ」
contexts.english: I was surprised that the Emiya boy and the Tohsaka girl still live, but they can do nothing. No one would be foolish enough to challenge us after being shown the overwhelming disparity in power."

counterexamples.description: Joy overrides pain without adaptation.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Shirou's arrival creates dark joy overcoming torment; she has not adjusted to poison.
counterexamples.explanation: Joy overrides pain without adaptation.

contexts.japanese: 昏い悦びが、暗い痛みを凌駕しただけの話。
contexts.english: Her dark joy overcomes her grim suffering.

counterexamples.description: Shirou alone exempted.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Everyone else can be killed regardless of identity.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou alone exempted.

contexts.japanese: 「いって。先輩以外は殺していいわ。他の相手が誰であろうと、問題なく斬り殺しなさい」
contexts.english: "Go. Kill everyone except Senpai. Slaughter everyone else, no matter who they are."

counterexamples.description: Danger to both and house explicit.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Shadow could crush them with the house if it wished.
counterexamples.explanation: Danger to both and house explicit.

contexts.japanese: ソレがその気になるだけで、俺たちは屋敷ごと潰される。
contexts.english: If it wanted to, it could crush us along with the entire house.

counterexamples.description: Remote physical location distinguished.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Sakura is under Ryudou Temple; courtyard figure is only her modeled shadow projection.
counterexamples.explanation: Remote physical location distinguished.

contexts.japanese: 本物の桜は柳洞寺の地下にいる。
contexts.english: The real Sakura is underground, beneath Ryudou Temple.

counterexamples.description: Refusal protects resolve.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Boy will not reach out or call to her because his resolve could weaken.
counterexamples.explanation: Refusal protects resolve.

contexts.japanese: ここで桜に声をかけ、わずかでも決意を弱める事はできない。
contexts.english: I can't call out to Sakura and risk weakening my resolve.

counterexamples.description: Restraint protects Shirou.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She will not permit entity to emerge while he remains in town.
counterexamples.explanation: Restraint protects Shirou.

contexts.japanese: そんな事、許すわけにはいかない。ここにはまだ先輩がいるんです。
contexts.english: I won't let that happen. Senpai is still here.

counterexamples.description: Possible last night of self retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She might endure only tonight and requests immediate flight.
counterexamples.explanation: Possible last night of self retained.

contexts.japanese: なら、今すぐ先輩を連れて逃げてください。わたしはそう長くはありません。このままだといつ自分が消えてしまうか判らない。わたしが耐えられるのは今夜だけかもしれない」
contexts.english: You need to take Senpai and run. I don't have much time left. I don't know when I might disappear. Tonight might be the last night I stay myself."

counterexamples.description: Mutual destruction proposed conditionally.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She asks Rin to take Shirou far away so she can take entity down with herself.
counterexamples.explanation: Mutual destruction proposed conditionally.

contexts.japanese: ……姉さん。先輩を連れて、遠いところに逃げてください。そうしてくれたら、わたしは安心してあの子と刺し違えるコトが出来ますから」
contexts.english: ...Nee-san, take Senpai and run somewhere far away. If you can do that, then I feel safe taking the child down with me."

counterexamples.description: Stammered wish not to be seen transforming.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She does not want Shirou to witness complete change and asks him away.
counterexamples.explanation: Stammered wish not to be seen transforming.

contexts.japanese: わた、わたしは、変わりきる姿を見られたくない。先輩、先輩さえ離れてくれれば、それでいいんです。
contexts.english: I... I don't want you to see me change. I'll be okay as long as Senpai... as long as Senpai goes away.

counterexamples.description: Shirou refuses abandonment and self-destruction.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He refuses fleeing without her and letting her destroy herself.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou refuses abandonment and self-destruction.

contexts.japanese: 桜を放って逃げる事も、アンリマユと刺し違える、という桜を認める訳にもいかない。
contexts.english: I refuse to leave her and run, and I won't let her kill herself either.

counterexamples.description: Rin attributes inconsistent desire to Sakura.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She accuses Sakura of wanting Rin dead while asking her to flee.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin attributes inconsistent desire to Sakura.

contexts.japanese: 気付いてるの桜？　貴方、さっきから言動がメチャクチャよ。わたしを殺したいクセに逃げろだなんてね。
contexts.english: Have you noticed how you don't make any sense, Sakura? You're telling me to run, even though you want to kill me.

counterexamples.description: Both have limited time.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Boy's dizziness leads him to think Sakura is not the only one running out of time.
counterexamples.explanation: Both have limited time.

contexts.japanese: ……どうやら、時間がないのは桜だけじゃなさそうだ。
contexts.english: ...It seems that Sakura isn't the only one running out of time.

counterexamples.description: Weapon's lethal purpose creates contradiction.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin says helping her means preparing the sword she intends to use to kill Sakura.
counterexamples.explanation: Weapon's lethal purpose creates contradiction.

contexts.japanese: わたしと行くって事は桜を殺すっていう事よ。宝石剣だってそう。貴方は桜を殺す武器を、わたしの為に用意しなくちゃいけないのよ」
contexts.english: Going with me means killing Sakura. That goes for the Jeweled Sword, too. You need to provide me with a weapon to kill her."

counterexamples.description: Sword still needs Projection.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Prior promise and inability to resist Shadow make the future projected sword necessary despite contradiction.
counterexamples.explanation: Sword still needs Projection.

contexts.japanese: 「……そうだな。宝石の剣に関しては、確かに矛盾してる。けど今の桜は俺たちの手に負えないし、剣を作るのは以前からの約束だ。宝石の剣を投影する事で桜の影に対抗できるなら、それは絶対に必要なものだ」
contexts.english: "...Yeah. I'm definitely contradicting myself by making the Jeweled Sword. But we can't beat Sakura right now, and I already promised that I'd make it. If you need me to Project the Jeweled Sword to fight Sakura's Shadow, then it has to be done."

counterexamples.description: Total casualties not inevitable.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Boy says the claimed tradeoff is not settled and expects a way to save Sakura without further deaths.
counterexamples.explanation: Total casualties not inevitable.

contexts.japanese: 「まだそうと決まった訳じゃないだろう。桜を助けて、これ以上犠牲が出ない方法がある筈だ」
contexts.english: "That isn't set in stone yet. There should be a way to help Sakura without causing any more deaths."

counterexamples.description: Inescapable guilt acknowledged.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Narration recognizes Rin's charge concerning people already killed as unavoidable guilt.
counterexamples.explanation: Inescapable guilt acknowledged.

contexts.japanese: 言い逃れのできない罪。
contexts.english: It's an inescapable sin.

counterexamples.description: Protection includes self-directed threat.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He will defend her even no longer human and even against the self that wishes to kill herself.
counterexamples.explanation: Protection includes self-directed threat.

contexts.japanese: 「—そうだ。たとえ桜が人でなくなったとしても守る。そうなって、自分を殺したがっている桜もひっくるめて、ぜんぶから桜を守るんだ。
contexts.english: "...Yeah. I'll protect Sakura, even if she stops being human. I'll protect her from everything, including the version of her that wants to kill herself.

counterexamples.description: Concession is conversational defeat.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin admits losing the argument to his unembarrassed determination.
counterexamples.explanation: Concession is conversational defeat.

contexts.japanese: 「……そ。ま、なに言っても無駄だとは思ってたけど、まさかこれほどとはね。正直、負けたわ」
contexts.english: "...Okay. I didn't think you'd listen to me, but you're this stubborn? Honestly, I give up."

counterexamples.description: Pouting register shift retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Former tension gives way to her slightly puffed cheeks.
counterexamples.explanation: Pouting register shift retained.

contexts.japanese: さっきまでの緊張は何処にいったのか、遠坂は微妙に頬をプリプリさせている。
contexts.english: Where did all her tension go? Tohsaka seems to be pouting, strangely enough.

counterexamples.description: Rin's restraint is precisely conditional.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She leaves Sakura to him while he tries and steps in only once he cannot move.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin's restraint is precisely conditional.

contexts.japanese: 士郎が頑張っているかぎり、桜をどうするかは貴方に任せる。わたしの出番は貴方が動けなくなってからにしてあげるわ。
contexts.english: As long as you keep trying, I'll let you decide how to deal with Sakura. I won't step in until you can't move anymore.

counterexamples.description: Saving her remains possible not guaranteed.
counterexamples.sourceReading: His efforts might save Sakura.
counterexamples.explanation: Saving her remains possible not guaranteed.

contexts.japanese: ……それなら文句ないでしょ。士郎の頑張り次第で桜は助かるかもしれないんだから」
contexts.english: ...No complaints there, right? You might be able to save her if you work hard enough."

counterexamples.description: Opposition remains despite shared care.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Their thinking still points in opposite directions even as boy believes Rin wants to save Sakura.
counterexamples.explanation: Opposition remains despite shared care.

contexts.japanese: 俺たちの考えは正反対だ。
contexts.english: We're thinking in opposite directions.

counterexamples.description: Shared affection in intact entry.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Shirou and Rin both like or love Sakura.
counterexamples.explanation: Shared affection in intact entry.

contexts.japanese: 俺と遠坂、どっちも桜が好きだっていうんなら。
contexts.english: We both love Sakura.

counterexamples.description: Ten PM before preparation.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Current time explicitly ten at night.
counterexamples.explanation: Ten PM before preparation.

contexts.japanese: 時刻は夜の十時。
contexts.english: It's 10:00 PM.

counterexamples.description: Prior shroud use concealed from Rin.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Illya has not told Rin he already released the shroud.
counterexamples.explanation: Prior shroud use concealed from Rin.

contexts.japanese: イリヤ、遠坂には聖骸布を解いた事を言っていないんだ。
contexts.english: Illya hasn't told Tohsaka that I took off the holy shroud.

counterexamples.description: Approximate half-power hope, no exact duplicate.
counterexamples.sourceReading: If all goes well original cannot be exactly copied but roughly half ability expected.
counterexamples.explanation: Approximate half-power hope, no exact duplicate.

contexts.japanese: 出来るだけ宝石剣に似せたアゾット剣と、士郎の投影とイリヤのサポート。うまくいけばオリジナルの複製とはいかないけど、半分ぐらいは能力の再現ができる筈よ」
contexts.english: I did my best to find you an Azoth Blade similar to the Jeweled Sword, and Illya will be supporting your Projection. If this goes well, we won't be able to replicate the original, but we should get something with about half of its power."

counterexamples.description: Boy recognizes huge stored mana.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Even an incomplete mage can perceive strongly charged weapon.
counterexamples.explanation: Boy recognizes huge stored mana.

contexts.japanese: そればかりではなく、半人前の俺でさえ判るほど強大な魔力が蓄積されていた。
contexts.english: But not just that—even I can tell that it's charged with a massive amount of magical energy.

counterexamples.description: Relative mana scales retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Small handful against Sakura yet hundreds times boy's capacity.
counterexamples.explanation: Relative mana scales retained.

contexts.japanese: ……まあ、桜の纏った影に比べたら掌一つ分の魔力ではあるのだが、それでも俺の許容量からすれば何百倍という破格さだ。
contexts.english: ...It might just be a small handful compared to the Shadow cloaking Sakura, but it's hundreds of times my own capacity.

counterexamples.description: Projection still needs time.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Even boy will take time and must begin to meet midnight.
counterexamples.explanation: Projection still needs time.

contexts.japanese: 「シロウ、そろそろ始めましょう。いくらシロウでもその剣の投影には時間がかかるわ。すぐに始めないと日付が変わる」
contexts.english: "Let's get started, Shirou. It'll take time to Project that sword, even for you. It'll be midnight if we don't start soon."

counterexamples.description: Private Projection request retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He wants only Illya with him and asks Rin to wait.
counterexamples.explanation: Private Projection request retained.

contexts.japanese: それと、投影中はイリヤと二人きりになりたいんで、遠坂は部屋で待っててくれ」
contexts.english: I want to be alone with Illya while I do the Projection, so go wait in your room, Tohsaka."

counterexamples.description: Screaming example is a conditional joke.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She promises not to enter even if he screams.
counterexamples.explanation: Screaming example is a conditional joke.

contexts.japanese: 「しつこいわね。分かったって言ったでしょ、たとえ士郎の悲鳴があがっても中には入らないわよ」
contexts.english: "Persistent, aren't you? I said I get it. I won't go in even if Shirou screams."

counterexamples.description: Rin expects Azoth to disappear.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She thinks Azoth is consumed once jeweled sword is made.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin expects Azoth to disappear.

contexts.japanese: 「？　貰うも何も、それを使って今から投影するんじゃない。宝石剣が出来たらアゾット剣はなくなるわよ」
contexts.english: "Huh? I mean, you're about to use it for the Projection. The Azoth Blade will be gone once you make the Jeweled Sword."

counterexamples.description: Breakage-blame pretext retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He requests ownership to remove feared blame if it breaks.
counterexamples.explanation: Breakage-blame pretext retained.

contexts.japanese: ほら、失敗したらこの剣も壊れるかもしれないし。その時、遠坂に怒られるかと思うと集中できない」
contexts.english: It might break if I fail, and I can't concentrate when I think of you getting mad at me for breaking something you own."

counterexamples.description: Likely guilt rather than certain intervention.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin probably will not stop him now but will feel responsible.
counterexamples.explanation: Likely guilt rather than certain intervention.

contexts.japanese: 事此処にいたって止めはしないだろうが、あいつは絶対に責任を感じる。
contexts.english: She probably wouldn't stop me, but she would definitely feel responsible.

counterexamples.description: Approval deliberately after war.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He intends retrospective admission/approval after war is over.
counterexamples.explanation: Approval deliberately after war.

contexts.japanese: それを和らげる為には、聖杯戦争が終わった後、実はもう使ってしまってました、と事後承諾させるしかないのだ。
contexts.english: The only way to alleviate that is to get her ex post facto approval with a "sorry, I actually used it," once the Holy Grail War is over.

counterexamples.description: Personal never-seen versus inherited record.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Illya has not seen sword herself but contains its record.
counterexamples.explanation: Personal never-seen versus inherited record.

contexts.japanese: 「分かってるわ。シロウにはまず、わたしの記録に入ってもらう。わたしだって見た事はないけど、わたしの中には宝石剣の記録があるわ。
contexts.english: "I know. I'm going to have you search the records inside me. I haven't personally seen it, but there's a record of the Jeweled Sword inside my mind.

counterexamples.description: Sight and consciousness move into record.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Body stays while consciousness and eyes enter Illya's record to analyze sword.
counterexamples.explanation: Sight and consciousness move into record.

contexts.japanese: 「いいから目を閉じて。シロウの体はそのままで、意識だけを別の場所に移すわ。前もやったでしょ？　シロウの眼をわたしの記録に移すから、そこで宝石剣を解析して。
contexts.english: "Just close your eyes. Stay still. I'm going to send your consciousness somewhere else. I did it before, remember? I'll send your sight inside me, where you can analyze the Jeweled Sword.

counterexamples.description: Binding released after entry.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Illya unbinds left arm once he is inside and demands quick Projection.
counterexamples.explanation: Binding released after entry.

contexts.japanese: ……シロウが中に入ったら、わたしが左腕の拘束を外す。二百年前の記録へ遡る圧力と、左腕の侵食が同時に来るわ。気をしっかり持って、出来るだけ早く投影を終わらせなさい」
contexts.english: ...Once you're inside, I'll unbind your left arm. Your arm is going to invade you at the same time while you travel two hundred years into history. Keep a firm grip on yourself and try to finish the Projection as quickly as you can."

counterexamples.description: Instruction coexists with visible fear.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Her voice and embrace tremble.
counterexamples.explanation: Instruction coexists with visible fear.

contexts.japanese: ……俺を正面から抱いたイリヤの腕も、小刻みに震えている。
contexts.english: ...I can feel her arms trembling as she hugs me from the front, too.

counterexamples.description: Do not look at unnecessary things.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She guides him to sword and tells him to exclude distraction.
counterexamples.explanation: Do not look at unnecessary things.

contexts.japanese: 「……宝石剣まではわたしが連れて行くから、シロウは息を止めているだけでいい。雑念は捨てて。余計なものは見ないで。シロウはわたしの中から、彼のゼルレッチを抜き取ってくるだけでいい—」
contexts.english: "...I'll take you until we find the Jeweled Sword so you just need to still your breathing. Don't get distracted. Don't look at anything you don't have to. You just need to draw out the Zelretch."

counterexamples.description: Cause of distortion unresolved.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He wonders whether sensory plunge or arm release causes the experience.
counterexamples.explanation: Cause of distortion unresolved.

contexts.japanese: それとも、左腕の拘束を外されたからか。
contexts.english: or because she undid the binding on my left arm?

counterexamples.description: Identity recognition fails.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He does not know who he is in the fragmented record experience.
counterexamples.explanation: Identity recognition fails.

contexts.japanese: 自分が判らない。
contexts.english: I don't know who I am.

counterexamples.description: Grail circuit remains huge.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Perceived structure is a giant circuit.
counterexamples.explanation: Grail circuit remains huge.

contexts.japanese: それは巨大な回路だった。
contexts.english: It's a giant circuit.

counterexamples.description: Shrinkage belongs to experienced viewpoint.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Lower view from shrinking self makes world too large.
counterexamples.explanation: Shrinkage belongs to experienced viewpoint.

contexts.japanese: 縮んだ体、低くなった視界では世界が広すぎる。
contexts.english: From the lower perspective of my shrunken body, the world is far too big.

counterexamples.description: Understands he cannot understand.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He recognizes inability to grasp sword despite seeing it.
counterexamples.explanation: Understands he cannot understand.

contexts.japanese: 自分では理解できないと理解した。
contexts.english: I understand that I cannot understand it.

counterexamples.description: Analyzing structure distinguished from theory.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Can analyze form/structure and Project it but not governing principles.
counterexamples.explanation: Analyzing structure distinguished from theory.

contexts.japanese: その構造を解析し投影する事しかできない。
contexts.english: I can only analyze its structure and Project it.

counterexamples.description: Future knowledge beyond young humanity.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Old man embodies future common sense inaccessible to humanity in childhood.
counterexamples.explanation: Future knowledge beyond young humanity.

contexts.japanese: まだ幼年期にいる人類には届かない、遥か未来の常識を老人は体現している—
contexts.english: The old man embodies common wisdom from the far future, which our young species has yet to reach...

counterexamples.description: Reaching repetition retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Repeated reach lines enact continued effort with burning perception.
counterexamples.explanation: Reaching repetition retained.

contexts.japanese: 何十メートルと左手を伸ばして、伸ばして、伸ばして、伸ばして—
contexts.english: I reach out dozens of meters. I reach, reach, reach...

counterexamples.description: Illya calls for return.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She demands stop and return while he continues.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya calls for return.

contexts.japanese: 「そこまでよ！　戻りなさいシロウ……！」
contexts.english: "That's enough! Come back, Shirou!"

counterexamples.description: Risk of self-disappearance challenged.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She asks whether he wants to fade away.
counterexamples.explanation: Risk of self-disappearance challenged.

contexts.japanese: 「諦めなさい……！　このまま消え去りたいのシロウ！」
contexts.english: "Give up! Do you want to fade away, Shirou!?"

counterexamples.description: Extended reach still fragmented.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Reach and repeated dashes continue across entries.
counterexamples.explanation: Extended reach still fragmented.

contexts.japanese: 届け—
contexts.english: Reach it—

counterexamples.description: Knife perception is delirious.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Fragmented boy feels a huge kitchen-knife stab before recognizing Illya.
counterexamples.explanation: Knife perception is delirious.

contexts.japanese: 横合いからでっかい包丁で刺された。
contexts.english: A huge kitchen knife stabs me in the side.

counterexamples.description: Illya not injured.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Boy confirms she is fortunately unhurt after striking her.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya not injured.

contexts.japanese: ……良かった。幸い、イリヤに怪我はない。
contexts.english: ...Thank goodness. Luckily, I didn't injure her.

counterexamples.description: Disobedient looking rebuked.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She repeats not to look at unnecessary things and forgives because result succeeded.
counterexamples.explanation: Disobedient looking rebuked.

contexts.japanese: 「バカ、余計なものは見るなって言ったじゃないっ……！
contexts.english: "You idiot! I told you not to look at anything unnecessary!

counterexamples.description: No sensed energy is boy's impression.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He cannot feel mana in new sword and thinks it inferior.
counterexamples.explanation: No sensed energy is boy's impression.

contexts.japanese: いや、そもそもこの剣にはまったく魔力を感じない。
contexts.english: In fact, I can't feel a speck of magical energy from this sword.

counterexamples.description: Flawless Projection limited to manufacture.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Illya specifically praises Projection and swordmaking.
counterexamples.explanation: Flawless Projection limited to manufacture.

contexts.japanese: 「そ。小言はいっぱいあるけど、とりあえずお疲れさまシロウ。投影だけなら完璧、非の打ち所のない剣製を見せてもらったわ」
contexts.english: "I have a lot to scold you about, but good work, Shirou. That was a perfect Projection. A flawless display of sword creation."

counterexamples.description: Tourist reading is boy's joke.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He wonders if world-travel statement amounts to ordinary wanderlust.
counterexamples.explanation: Tourist reading is boy's joke.

contexts.japanese: この世界にはいないだの、ひょっこりやってくるだの、それはただの放浪趣味の旅行好きってヤツではなかろうか。
contexts.english: Not in this world? Pop in for a visit? She makes him sound like some kind of wanderer who travels around for fun.

counterexamples.description: Pain used to preserve awareness.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He clenches wounded hand around pendant to keep conscious.
counterexamples.explanation: Pain used to preserve awareness.

contexts.japanese: 右手を強く握って、ペンダントを裂けた肌の肉に突き刺して、意識を保つ。
contexts.english: I clench my right hand and let the pendant dig into my torn skin. It keeps me awake.

counterexamples.description: One-more estimate is self-assessment.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He thinks he can manage roughly one further Projection.
counterexamples.explanation: One-more estimate is self-assessment.

contexts.japanese: これなら、あと一回ぐらいはなんとか投影が使える。
contexts.english: I should be able to manage one more Projection.

counterexamples.description: Comprehension failure distinguished from hearing.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He hears but cannot understand her words.
counterexamples.explanation: Comprehension failure distinguished from hearing.

contexts.japanese: 聞こえないのではなく、遠坂は知らない言葉で喋っている。
contexts.english: It's not that I can't hear her, but Tohsaka's saying words I don't understand.

counterexamples.description: Hand-off inferred after memory gap.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Sword he apparently projected is already with Rin while his hand is empty.
counterexamples.explanation: Hand-off inferred after memory gap.

contexts.japanese: アレはついさっき俺が投影した＜らしい＞もので、左手はとうに空っぽで、つまりもう遠坂に手渡したのか。
contexts.english: I just Projected that (I think), and my left hand is empty, which means I must've given it to her.

counterexamples.description: Memory loss follows intact-brain confidence.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He feels chill and loss of memory with understanding not matching contents.
counterexamples.explanation: Memory loss follows intact-brain confidence.

contexts.japanese: 記憶がとんでいる。
contexts.english: My memory is going away.

counterexamples.description: Blood helps refocus at cost.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Clenched hand sheds blood while eyes regain focus.
counterexamples.explanation: Blood helps refocus at cost.

contexts.japanese: ポタポタと血液がこぼれるかわりに、ようやく、目の焦点があってくれた。
contexts.english: Blood drips, but I finally manage to focus my eyes.

counterexamples.description: Light limbs coexist with failing head.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Limbs are oddly light compared with fragmented consciousness.
counterexamples.explanation: Light limbs coexist with failing head.

contexts.japanese: 断線だらけの頭に比べて、手足は異様に軽い。
contexts.english: My limbs feel light compared to my disconnected head.

counterexamples.description: Pendant prompts astonishment.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin sees bloody hand's pendant and is shocked.
counterexamples.explanation: Pendant prompts astonishment.

contexts.japanese: 遠坂は愕然と、俺の掌にあるペンダントを見つめている。
contexts.english: Tohsaka looks astonished. She's looking at the pendant in my hand.

counterexamples.description: Simple recollection unreachable.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Boy cannot recall even a supposedly unforgettable provenance.
counterexamples.explanation: Simple recollection unreachable.

contexts.japanese: 簡単な、忘れられない事なのに、どうしても記憶の引き出しから出てこない。
contexts.english: It's something so easy and hard to forget, but I can't recall it no matter how hard I try.

counterexamples.description: Precious-pendant words are not wholly his.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Narration says words not his spill out after keep-close-until-end insistence.
counterexamples.explanation: Precious-pendant words are not wholly his.

contexts.japanese: 自分のものではない言葉がこぼれる。
contexts.english: Words that aren't mine spill from my lips.

counterexamples.description: Two matching pendants recognized.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin produces hers and boy sees exact match.
counterexamples.explanation: Two matching pendants recognized.

contexts.japanese: 確かに同じだ。
contexts.english: It's exactly the same.

counterexamples.description: Different remaining energy and prior use matter.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Hers empty, his has some remaining, and having been used carries significance.
counterexamples.explanation: Different remaining energy and prior use matter.

contexts.japanese: 「違うわ。わたしのは空っぽだけど、士郎のは少しだけ残ってる。取るに足りない量だけど、それでも、使われたからには意味があるんだわ」
contexts.english: "No, they're not. Mine's empty, but yours still has a little left in it. It isn't enough to use for anything, but... It has meaning because it was used."

counterexamples.description: Possible later usefulness retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She tells him to keep it because it might help.
counterexamples.explanation: Possible later usefulness retained.

contexts.japanese: 「それ、持っていて。何かの役に立つかもしれないから」
contexts.english: "Keep it. It might come in handy."

counterexamples.description: Midnight agreed time preserved.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Departure meets midnight arrangement.
counterexamples.explanation: Midnight agreed time preserved.

contexts.japanese: 午前零時、約束の時間になった。
contexts.english: It's midnight, the time we agreed on.

counterexamples.description: Illya remains for two reasons.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Zouken targeting her and boy's own wish both explain staying.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya remains for two reasons.

contexts.japanese: 臓硯がイリヤを狙っている、という事もあるが、イリヤに残ってもらうのは俺の希望でもあるからだ。
contexts.english: It's true that Zouken's targeting Illya, but it's also my wish for her to stay here.

counterexamples.description: No pain does not mean healing.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Living-creature functions continue eroding despite no arm pain.
counterexamples.explanation: No pain does not mean healing.

contexts.japanese: ただ、生物としての機能が、少しずつこそぎ落ちているだけだ。
contexts.english: My functions as a living creature are just slowly being eroded.

counterexamples.description: Stopping disrupts sense of purpose.
counterexamples.sourceReading: If he stops, he ceases understanding what he is doing.
counterexamples.explanation: Stopping disrupts sense of purpose.

contexts.japanese: 立ち止まっていると、自分が何をしているか判らなくなる。
contexts.english: If I stop, I won't know what I'm doing.

counterexamples.description: Separate household time spans retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Ten-year house life and last year-and-half familiar mornings distinct.
counterexamples.explanation: Separate household time spans retained.

contexts.japanese: いつも、この一年半、身近で在り続けてくれた朝の風景。
contexts.english: This morning scene became so familiar to me over the last year and a half.

counterexamples.description: Kiritsugu training memory retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Workshop is place where he followed Kiritsugu's example through nightly training.
counterexamples.explanation: Kiritsugu training memory retained.

contexts.japanese: ここで切嗣の背中を追いかけて、毎夜、無我夢中になって鍛錬をした。
contexts.english: This is where I followed in Kiritsugu's footsteps and threw myself into training every night.

counterexamples.description: Guestroom occupied only days.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Room had only several days' use in relevant memory.
counterexamples.explanation: Guestroom occupied only days.

contexts.japanese: たった数日間だけ使われた客間。
contexts.english: It's a guestroom that's only been used for the last several days.

counterexamples.description: Recall instability is deliberate.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Boy now cannot retrieve household life despite earlier evocative recollections.
counterexamples.explanation: Recall instability is deliberate.

contexts.japanese: この家で起きたコト、今まで過ごしてきたコトがこれっぽっちも思い出せない。
contexts.english: I can't remember anything that happened in this house, or anything I've experienced.

counterexamples.description: New realization of importance, not first care.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Boy recognizes how much Sakura mattered.
counterexamples.explanation: New realization of importance, not first care.

contexts.japanese: 桜が、大切だったんだ。
