counterexamples.sourceReading: Eternal sight will not be lost however she changes.
counterexamples.explanation: Memory persists through transformation.

contexts.japanese: 彼女がどう変貌しようと失われない、切り取られた、永遠の風景だった。
contexts.english: That was an eternal sight that will never be lost, no matter how much she changes.

counterexamples.description: Explicit refusal to kill retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He realizes he cannot kill Saber.
counterexamples.explanation: Explicit refusal to kill retained.

contexts.japanese: 俺に、セイバーは殺せない。
contexts.english: I can't kill Saber.

counterexamples.description: Dropped dagger goes into earth instead of chest.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Blade plunges into dry ground, explicitly not Saber.
counterexamples.explanation: Dropped dagger goes into earth instead of chest.

contexts.japanese: セイバーの胸ではなく、乾いた地面に突き刺さる。
contexts.english: It plunges not into her chest, but the dry earth.

counterexamples.description: First hatred explicitly preserved.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Saber says this is first time she has hated Shirou.
counterexamples.explanation: First hatred explicitly preserved.

contexts.japanese: 「—シロウ。初めて、貴方を憎んだ」
contexts.english: "...Shirou, this is the first time I have hated you."

counterexamples.description: Mercy asks her to kill him.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Saber says he is telling her to kill him.
counterexamples.explanation: Mercy asks her to kill him.

contexts.japanese: 「貴方は、私に貴方を殺せというのですね」
contexts.english: "You're telling me to kill you."

counterexamples.description: Unknown plea remains a question.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He asks whether unidentified cause of vibration calls desperately for help.
counterexamples.explanation: Unknown plea remains a question.

contexts.japanese: この振動を起こしている“誰か”が、必死に助けを求めている—？
contexts.english: Is whoever's making these vibrations desperately calling for help...?

counterexamples.description: Execution postponed explicitly.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Saber delays his execution while Sakura seeks help.
counterexamples.explanation: Execution postponed explicitly.

contexts.japanese: 「—貴方の処刑は先送りです。桜が、救いを求めている」
contexts.english: "I am delaying your execution. Sakura requests my aid."

counterexamples.description: Shadow removes Saber without rescue.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Shadow swallowed her and seeped away into ground.
counterexamples.explanation: Shadow removes Saber without rescue.

contexts.japanese: セイバーを呑み込んだ影は、地面に染み込むように消えてしまった。
contexts.english: It swallowed Saber whole and seeped away into the ground.

counterexamples.description: Forgotten dagger circumstance retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He cannot understand why dagger formerly held is in ground.
counterexamples.explanation: Forgotten dagger circumstance retained.

contexts.japanese: さっきまで握っていた筈の短剣が、どうして地面に刺さっていたのだろう。
contexts.english: I was just holding it. So why is it in the ground now?

counterexamples.description: One more Projection is a bounded self-estimate.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Combined remaining mana seems usable, but one last Projection is limit before uncontrollable arm.
counterexamples.explanation: One more Projection is a bounded self-estimate.

contexts.japanese: 合わせればまだいけそうだが、投影はあと一度が限界だ。その後は何をしても、アーチャーの腕を抑えきれなくなる。
contexts.english: I think I can manage with that combined power, but I'm limited to one last Projection. I won't be able to control Archer's arm anymore, no matter what I do afterwards.

counterexamples.description: Distant voice stays unfamiliar.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He does not recognize the calling voice.
counterexamples.explanation: Distant voice stays unfamiliar.

contexts.japanese: 聞き覚えのない、
contexts.english: unfamiliar.

counterexamples.description: Precious voice impels tin body.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Voice feels important and he moves his inert tin body.
counterexamples.explanation: Precious voice impels tin body.

contexts.japanese: 大切なもののような気がして、ブリキの体を前進させる。
contexts.english: It feels important to me. I walk on in my tin body.

counterexamples.description: Each step erodes thinking.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Progress carves away cognition with collapsing-building simile.
counterexamples.explanation: Each step erodes thinking.

contexts.japanese: 一歩進む度に脳は切り刻まれ、倒壊するビルのように、思考能力が削られていく。
contexts.english: With each step, something carves away my brain's ability to think, like a collapsing building.

counterexamples.description: No sign of combat remains observed.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He sees no indication of fighting.
counterexamples.explanation: No sign of combat remains observed.

contexts.japanese: 戦いの気配など何処にもない。
contexts.english: There are no signs of any fighting.

counterexamples.description: Finite thought cycles retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Thinking has a limited number of cycles left.
counterexamples.explanation: Finite thought cycles retained.

contexts.japanese: 既に、思考は回数制になっている。
contexts.english: My mind only has a limited number of cycles left.

counterexamples.description: Avoiding excess thought protects last weapon.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Extra considerations must not degrade remaining Projection.
counterexamples.explanation: Avoiding excess thought protects last weapon.

contexts.japanese: その最後の武器を、余分な“考察”で劣化させる訳にはいかない。
contexts.english: I can't allow any excess considerations to degrade my final weapon.

counterexamples.description: Emotionless red eyes retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Sakura's red eyes lack emotion.
counterexamples.explanation: Emotionless red eyes retained.

contexts.japanese: 感情のない赤い瞳。
contexts.english: Her red eyes lack any emotion.

counterexamples.description: Alien smile causes forgotten words and Projection.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Her unlike-self smile makes him forget speech and projected object.
counterexamples.explanation: Alien smile causes forgotten words and Projection.

contexts.japanese: 言うべき言葉、投影すべき物を忘却させるほど、桜の笑みは“別人”すぎた。
contexts.english: Sakura's smile is so unlike herself that I forget what I was going to say or what I needed to Project.

counterexamples.description: Forgotten rescue words yield unnecessary Rin question.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He forgets words to restore Sakura and asks what he already thinks he knows.
counterexamples.explanation: Forgotten rescue words yield unnecessary Rin question.

contexts.japanese: 桜を取り戻す言葉を忘れて、しなくてもいい質問、分かりきった疑問を口にする。
contexts.english: I forget what I needed to say to bring Sakura back, and ask an unnecessary question that I already know the answer to.

counterexamples.description: Ribbon-like trace remains uncertain.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Observed black scrap resembles ribbon at her feet.
counterexamples.explanation: Ribbon-like trace remains uncertain.

contexts.japanese: 黒く染まった地面には、黒い、リボンのような布きれが転がっている。
contexts.english: There's something that looks like a black ribbon on the darkened ground around her feet.

counterexamples.description: Saving two and killing Rin is Sakura's accusation.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She credits boy with saving Saber and Sakura and killing Rin for her.
counterexamples.explanation: Saving two and killing Rin is Sakura's accusation.

contexts.japanese: 「けど嬉しいです。先輩はセイバーを助けて、わたしを助けて、姉さんを殺してくれた。
contexts.english: "But I'm so happy. You saved Saber, saved me, and killed Nee-san for me.

counterexamples.description: Offer to swallow boy retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Sakura plans to take Shirou in too.
counterexamples.explanation: Offer to swallow boy retained.

contexts.japanese: 「—先輩も一緒に取り込んであげます。
contexts.english: "I'm going to swallow you up, too.

counterexamples.description: Giants merge into consuming wave.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Giants meld and swallow him as tsunami.
counterexamples.explanation: Giants merge into consuming wave.

contexts.japanese: 巨人たちは溶け合い、津波となって俺を呑み込んだ。
contexts.english: The giants meld together and swallow me like a tsunami.

counterexamples.description: Sensation immediately vanishes.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He loses all body sensation instantly.
counterexamples.explanation: Sensation immediately vanishes.

contexts.japanese: 一瞬にして全身の感覚が消失する。
contexts.english: Instantly, I lose all sensation in my body.

counterexamples.description: Sakura explicitly alive.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He can verify Sakura lives.
counterexamples.explanation: Sakura explicitly alive.

contexts.japanese: 桜は、生きている。
contexts.english: Sakura is alive.

counterexamples.description: Grail condition on eventual emergence retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Shadow will emerge eventually while Greater Grail remains.
counterexamples.explanation: Grail condition on eventual emergence retained.

contexts.japanese: この大聖杯がある限り、いずれ、自分から外に這い出て来るだろう。
contexts.english: As long as the Greater Grail exists, it'll come crawling out someday.

counterexamples.description: Cave collapse alone may not destroy it.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He does not think cave-in would erase entity.
counterexamples.explanation: Cave collapse alone may not destroy it.

contexts.japanese: ……だが、この洞穴が崩れたところでアレが消え去るとは思えない。
contexts.english: ...But I don't think it'll disappear even if the cave comes down.

counterexamples.description: Strongest weapon limited to his knowledge.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Plan uses strongest Noble Phantasm he knows.
counterexamples.explanation: Strongest weapon limited to his knowledge.

contexts.japanese: 俺が知り得る限り最強の宝具で、あの怪物を一掃する。
contexts.english: To blow it away with the most powerful Noble Phantasm I know of.

counterexamples.description: About hundred meters retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Distance to target is roughly100 meters.
counterexamples.explanation: About hundred meters retained.

contexts.japanese: アンリマユの足元まで、ざっと百メートル。
contexts.english: It's about a hundred meters to Aŋra Mainiiu's feet.

counterexamples.description: Escape plan interrupts mid-utterance.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Taking both women back breaks off.
counterexamples.explanation: Escape plan interrupts mid-utterance.

contexts.japanese: さっさと片付けて、二人を地上に連れ戻、
contexts.english: I'll clean this all up, and take them back—

counterexamples.description: Trust remains when name is lost.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He recognizes familiar trustworthy woman without producing name.
counterexamples.explanation: Trust remains when name is lost.

contexts.japanese: よく知っている。なにやら物騒な格好をしているが、この女性は信頼できると、覚えている。
contexts.english: I know her well. She looks kinda scary, but I remember that this woman can be trusted.

counterexamples.description: Women explicitly entrusted to escape.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He asks woman to take Sakura and Rin out.
counterexamples.explanation: Women explicitly entrusted to escape.

contexts.japanese: 「助かった。遠坂と桜を連れて、外に出られるか」
contexts.english: "Thanks. Can you take Tohsaka and Sakura back outside?"

counterexamples.description: Remastering risk remains hypothetical.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He warns Angra Mainyu may try to make Sakura Master again.
counterexamples.explanation: Remastering risk remains hypothetical.

contexts.japanese: 「アレを閉じてから行く。すぐ終わるだろうけど、遠坂の傷は一刻を争う。桜だって、ここにいたらアイツの影響を受けるだろう。アンリマユとやらは、懲りずに桜をマスターにするかもしれない」
contexts.english: "I'm going to shut that thing off. I think it'll be quick, but Tohsaka's wound needs help soon. It's going to affect Sakura if she stays here. Aŋra Mainiiu might not have learned its lesson and still try to make her its Master."

counterexamples.description: Rider name remains broken.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Ri-R-R fails before he falls back on her speed.
counterexamples.explanation: Rider name remains broken.

contexts.japanese: 「頼む。なんとか二人を連れて外に出てくれ。洞窟、崩れ出してるだろ。ええっと、ラ—ラ、ラ、くそ、アンタの足なら、あんな落盤なんて問題じゃない」
contexts.english: "Thanks. Do what you can to get them out of here. The cave's gonna come down soon, right? Ri—R-R—damn it, anyway, I know you're fast enough to avoid any cave-ins."

counterexamples.description: Rider promises to return after safety.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She says she will get him after moving women to safe place.
counterexamples.explanation: Rider promises to return after safety.

contexts.japanese: —では。二人を安全な場所に運び次第、迎えに来ます」
contexts.english: ...Then I will come get you once I move them to a safe place."

counterexamples.description: Rin required for Sakura's happiness.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He prioritizes treatment and says Sakura cannot be happy without Rin.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin required for Sakura's happiness.

contexts.japanese: 「あー……それは頼もしいんだけど、二人の手当てを優先してくれ。任せられるのはアンタしかいない。こっちはこっちでとっとと逃げるから、遠坂を治してやってくれ。そいつがいないと、桜は幸せになれない」
contexts.english: "Ahh... I'd appreciate that, but you should prioritize their first aid. You're the only one I can count on. I'll be out real soon, so just heal Tohsaka. Sakura won't be happy unless she's around too."

counterexamples.description: Shirou also required retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rider says Sakura needs both him and Rin and rejects another support.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou also required retained.

contexts.japanese: サクラには貴方とリンが必要です。それを肝に銘じておきなさい。……私も、サクラを支えるのは貴方でなければ納得できませんから」
contexts.english: Sakura needs both you and Rin. Please try to remember that... I also do not approve of anyone other than you supporting Sakura."

counterexamples.description: Disconnecting consciousness retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Mind disconnects on hundred-meter approach.
counterexamples.explanation: Disconnecting consciousness retained.

contexts.japanese: 意識が断線する。
contexts.english: My consciousness disconnects.

counterexamples.description: Hundreds of inner blades retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Blades grow from within body.
counterexamples.explanation: Hundreds of inner blades retained.

contexts.japanese: 体の中から、数百の刃が生えてくる。
contexts.english: Hundreds of blades are sprouting from my body.

counterexamples.description: End already set retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Narration says end was determined long before.
counterexamples.explanation: End already set retained.

contexts.japanese: この終わりは、とうに決められていた事だ。
contexts.english: This ending was set a long time ago.

counterexamples.description: One day, hour or minute desired.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He would take even one minute of extension.
counterexamples.explanation: One day, hour or minute desired.

contexts.japanese: たった一日。一時間でも一分でもいい。
contexts.english: Just one day. One hour. Even one minute.

counterexamples.description: Wants to live to limit despite appearances.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He wants remaining life however undignified.
counterexamples.explanation: Wants to live to limit despite appearances.

contexts.japanese: 生きていられるのなら、どんなにみっともなくても、限界までここにいたい。
contexts.english: If I'm going to live, I want to live as long as I can, appearances be damned.

counterexamples.description: Pleasure account remains character narration.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The scene equates life with pursuit of pleasure.
counterexamples.explanation: Pleasure account remains character narration.

contexts.japanese: “生きる”コトに一番重要な部分。生とは快楽の追求であり、それがない人間は獣と同じ。
contexts.english: The most important part of really being alive. Life is the pursuit of pleasure. Without it, humans are just beasts.

counterexamples.description: Arrival may cost identity and purpose.
counterexamples.sourceReading: By reaching target he expects to lose who he is and what to do.
counterexamples.explanation: Arrival may cost identity and purpose.

contexts.japanese: たどり着けたところで、自分が誰か、何をするかを、きっと無くしてしまっている。
contexts.english: By the time I get there, I won't even remember who I am or what I'm supposed to do.

counterexamples.description: Flower-viewing promise retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Remembered line addresses Sakura and proposes seeing flowers.
counterexamples.explanation: Flower-viewing promise retained.

contexts.japanese: 「桜—花を見に行こう」
contexts.english: "Sakura... Let's go look at the flowers."

counterexamples.description: For what and for whom disappear.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He loses his reason and beneficiary for existence.
counterexamples.explanation: For what and for whom disappear.

contexts.japanese: 何の為に誰の為に存在しているのか消失した。
contexts.english: I've lost what and whom I exist for.

counterexamples.description: Body dead explicitly retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Narration states body is dead.
counterexamples.explanation: Body dead explicitly retained.

contexts.japanese: 肉体は死んだ。
contexts.english: My body is dead.

counterexamples.description: Soul remains explicitly retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Soul remains here despite body death.
counterexamples.explanation: Soul remains explicitly retained.

contexts.japanese: だが、ここに、魂が残されている。
contexts.english: But my soul is still here.

counterexamples.description: Shirou died statement retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Narration says Shirou Emiya died.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou died statement retained.

contexts.japanese: そうして衛宮士郎は死んだ。
contexts.english: That's how Shirou Emiya died.

counterexamples.description: Seasonal promise remains incomplete.
counterexamples.sourceReading: When winter ends and spring comes is left unfinished.
counterexamples.explanation: Seasonal promise remains incomplete.

contexts.japanese: いつか冬が過ぎて、春になったら—
contexts.english: Once winter is over and spring comes...

counterexamples.description: Only enough oxygen to move.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Breath brings just enough oxygen for movement.
counterexamples.explanation: Only enough oxygen to move.

contexts.japanese: 呼吸をして、体に、動けるだけの酸素を入れる。
contexts.english: I breathe, taking in just enough oxygen to move.

counterexamples.description: Throat has just one movement.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He can move throat only once.
counterexamples.explanation: Throat has just one movement.

contexts.japanese: 喉は一度しか動かない。
contexts.english: I can only move my throat once.

counterexamples.description: Left arm unsealed.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He releases left arm.
counterexamples.explanation: Left arm unsealed.

contexts.japanese: 左腕を解放する。
contexts.english: I unseal my left arm.

counterexamples.description: Consciousness nearly gone.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Awareness is close to disappearing.
counterexamples.explanation: Consciousness nearly gone.

contexts.japanese: 意識が消えかけてきた。
contexts.english: My consciousness is almost gone.

counterexamples.description: Intent to destroy both Grail and curse.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Strongest known sword is to destroy curse together with Greater Grail.
counterexamples.explanation: Intent to destroy both Grail and curse.

contexts.japanese: 俺が知り得る中で最強の剣を以って、大聖杯ごと、この呪いを破壊する。
contexts.english: I'll make the strongest sword I know and destroy the entire Greater Grail, and this curse.

counterexamples.description: Absolute end prospective in unfinished connector.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He calls this absolute end before unfinished I.
counterexamples.explanation: Absolute end prospective in unfinished connector.

contexts.japanese: それは絶対の終わりだ。
contexts.english: This is the absolute end.

counterexamples.description: Oxygen doubt remains uncertain and broken.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He wonders whether present self needs oxygen and begins a failing movement forecast.
counterexamples.explanation: Oxygen doubt remains uncertain and broken.

contexts.japanese: だが、もしかすると、酸素なんてなくても今の自分は動けるし、酸素をいっぱいとったところで、もうじき動けなくな
contexts.english: But right now, maybe I can move without any oxygen, and even if I breathed in a lot, it won't be long before I—

counterexamples.description: Speaker blank retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Name before told me is absent.
counterexamples.explanation: Speaker blank retained.

contexts.japanese: —は言った。
contexts.english: —told me.

counterexamples.description: Opponent name first absent.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Blank figure stands before Grail in crimson light.
counterexamples.explanation: Opponent name first absent.

contexts.japanese: 赤黒い炎に照らされて、—が立っている。
contexts.english: stands —, lit by dark crimson flames.

counterexamples.description: Certainty explicitly source-bound.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Narrator says lack of survival time is not conjecture.
counterexamples.explanation: Certainty explicitly source-bound.

contexts.japanese: 憶測ではなく、これは断定だ。
contexts.english: That isn't speculation. It's a fact.

counterexamples.description: Minutes remain regardless of action.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Kirei will die within minutes regardless.
counterexamples.explanation: Minutes remain regardless of action.

contexts.japanese: 言峰綺礼は、何をしなくとも、あと数分後に死亡する。
contexts.english: Kirei Kotomine will die in minutes, no matter what.

counterexamples.description: Neither outcome has surviving beneficiary.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Regardless of success no one remains to reap result.
counterexamples.explanation: Neither outcome has surviving beneficiary.

contexts.japanese: だが、どちらが目的を果たそうと、結果を得る者はいない。それを承知でおまえはここまで来た。
contexts.english: But no matter who succeeds, no one will be left to reap the benefits. You knew that when you came here.

counterexamples.description: Others' misfortune gives Kirei bliss.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Kirei derives bliss from others' unhappiness.
counterexamples.explanation: Others' misfortune gives Kirei bliss.

contexts.japanese: 私は、他人の不幸に至福を感じるだけだ」
contexts.english: I derive bliss from others' misfortune."

counterexamples.description: Prenatal evil judgment challenged.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He calls judging evil before birth arrogant and aiding birth love.
counterexamples.explanation: Prenatal evil judgment challenged.

contexts.japanese: 「そもそも何故殺す。生まれる前から悪と決めつけるのは傲慢ではないか。孵りたがっている命ならば、孵化させてやるのが愛ではないのか」
contexts.english: "And why kill it? Is it not arrogant to judge it as evil before it is even born? Is it not love to help birth something which wants to be born?"

counterexamples.description: Old justice lost in choosing Sakura.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Choosing to save Sakura cost justice formerly believed by Shirou Emiya.
counterexamples.explanation: Old justice lost in choosing Sakura.

contexts.japanese: 桜を救うと決めた時点で、俺には、衛宮士郎が信じていた正義はなくなってしまった。
contexts.english: The moment I decided to save Sakura, I lost the justice that Shirou Emiya believed in.

counterexamples.description: Father-killing and Sakura-preservation claim retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Kirei explicitly attributes both acts to desire for answer he cannot give himself.
counterexamples.explanation: Father-killing and Sakura-preservation claim retained.

contexts.japanese: その為におまえの父を殺し、その為に間桐桜を生かした。私では答えは出せない。故に、答えを出せるモノの誕生を願った」
contexts.english: That is why I killed your father and prolonged Sakura Matou's life. I cannot provide the answer, so I wished for the birth of something which can."

counterexamples.description: Shirou understands use of Sakura despite distant goal.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He cannot grasp wish fully but understands Sakura was used for it.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou understands use of Sakura despite distant goal.

contexts.japanese: こいつは—そんな事の為に、桜を。
contexts.english: He used Sakura for a wish like that.

counterexamples.description: Unexpected liking remains tentative.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He thinks he apparently liked Kirei.
counterexamples.explanation: Unexpected liking remains tentative.

contexts.japanese: どうも俺は、言峰綺礼という男が好きだったらしい。
contexts.english: But I think I liked Kirei Kotomine.

counterexamples.description: Both regard themselves as sinners.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Shirou recognizes their shared self-condemnation.
counterexamples.explanation: Both regard themselves as sinners.

contexts.japanese: 共に自身を罪人と思い。
contexts.english: We both think of ourselves as sinners.

counterexamples.description: Impending death is not sole cause of persistence.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Kirei does not stand fast only to obtain wish at life's end.
counterexamples.explanation: Impending death is not sole cause of persistence.

contexts.english: It isn't because he's about to die and wants to see his wish come true.

counterexamples.description: Never another path retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Kirei has walked no other life path.
counterexamples.explanation: Never another path retained.

contexts.japanese: 今までそれ以外の道を歩かなかった。
contexts.english: He's never walked any other path.

counterexamples.description: Envy of others explicitly retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Kirei says he envies them.
counterexamples.explanation: Envy of others explicitly retained.

contexts.japanese: 「—私は、おまえたちを羨んでいる。
contexts.english: "...I envy you all.

counterexamples.description: Their happiness gave him no joy.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Recalled split thought says he could not feel their happiness as happiness.
counterexamples.explanation: Their happiness gave him no joy.

contexts.japanese: “—私には、幸福と感じられなかった”
contexts.english: "...never gave me any joy."

contexts.japanese: “おまえたちが幸福と感じるものが—”
contexts.english: "The things which make you feel happiness..."

counterexamples.description: No happiness attained despite repeated seeking.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He sought and obtained no happiness.
counterexamples.explanation: No happiness attained despite repeated seeking.

contexts.japanese: 求めて求めて、何一つ幸福を得られなかった。
contexts.english: He searched and searched, but never gained even one bit of happiness.

counterexamples.description: Forgotten breathing restarted.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He resumes breath forgotten during exchange.
counterexamples.explanation: Forgotten breathing restarted.

contexts.japanese: 忘れていた呼吸を再開する。
contexts.english: I restart my forgotten breathing.

counterexamples.description: No magical battle.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Narration denies magecraft battle here.
counterexamples.explanation: No magical battle.

contexts.japanese: 魔術戦になどなる訳がない。
contexts.english: This won't be a battle of magecraft.

counterexamples.description: Counter misses and own chest struck.
counterexamples.sourceReading: His right fist misses; impact is received in his chest.
counterexamples.explanation: Counter misses and own chest struck.

contexts.japanese: だが、突き出した右拳は宙を切り、衝撃を受けたのはこちらの胸元。
contexts.english: But my right fist cuts through empty air, and it's my chest that takes an impact.

counterexamples.description: Opponent folds left and strikes abdomen.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Kirei lowers tall body to boy's left and punches stomach.
counterexamples.explanation: Opponent folds left and strikes abdomen.

contexts.japanese: 長身を折り畳むよう俺の左横に屈み、拳で腹を殴りつけ、
contexts.english: He bends his tall body to my left flank, drives a fist into my stomach,

counterexamples.description: Organ-destroying power remains counterfactual.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Even second punch had power to destroy organs.
counterexamples.explanation: Organ-destroying power remains counterfactual.

contexts.japanese: いや、それを言うなら腹を叩いた二撃目ですら、内臓を破壊する威力があった。
contexts.english: No, if we're going with that, even the second blow to my stomach would have destroyed my organs.

counterexamples.description: Chinese martial arts, unnamed school.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Shirou identifies Chinese martial arts used by priest.
counterexamples.explanation: Chinese martial arts, unnamed school.

contexts.japanese: 「神父のクセに、中国拳法、なんて」
contexts.english: "You're a priest who uses Chinese martial arts...?"

counterexamples.description: Teacher's forms and adequacy against dying man.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Kirei calls forms imitation, sufficient against a dying foe.
counterexamples.explanation: Teacher's forms and adequacy against dying man.

contexts.japanese: 「そうでもない。私のコレは真似事だ。師の套路を真似ただけの、内に何も宿らぬ物だが—死に損ないの相手には十分のようだ」
contexts.english: "Not quite. I simply imitate my teacher's taolu. My moves lack internal power...but it is sufficient against a dying man."

counterexamples.description: Striking blade body costs attacker.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Bloody hand is price of attacking bundle of blades barehanded.
counterexamples.explanation: Striking blade body costs attacker.

contexts.japanese: 刃の塊を素手で砕こうとした代償だった。
contexts.english: what he gets for hitting a bundle of blades.

counterexamples.description: Lethal thorns will not stop him.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Kirei will continue even against death-thorn body.
counterexamples.explanation: Lethal thorns will not stop him.

contexts.japanese: あいつは、たとえ相手が死の棘だろうと手を止める事はしない。
contexts.english: He won't stop even if his opponent is covered with lethal thorns.

counterexamples.description: Battle wagers own selves.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He frames battle as wagering selves rather than just outside threat.
counterexamples.explanation: Battle wagers own selves.

contexts.japanese: 「外敵との戦いではなく、自身を賭ける戦いという事だ—！」
contexts.english: "A battle not against an outside threat, but which wagers our very selves on the outcome!"

counterexamples.description: Hourglass vessel breaks before sand empties.
counterexamples.sourceReading: At current rate body-clock vessel shatters before life-time runs out.
counterexamples.explanation: Hourglass vessel breaks before sand empties.

contexts.japanese: このままでいけば、砂時計が空っぽになる前に砂時計ごと破壊される。
contexts.english: At this rate, my hourglass will shatter before it even runs out.

counterexamples.description: Cave-in excluded from attention.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He no longer perceives collapse and falling rubble.
counterexamples.explanation: Cave-in excluded from attention.

contexts.japanese: 止まない落盤の音も、雨のように降り注ぐ土塊も目に入らない。
contexts.english: I don't perceive the sounds of the collapsing cave and the rain of rubble at all.

counterexamples.description: Immediate opponent is target.
counterexamples.sourceReading: What he must defeat is in front of him.
counterexamples.explanation: Immediate opponent is target.

contexts.japanese: 倒すべきモノは目の前にいる。
contexts.english: The thing I need to beat is right in front of me.

counterexamples.description: Opening remains shortened variant.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Consciousness disconnects without09's extra hundred-meter eternity line.
counterexamples.explanation: Opening remains shortened variant.

contexts.japanese: 意識が断線する。
contexts.english: My mind disconnects.

counterexamples.description: Hundreds of blades arise within.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Blades grow from body interior.
counterexamples.explanation: Hundreds of blades arise within.

contexts.japanese: 体の中から、数百の刃が生えてくる。
contexts.english: Hundreds of blades are sprouting from my body.

counterexamples.description: Predetermined ending retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: End had already been set.
counterexamples.explanation: Predetermined ending retained.

contexts.japanese: この終わりは、とうに決められていた事だ。
contexts.english: This ending was set a long time ago.

counterexamples.description: Even minute desired.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He longs for one day, hour or minute.
counterexamples.explanation: Even minute desired.

contexts.japanese: たった一日。一時間でも一分でもいい。
contexts.english: Just one day. One hour. Even one minute.

counterexamples.description: Desire to live despite shame retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He wants live to limit regardless of appearance.
counterexamples.explanation: Desire to live despite shame retained.

contexts.japanese: 生きていられるのなら、どんなにみっともなくても、限界までここにいたい。
contexts.english: If I'm going to live, I want to live as long as I can, appearances be damned.

counterexamples.description: Concrete finger biting present.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He bites fingers trying to preserve self.
counterexamples.explanation: Concrete finger biting present.

contexts.japanese: 自分が自分のままでいる事に、指を食うほど執着している。
contexts.english: I bite my fingers to remind myself that I'm still me.

counterexamples.description: Each step erases him.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Self disappears with forward steps.
counterexamples.explanation: Each step erases him.

contexts.japanese: 一歩進む度に俺は消える。
contexts.english: With each step forward, I disappear.

counterexamples.description: Flower promise survives.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Remembered line proposes seeing flowers with Sakura.
counterexamples.explanation: Flower promise survives.

contexts.japanese: 「桜—花を見に行こう」
contexts.english: "Sakura... Let's go look at the flowers."

counterexamples.description: Purpose and beneficiary lost.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He loses for what and whom he exists.
counterexamples.explanation: Purpose and beneficiary lost.

contexts.japanese: 何の為に誰の為に存在しているのか消失した。
contexts.english: I've lost what and whom I exist for.

counterexamples.description: Body death remains separate.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Body is dead.
counterexamples.explanation: Body death remains separate.

contexts.japanese: 肉体は死んだ。
contexts.english: My body is dead.

counterexamples.description: Soul remains despite body death.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Soul stays here.
counterexamples.explanation: Soul remains despite body death.

contexts.japanese: だが、ここに、魂が残されている。
contexts.english: But my soul is still here.

counterexamples.description: Named death statement retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Narration says Shirou Emiya died.
counterexamples.explanation: Named death statement retained.

contexts.japanese: そうして衛宮士郎は死んだ。
contexts.english: That's how Shirou Emiya died.

counterexamples.description: Seasonal promise stays unfinished.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Winter passes and spring comes, then line breaks off.
counterexamples.explanation: Seasonal promise stays unfinished.

contexts.japanese: いつか冬が過ぎて、春になったら—
contexts.english: Once winter is over and spring comes...

counterexamples.description: Use bars return.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Using last Projection means no going back.
counterexamples.explanation: Use bars return.

contexts.japanese: 使えば、絶対に戻れない。
contexts.english: If I use this, there's no going back.

counterexamples.description: Life obligates alternative search.
counterexamples.sourceReading: As long as alive he must search another method.
counterexamples.explanation: Life obligates alternative search.

contexts.japanese: それでも—命がある限り、まだ他に方法を探さなくては。
contexts.english: Still, as long as I have my life, I need to find another way.

counterexamples.description: Protect-Sakura promise explicit.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He promised protection from everything.
counterexamples.explanation: Protect-Sakura promise explicit.

contexts.japanese: 約束をした。全ての事から桜を守ると。
contexts.english: I made a promise to protect Sakura from everything.

counterexamples.description: Shared-life desire survives typo.
counterexamples.sourceReading: After fragment he wants to live with Sakura.
counterexamples.explanation: Shared-life desire survives typo.

contexts.japanese: 桜を—桜と一緒に、生きていきたい。
contexts.english: I want to Sakura to live—I want to live with Sakura.

counterexamples.description: Curse destruction required in boy's moral formulation.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He sees curse destruction as absolute condition for her happiness after sins.
counterexamples.explanation: Curse destruction required in boy's moral formulation.

contexts.japanese: 桜の罪。桜に幸福が許される絶対条件が、この呪いの破壊にある。
contexts.english: Sakura's sins. Destroying this curse is the absolute condition to let her be happy.

counterexamples.description: Sword in hand before interruption.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Sword appears in his hand.
counterexamples.explanation: Sword in hand before interruption.

contexts.japanese: 手に剣を。
contexts.english: A sword in my hand.

counterexamples.description: Speaker name forgotten.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He hears voice without remembering name.
counterexamples.explanation: Speaker name forgotten.

contexts.japanese: もう名前も思い出せない、誰かの声。
contexts.english: Someone's voice. I can't remember her name.

counterexamples.description: Not returning feared.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Without stopping her he thinks she will never come back.
counterexamples.explanation: Not returning feared.

contexts.japanese: —そうしなければ、—は、二度と帰ってこないと。
contexts.english: If I don't, — will never come home.

counterexamples.sourceReading: He wants life but must recover name and stop sacrifice.
counterexamples.explanation: Wants live and stop her simultaneously.

contexts.japanese: 生きたい。名前を。名前を呼んで、止めさせないと。
contexts.english: I want to live. What's her name? I have to say her name and stop her.

counterexamples.sourceReading: He knows affirmative answer makes her disappear yet wishes to live wholeheartedly.
counterexamples.explanation: Desire persists despite understood cost.

contexts.english: But I want to live. I know — will disappear if I nod, what's her name, I wish from the bottom of my heart to live.

counterexamples.sourceReading: He says no need show it, come back.
counterexamples.explanation: Miracle refused as sacrifice.

contexts.japanese: いい。そんなの見なくていい。いいから戻ってきてくれ。
contexts.english: Don't do it. You don't have to show me. Just come back.

counterexamples.sourceReading: Only her body can be used; imperfect result expected fixable with Rin.
counterexamples.explanation: Imperfect body and Rin trial-and-error preserved.

contexts.japanese: 使えるのはわたしの体しかないから、完全に再現はできないの。けどだいじょうぶ。リンといっしょに試行錯誤すれば、すぐに元通りにしてもらえるわ。
contexts.english: We only have my body to use, so I can't completely recreate it. It'll be okay, though. If you do some trial and error with Rin, I'm sure you can go back to normal.

counterexamples.description: Sacrificial key and first ritual callback retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: White figure becomes sacrificial key and closes Greater Grail like first rite.
counterexamples.explanation: Sacrificial key and first ritual callback retained.

contexts.japanese: 白い装束の誰かは、初めの儀式のように、起動のための生贄になって、大聖杯を閉ざしていく。
contexts.english: Someone in a white dress becomes a sacrificial key and closes the Greater Grail, just like the very first ritual.

counterexamples.description: No blood relation explicit.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She and Shirou not blood related.
counterexamples.explanation: No blood relation explicit.

contexts.japanese: わたしとシロウは血が繋がっていないけど。
contexts.english: We aren't related by blood,

counterexamples.description: Cannot sacrifice and promised togetherness.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He cannot sacrifice her and recalls promised shared life to make up loneliness.
counterexamples.explanation: Cannot sacrifice and promised togetherness.

contexts.japanese: 犠牲にできない。一緒に暮らすって言った。今まで一人にした分、一緒に暮らすって言っただろう。
contexts.english: I can't sacrifice you. I said we'd live together, that I'd make up for all the time you spent alone.

counterexamples.description: Big-sister reversal retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She is older sister so must protect little brother.
counterexamples.explanation: Big-sister reversal retained.

contexts.japanese: ……ええ。わたしはお姉ちゃんだもん。なら、弟を守らなくっちゃ。
contexts.english: ...Yeah. Well, I'm your big sister. So I have to protect my little brother.

counterexamples.description: Actual relative age retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Silver-haired red-eyed girl slightly older than him.
counterexamples.explanation: Actual relative age retained.

contexts.japanese: 俺より少しだけ年上の、銀の髪と赤い目をした—
contexts.english: She's a girl with red eyes and silver hair, a little older than me—

counterexamples.description: Recovered name repeated.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He repeatedly calls Illya after remembering.
counterexamples.explanation: Recovered name repeated.

contexts.japanese: 「イリヤ—イリヤ、イリヤ、イリヤ、イリヤ、イリヤ—！！！」
contexts.english: "Illya... Illya, Illya, Illya, Illya, Illya!!!"

counterexamples.description: Smiling farewell and closed gate.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She says goodbye, smiles and closes Grail gate.
counterexamples.explanation: Smiling farewell and closed gate.

contexts.japanese: じゃあねと微笑って、パタン、と大聖杯の門を閉めた。
contexts.english: She said goodbye, smiled, and shut the door to the Greater Grail.

counterexamples.description: No mana remains in body.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Not even fragment of power left.
counterexamples.explanation: No mana remains in body.

contexts.japanese: この体には、一欠片の魔力も残っていない。
contexts.english: There isn't a single bit of power left in this body.

counterexamples.description: Saved life still sinks.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Life Illya saved is sinking.
counterexamples.explanation: Saved life still sinks.

contexts.japanese: 彼女が救ってくれた命が、沈んでいく。
contexts.english: The life she saved is sinking.

counterexamples.description: Cold pain restores failing awareness.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Pain wakes sinking consciousness.
counterexamples.explanation: Cold pain restores failing awareness.

contexts.japanese: それは沈みかけた意識を覚ます—
contexts.english: It awakens my sinking mind.

counterexamples.description: Only one breath of mana.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Pendant holds one breath's mana.
counterexamples.explanation: Only one breath of mana.

contexts.japanese: ほんの一呼吸分の魔力。
contexts.english: One breath of magical energy.

counterexamples.description: Actual hand extended afterward.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He reaches out after pendant contact.
counterexamples.explanation: Actual hand extended afterward.

contexts.japanese: 手を伸ばす。
contexts.english: I reach out.

counterexamples.description: No greeting at temple.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Nobody welcomes group.
counterexamples.explanation: No greeting at temple.

contexts.japanese: 出迎えはない。
contexts.english: Nobody comes out to greet us.

counterexamples.description: Front-gate restriction is reported.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Boy asks Rider about barrier and heard front-gate-only rule.
counterexamples.explanation: Front-gate restriction is reported.

contexts.japanese: 「……ライダー、大丈夫か？　柳洞寺は結界が張ってあるんだろ。サーヴァントは正門からしか山に入れないって聞いたけど」
contexts.english: "Are you all right, Rider? I know there's a Bounded Field around the temple. I heard Servants can't go in except by the front gate."

counterexamples.description: Visibility self-correction retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Boy discovers he can see pretty well despite complaint.
counterexamples.explanation: Visibility self-correction retained.

contexts.japanese: ……あ。わりと見通せる。
contexts.english: ...Oh. I can see pretty well, actually.

counterexamples.description: Stream motivates source search.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Water must come from somewhere.
counterexamples.explanation: Stream motivates source search.

contexts.japanese: 小川って事は、どこからか水が涌いているって事だ。
contexts.english: That means the water must be coming from somewhere.

counterexamples.description: Don't turn around before restraint removal.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rider explicitly tells boy not to turn.
counterexamples.explanation: Don't turn around before restraint removal.

contexts.japanese: 「—。士郎、振り向かないように」
contexts.english: "...Don't turn around, Shirou."

counterexamples.description: Water is spring rather than river.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Small stream is spring spilling from rock.
counterexamples.explanation: Water is spring rather than river.

contexts.japanese: ……それは川というより、岩からこぼれる清水の流れにすぎなかった。
contexts.english: It turned out to be only a spring, rather than a river.

counterexamples.description: Rider guards rear.

counterexamples.explanation: Rider guards rear.

contexts.japanese: 「先にどうぞ。後は私が守ります」
contexts.english: "Go ahead. I will guard the rear."

counterexamples.description: Back-down cramped descent retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He must descend on back or tumble into darkness.
counterexamples.explanation: Back-down cramped descent retained.

contexts.japanese: 背中をつけて下っていかなければ、すぐさま無限の闇へ転がり落ちていきそうだ。
contexts.english: I'll tumble down into the infinite darkness unless I slowly go down on my back.

counterexamples.description: Depth still unknown.

counterexamples.explanation: Depth still unknown.

contexts.japanese: ……先はどれほど暗く、地下に続いているかは判らない。
contexts.english: ...The way ahead is dark, and I can't tell how far down this goes.

counterexamples.explanation: Rin asks why jeweled sword made.

contexts.japanese: 「宝石剣。なんで作ってくれたの」
contexts.english: "The Jeweled Sword. Why did you make it for me?"

counterexamples.description: Rescue requires Rin despite risk.

counterexamples.explanation: Rescue requires Rin despite risk.

contexts.japanese: 「よくない。よくないけど、遠坂がいないと桜は助けられない。桜を助けたいんなら、一人より二人の方が確実だろ。
contexts.english: "I'm not okay with it. But I can't save Sakura without you, and we have a better chance together than alone.

counterexamples.description: Second sword-projection promise retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He had promised to Project sword.
counterexamples.explanation: Second sword-projection promise retained.

contexts.japanese: ……それに、剣を投影するのは約束だった。
contexts.english: ...Plus, I promised you that I'd Project the sword.

counterexamples.description: Broken prior promise specifically victory.

contexts.japanese: 聖杯戦争の勝者を遠坂にすると約束した。
contexts.english: I promised to make Tohsaka the victor of the Holy Grail War.

counterexamples.description: Rin is girl liked formerly.

counterexamples.explanation: Rin is girl liked formerly.

contexts.japanese: 何も無かった俺を信じてくれた、遠坂凛っていう、好きだった女の子の為に。
contexts.english: For Rin Tohsaka, the girl I liked at the time, who believed in me when I had nothing left.

contexts.japanese: 「ああ。遠坂ほどじゃないけどな」
contexts.english: "Yeah. Not as much as you are, though."

contexts.english: "...Let's go. From here on out, prioritize your own life."

counterexamples.description: Rider explicitly follows too.

counterexamples.explanation: Rider explicitly follows too.

contexts.english: Rider and I move forward, keeping an eye on our surroundings.

counterexamples.description: Blood trace certain but owner unknown.
