counterexamples.explanation: Blood trace certain but owner unknown.

contexts.japanese: 間違いなく血の跡だ。
contexts.english: These are unmistakably bloodstains.

counterexamples.description: Prior entrant remains question.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He asks whether someone came before them.
counterexamples.explanation: Prior entrant remains question.

contexts.japanese: 俺たちより先に来た者がいるのか。
contexts.english: Did someone get here before us?

counterexamples.description: Losing focus threatens disconnection.
counterexamples.sourceReading: If attention lapses mind shuts off.
counterexamples.explanation: Losing focus threatens disconnection.

contexts.japanese: 気を抜けば意識が切れる。
contexts.english: If I lose focus, my mind will shut off.

counterexamples.description: Right-hand pendant retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He grips pendant tightly with right hand.
counterexamples.explanation: Right-hand pendant retained.

contexts.japanese: 右手に持ったペンダントを強く握る。
contexts.english: I grip the pendant tightly in my right hand.

counterexamples.description: Others absent from gatekeeper cavern.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Sakura, Zouken and Assassin not visibly there.
counterexamples.explanation: Others absent from gatekeeper cavern.

contexts.japanese: 桜も、臓硯もアサシンも姿がない。
contexts.english: I don't see Sakura, Zouken, or Assassin.

counterexamples.description: Boy still lacks sword-power knowledge.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He says he does not know abilities.
counterexamples.explanation: Boy still lacks sword-power knowledge.

contexts.japanese: あの剣がどんな能力を持っているかは知らないが、セイバーとまともに斬り合うハラらしい。
contexts.english: I don't know what powers that sword has, but she seems to think it'll work in a clash against Saber.

counterexamples.description: Only secret weapon kept for remaining foes.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He wants jeweled sword unrevealed against supposed Zouken/Assassin presence.
counterexamples.explanation: Only secret weapon kept for remaining foes.

contexts.japanese: 手の内が判っているセイバーなら、こっちにも対抗策がある。まだ臓硯とアサシンが控えている状況で、唯一“秘密”である宝石剣を使うのは—
contexts.english: I know Saber, so there are ways to deal with her. We shouldn't reveal our only secret weapon while Zouken and Assassin could still be waiting—

counterexamples.description: Trust keeps uncertainty about fate.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin trusts boy without knowing what happens to him.
counterexamples.explanation: Trust keeps uncertainty about fate.

contexts.japanese: 「士郎。アンタがどうなるかは知らないけど、わたしは信頼してるんだから。ちゃんと期待に応えてよね」
contexts.english: "Shirou. I don't know what will happen to you, but I trust you. Make sure you live up to that."

counterexamples.description: Don't arrive too late conditional on rescue.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She warns boy to arrive soon if he wants save Sakura.
counterexamples.explanation: Don't arrive too late conditional on rescue.

contexts.japanese: 「だ、だから、ケリがついた後に来られて文句言われるのも迷惑だってコト！　……その、桜を助けたいっていうんなら、あんまり遅くならないようにね」
contexts.english: "I-I'm saying that I don't want you to complain when you show up after everything's over! ...If you want to save Sakura, then don't take too long."

counterexamples.description: Boy's death threatened.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Saber says he will die here.
counterexamples.explanation: Boy's death threatened.

contexts.japanese: 「それは不可能です。貴方はここで死ぬのですから、シロウ」
contexts.english: "That is impossible. You will die here, Shirou."

counterexamples.description: Rider challenges passage-rule application.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She says staying here should protect him under stated order.
counterexamples.explanation: Rider challenges passage-rule application.

contexts.japanese: 「殺す、とは聞き捨てなりませんね。貴方が手にかけるのはこの道を通る者のみ。彼がこの場に留まるのなら、貴方に襲われる事はない筈ですが」
contexts.english: "Did I hear you correctly? You said that you would only kill those who attempt to pass. If he stays here, you should not attack him."

counterexamples.description: Saber knows he cannot stay.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He knows cannot win yet must proceed.
counterexamples.explanation: Saber knows he cannot stay.

contexts.japanese: だが、その男はどうあっても先に進む。私には勝てないと理解していながら、先に進むしかない。
contexts.english: But he will try to pass. He knows he cannot beat me, but he still needs to go.

counterexamples.description: Destruction resolve grounded in Sakura rescue.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Saber is obstacle to boy's rescue purpose.
counterexamples.explanation: Destruction resolve grounded in Sakura rescue.

contexts.japanese: 「俺は桜を助ける。その為に、おまえは邪魔だ」
contexts.english: "I'm going to save Sakura. You're in the way."

counterexamples.description: Agreed Rider role takes front.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rider places boy behind and engages Saber according to plan.
counterexamples.explanation: Agreed Rider role takes front.

contexts.japanese: 「士郎、貴方は後ろに。指示通り、セイバーの相手は私がします」
contexts.english: "Shirou, get behind me. I will engage Saber, as planned."

counterexamples.description: Boy must await opportunity.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rider creates situation and tells him stay still watch timing.
counterexamples.explanation: Boy must await opportunity.

contexts.japanese: 「状況は私が作ります。貴方は動かず、機を逃さぬよう気を配りなさい」
contexts.english: "I will create an opportunity. Stay still and make sure you don't miss it."

counterexamples.description: Entrusted life explicit.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rider puts her life in his hands.
counterexamples.explanation: Entrusted life explicit.

contexts.japanese: 「—では。私の命は貴方に預けます、士郎」
contexts.english: "I am off. My life is in your hands, Shirou."

counterexamples.description: Shirou question is last barrier.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Question about boy is final inner barrier.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou question is last barrier.

contexts.japanese: 凛の問いかけは、少女にとって最後の関だった。
contexts.english: Rin's question was the last barrier.

counterexamples.description: Sole desired kill identified.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She says Shirou alone is person she really wants to kill.
counterexamples.explanation: Sole desired kill identified.

contexts.japanese: ううん—わたしが殺してしまいたいのはあの人だけなんです、姉さん。
contexts.english: Actually, he's the only person I really want to kill, Nee-san.

counterexamples.description: Inward incorporation distinguished from spoken kill.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Unquoted completion wants swallow Senpai.
counterexamples.explanation: Inward incorporation distinguished from spoken kill.

contexts.japanese: —先輩も、呑み込んでしまいたい。
contexts.english: ...I want to hurry up and swallow Senpai.

counterexamples.description: Delegating their issue to Shirou judged mistake.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin decides entrusting sisters' problem to boy was wrong.
counterexamples.explanation: Delegating their issue to Shirou judged mistake.

contexts.japanese: そもそも自分たちの問題を、士郎に預けようとした事が間違いだった。
contexts.english: It was always a mistake to entrust their personal problems to Shirou.

counterexamples.description: Cannot criticize Shirou after own failure.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin links her inability to his choice.
counterexamples.explanation: Cannot criticize Shirou after own failure.

contexts.japanese: 「……あーあ。士郎の事は言えないな、わたしも」
contexts.english: "...Oh, man. I can't rag on Shirou anymore, can I?"

counterexamples.description: Distant-thunder memory inaccessible.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He wonders but cannot retrieve hearing such thunder.
counterexamples.explanation: Distant-thunder memory inaccessible.

contexts.japanese: ぼんやりと頭に浮かんだが、いつ、遠雷なんてものを聞いたのか、思い出す事ができなかった。
contexts.english: I wonder about it absently, but I can't remember a time I ever heard distant thunder.

counterexamples.description: Dagger crumbles with Saber disappearance.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Both disappearance and blade collapse coincide.
counterexamples.explanation: Dagger crumbles with Saber disappearance.

contexts.japanese: ……セイバーが影になって消えていくのと同時に、手にした短剣が崩れていく。
contexts.english: ...The dagger in my hand began to crumble as soon as Saber disappeared back into the shadows.

counterexamples.description: Azoth fully destroyed.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Blade crumbles to dust after all-reserve investment.
counterexamples.explanation: Azoth fully destroyed.

contexts.japanese: 遠坂がありったけの貯蓄を注ぎ込んで作り上げたアゾット剣は、跡形もなく砕け散ってしまった。
contexts.english: The Azoth Blade that Tohsaka put her life savings into has crumbled to dust.

counterexamples.description: One final Projection estimated.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Combined reserves seem usable once, then uncontrollable arm.
counterexamples.explanation: One final Projection estimated.

contexts.japanese: 合わせればまだいけそうだが、投影はあと一度が限界だ。その後は何をしても、アーチャーの腕を抑えきれなくなる。
contexts.english: I think I can manage with that combined power, but I'm limited to one last Projection. I won't be able to control Archer's arm anymore, no matter what I do afterwards.

counterexamples.description: Bullet-proof impression remains boast.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He bets bullet would bounce with metallic joints.
counterexamples.explanation: Bullet-proof impression remains boast.

contexts.japanese: これなら、鉄砲をうけても跳ね返しそうだ。
contexts.english: I bet bullets would bounce off me now.

counterexamples.description: Bleeding deliberately ignored.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He pretends not see blood.
counterexamples.explanation: Bleeding deliberately ignored.

contexts.japanese: 見ないフリをした。
contexts.english: I pretend not to see it.

counterexamples.description: Rider hurt and mana exhausted.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Alive but wrecked body and little mana.
counterexamples.explanation: Rider hurt and mana exhausted.

contexts.japanese: ただ、体じゅうボロボロで、魔力もほとんど尽きている。
contexts.english: But she's beat up all over, and most of her magical energy is spent.

counterexamples.description: Catch up when able run.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He goes ahead and asks pursuit after recovery.
counterexamples.explanation: Catch up when able run.

contexts.japanese: 「先に行ってる。走れるようになったら来てくれ」
contexts.english: "I'm going on ahead. Catch up later once you can run."

counterexamples.description: Dry slave-driver complaint retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rider says he works people harder than expected.
counterexamples.explanation: Dry slave-driver complaint retained.

contexts.japanese: 「っ—う。……思ったより、人使いが荒いのですね、貴方は」
contexts.english: "Ngh...urgh. You're more of a slave driver than I expected."

counterexamples.description: Rider wisely waits reliable recovery.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Does not force body before proper recovery.
counterexamples.explanation: Rider wisely waits reliable recovery.

contexts.japanese: ここで無理をして立ち上がるより、確実に回復してから動くべきだと判っているのだ。
contexts.english: She knows that she should take time to properly recover instead of forcing herself to get up.

counterexamples.description: Tremor intervals shorten.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Tremors occur more frequently.
counterexamples.explanation: Tremor intervals shorten.

contexts.japanese: ……地鳴りの間隔が狭まっている。
contexts.english: ...The tremors are happening more often.

counterexamples.description: Cough product unnamed.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Something exits mouth.
counterexamples.explanation: Cough product unnamed.

contexts.japanese: 口から何か出た。
contexts.english: Something comes out of my mouth.

counterexamples.description: Clothes split from inside.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Wound opens through clothes internally.
counterexamples.explanation: Clothes split from inside.

contexts.japanese: 服が内側から破れて、大きな傷口が見えていた。
contexts.english: My clothes are torn from the inside, and I can see gaping wounds.

counterexamples.description: Earlier record lacked entity.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Illya-record wasteland did not contain this thing.
counterexamples.explanation: Earlier record lacked entity.

contexts.japanese: 以前、イリヤの記録にあった荒野に、あんなモノは存在しなかった。
contexts.english: That didn't exist in the wasteland I saw in Illya's record.

counterexamples.description: Entity took Sakura in boy's framing.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He calls it thing that took Sakura from him.
counterexamples.explanation: Entity took Sakura in boy's framing.

contexts.japanese: 俺から桜をとっていった奴か。
contexts.english: The thing that took Sakura from me.

counterexamples.description: Incarnation nearly underway.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He says entity almost incarnated.
counterexamples.explanation: Incarnation nearly underway.

contexts.japanese: 「—受肉、しかけてる」
contexts.english: "It's almost incarnated..."

counterexamples.description: Flashy battle inferred as Rin.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Boy does not know actions but concludes style is Rin.
counterexamples.explanation: Flashy battle inferred as Rin.

contexts.japanese: ……何が起きているのかは判らないが、まあ、ああいう派手なのは遠坂に決まっている。
contexts.english: ...I don't know what's happening up there, but given how flashy it is, it can only be Tohsaka.

counterexamples.description: Complete body needed to emerge.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He judges it cannot exit before complete flesh.
counterexamples.explanation: Complete body needed to emerge.

contexts.japanese: あそこで完全に“肉体”を形成しなければ、ヤツは外に出て来れない。
contexts.english: It can't come out unless its body is fully formed.

counterexamples.description: Contempt becomes clear refusal.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Not-on-my-watch rejects entity's emergence.
counterexamples.explanation: Contempt becomes clear refusal.

contexts.japanese: 「—ふざけろ」
contexts.english: "...Not on my watch."

counterexamples.description: Time stop is subjective flash.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Huge light makes it seem time stops.
counterexamples.explanation: Time stop is subjective flash.

contexts.japanese: そうとしか思えないほどの、強大な光が放たれ、そして—
contexts.english: An enormous source of light blinds me enough to feel that way, and...

counterexamples.description: Child-like wail and violent shaking.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Wail accompanies onset of stronger world shaking.
counterexamples.explanation: Child-like wail and violent shaking.

contexts.japanese: 子供のような泣き声と共に、大きく、世界が揺れ始めた。
contexts.english: I hear a child-like wail, and the world begins to shake violently.

counterexamples.description: Deeper emergence convulsion.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Squirming giant attempting emergence explains fundamental collapse.
counterexamples.explanation: Deeper emergence convulsion.

contexts.japanese: これはもっと根本的な部分の崩壊であり、あの巨大な影が、外に出ようとする惷動だった。
contexts.english: This is destruction on a more fundamental level. It's the frenzied squirming of that giant shadow attempting to come out.

counterexamples.description: Arrival too late visibly registered.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Sight burns late-arrival failure into eyes.
counterexamples.explanation: Arrival too late visibly registered.

contexts.japanese: 自分が遅かった事を、網膜に焼き付けた。
contexts.english: and a scene that I was too late to stop is burned into my eyes.

counterexamples.description: Rin face-down and face unseen.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He cannot yet see her face.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin face-down and face unseen.

contexts.japanese: うつぶせに倒れた遠坂の顔は見えない。
contexts.english: Tohsaka's sprawled face down, and I can't see her face.

counterexamples.description: Stem-fallen flower image.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin resembles large flower fallen from stalk.
counterexamples.explanation: Stem-fallen flower image.

contexts.japanese: 地面に崩れ落ちた遠坂は、茎から落ちた大輪の花のようだった。
contexts.english: She resembles a large flower fallen from its stem.

counterexamples.description: Core identity despite engulfment retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Sakura's core unchanged despite shadow swallowing her.
counterexamples.explanation: Core identity despite engulfment retained.

contexts.japanese: どんなに影に呑まれようと、その芯は変わらない。
contexts.english: Even if the Shadow swallows her, she hasn't changed at her core.

counterexamples.description: Possibility escalates to resolve and joint responsibility.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Still can save; no, will save whatever it takes; both must save her.
counterexamples.explanation: Possibility escalates to resolve and joint responsibility.

contexts.japanese: 「そうだ、死んでいない。まだ助かる。いや、どうあっても助けるんだ。俺とおまえで助けなくっちゃいけないんだ。そうだろう、桜」
contexts.english: "That's right. She isn't dead. We can still save her. No, we will save her. You and I need to save her. Isn't that right, Sakura?"

counterexamples.description: Shirou shields Rin and takes blow on back.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Covers her with body and receives attack behind.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou shields Rin and takes blow on back.

contexts.japanese: 遠坂に覆い被さって、影の一撃を背中で受ける。
contexts.english: I shield Tohsaka with my body and take the Shadow's attack on my back.

counterexamples.description: Childish tantrum rather than lofty demon purpose retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Petulant loser doesn't want Sakura taken away.
counterexamples.explanation: Childish tantrum rather than lofty demon purpose retained.

contexts.japanese: 「わかってる。往生際が悪いガキの仕業だ。桜をとられたくないって、駄々をこね始めやがった。
contexts.english: "I know. It's that sore loser behind you. It doesn't want me to take you, so it's throwing a tantrum.

counterexamples.description: Sakura's cry apparently changes lethal trajectory.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Would sever head but cry seems to divert it.
counterexamples.explanation: Sakura's cry apparently changes lethal trajectory.

contexts.japanese: 本来なら俺の首をかっ飛ばしたソレは、桜の叫びで、軌道を変えてくれたようだ。
contexts.english: It would have taken my head off, but Sakura's shout seems to have changed its trajectory.

counterexamples.description: Advance's harm to Sakura retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: His steps tighten restraint and hurt heart/body.
counterexamples.explanation: Advance's harm to Sakura retained.

contexts.japanese: 俺の前進は、桜の心と体を傷つけている。
contexts.english: My advance is hurting Sakura's body and heart.

counterexamples.description: Deliberate blunt push retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Non-stabbing impact intentionally pushes boy away.
counterexamples.explanation: Deliberate blunt push retained.

contexts.japanese: 今のは桜が、自分の意志で俺を押しのけようとしたものだ。
contexts.english: Sakura did it out of her own will, to push me away.

contexts.japanese: ……刺し傷じゃない、ただの打撃だ。
contexts.english: ...It isn't a stab. It was just a dull punch.

counterexamples.description: Irrestitution and demand to live retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Cannot return lives taken, asks if still told to live.
counterexamples.explanation: Irrestitution and demand to live retained.

contexts.japanese: そんな—そんな人間にどうしろっていうんです……！　奪ってしまったものは返せない。わたしは多くの人を殺しました。それでも、それでも生きていけっていうんですか、先輩は……！」
contexts.english: What's someone like me supposed to do now!? I can't give back what I've taken from them. I've killed too many people. Are you still going to tell me to live despite all that, Senpai!?"

counterexamples.description: Nonvoluntary acts still leave lasting guilt retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Taking lives stays in her heart even if not her will.
counterexamples.explanation: Nonvoluntary acts still leave lasting guilt retained.

contexts.japanese: どうあっても、桜の意思でなかったとしても、多くの人の命を奪った咎は、桜の心に在り続けるだろう。
contexts.english: No matter what, she'll never forget the sin of taking so many lives, even if it wasn't of her own free will.

counterexamples.description: Responsibility response retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Because lives taken, fulfill responsibility; yes he still asks living.
counterexamples.explanation: Responsibility response retained.

contexts.japanese: 「—当然だろう。奪ったからには責任を果たせ、桜」
contexts.english: "...Of course I am. You need to take responsibility for what you've done, Sakura."

counterexamples.description: Ignorance of guilt allocation and punishment retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He doesn't know where guilt lies or punishment's weight.
counterexamples.explanation: Ignorance of guilt allocation and punishment retained.

contexts.japanese: 「そうだ。罪の所在も罰の重さも、俺には判らない」
contexts.english: "Yeah. I don't know who's responsible or how heavy the punishment should be."

counterexamples.description: Penetration expressly negated.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Shadow attacks slide aside with sparks, do not pierce.
counterexamples.explanation: Penetration expressly negated.

contexts.japanese: 影は突き刺さらず、火花をこぼしてズレていく。
contexts.english: They get deflected and fail to pierce me, throwing up a shower of sparks.

counterexamples.description: All remaining mana spent on one replication.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Shirou's remaining energy entirely poured into copy.
counterexamples.explanation: All remaining mana spent on one replication.

contexts.japanese: 衛宮士郎に残った魔力を、全てその複製に注ぎ込む。
contexts.english: Shirou Emiya devotes all of his remaining magical energy into its replication.

counterexamples.description: Contract-breaking dagger function retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Raises final projected contract-breaking dagger.
counterexamples.explanation: Contract-breaking dagger function retained.

contexts.japanese: 契約破りの短剣を振り上げる。
contexts.english: I raise a dagger of contract-breaking.

counterexamples.description: Yes and willing chest presentation retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She steels breath, briefly answers yes and offers target.
counterexamples.explanation: Yes and willing chest presentation retained.

contexts.japanese: はい、と短く答えて、桜は自ら胸を差し出し—
contexts.english: Sakura says, "yes," and exposes her chest.

counterexamples.description: Homecoming and cutting ties retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Come home; break ties with entity.
counterexamples.explanation: Homecoming and cutting ties retained.

contexts.japanese: 「帰ろう桜。—そんなヤツとは縁を切れ」
contexts.english: "Let's go home, Sakura. Cut your ties with that guy."

counterexamples.description: Heart stab apparent lethality retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: One breath thrust into her heart.
counterexamples.explanation: Heart stab apparent lethality retained.

contexts.japanese: 一息で、彼女の心臓を突き刺した。
contexts.english: In a breath, I stab her in the heart.

counterexamples.description: Internal destruction bypasses altered exterior.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Palm blow targets interior rather than surface.
counterexamples.explanation: Internal destruction bypasses altered exterior.

contexts.japanese: 外側ではなく内側の破壊を旨とした一撃は、容赦なく衝撃を通してくる。
contexts.english: His attack, aimed at doing internal rather than external damage, ruthlessly sends shockwaves through me.

counterexamples.description: Whitening caused by repair invasion rather than enemy damage.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Pain comes from arm's repairing/rewriting body, not direct damage.
counterexamples.explanation: Whitening caused by repair invasion rather than enemy damage.

contexts.japanese: それは敵によるダメージではなく、傷ついた体を直し、書き換えようとする、左腕からの痛みだった。
contexts.english: It isn't the damage from his attacks, but from the pain of my left arm repairing and overwriting my injured body.

counterexamples.description: Head strike can end combat in one blow.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Untransformed face/head only vulnerable surface.
counterexamples.explanation: Head strike can end combat in one blow.

contexts.japanese: 頭に直撃されては一撃で終わる。
contexts.english: This could end with a single blow to my head.

counterexamples.description: Brain erosion is cost of blade survival.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Blades keep body alive in exchange for brain loss.
counterexamples.explanation: Brain erosion is cost of blade survival.

contexts.japanese: それと引き換えに脳髄が削られていく。
contexts.english: In exchange, my brain is shaved away.

counterexamples.description: One-second mental burnout retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Pain burns him out in another second, ending thought.
counterexamples.explanation: One-second mental burnout retained.

contexts.japanese: あと一秒で痛みに耐え切れず焼き切れ、何も考えられなくなる。
contexts.english: In one more second, I'll give into the pain and burn out, and I won't be able to think anymore.

counterexamples.description: Both unable to run retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Kirei too can only walk, both nearing disappearance.
counterexamples.explanation: Both unable to run retained.

contexts.japanese: ……もう走る事もできないのは敵も同じ。
contexts.english: ...He can't run anymore, either.

counterexamples.description: Private tears and smile only before Shirou retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Always alone tears, smile only before him.
counterexamples.explanation: Private tears and smile only before Shirou retained.

contexts.japanese: 笑っていたのは俺の前だけで、ずっと一人で泣いていたんだ。
contexts.english: She always cried alone, and only ever smiled in front of me.

counterexamples.description: Sakura's no-future-body promise to protect him retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She offered protection despite body without future.
counterexamples.explanation: Sakura's no-future-body promise to protect him retained.

contexts.japanese: 未来のない体で、俺を守ると言った彼女が—
contexts.english: The girl who said she'd protect me, in a body with no future...

counterexamples.description: Counted barrage reaches seven.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Two through seven after first blow, then counter.
counterexamples.explanation: Counted barrage reaches seven.

contexts.japanese: 七撃—！
contexts.english: Seven blows...!

counterexamples.description: Kirei's superior strength retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Many times stronger means cannot easily hit him.
counterexamples.explanation: Kirei's superior strength retained.

contexts.japanese: ちくしょう、そうだよ、そう簡単に殴らせてなんてくれねえよ、あいつの方が何倍も強いんだから、
contexts.english: Damn it, that's right, he won't let me hit him that easily, and he's many times stronger than me...

counterexamples.description: Convenient skill reversal rejected.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Difference of ability cannot be overturned.
counterexamples.explanation: Convenient skill reversal rejected.

contexts.japanese: 実力差は覆らない。
contexts.english: I can't overcome the difference in fighting strength.

counterexamples.description: Earlier forest death timing retained as inference.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Kirei reached dying condition slightly earlier in forest.
counterexamples.explanation: Earlier forest death timing retained as inference.

contexts.japanese: あの森で死に体になったのは、わずかに、この男の方が早かったのか。
contexts.english: He must have started dying just slightly before me in the forest.

counterexamples.description: Victory concession and only seconds remaining retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Kirei concedes, urges goal with uncertain brief bodily duration.
counterexamples.explanation: Victory concession and only seconds remaining retained.

contexts.japanese: 「おまえの勝ちだ衛宮士郎。その体で何秒保つかは知らんが、目的があるのなら急ぐがいい」
contexts.english: "You win, Shirou Emiya. I don't know how many more seconds your body will last, but hurry to your goal if you have one."

counterexamples.description: Enemy remains detestable at final moment.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Unchanged even dying, continues as hated enemy.
counterexamples.explanation: Enemy remains detestable at final moment.

contexts.japanese: 崩れていくこの瞬間さえ、いけすかない俺の敵であり続ける。
contexts.english: He's still my detestable enemy, even as he crumbles away.

counterexamples.description: Final expression uncertain with useless vision.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Whether he smiled cannot be determined by failing eyes.
counterexamples.explanation: Final expression uncertain with useless vision.

contexts.japanese: 最期に男は笑ったのか。
contexts.english: Did he laugh at the end?

contexts.japanese: スクラップ寸前の俺の眼は用を成さず、
contexts.english: My nearly scrap metal eyes are useless.

counterexamples.description: Trust Rider because boy cannot defeat Saber.
counterexamples.sourceReading: No matter what Shirou cannot beat Saber, do own job.
counterexamples.explanation: Trust Rider because boy cannot defeat Saber.

contexts.japanese: そうだよー。シロウじゃどうあってもセイバーには勝てないんだから、ここはライダーを信じて自分の仕事に徹するコト！
contexts.english: Yeah! You can't beat Saber no matter what, Shirou, so trust Rider and focus on your own job!

counterexamples.description: Unheroic rear support steals glory.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Observe far away and steal best part.
counterexamples.explanation: Unheroic rear support steals glory.

contexts.japanese: うむ。士郎の役割は後方支援、遠くから戦いを見守って、おいしいところをかっさらうべし！
contexts.english: Mm-hm. Your job is rear-line support. Watch the duel from far away and steal the glory when the time's right!

counterexamples.description: Only one rescue and keep resolve.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Final battle commitment save one, follow through in any circumstances.
counterexamples.explanation: Only one rescue and keep resolve.

contexts.japanese: 助けられるのは一人だけ。その覚悟で最終決戦に臨んだんだから、どんな状況だろうと貫き通さないと。
contexts.english: You can only save one person. You made up your mind on that before you went to the final battle, so you've got to see it all the way through.

counterexamples.description: Own power rather than uncertain Grail reliance retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Can't rely on Grail may not obtain, must beat both by own resources.
counterexamples.explanation: Own power rather than uncertain Grail reliance retained.

contexts.japanese: だから今は一番確実な方法をとる。手に入るかどうかも分からない聖杯なんかには頼れない。わたしたちはわたしたちだけの力で、臓硯とあの影を倒さないといけない」
contexts.english: But I'm going to take the surest method I know. We can't depend on a Holy Grail that we're not even sure we'll obtain. We have to do everything within our own power to defeat Zouken and the Shadow."

counterexamples.description: Sleep contradiction retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin says not slept once; boy claims properly slept.
counterexamples.explanation: Sleep contradiction retained.

contexts.japanese: 「馬鹿言わないで。士郎、一睡もしてないでしょ。そんな体でいられちゃわたしたちが困るってわからない？」
contexts.english: "Don't be stupid, Shirou. You haven't been sleeping at all. It's going to be a problem for all of us if you stay in that condition."

contexts.japanese: 「それこそバカ言うなよ。昨日はちゃんと眠ったぞ、俺」
contexts.english: "You're the one who sounds stupid. I got a full night's sleep yesterday."

counterexamples.description: Mystic Eyes analogy and knowledge limit retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He thinks imitation concerns Mystic Eyes but as far knows Rin lacks them.
counterexamples.explanation: Mystic Eyes analogy and knowledge limit retained.

contexts.japanese: ライダーの真似事というと魔眼の真似事というコトだが、知っているかぎり遠坂は魔眼持ちじゃない。
contexts.english: She must be talking about Rider's Mystic Eyes, but as far as I know, Tohsaka doesn't have Mystic Eyes of her own.

counterexamples.description: Improvised suggestion merely proposed.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She might improvise sleep suggestion but can't Rider feat.
counterexamples.explanation: Improvised suggestion merely proposed.

contexts.japanese: 「正解。今まで興味はなかったけど、魔眼も悪くないかなって。流石にあんな離れ業は無理だけど、眠りの暗示ぐらいなら即興で出来そうだなって」
contexts.english: "That's right. I wasn't really interested in them before, but Mystic Eyes don't seem so bad. I can't get on her level, obviously, but I might be able to improvise and hypnotize you to sleep."

counterexamples.description: Question explicitly offers yes/no.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Teasing experiment invitation asks yes or no.
counterexamples.explanation: Question explicitly offers yes/no.

contexts.japanese: 「い、いいじゃない別にっ！　それでどうするのよ士郎。
contexts.english: "W-what's wrong with that!? So how about it, Shirou?

contexts.japanese: やるの、やらないの」
contexts.english: Yes or no?"

counterexamples.description: Too-effective spell could paralyze instead of sleep.
counterexamples.sourceReading: If works excessively effect becomes paralysis.
counterexamples.explanation: Too-effective spell could paralyze instead of sleep.

contexts.japanese: 「あ、そうか。うまくかかりすぎたら睡眠じゃなくて麻痺になるものね。士郎、単純だからかかりやすそうだし」
contexts.english: "Oh, right. If it goes too well, I might paralyze you instead of just putting you to sleep. You haven't got much of a resistance after all."

counterexamples.description: Accepting nursing help retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Trust Rin caring Sakura permits accepting kindness.
counterexamples.explanation: Accepting nursing help retained.

contexts.japanese: 遠坂が桜を看ていてくれるなら安心できるし、ここは遠坂の好意に甘えよう。
contexts.english: I can trust Tohsaka to take good care of Sakura, so I'll accept her goodwill.

counterexamples.description: Lunch and dinner reserved for boy.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He delivers two meals; Rin handles remainder.
counterexamples.explanation: Lunch and dinner reserved for boy.

contexts.japanese: 昼食と夕食は俺が持っていくから、それ以外は遠坂に甘えていいか」
contexts.english: I'll bring lunch and dinner to her, but can I ask you to take care of her in the meantime?"

counterexamples.description: Mixed assessment of intuition and cold/kind behavior retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Unsure perceptive/oblivious and cold/kind.
counterexamples.explanation: Mixed assessment of intuition and cold/kind behavior retained.

contexts.japanese: 勘が良いんだか悪いんだか、冷たいヤツなのか優しいヤツなのか。
contexts.english: Sometimes I can't tell if she's perceptive or oblivious, if she's nice or cold.

counterexamples.description: Eleven years require gradual closeness.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Separation not easily bridged, gradually closer.
counterexamples.explanation: Eleven years require gradual closeness.

contexts.japanese: 十一年もの年月はそう簡単には埋まらないだろうが、それでも、少しずつ距離を縮めていって、何気ないことでも笑い合える仲になってほしい。
contexts.english: It won't be easy to overcome 11 years of separation, but I hope they can slowly close the distance and get along well enough to smile together without forcing themselves to.

counterexamples.description: Appearing corrected to opening Grail.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Strictly war-end means Grail opens.
counterexamples.explanation: Appearing corrected to opening Grail.

contexts.japanese: いや、厳密に言えば聖杯が“開かれる”。
contexts.english: To be more precise, it will open.

counterexamples.description: Gate/contents theory remains conditional.
counterexamples.sourceReading: If Zouken's gate explanation true, asks Sakura fate.
counterexamples.explanation: Gate/contents theory remains conditional.

contexts.japanese: ……それが確かなら、聖杯である桜はどうなるのか。
contexts.english: ...IF that's true, then what will happen to Sakura, who's a Holy Grail?

counterexamples.description: Automatic appearance versus last-Master summoning unresolved.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He doesn't know which process applies.
counterexamples.explanation: Automatic appearance versus last-Master summoning unresolved.

contexts.japanese: マスターが最後の一人になった時点で現れるものなのか、最後の一人になったマスターが召喚するものなのか。
contexts.english: It might show up once only one Master is left, or it might need the last Master to summon it.

contexts.japanese: ……これが後者なら問題はない。
contexts.english: ...If it's the latter, that won't be a problem.

counterexamples.description: Confidence in Rin's chance retained as his reasoning.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She would not propose fight without strong odds.
counterexamples.explanation: Confidence in Rin's chance retained as his reasoning.

contexts.japanese: あいつが戦うと言うからには、高い勝算があるという事だ。
contexts.english: She wouldn't say that unless we had a strong chance of victory.

counterexamples.description: Waiting leaves shadow casualties retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Waiting deadline means leaving shadow unattended.
counterexamples.explanation: Waiting leaves shadow casualties retained.

contexts.japanese: 戦いの期限切れを待つ、という事はあの影を放置する、という事。
contexts.english: Waiting the war out would mean allowing the Shadow to keep killing.

counterexamples.description: No death-concept hypothesis conditional.
counterexamples.sourceReading: If contents overflow, shadow probably lacks death concept.
counterexamples.explanation: No death-concept hypothesis conditional.

contexts.japanese: アレが聖杯の中からこぼれてくるモノだとしたら、影自体には死の概念はないだろう。
contexts.english: If it's something that spilled out of the Holy Grail, then the Shadow itself probably has no concept of death.

counterexamples.description: Expected Kirei recognition is boy inference.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Should notice bodily abnormality from oversight/prior-war survival/treatment.
counterexamples.explanation: Expected Kirei recognition is boy inference.

contexts.japanese: なら、桜の体の異状に気がついて然るべきだろう……！
contexts.english: Then he definitely would have noticed what was wrong with Sakura...!

counterexamples.description: Missing-something hunch retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Feels missing, shakes off foreboding and enters.
counterexamples.explanation: Missing-something hunch retained.

contexts.japanese: 嫌な予感、何か欠けている、という虫の報せを振り払って、ドアを開けた。
contexts.english: Something feels wrong, something missing, but I shake off the hunch and open the door.

counterexamples.description: Empty bed after fleeting Rider retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Sakura supposed asleep but nobody in bed, Rider disappears.
counterexamples.explanation: Empty bed after fleeting Rider retained.

contexts.japanese: 桜が眠っている筈のベッドには、誰の姿も見当たらなかった。
contexts.english: The bed that Sakura is supposed to be sleeping in is unoccupied.

counterexamples.description: Rin's protective-command explanation remains probable.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Probably told not harm boy, spirit withdrawal as he entered.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin's protective-command explanation remains probable.

contexts.japanese: ……彼女、貴方には手を出さないよう命じられているんでしょうね。士郎が入ってきた途端、霊体化して外に逃げていったわ」
contexts.english: ...She probably got told not to lay a hand on you. The second you came in, she went into spirit form and ran outside."

counterexamples.description: Cannot finish denying Sakura secrets retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He cannot say there are none and reflects on nightmares.
counterexamples.explanation: Cannot finish denying Sakura secrets retained.

contexts.japanese: あるものか、とは言えなかった。
contexts.english: I can't say for sure that isn't true.

counterexamples.description: Changed-identity dilemma remains conditional.
counterexamples.sourceReading: If found not Sakura anymore knows necessary action.
counterexamples.explanation: Changed-identity dilemma remains conditional.

contexts.japanese: けど—見つけ出して、あの子の姿を見た時。桜がもう桜じゃなかったら、やるべき事は判ってるわね」
contexts.english: But if we find her and she isn't Sakura anymore, you know what we have to do."

counterexamples.description: Recalled eye appeal remains represented memory.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Repeats earlier message read in Rin's eyes.
counterexamples.explanation: Recalled eye appeal remains represented memory.

contexts.japanese: “—もういいでしょう、士郎”
contexts.english: "It's over, Shirou."

counterexamples.description: Separating wall remains simile.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Looks from far away as if wall between.
counterexamples.explanation: Separating wall remains simile.

contexts.japanese: イリヤは遠く、まるで壁があるように、離れた場所から俺を見ていた。
contexts.english: Illya's watching me from afar, as if there's a wall between us.

counterexamples.description: Boy resolve survives changed condition.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Even no longer herself his course still one.
counterexamples.explanation: Boy resolve survives changed condition.

contexts.japanese: 桜が桜でなくなっていようと、俺がする事は一つだけなんだから。
contexts.english: Even if Sakura isn't herself anymore, there's only one thing for me to do.

counterexamples.description: Each girl has another self retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Illya and Sakura each inner other unlike his known girl.
counterexamples.explanation: Each girl has another self retained.

contexts.japanese: 「……そう。けどシロウ。わたしもサクラも、自分の中にもう一つの自分を持っている。それはきっとシロウが知ってるわたしじゃないし、シロウが想ってるサクラとは違うんだよ。
contexts.english: "...I see. Shirou, Sakura and I each have another self inside us. It's a version of me that you don't know, and a version of Sakura that isn't what you think.

counterexamples.description: Full Illya motive remains unknown.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Cannot know how much feeling lies in question.
counterexamples.explanation: Full Illya motive remains unknown.

contexts.japanese: その問いにどれだけの想いが込められているのか、俺には知る由もない。
contexts.english: I don't know what feelings are behind that question.

counterexamples.description: Remaining Illya condition retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: If Illya inside, recognizes known Illya despite transformation.
counterexamples.explanation: Remaining Illya condition retained.

contexts.japanese: その中にイリヤがいるのなら、それは、俺の知っているイリヤだと思う」
contexts.english: If you're still somewhere in there, then you're the Illya I know."

counterexamples.description: Ajar door entrance/exit unresolved.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Did somebody enter or leave, frightening quiet.
counterexamples.explanation: Ajar door entrance/exit unresolved.

contexts.japanese: ……誰かが入っていったのか、それとも出ていったのか。
contexts.english: ...Did someone enter or leave?

counterexamples.description: Only glimpse, never entered Sakura's room.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Shinji brought him, blushing Sakura pushed them outside.
counterexamples.explanation: Only glimpse, never entered Sakura's room.

contexts.japanese: 中に入ったコトはない。
contexts.english: I've never been inside.

counterexamples.description: Plain feminine Sakura room intact entry.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Simple girlish decor unchanged since approximate two years.
counterexamples.explanation: Plain feminine Sakura room intact entry.

contexts.japanese: 女の子らしい部屋。桜らしい飾り気のない部屋。
contexts.english: It's a girly room, barely decorated at all, which is like Sakura.

counterexamples.description: Neglecting Sakura would undermine scolding Shirou.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She can't chastise recklessness if neglects patient herself.
counterexamples.explanation: Neglecting Sakura would undermine scolding Shirou.

contexts.japanese: 士郎の無鉄砲さは頭に来るが、それで桜を放っておいたら士郎をとっちめるコトができなくなる。
contexts.english: Shirou's recklessness is irritating, but she won't be in any position to scold Shirou if she neglects Sakura.

counterexamples.description: Kilometer limit remains Rin estimate.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She confident exhausted boy soon stops down slope.
counterexamples.explanation: Kilometer limit remains Rin estimate.

contexts.japanese: どうせ士郎はすぐに息が上がって、下り坂の途中でぜいぜいと立ち止まるに決まっている。あの体では一キロも走り続けられまい。
contexts.english: Shirou's bound to run out of breath and stop halfway down the hill. He can't run a kilometer in his condition.

counterexamples.description: Strongest remaining member duty to weak companions.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Extra energy entails duty to care exhausted group.
counterexamples.explanation: Strongest remaining member duty to weak companions.

contexts.japanese: 余力がある分、ダウンしている仲間の面倒を見るのは当然の義務である。
contexts.english: It's only responsible of her to spend her extra energy taking care of her exhausted friends.

counterexamples.description: Killer recognition despite inability to reconstruct.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Cannot read what happened, yet knows Sakura killed Shinji.
counterexamples.explanation: Killer recognition despite inability to reconstruct.

contexts.japanese: そんな事、読み取れる筈もないのに、
contexts.english: It shouldn't be possible to glean what happened, but...

contexts.japanese: 慎二を手にかけたのが、彼女だと判ってしまった。
contexts.english: I know she killed him.

counterexamples.description: Less than half day since last night's embrace.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He recalls embrace only hours ago.
counterexamples.explanation: Less than half day since last night's embrace.

contexts.japanese: 昨日の夜から。桜を抱きしめた夜から半日も経っていないというのに、どうして、こんな、事に。
contexts.english: It hasn't even been half a day since I held Sakura last night, so how...why...

counterexamples.description: Zouken remote, no body behind boy.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Voice from somewhere else, house empty.
counterexamples.explanation: Zouken remote, no body behind boy.

contexts.japanese: いま響いたものは、ここではない何処かにいる臓硯の声にすぎない。
contexts.english: This is just Zouken's voice, transmitted from somewhere else.

counterexamples.description: Despair prerequisite to accepting own shadow.
counterexamples.sourceReading: World must become hopeless for her to accept shadow.
counterexamples.explanation: Despair prerequisite to accepting own shadow.

contexts.japanese: 『応よ。桜をその気にさせるのはワシでは出来ぬ。ワシはちと、アレに嫌われすぎてしまったからな。おぬしか慎二、どちらかにアレの堰を壊してもらわねばならなかった。
contexts.english: "Oh, yes. I could not have driven Sakura to such lengths. She despised me a bit too much for that. I needed you or Shinji to break the seal on that dam.

counterexamples.description: Shirou betrayal counterfactual would fully awaken.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Would prefer him betrayal, then not halfway but body/mind shadow.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou betrayal counterfactual would fully awaken.

contexts.japanese: 『いや、欲を言えばおぬしの手で桜を裏切ってほしかったのだぞ？　それならばあのように半端な覚醒では留まらず、心身ともに影そのものに変わり果てたであろうに！
contexts.english: "I would have most preferred it if the betrayal had come from you, though. Then, she wouldn't have awakened only halfway, and would have fully become the Shadow in both body and mind!

counterexamples.description: Monitoring insects destroyed, voice soon lost.
counterexamples.sourceReading: All left bugs crushed, channel will soon stop.
counterexamples.explanation: Monitoring insects destroyed, voice soon lost.

contexts.japanese: 『おお、これは怖い。監視役にと残した蟲どもが軒並み潰れおったわ。はは、これではすぐに声すら届かなくなるな』
contexts.english: "Oh, how fearsome. You've crushed all the bugs I left there to monitor the room. Haha, soon, my voice won't be able to reach you."

counterexamples.description: Mock gratitude prevents either confrontation or killing boy.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Cannot die at goal and won't kill supposedly helpful boy.
counterexamples.explanation: Mock gratitude prevents either confrontation or killing boy.

contexts.japanese: ここでおぬしに殺される訳にもいかぬし、おぬしを仕留めるほど恩知らずでもないのでな』
contexts.english: I can't afford to let you kill me, nor am I ungrateful enough to kill you."

counterexamples.description: Wanting another person taught by boy is malicious credit.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Boy fostered Sakura's desire, according to Zouken.
counterexamples.explanation: Wanting another person taught by boy is malicious credit.

contexts.japanese: 『振ったとも。おぬしはあそこまで桜を育ててくれたではないか。あの娘に、他者を欲するという感情を教え込んだのは他ならぬおぬしよ。
contexts.english: "But you have. You raised her splendidly. You taught her how it feels to want someone else.

counterexamples.description: Grating laughter intact, trailing response excluded.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Loud laugh grates then source interrupted response damaged in keyed witness.
counterexamples.explanation: Grating laughter intact, trailing response excluded.

contexts.japanese: 耳障りな哄笑が響く。
contexts.english: His laugh is grating.

counterexamples.description: Immediate branch prioritizes rescue over taunt.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Stops caring about remote laughter, runs for Illya.
counterexamples.explanation: Immediate branch prioritizes rescue over taunt.

contexts.japanese: 部屋に響きわたる臓硯の笑いなどどうでもいい。
contexts.english: I don't care about Zouken's cackling.

counterexamples.description: Twenty-minute full-speed return retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Home twenty minutes at full sprint.
counterexamples.explanation: Twenty-minute full-speed return retained.

contexts.japanese: 屋敷まで全力で走って二十分。
contexts.english: It takes twenty minutes to get home from the mansion at a full sprint.

counterexamples.description: Angry mistaken house-presence belief retained.
