contexts.english: "Thanks, and sorry, Rider. If I'm not good anymore, find someone new to contract with right away. I'd...rather it not be Senpai, but I guess it's all right if it's you."

counterexamples.description: Noble Phantasm use is future necessity requiring assent.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Ill wind, will use treasure, okay?
counterexamples.explanation: Noble Phantasm use is future necessity requiring assent.

contexts.japanese: 「……よくない風です。宝具を使用する事になりますが、構いませんね」
contexts.english: "...This is an ill breeze. I will need to use my Noble Phantasm, if you don't mind."

counterexamples.description: Danger-conditioned order to return Shirou survives.
counterexamples.sourceReading: If threatened bring boy home.
counterexamples.explanation: Danger-conditioned order to return Shirou survives.

contexts.japanese: 「うん。危なくなったら先輩を連れ帰ってきて」
contexts.english: "Yeah. If Senpai's in danger, bring him home."

counterexamples.description: Unmotivated idle stretch and weary waking preserved.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Arm stretches without purpose, blankly watches ceiling.
counterexamples.explanation: Unmotivated idle stretch and weary waking preserved.

contexts.japanese: 意味もなく片手を伸ばして、ぼんやりと天井を眺めて、ぱたん、と伸ばした腕が布団に落ちた。
contexts.english: I stick my arm up in the air for no real reason, stare at the ceiling, then let it fall on the futon.

counterexamples.description: Accumulated fatigue hypothesis stays tentative.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Wonders whether fatigue built up.
counterexamples.explanation: Accumulated fatigue hypothesis stays tentative.

contexts.japanese: 疲労が溜まっているんだろうか。
contexts.english: Maybe the fatigue has been building up.

counterexamples.description: Self-demand follows Sakura worse condition and effort.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She striving alone so his lesser fatigue no excuse to rest.
counterexamples.explanation: Self-demand follows Sakura worse condition and effort.

contexts.japanese: その桜が一人で頑張ってるんだから、この程度のだるさで休んでられるかって言うのだ。
contexts.english: She's doing her best, so I can't let a little grogginess keep me down.

counterexamples.description: Embarrassed dizziness distinct from physical sluggishness.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Not body fatigue, doorway reminds last night.
counterexamples.explanation: Embarrassed dizziness distinct from physical sluggishness.

contexts.japanese: 体のだるさからではない。
contexts.english: It isn't from my body's slowness.

contexts.japanese: なんというか、入り口に目を向けた途端、昨夜のコトをよけいに思い出してしまったからだ。
contexts.english: It's like...as soon as I look at my bedroom door, I remember what happened last night all too vividly.

counterexamples.description: Blank conversational mind remains.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Finds no suitable words after stammering.
counterexamples.explanation: Blank conversational mind remains.

contexts.japanese: 気の利いた言葉を探すも、頭は空っぽだ。
contexts.english: I try to think of something clever to say, but draw a blank.

counterexamples.description: Repeated greeting recognized as his own failure.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Just same greeting as prior, self calls fool.
counterexamples.explanation: Repeated greeting recognized as his own failure.

contexts.japanese: ……って、さっきの挨拶となにも変わってないじゃんかばかー！
contexts.english: ...Wait, I greeted her already! Idiot!

counterexamples.description: Sakura's identical reply drives shared awkwardness.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Her response seems exactly same too.
counterexamples.explanation: Sakura's identical reply drives shared awkwardness.

contexts.japanese: なんか、桜の返事も、さっきとまったく同じ気がする。
contexts.english: Somehow, Sakura's reply feels exactly the same, too.

counterexamples.description: Her realization remains his interpretation.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Perhaps noticed same, wide eyes, his expression probably alike.
counterexamples.explanation: Her realization remains his interpretation.

contexts.japanese: それに気がついたのか、目を点にしてこっちを見る。
contexts.english: Her eyes go wide, as if she's realized the same thing.

contexts.japanese: きっと桜から見た俺も、あんな顔をしているんだろう。
contexts.english: I must be making the same face.

counterexamples.description: Both nervous anticipation eases him.
counterexamples.sourceReading: They waited anxiously yet eagerly to meet.
counterexamples.explanation: Both nervous anticipation eases him.

contexts.japanese: 俺たちはお互い、ずっと緊張しながら、それでも顔を合わせるのを待ち焦がれていたのだ。
contexts.english: We've both been nervously looking forward to seeing each other.

counterexamples.description: Third greeting and relieved smile survive.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Explicit third good morning with relaxing expression and relief.
counterexamples.explanation: Third greeting and relieved smile survive.

contexts.japanese: 「……ふう。三度目になるけど、おはよう桜」
contexts.english: "Whew. Good morning for the third time, Sakura."

contexts.japanese: 安堵を込めて口にした言葉。
contexts.english: This time, I say it with relief.

counterexamples.description: Familiar etiquette doesn't erase all tension.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Usual greetings/meal manners possible, nerves not wholly released.
counterexamples.explanation: Familiar etiquette doesn't erase all tension.

contexts.japanese: こう、いつも通りの作法が出来たところで、やっぱり緊張は抜けきらないのだ。
contexts.english: Even though we try to carry on like we always do, I still can't stop feeling nervous.

counterexamples.description: Girl-handling-better generalization remains question.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He wonders if girls stronger in this respect.
counterexamples.explanation: Girl-handling-better generalization remains question.

contexts.japanese: ……なんというか、そういうところは女の子の方が強いんだろうか？
contexts.english: ...Is this something that girls are better at?

counterexamples.description: First bowl versus offered refill and genuine praise survive.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Not finished first bowl, soup delicious.
counterexamples.explanation: First bowl versus offered refill and genuine praise survive.

contexts.japanese: 「—いや、まだ一杯目。けど美味いぞ。うん、すごく美味い」
contexts.english: "...No, I'm still on my first bowl. But it's good. Delicious, actually."

counterexamples.description: Her smile affects his heart.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Smile chokes chest emotional response.
counterexamples.explanation: Her smile affects his heart.

contexts.japanese: く、その笑顔は胸に詰まる。
contexts.english: Her smile squeezes my heart.

counterexamples.description: Keep Sakura home to avoid direct Zouken encounter.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Direct meeting unsafe, boy will deal with elder.
counterexamples.explanation: Keep Sakura home to avoid direct Zouken encounter.

contexts.japanese: 「話を戻そう。今後の方針だけど、とりあえず桜はうちから出ないこと。臓硯と直接会うのは危険だからな。あの爺さんとはこっちでカタをつける」
contexts.english: "Let's get back on topic. Going forward, I think we shouldn't let Sakura go outside. It's too dangerous if she runs into Zouken. I'll deal with the old man."

counterexamples.description: Method not yet selected.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Several likely routes, hasn't decided which.
counterexamples.explanation: Method not yet selected.

contexts.japanese: 手段は幾つかあるだろうが、そのどれを取るべきかはまだ考えていなかった。
contexts.english: I'm sure there are ways to beat him, but I haven't given much thought to picking one.

counterexamples.description: Illya rather than Rin identified potential helper.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Knows Berserker Master Illya and trusts she'll listen.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya rather than Rin identified potential helper.

contexts.japanese: 「え？　いや、遠坂じゃない。俺、バーサーカーのマスターとは知り合いなんだ。イリヤって言うんだけど、あの娘なら話せばちゃんと聞いてくれる」
contexts.english: "Huh? No, not her. I'm acquainted with Berserker's Master. Her name is Illya, and she'll listen to what I have to say."

counterexamples.description: Berserker doesn't remove need for caution against tricks.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Strong in direct combat but indirect enemy could endanger Illya.
counterexamples.explanation: Berserker doesn't remove need for caution against tricks.

contexts.japanese: となると、バーサーカーを連れたイリヤでも油断はできない。
contexts.english: So, Illya can't get careless, even if she has Berserker.

counterexamples.description: Half-day arrival estimate is belief.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Remembers guided route, broad forest maybe difficult, should reach half-day.
counterexamples.explanation: Half-day arrival estimate is belief.

contexts.japanese: 「ああ、前に見せられた。道順は記憶している。広い森なんで想像通りにはいかないだろうが、半日もあれば辿り着ける筈だ」
contexts.english: "Yeah, she showed me before. I still remember the way there. It was a really big forest, so I'm sure it won't be easy to get there, but it should take about half a day."

counterexamples.description: Early return-by-night promise stays prospective.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Leaving now should permit return before night.
counterexamples.explanation: Early return-by-night promise stays prospective.

contexts.japanese: 「そうだな。善は急げって言うし、今から行けば夜までには帰ってこれる」
contexts.english: "Yeah. It's better to strike while the iron's hot, and if I go now, I can be back by nightfall."

counterexamples.description: Sakura judged at greater risk because can't resist Zouken.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Left at home dangers same; actually much more vulnerable to elder.
counterexamples.explanation: Sakura judged at greater risk because can't resist Zouken.

contexts.japanese: いや、臓硯に出会えば逆らえなくなる桜の方が、俺より何倍も危険だろう。
contexts.english: No, much more dangerous, since she can't defend herself against Zouken.

counterexamples.description: Order prioritizes carrying Sakura away over costly battle.
counterexamples.sourceReading: If elder appears avoid consuming magic, carry and run; Rider speed protects.
counterexamples.explanation: Order prioritizes carrying Sakura away over costly battle.

contexts.japanese: もし臓硯が来たら魔力を消費する戦闘は避けて、桜を抱きかかえて逃げること。ライダーの足なら追いつかれる事はないだろ」
contexts.english: If Zouken shows up, avoid fighting since that will use magical energy. Take Sakura and run. He won't be able to keep up with you."

counterexamples.description: Sakura's forest warning remains unfinished.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Forest now... interrupted before complete explanation.
counterexamples.explanation: Sakura's forest warning remains unfinished.

contexts.japanese: 「…………けど、先輩だって危険です。あの森は、いま」
contexts.english: "...But you're in danger, too. That forest is..."

counterexamples.description: No-longer-Master safety assertion remains boy's argument.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He says not Master so Illya uninterested, will flee if danger.
counterexamples.explanation: No-longer-Master safety assertion remains boy's argument.

contexts.japanese: 「心配すんな。危ないって思ったらすぐに逃げる。それにイリヤはマスター以外に興味はないんだ。マスターじゃなくなった俺がいっても危険はない」
contexts.english: "Don't worry. If it looks dangerous, I'll run away immediately. Illya doesn't have any interest in people who aren't Masters, anyway. I won't be in any danger."

counterexamples.description: Route memory and intuition from magic remain.
counterexamples.sourceReading: No map/compass, guidance from Illya magic, relies memory and instinct.
counterexamples.explanation: Route memory and intuition from magic remain.

contexts.japanese: もともとイリヤの魔術によって得た直感である。なら、頼りになるのは見せられた記憶と、自身の直感だけだろう。
contexts.english: I still have the sense of direction I got from the magecraft Illya cast on me. All I can do is rely on the memory of what I saw, and my own intuition.

contexts.japanese: 地図、コンパスといった物は持ってこなかった。
contexts.english: I don't have a map or a compass.

counterexamples.description: Taxi and foot travel duration qualified.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Before ten, one taxi hour and four forest hours if enough.
counterexamples.explanation: Taxi and foot travel duration qualified.

contexts.japanese: で済むといいのだが。
contexts.english: I hope it only takes that long.

contexts.japanese: 「………十時前。タクシーで一時間、森の中を歩いて四時間……」
contexts.english: "...It isn't ten o'clock yet. One hour by taxi, and then four more hours walking through the forest..."

counterexamples.description: Slow taxi search remains future plan.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Will drive slowly to find entrance then leave car and walk.
counterexamples.explanation: Slow taxi search remains future plan.

contexts.japanese: とりあえず、タクシーには徐行してもらって、あの時見た森の入り口を探し出す。
contexts.english: Anyway, I'll have the taxi drive slowly while I look for the entrance to the forest that I saw the other day.

contexts.japanese: 入り口が見つかったらタクシーから降りて、そこから徒歩だ。
contexts.english: Once I find it, I'll leave the car and walk the rest of the way.

counterexamples.description: Earliest arrival before sundown retains uncertainty.
counterexamples.sourceReading: At shortest can reach castle before dusk, decide afterward.
counterexamples.explanation: Earliest arrival before sundown retains uncertainty.

contexts.japanese: —最短で行けば日暮れ前にイリヤの城に着ける。
contexts.english: If all goes well, I should make it to Illya's castle before sundown.

counterexamples.description: Warm intent in formal voice survives.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Businesslike cool-sounding but polite/awkward maximum friendliness reminds Saber.
counterexamples.explanation: Warm intent in formal voice survives.

contexts.japanese: それでも丁寧に、不器用ながらもできる限りの親しみを込めて呼んでくれた、その響き。
contexts.english: The way she said my name politely and awkwardly, yet as kindly as she could.

counterexamples.description: Rider's distrust grounded in not knowing him like Sakura.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Has not equivalent knowledge so asks motive.
counterexamples.explanation: Rider's distrust grounded in not knowing him like Sakura.

contexts.japanese: 「ええ。私はサクラほど貴方を知っている訳ではありませんから」
contexts.english: "Yes. I do not know you as well as Sakura does."

counterexamples.description: Outside energy supply needed to stabilize morning power.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Stable energy indicates replenishment; otherwise fever recurring.
counterexamples.explanation: Outside energy supply needed to stabilize morning power.

contexts.japanese: 「……そのようですね。朝、サクラの魔力は安定していました。外部からの供給がなければ、サクラはまた熱に魘されていたでしょう。
contexts.english: "...It appears so. Her magical energy was stable this morning. Without an external supply of energy, she would have suffered from another fever.

counterexamples.description: Love is stated protective motive.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Loves Sakura, sufficient reason protect loved woman.
counterexamples.explanation: Love is stated protective motive.

contexts.japanese: 「それだけだ。俺は桜が好きだ。桜を守る理由はそれだけだ。自分が好きになった女を守るのは、男として当然だろ」
contexts.english: "That's all. I love Sakura. That's all the reason I need to protect her. I think it's perfectly natural for a man to protect the woman he loves."

counterexamples.description: He embraces Grail use for happiness rather than simply disclaiming gain.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Actually would use as much if makes Sakura happy.
counterexamples.explanation: He embraces Grail use for happiness rather than simply disclaiming gain.

contexts.japanese: 「いや、するよ。聖杯がなんであるかは知らないけど、それが桜を幸せにしてくれるんだったらいくらでも使ってやる」
contexts.english: "Oh, I'll use it. I don't know what the Holy Grail is, but I'll use it as much as it takes to make her happy."

contexts.japanese: 「……では、貴方はサクラの為に戦うのですね？　目的はあくまでサクラの体を救う為。サクラに聖杯を獲らせ、自分の益とする気はないと？」
contexts.english: "...And will you fight for her sake? You say that your goal is to heal her body. Will you give her the Holy Grail and not use it for your own benefit?"

counterexamples.description: Accent change request is distinct from name change.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Wants different accent pronouncing name.
counterexamples.explanation: Accent change request is distinct from name change.

contexts.japanese: 「ああ、簡単な事だ。さっきの呼び方だけど、シロウって発音じゃなくて、違うアクセントにしてくれないか」
contexts.english: "It's simple. Could you pronounce my name with a different accent than the one you used earlier?"

counterexamples.description: Grave-wax pun supplied explicitly.
counterexamples.sourceReading: 死蝋 homophonic response to attempt.
counterexamples.explanation: Grave-wax pun supplied explicitly.

contexts.japanese: 「あ。いや、それじゃ死蝋だ。もうちょっと、なんて言うか」
contexts.english: "Uh, no. That's how you say 'grave wax.' Be more, I dunno..."

counterexamples.description: Private clumsiness remains tentative impression.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Somehow feels maybe clumsy private life.
counterexamples.explanation: Private clumsiness remains tentative impression.

contexts.japanese: なんとなくではあるのだが、私生活ではドジっ子のような気もする。
contexts.english: Somehow, I get the impression that she would be a little clumsy in private life.

counterexamples.description: He withdraws demand before her successful attempt.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Original way okay, then she gets appropriate pronunciation.
counterexamples.explanation: He withdraws demand before her successful attempt.

contexts.japanese: 「ごめんな、元のままでいいよ」
contexts.english: "Sorry. You can just say it the old way."

contexts.japanese: 「ああ、文句なしだ。悪いな、俺の我が侭につき合わせて」
contexts.english: "Yeah, no complaints. Sorry for being so selfish."

counterexamples.description: He corrects Rider: earlier pronunciation liked.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rider assumes disliked, boy says no liked.
counterexamples.explanation: He corrects Rider: earlier pronunciation liked.

contexts.japanese: 「—まさか。さっきの呼び方は、好きだった」
contexts.english: "Not at all, actually. I liked it."

counterexamples.description: Precisely liking makes him reserve it for Saber.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Because liked, doesn't want others using; wants hers alone.
counterexamples.explanation: Precisely liking makes him reserve it for Saber.

contexts.japanese: 好きだったからこそ、他のやつには使ってほしくない。
contexts.english: It's because I liked it that I don't want anyone else to say it that way.

contexts.japanese: 下らないこだわりと分かってはいても、あの呼び方だけは、彼女のものにしておきたかったのだ。
contexts.english: I know it's a silly thing to get hung up on, but I want her to be the only one to say my name that way.

counterexamples.description: Responsibility belongs to his personal request, no fault Rider.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Just selfish demand, Rider not wrong; she won't ask further.
counterexamples.explanation: Responsibility belongs to his personal request, no fault Rider.

contexts.japanese: 「ほんとにただの我が侭なんだ。ライダーが悪いわけじゃない」
contexts.english: "I really am just being selfish. You didn't do anything wrong."

contexts.japanese: 「……わかりました。貴方がそう言うのなら、私も理由は問いません」
contexts.english: "...Very well. Then I won't ask why."

counterexamples.description: Taxi hail is first actual departure step.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Now heads intersection to get cab, outskirts/forest search after.
counterexamples.explanation: Taxi hail is first actual departure step.

contexts.japanese: まずは交差点まで降りて、タクシーを拾う。
contexts.english: First I need to go to the intersection and hail a taxi.

counterexamples.description: First physical visit and magically familiar entrance coexist.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Forest entrance new to his own eyes but familiar from Illya viewpoint.
counterexamples.explanation: First physical visit and magically familiar entrance coexist.

contexts.japanese: 初見にして見覚えのある森の入り口は、日中だというのに朝靄のように白ばんでいた。
contexts.english: I find the forest entrance, which feels familiar despite this being my first time seeing it, shrouded in mist even during daytime.

counterexamples.description: Mist and screened sunlight erase time sense.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Forest atmosphere obscures temporal cues.
counterexamples.explanation: Mist and screened sunlight erase time sense.

contexts.japanese: 立ち込める霧と木々に遮られた陽光が、森から時間の感覚を奪っている。
contexts.english: In the woods, the mist hanging in the air and the lack of sunlight getting through the trees make me lose my sense of time.

counterexamples.description: Arrival is after noon.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Clock just past midday before four-hour remembered estimate.
counterexamples.explanation: Arrival is after noon.

contexts.japanese: 時刻は正午を過ぎたあたり。
contexts.english: It's now sometime past noon.

counterexamples.description: Four-hour route remains remembered experience.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Through Illya's eyes journey took roughly four hours from entrance.
counterexamples.explanation: Four-hour route remains remembered experience.

contexts.japanese: イリヤの“眼”から見た時、城まではここからざっと四時間ほどだった。
contexts.english: When I was seeing through Illya's "eyes," it took roughly four hours to get to the castle from here.

counterexamples.description: Uneven terrain drains stamina gradually.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Less severe than mountain but unpaved ground taxes body bit by bit.
counterexamples.explanation: Uneven terrain drains stamina gradually.

contexts.japanese: 山道ほどではないにしろ、舗装されていない地面は少しずつ体力を奪っていく。
contexts.english: It isn't as bad as walking in the mountains, but the uneven terrain saps my stamina, bit by bit.

counterexamples.description: Physical stamina and unnoticed mental fatigue remain distinct.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Daily training makes all-day path possible, but mental fatigue silently costs strength.
counterexamples.explanation: Physical stamina and unnoticed mental fatigue remain distinct.

contexts.japanese: 日頃鍛えている分、この程度の獣道なら一日歩いたところで問題はないが、精神面の疲れは気付かないうちに体力を奪うものだ。
contexts.english: Thanks to my daily training, I don't have a problem with walking in the wilderness all day, but it does build up mental fatigue that isn't easy to notice.

counterexamples.description: Mental disturbance can cause small mistakes before physical limit.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Body limit distant; disordered mind may produce minor errors.
counterexamples.explanation: Mental disturbance can cause small mistakes before physical limit.

contexts.japanese: 体力的な限界はまだ先だろうが、乱れた精神では些細なミスも起こすだろう。
contexts.english: My physical limits are still a ways off, but the mental stress could cause me to start making small mistakes.

counterexamples.description: Detouring a direct trail remains conditional caution.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Straight-looking animal trail may need avoidance.
counterexamples.explanation: Detouring a direct trail remains conditional caution.

contexts.japanese: 無遠慮に歩き回るのは襲ってくれと言っているようなもので、一見まっすぐな獣道でも迂回しなければならない場合もある。
contexts.english: Walking around recklessly is like asking to get attacked, so there are times when it's better to go around a game trail that would've taken you straight to your destination.

counterexamples.description: Sparse wildlife is attributed tentatively to Einzbern magic.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Probably their magecraft causes absence of living presence.
counterexamples.explanation: Sparse wildlife is attributed tentatively to Einzbern magic.

contexts.japanese: 生き物の気配が希薄なのは、アインツベルンの魔術によるものなのだろう。
contexts.english: The lack of local wildlife is probably due to Einzbern magecraft.

counterexamples.description: Avoidance precedes encounter.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rule is not flee upon danger but avoid dangerous places initially.
counterexamples.explanation: Avoidance precedes encounter.

contexts.japanese: 危険に遭ったら逃げるのではなく、そもそも危険な場所には近寄らないのが、こういう道行きの鉄則である。
contexts.english: An iron rule of hiking isn't to run away at the first sign of danger, but to avoid dangerous-looking places to begin with.

counterexamples.description: Present forest differs from shared memory as impression.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He feels atmosphere unlike Illya's view.
counterexamples.explanation: Present forest differs from shared memory as impression.

contexts.japanese: 「……にしても。この森、イリヤに見せてもらった時と様子が違う気がする」
contexts.english: "Still, though...this forest feels different from what Illya showed me."

counterexamples.description: Sweet odor remains unidentified and unlike sap.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Initially thought sap, lacks forest freshness, recognition unfinished.
counterexamples.explanation: Sweet odor remains unidentified and unlike sap.

contexts.japanese: 樹液の匂いかと思ったが、微妙に違う。
contexts.english: I thought it was the scent of tree sap, but it's not quite that.

contexts.japanese: これは—
contexts.english: This is...

counterexamples.description: Strengthening takes several minutes.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Stops, concentrates, reinforces wooden sword over minutes.
counterexamples.explanation: Strengthening takes several minutes.

contexts.japanese: ……足を止めて意識を集中させ、数分かけて木刀に“強化”をかける。
contexts.english: I stop, concentrate, and take a few minutes to Strengthen my sword.

counterexamples.description: Both issue stop commands and freeze.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Simultaneous mutual confrontation deadlocks them.
counterexamples.explanation: Both issue stop commands and freeze.

contexts.japanese: 二人して、バッタリと固まってしまった。
contexts.english: We both freeze.

contexts.japanese: 「そこまでだ、動くな—！」
contexts.english: "Hold it right there!"

contexts.japanese: 「そこまでよ、動かないで—！」
contexts.english: "Stop right there!"

counterexamples.description: Plotting inference remains Shirou's comic interpretation.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He marvels Rin doesn't deny scheming.
counterexamples.explanation: Plotting inference remains Shirou's comic interpretation.

contexts.japanese: ここで驚くべきは、なにか企んでるってコトを否定しないところだろう、うむ。
contexts.english: What surprises me is that she doesn't deny that she's up to something.

counterexamples.description: Rin's fighting answer remains hypothetical.
counterexamples.sourceReading: If she were here to fight, Shirou lacks formal stake as non-Master.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin's fighting answer remains hypothetical.

contexts.japanese: 「……だとしたらどうなの。貴方はもうマスターじゃない。なら、わたしたちの戦いに首をつっこむ資格も義理もない筈よ」
contexts.english: "...So what if I am? You aren't a Master anymore. You don't have the right or obligation to stick your neck out into our battles."

counterexamples.description: Sakura alliance is only one motive.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He admits alliance plan but objects to harm too.
counterexamples.explanation: Sakura alliance is only one motive.

contexts.japanese: 「なんでよ。もしかしてイリヤと桜を組ませるってハラ？」
contexts.english: "Why? Are you trying to get her to team up with Sakura?"

counterexamples.description: Original desire to stop fighting is recognized as persistent.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin identifies his starting ideal still unchanged.
counterexamples.explanation: Original desire to stop fighting is recognized as persistent.

contexts.japanese: 「初めから戦いを止める為に、でしょ？　なんだ、それまだ変わってなかったんだ」
contexts.english: "You want to stop the war, right? So that still hasn't changed, huh?"

counterexamples.description: Bright smile and insult remain paired.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin calls him very stupid with surprising grin.
counterexamples.explanation: Bright smile and insult remain paired.

contexts.japanese: こっちがびっくりするぐらいの笑顔で、そんなコトを言いやがった。
contexts.english: She gives me a grin so bright it makes me blink, even as she says that.

contexts.japanese: 「衛宮くんって、すっごいバカでしょ」
contexts.english: "Emiya, you're really stupid."

counterexamples.description: Destination inference begins as guess, then confirmed by his clothing/words.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin says earlier shot in dark; now recognizes plan talk Illya.
counterexamples.explanation: Destination inference begins as guess, then confirmed by his clothing/words.

contexts.japanese: 「いいからいいから。で、その格好からするに衛宮くんもイリヤスフィールに用が有るってワケね。さっきはあてずっぽうで言ったけど、ホントにイリヤスフィールと話し合いをするつもりなんだ」
contexts.english: "All right, settle down. From the looks of it, you've got some business with Illyasviel. I was just taking a shot in the dark earlier, but you really do intend to talk to her."

counterexamples.description: Shirou recognizes his accidental disclosure.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Said unnecessary fact revealing destination.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou recognizes his accidental disclosure.

contexts.japanese: また口にしなくともいいコトを。
contexts.english: I said something else I shouldn't have.

counterexamples.description: Rin's map remains old and distrusted.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Knows general area but doubts ancient map reliability.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin's map remains old and distrusted.

contexts.japanese: わたしもだいたいの場所は判るんだけど、大昔の地図だから信憑性低くって。衛宮くんが知ってるなら話は早いわ」
contexts.english: I know her general area, but I don't really trust my old map. If you know where to go, that saves me a lot of trouble."

counterexamples.description: Rin prefers common front and names warning mission.
counterexamples.sourceReading: If possible cooperate; immediate objective Zouken, came to warn Illya.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin prefers common front and names warning mission.

contexts.japanese: 「売らないわよ？　イリヤスフィールと共闘できるなら、それに越した事はないもの。とりあえずやるべき事は臓硯の排除でしょ。わたしがここに来たのは、イリヤスフィールに忠告に来ただけだもの」
contexts.english: "I won't, not if she's willing to form a common front. First order of things is to eliminate Zouken, right? I just came here to give her a warning."

counterexamples.description: Shirou's option can remove fight risk.
counterexamples.sourceReading: If he has prospect, no need dangerous gamble; his effort may settle peacefully.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou's option can remove fight risk.

contexts.japanese: 「でも、見たところ衛宮くんには当てがありそうじゃない？　なら冒険をする必要もないし、衛宮くんの努力次第で事は丸く収まるってこと」
contexts.english: "But it sounds like you have another option. In that case, I don't need to take the risk of fighting her. Depending on how well you do, we might settle everything peacefully."

counterexamples.description: Successful persuasion means Rin leaves.
counterexamples.sourceReading: If he persuades Illya, Rin withdraws peacefully.
counterexamples.explanation: Successful persuasion means Rin leaves.

contexts.japanese: 「ほら、難しい顔しないっ。貴方がイリヤスフィールを説得できるなら、わたしは大人しく帰ってあげる。
contexts.english: "Come on, don't give me that look. If you can persuade her, then I'll leave peacefully.

counterexamples.description: Rin's innocent denial sustains joke.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Claims same destination coincidence despite clear intent follow.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin's innocent denial sustains joke.

contexts.japanese: 「まさかあ、そんなの言いがかりよう？　たまたま行き先が同じってコトもあるんだし」
contexts.english: "Did I ever say that? We just happen to be headed in the same direction."

counterexamples.description: Shirou disclaims route certainty.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Warns he may be wrong/lost.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou disclaims route certainty.

contexts.japanese: 「—言っとくけど。俺だって道に確証はないぞ。
contexts.english: "Fair warning—I'm not sure I'm going the right way, either.

contexts.japanese: 迷っても文句言うなよ」
contexts.english: Don't complain if I get lost."

counterexamples.description: Rin promises not to interrupt negotiations.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Limited cooperation while Shirou talks, interrupted before ally assessment finishes.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin promises not to interrupt negotiations.

contexts.japanese: 「ええ、貴方がイリヤスフィールと交渉している間も邪魔はしないわ。あの子、敵に回したら厄介だけど味方にできるなら頼もし—」
contexts.english: "Yeah, I won't interfere in your negotiations with her. She's a pain to deal with as an enemy, but if we can be allies—"

counterexamples.description: Distant sound is only explosion-like.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Trees shake and noise resembles blast before storm comparison.
counterexamples.explanation: Distant sound is only explosion-like.

contexts.japanese: 遠くからは爆発めいた音が響いてくる。
contexts.english: A noise that resembles an explosion echoes from afar.

counterexamples.description: Rin infers a single opponent without naming them.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Given their presence, only one possible foe for Berserker, identity withheld.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin infers a single opponent without naming them.

contexts.japanese: 「ええ。わたしたちがここにいる以上、バーサーカーが戦う相手は一人しかいない。……どうする？　わたしは行くけど、衛宮くんは残る？」
contexts.english: "Yeah. Since we're here, there's only one person he could possibly be fighting against... So what now? I'm going ahead. Are you staying?"

counterexamples.description: Choice urgency survives in intact held-page entry.
counterexamples.sourceReading: No time to think before branch.
counterexamples.explanation: Choice urgency survives in intact held-page entry.

contexts.japanese: 考えている暇はない。
contexts.english: There's no time to think.

counterexamples.description: Formation and narrow immediate safety assurance survive.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Shirou behind Rin, Archer ahead prevents only instant encounter death.
counterexamples.explanation: Formation and narrow immediate safety assurance survive.

contexts.japanese: 「それじゃわたしの後ろにいて。アーチャーを先行させるから、それで出会い頭に即死……ってのだけは避けられるわ」
contexts.english: "Then stay behind me. I'll send Archer on ahead...so that should help us avoid getting killed instantly."

counterexamples.description: Archer materializes, glances once, then advances.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Single look carries no specified emotion; path-clearing movement.
counterexamples.explanation: Archer materializes, glances once, then advances.

contexts.japanese: 霊体から実体化したアーチャーは一度だけこちらに視線を向け、道を切り開くように疾走していく。
contexts.english: Archer drops from spirit to material form, gives me one glance, and then charges forward, blazing a path.

counterexamples.description: Illya safety plea remains a wish.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He tells/hopes she be safe while chasing.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya safety plea remains a wish.

contexts.japanese: 「イリヤ、無事でいろよ…………！」
contexts.english: "Be safe, Illya...!"

counterexamples.description: Staying is reasoned caution.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Leaving before knowing event judged dangerous.
counterexamples.explanation: Staying is reasoned caution.

contexts.japanese: 何が起きているかが判明するまで、ここを離れるのは危険だろう。
contexts.english: It'd be dangerous for me to leave this spot without first figuring out what's going on.

counterexamples.description: Rin endorses his choice because he is alone.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She has Archer; his cautious stay correct.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin endorses his choice because he is alone.

contexts.japanese: 「ええ。けど衛宮くんが残るのは正しい選択よ。わたしにはアーチャーがいるけど、衛宮くんは一人きりだから。
contexts.english: "Yeah. But you're making the right choice. I have Archer, but you're alone.

counterexamples.description: Rin promises return if danger appears.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Will come back immediately upon judging risk.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin promises return if danger appears.

contexts.japanese: 「もちろん。危ないって思ったらすぐ戻るわ」
contexts.english: "Of course not. I'll be right back if it looks dangerous."

counterexamples.description: Opponent identification remains Shirou's deduction.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Assumes Berserker against Zouken/Assassin.
counterexamples.explanation: Opponent identification remains Shirou's deduction.

contexts.japanese: 相手は臓硯とアサシン以外にない。
contexts.english: He must be up against Zouken and Assassin.

counterexamples.description: Saber callback destabilizes confidence in raw superiority.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Saber also shouldn't have lost.
counterexamples.explanation: Saber callback destabilizes confidence in raw superiority.

contexts.japanese: だが—敗ける筈がなかったのは、セイバーも同じではなかったか。
contexts.english: But...wasn't that true for Saber, too?

counterexamples.description: Initial darkness isn't absence of light.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Retina paralyzed by black light like sun glare.
counterexamples.explanation: Initial darkness isn't absence of light.

contexts.japanese: 光が途絶えた事による闇ではない。
contexts.english: It isn't the darkness that comes from an absence of light.

contexts.japanese: 強烈な閃光、太陽を直視したように、網膜が黒い光に麻痺している。
contexts.english: Instead, a dark light is seared into my retinas, like I've just looked directly into the sun.

counterexamples.description: Tree collisions prove tangible forest initially.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Groping blind, random movement hits trunks.
counterexamples.explanation: Tree collisions prove tangible forest initially.

contexts.japanese: デタラメに進むたびに、木の幹が体に当たる。
contexts.english: I bump into tree trunks.

counterexamples.description: Painful contact reassures against nothingness.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Injury preferable to no response/existence.
counterexamples.explanation: Painful contact reassures against nothingness.

contexts.japanese: 何かにぶつかって怪我をする方が、何も“無い”よりは安心できる。
contexts.english: Getting injured from bumping into things is more comforting than nothing at all.

counterexamples.description: Temporary-blindness explanation remains self-reassurance.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He tells himself sudden light caused short vision loss.
counterexamples.explanation: Temporary-blindness explanation remains self-reassurance.

contexts.japanese: 大丈夫、突然の光で一時的に視力が飛んだだけだ。
contexts.english: I'll be all right. It's just temporary blindness from seeing a sudden bright light.

counterexamples.description: Repetition escalates false certainty of recovery.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Waits through lengthening pauses and insists vision absolutely returns.
counterexamples.explanation: Repetition escalates false certainty of recovery.

contexts.japanese: 視力は戻る。それだけは絶対と言い切れる。
contexts.english: My eyesight will return. I can say that for sure.

counterexamples.description: Missing collisions become explicit source of worry.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Storm and impacts stop; he questions meaning.
counterexamples.explanation: Missing collisions become explicit source of worry.

contexts.japanese: あれだけ密集していた木にぶつからなくなった事に、なにか意味があるのだろうか……？
contexts.english: I wonder what it means that I've stopped bumping into all those trees.

counterexamples.description: Restored eyes and absent world are both stated.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Numbness gone and vision normal, forest touch vanished; he defers implications.
counterexamples.explanation: Restored eyes and absent world are both stated.

contexts.japanese: 眼球の痺れはとっくにとれていて、視力が元通りになっている事も、後で考えるとしよう。
contexts.english: I can wonder later why it's dark even though my eyes are working again and my vision is back to normal.

contexts.japanese: 森の手触りがなくなった事は、まあ、後で考えればいい。
contexts.english: I can ponder later why I'm not touching the forest anymore.

counterexamples.description: He walks through sensationless nothingness.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Continues through void without tactile contact.
counterexamples.explanation: He walks through sensationless nothingness.

contexts.japanese: 感触のない無を歩いていく。
contexts.english: Still feeling nothing, I walk through the darkness.

counterexamples.description: Exitless shadow world remains framed as bad joke.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He imagines trapped there and brittlely dismisses it.
counterexamples.explanation: Exitless shadow world remains framed as bad joke.

contexts.japanese: 出口のない影の世界に囚われたような、質の悪い冗談とかを。
contexts.english: A bad joke like that, maybe.

counterexamples.description: Repeated little longer survives.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Brittle reassurance repeats while no sensation.
counterexamples.explanation: Repeated little longer survives.

contexts.japanese: だがあと少しだ。
contexts.english: But it's just a little longer.

counterexamples.description: Three Servants are counted.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Berserker, Assassin, unknown black-armored swordsman clash.
counterexamples.explanation: Three Servants are counted.

contexts.japanese: 刃を交わらせるサーヴァントは三体。
contexts.english: Three Servants are clashing weapons.

counterexamples.description: Recognition remains delayed through comparison.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Appearance new but evokes someone well known.
counterexamples.explanation: Recognition remains delayed through comparison.

contexts.japanese: 同時に、俺のよく知っているヤツを連想させた。
contexts.english: ...it immediately calls to mind someone I know well.

counterexamples.description: Shirou recognizes no chance against either threat.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Intervention seems futile against Shadow or swordsman.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou recognizes no chance against either threat.

contexts.japanese: あの“黒い影”にも黒い剣士にも勝てる見込みなんてない。
contexts.english: I don't have a chance of winning against the Shadow or the swordsman.

counterexamples.description: Assassin pursues through trees behind group.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin ahead, Shirou with Illya, Assassin rear.
counterexamples.explanation: Assassin pursues through trees behind group.

contexts.japanese: 背後には、木々をすり抜けて追ってくるアサシンの気配。
contexts.english: I can sense Assassin chasing us through the trees.

counterexamples.description: Illya's presence obstructs escape.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Cannot shake Servant pursuer while carrying/leading her.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya's presence obstructs escape.

contexts.japanese: イリヤを連れた状態ではどうやって振り払—
contexts.english: How am I supposed to shake him off with Illya in tow?

counterexamples.description: Assassin rejects Shirou as target.
counterexamples.sourceReading: At Shirou's ear says you are not needed.
counterexamples.explanation: Assassin rejects Shirou as target.

contexts.japanese: 「—そこまでだ。オマエは要らない」
contexts.english: "That's far enough. I don't need you."

counterexamples.description: Archer mocks reliance on ambush.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Calls Assassin third-rate unable kill boy except surprise.
counterexamples.explanation: Archer mocks reliance on ambush.

contexts.japanese: 「……フン。奇襲でなければ小僧の首も落とせないのか、三流」
contexts.english: "...Hmph. So you can't even kill a child without resorting to an ambush? You third-rate."

counterexamples.description: Taking Illya's hand creates duty through the end.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Archer orders boy run/protect her after choosing rescue.
counterexamples.explanation: Taking Illya's hand creates duty through the end.

contexts.japanese: 「詮議は後だ。走れ小僧。イリヤの手を取ったからには、最後まで守り通せ」
contexts.english: "Save the discussion for later. Run, boy. Now that you've taken Illya's hand, protect her til the very end."

counterexamples.description: Narration rejects Assassin weakness.
counterexamples.sourceReading: His difficulty comes from fierce Archer, not simple low ability.
counterexamples.explanation: Narration rejects Assassin weakness.

contexts.japanese: が、それはアサシンが弱いのではない。
contexts.english: But, that isn't because he's weak.

counterexamples.description: Archer's advantage is explicit but unexplained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Unusually fierce pressure creates winning momentum.
counterexamples.explanation: Archer's advantage is explicit but unexplained.

contexts.japanese: —勝勢はアーチャーにある。
contexts.english: Archer has the advantage.

contexts.japanese: なんでか知らないが、今のアーチャーは鬼神めいた強さだった。
contexts.english: I don't know why, but right now, he's fighting with demonic frenzy.

counterexamples.description: Shadow emergence breaks false relief.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Appears behind Rin as if born from tree shade.
counterexamples.explanation: Shadow emergence breaks false relief.

contexts.japanese: 木々の影から生まれるように、アレが、浮かび上がっていた。
contexts.english: It boils up, as if it was born in the shade of the trees.

counterexamples.description: Shirou anticipates Rin's impalement without reaching her.
counterexamples.sourceReading: About to witness tentacle pierce Rin.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou anticipates Rin's impalement without reaching her.

contexts.japanese: 俺は、遠坂の体が黒い触手に貫かれるのを目の当たりにしようとし、
contexts.english: I can only watch as the tentacles lance forth to impale Tohsaka...

counterexamples.description: Archer remains alive with little blood.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Breathing and limited bleeding despite being done fighting.
counterexamples.explanation: Archer remains alive with little blood.

contexts.japanese: まだ息はあるし、出血も少ない。
contexts.english: He's still breathing, and there isn't much blood.

counterexamples.description: Shirou intuitively knows Archer cannot fight.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Severe disabling effect despite ordinary regenerative expectation.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou intuitively knows Archer cannot fight.

contexts.japanese: ……それでも、アーチャーはもう戦えないと判ってしまった。
contexts.english: Still, I know that he can't fight anymore.

counterexamples.description: Servant summoning status limits resistance.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Even powerful Heroic Spirit summoned as Servant cannot beat Shadow.
counterexamples.explanation: Servant summoning status limits resistance.

contexts.japanese: いかに強力な英霊であろうと、その身がサーヴァントとして召喚された以上、あの“黒い影”には敵わない。
contexts.english: No matter how powerful a Heroic Spirit is, it can't beat the Shadow because it's a summoned Servant.

counterexamples.description: Knowledge remains unexplained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He understands vaguely without reason.
counterexamples.explanation: Knowledge remains unexplained.

contexts.japanese: それを、理由もなく漠然と理解した。
contexts.english: I just know that, somehow.

counterexamples.description: Overfilled water-balloon image remains premonition.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Still pouring into near-bursting balloon.
counterexamples.explanation: Overfilled water-balloon image remains premonition.

contexts.japanese: もういっぱいではちきれそうな風船に、まだ水を注いでいる。
contexts.english: The balloon is engorged and still filling.

counterexamples.description: Shirou recognizes imminent engulfment.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Staying means complete consumption.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou recognizes imminent engulfment.

contexts.japanese: 「ま—ずい」
contexts.english: "Oh...crap."

contexts.japanese: ここにいては完全に呑み込まれる。
contexts.english: We'll be completely swallowed by it here.

counterexamples.description: Choice distinguishes each girl's protector.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin has Archer; Illya has nobody, cannot reach both.
counterexamples.explanation: Choice distinguishes each girl's protector.

contexts.japanese: 遠坂にはアーチャーがいて、イリヤには誰もいない。
contexts.english: Tohsaka has Archer, but Illya has nobody else.

counterexamples.description: Shirou assumes Berserker's protective role.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Must take his place guarding Illya.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou assumes Berserker's protective role.

contexts.japanese: バーサーカーの代わりを果たさなければ—！
contexts.english: in Berserker's place!

counterexamples.description: He physically covers Illya.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Forces her down and shields her body.
counterexamples.explanation: He physically covers Illya.

contexts.japanese: そのまま、イリヤを隠すように覆い被さった瞬間。
contexts.english: Just as I cover her with my body,

counterexamples.description: Body feels at risk of being blown away.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Compressed release produces violent wave.
counterexamples.explanation: Body feels at risk of being blown away.

contexts.japanese: 体が吹き飛ばされそうだ。
contexts.english: I feel like my body's about to be blown away.

counterexamples.description: Body and self loss are paired.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Ruby links body with self in shock.
counterexamples.explanation: Body and self loss are paired.

contexts.japanese: 体が、ない。
contexts.english: I have no self. No body.

counterexamples.description: Right arm resists Shadow.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Functioning right side opposes taking Illya.
counterexamples.explanation: Right arm resists Shadow.

contexts.japanese: それに、右腕で懸命に抗った。
contexts.english: I use my right arm to resist as best as I can.

counterexamples.description: Loss is beyond left shoulder.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Only left-side portion gone, not whole body/numbness.
counterexamples.explanation: Loss is beyond left shoulder.

contexts.japanese: なくなったのは、左肩の向こうだけ。
contexts.english: I'm only missing everything from my left shoulder.

counterexamples.description: Shock-driven minimization repeats body remains.

まるで体がなくなってしまったと思うほど、大きく何かが欠けてしまった。

I still feel a deep sense of loss, as if I really have lost my whole body.

counterexamples.explanation: Illya is explicitly unharmed.

contexts.japanese: ……イリヤは、無事だった。
contexts.english: ...Illya's safe.

counterexamples.explanation: Rin's condition remains unknown to Shirou.

contexts.english: Tohsaka...I wonder how she's doing.

counterexamples.explanation: Transplant proposal contrasts two losses with one certain survivor.

contexts.english: "There's nothing to consider. If I do nothing, two will die. But if I transplant this, I'm sure to save one.

counterexamples.explanation: Shirou identifies Archer and Rider as speakers.

counterexamples.explanation: Ordinary fatality and their exceptional status remain asserted.

contexts.english: "Normally, he would die. You can't save a person by attaching a spiritual body to theirs. But he and I are a special case. Rin will know what to do once she wakes up."

counterexamples.sourceReading: Black sun gone; consciousness now fails.
counterexamples.explanation: Second darkness is distinguished from black sun.

contexts.japanese: 森に黒い太陽はもうない。
contexts.english: The black sun is gone.

counterexamples.explanation: Archer gives restrained farewell to Tohsaka.

contexts.japanese: 「—ここまでか。達者でな、遠坂」
contexts.english: "...This is as far as I go. Be well, Tohsaka."

counterexamples.explanation: Archer is gravely incapacitated but not declared dead.

contexts.english: Archer's on his last legs, and Tohsaka's too shocked by his injuries to move.

counterexamples.explanation: Distances and intended rescue steps remain prospective.

contexts.english: I'm about five meters from Tohsaka, and the Shadow is another ten meters away. If I run as fast as I can, grab her hand and jump to the side, I can—

counterexamples.explanation: Shadow bursts instantaneously.

contexts.english: I couldn't even grab Tohsaka's hand.

counterexamples.explanation: Lethal jungle fever remains figurative bodily destruction.

counterexamples.explanation: Mind dies before body.

contexts.japanese: —精神が、体より先に死んだ。
contexts.english: ...my mind dies before my body.

counterexamples.explanation: Soulless flesh is swallowed after mental loss.

contexts.japanese: 魂を失った肉はあっけなく呑まれていく。

counterexamples.explanation: Argument is interpreted as a form of closeness.

contexts.japanese: あの二人の場合、あれはあれで仲がいい、と見るべきだろう。
contexts.english: You could say they actually get along pretty well.

counterexamples.explanation: Kirei warns Shirou no longer has fighting body.

contexts.english: "Do not forget, Shirou Emiya. You no longer have a body that can fight."

counterexamples.explanation: Shirou minimizes condition to unusable left arm.

contexts.english: "That's not true. I can't use my left arm, but I can still fight."

You may be fine as long as you don't fight, but Sakura Matou is falling apart with each passing hour. That is why you cannot stop fighting, even if you know it will hasten your demise."

contexts.japanese: 故に—間桐桜を救うという事は、自分を殺すという事だと理解しているな？」
contexts.english: Do you understand that saving Sakura Matou means killing yourself?"

counterexamples.explanation: Rin now addresses him as Shirou.

contexts.english: "That took a while, Shirou. What were you talking with Kirei about?"

counterexamples.explanation: He only wonders whether to ask about name use.

counterexamples.explanation: Rin explicitly offers cooperation.

contexts.english: "Yeah, I'm saying that I'll work together with you!

counterexamples.sourceReading: Shirou denies the insinuation, says he simply felt it, then argues his guardian role makes the choice natural.
counterexamples.explanation: The guardian justification is blurted defensively.

contexts.japanese: 「わ、わけあるかばかものーっ！　ささ、さっきのはなんとなくそう思ったから口にしただけというか、俺はイリヤの保護者になったんだからイリヤを取るのは当然だ文句あるかっ……！」
contexts.english: "L-like hell I am, idiot! I just picked her because I felt like it. I'm basically Illya's guardian now anyway, so it only makes sense I'd choose her...!"

counterexamples.description: The supposed choice affecting Sakura remains unclear to Shirou.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He fixates on what Rin claims to be recognizing or accepting.
counterexamples.explanation: The supposed choice affecting Sakura remains unclear to Shirou.

contexts.japanese: 何を認めようとしているのか、そのあたり凄く気になるぞ遠坂。
contexts.english: I'm extremely curious what "choice" Tohsaka thinks I'm making.

counterexamples.description: Rin assigns Shirou an obligation in Archer's place.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Her ownership rhetoric rests on Archer's loss and transferred responsibility.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin assigns Shirou an obligation in Archer's place.

contexts.japanese: —貴方にはアーチャーの代わりをする義務がある。
contexts.english: ...You have an obligation to serve me in Archer's place.

counterexamples.description: Rin says Shirou's body is no longer solely his.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The limb creates responsibility beyond private self-disposal.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin says Shirou's body is no longer solely his.

contexts.japanese: その体は、もう貴方一人のものじゃない」
contexts.english: Your body doesn't belong only to you anymore."

counterexamples.description: Shirou understands that Archer's arm saved him after Rin lost Archer.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The paired loss and survival motivate repayment.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou understands that Archer's arm saved him after Rin lost Archer.

contexts.japanese: 遠坂はアーチャーを失い、アーチャーの腕で俺は生き延びた。
contexts.english: Tohsaka lost Archer, and Archer's arm saved my life.

counterexamples.description: The Illya choice does not prevent delegating strategy to Rin.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Shirou sets Servant rhetoric aside and entrusts future policy to her.
counterexamples.explanation: The Illya choice does not prevent delegating strategy to Rin.

contexts.japanese: 「…………ああ、そうだな。サーヴァント云々は置いておくとして、今後の方針は遠坂に一任する。
contexts.english: "...Yeah, I know. Setting aside the fact that you keep calling me a Servant, I'll let you decide our next steps.

counterexamples.description: Rin divides planning and execution roles.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She thinks; Shirou acts; their fates are joined.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin divides planning and execution roles.

contexts.japanese: 「そういう事よ。わたしが考える役で、士郎は実行する役。わたしたちは運命共同体なんだから、今後はしっかり働いてもらうわ」
contexts.english: "That's right. I'll do the thinking, while you do the work. We're in the same boat now, so I'll be working you hard."

counterexamples.description: Stopping Illya remains the immediate priority.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Shirou acts despite the battle spectacle.
counterexamples.explanation: Stopping Illya remains the immediate priority.

contexts.japanese: それでも—今は、イリヤを止めないと……！
contexts.english: But still...right now, I have to stop Illya!

counterexamples.description: Shirou falls while still holding Illya.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The blast/wind overwhelms him, but the rescue grip remains.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou falls while still holding Illya.

contexts.japanese: イリヤを抱きかかえ、暴風に耐え切れず地面に倒れる。
contexts.english: The wind pushes me to the ground, Illya still in my arms.

counterexamples.description: Shock makes Shirou forget even the act of standing.
counterexamples.sourceReading: This exceeds physical inability in the preceding line.
counterexamples.explanation: Shock makes Shirou forget even the act of standing.

contexts.japanese: 立ち上がる事さえ、忘れてしまった。
contexts.english: I can't even remember to stand.

counterexamples.description: The unidentified heat is explicitly felt resonating with the Noble Phantasm.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He knows neither identity nor reason.
counterexamples.explanation: The unidentified heat is explicitly felt resonating with the Noble Phantasm.

contexts.japanese: 正体は掴めず理由も定かではないが、この熱は今の宝具と共鳴したものだと感じ取れた。
contexts.english: I don't know what or why, but I sense this heat resonating with the Noble Phantasm that was just unleashed.

counterexamples.description: A momentary glimpse completely captivates Shirou.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The sword steals his heart despite being barely visible.
counterexamples.explanation: A momentary glimpse completely captivates Shirou.

contexts.japanese: たった一瞬、わずかにしか見えなかったモノに、心底心を奪われた。
contexts.english: My heart was stolen by something I only caught sight of for a brief instant.

counterexamples.description: Beautiful is rejected as insulting to the sword.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Its value is not ordinary visual beauty.
counterexamples.explanation: Beautiful is rejected as insulting to the sword.

contexts.japanese: 否、美しいなどという形容では、あの剣を汚すだけだ。
contexts.english: No, the word "beautiful" would be an insult to this sword.

counterexamples.description: The legend is woven from human hopes and thoughts.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Collective human aspiration remains central.
counterexamples.explanation: The legend is woven from human hopes and thoughts.

contexts.japanese: 人々の想念、希望のみで編まれた伝説。
contexts.english: It's a legend imbued with the hopes and dreams of the people.

counterexamples.description: Freezing rather than burning remains a question.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Cold air prompts a tentative mechanism, not confirmed physics.
counterexamples.explanation: Freezing rather than burning remains a question.

contexts.japanese: アレは酸素を燃やすモノではなく、むしろ凍らせるものなのか。
contexts.english: Maybe it doesn't burn oxygen, but freezes it, instead.

counterexamples.description: Saber shows no bloodlust or hostility.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Shirou fears death despite their absence.
counterexamples.explanation: Saber shows no bloodlust or hostility.

contexts.japanese: 剣士からは殺気も敵意も感じられない。
contexts.english: I can't feel any bloodlust or hostility from the swordsman.

counterexamples.description: The nobility Shirou once felt in Saber is absent.
counterexamples.sourceReading: This loss, beyond hostility, drives his recognition of radical change.
counterexamples.explanation: The nobility Shirou once felt in Saber is absent.

contexts.japanese: 以前あれほど感じられた気高ささえ、皆無だった。
contexts.english: She doesn't have any of the nobility she used to.

counterexamples.description: Berserker's last blow is only a tentative cause of the broken helm.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Shirou infers it with だろう.
counterexamples.explanation: Berserker's last blow is only a tentative cause of the broken helm.

contexts.japanese: バーサーカーの最後の一撃だろう。
contexts.english: It must have been thanks to Berserker's last attack.

counterexamples.description: The exposed face identifies Saber beyond doubt.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Recognition follows the helm's failure.
counterexamples.explanation: The exposed face identifies Saber beyond doubt.

contexts.japanese: 素顔を現した敵は、変わり果てていようと、紛れもなく彼女だった。
contexts.english: When I see her bare face, I know without a doubt that it's her, no matter how much she's changed.

counterexamples.description: Saber's changed golden eyes regard Shirou as a fallen enemy.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Her gaze is unreadable and adversarial.
counterexamples.explanation: Saber's changed golden eyes regard Shirou as a fallen enemy.

contexts.japanese: 金に変色した瞳は何事も示さず、ただ、倒れ伏した敵を見下ろしている。
contexts.english: Her eyes are now gold and unreadable. They just stare down at me, her fallen foe.

counterexamples.description: Shirou prepares the available right arm while holding Illya.
counterexamples.sourceReading: This wording precedes later left-arm loss and does not itself certify amputation.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou prepares the available right arm while holding Illya.

contexts.japanese: イリヤを一層強く抱きしめ、残った右腕に力を込める。
contexts.english: I hold on tight to Illya, and tense my right arm.

counterexamples.description: Saber diverts her stroke to three arrows.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Archer interrupts before she cuts Shirou down.
counterexamples.explanation: Saber diverts her stroke to three arrows.

contexts.japanese: 彼女は立ち上がろうとした俺を斬り伏せようとし、瞬間—横合いから掃射された三連の矢を弾いていた。
contexts.english: Just as she's about to cut me down while I'm trying to stand up, she instantly changes direction and deflects three arrows.

counterexamples.description: Archer follows ranged fire immediately with blades.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The attack is a two-stage intervention.
counterexamples.explanation: Archer follows ranged fire immediately with blades.

contexts.japanese: アーチャーはセイバーを狙い撃ち、間髪入れずに斬りかかった。
contexts.english: Archer immediately follows his sniping up with a bladed assault.

counterexamples.description: Saber easily repels Archer's fast paired swords.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The intervention buys little.
counterexamples.explanation: Saber easily repels Archer's fast paired swords.

contexts.japanese: 神速の踏み込みで放ったアーチャーの両刀は、容易くセイバーに弾かれた。
contexts.english: Saber easily blocks his blindingly fast dual swords.

counterexamples.description: Shadow tangles Archer's feet.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The restraint explains his abnormal difficulty.
counterexamples.explanation: Shadow tangles Archer's feet.

contexts.japanese: 見ればあいつの足元にも、黒い影が絡まり始めていた。
contexts.english: I look and see that his feet are tangled in the Shadow, too.

counterexamples.description: The demand for Illya is read from Saber's eyes.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Saber does not voice it.
counterexamples.explanation: The demand for Illya is read from Saber's eyes.

contexts.japanese: イリヤを渡さなければ殺す、と絶対の意思を告げていた。
contexts.english: They declare that she'll kill me unless I hand Illya over.

counterexamples.description: Illya's release is interpreted as permission to surrender her.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The seeming implication triggers Shirou.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya's release is interpreted as permission to surrender her.

contexts.japanese: それが—自分を差し出していい、と言っているようで、最後のスイッチが入った。
contexts.english: The gesture seems to say that it's okay to hand her over. It flips a switch inside me.

counterexamples.description: Shirou's left hand is free and placed on the wooden sword.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Both hands are available at this point.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou's left hand is free and placed on the wooden sword.

contexts.japanese: イリヤを後ろに押しのけて、自由になった左手を木刀に添える。
contexts.english: I push Illya back and take hold of my wooden sword with my now free left hand.

counterexamples.description: Shirou cannot apologize or ask Saber to return.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Her silence makes those words impermissible to him.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou cannot apologize or ask Saber to return.

contexts.japanese: 謝る事などできないし、戻って来いとも言えない。
contexts.english: I can't apologize, nor can I ask her to come back to me.

counterexamples.description: Mutual destruction is explicitly rejected.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Saber taught him it only works between evenly matched opponents.
counterexamples.explanation: Mutual destruction is explicitly rejected.

contexts.japanese: 相打ちなんて狙わない。そんな戦法は通用しないとセイバー自身に教わった。
contexts.english: I won't try for a mutual kill. Saber personally taught me that it isn't an effective tactic.

counterexamples.description: Shirou intends both survival and victory.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The goal is implausible but unambiguous.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou intends both survival and victory.

contexts.japanese: 自分は生き延びて敵を倒す。
contexts.english: I'll defeat my enemy and survive.

counterexamples.description: The apparent death is recognition of a decisive sparring point.
counterexamples.sourceReading: His body knows Saber has scored ippon; actual decapitation has not occurred.
counterexamples.explanation: The apparent death is recognition of a decisive sparring point.

contexts.japanese: なまじセイバーと試合をした分、それが一本だと体で判った。
contexts.english: I've sparred rashly with Saber enough times to know that she won this bout.

counterexamples.description: Shirou's head remains attached.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The text overturns the apparent killing stroke immediately.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou's head remains attached.

contexts.japanese: 首は、いつまでも付いたままだった。
contexts.english: My head stays attached.

counterexamples.description: The Shadow is Shirou's guessed reason Saber stopped.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He asks whether that is the explanation.
counterexamples.explanation: The Shadow is Shirou's guessed reason Saber stopped.

contexts.japanese: ……まさか、セイバーが剣を止めた理由とはアレか。
contexts.english: Don't tell me she stopped her sword because of that.

counterexamples.description: The emerging Shadow is recognized as the park's unknown curse mass.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Identity remains descriptive rather than a named entity.
counterexamples.explanation: The emerging Shadow is recognized as the park's unknown curse mass.

contexts.japanese: 呪いの塊としか言えない、正体不明の存在だ—
contexts.english: that I saw before in the park...

counterexamples.description: Shirou admits ignorance about Saber's continued presence and hostility.
counterexamples.sourceReading: No objective explanation is supplied here.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou admits ignorance about Saber's continued presence and hostility.

contexts.japanese: —何故彼女がこの世に残っているのか、どうして敵に回ったのかは、俺の知るところじゃない。
contexts.english: —I have no way of knowing why she's still in this world, or why she's on their side now.

counterexamples.description: Shirou's guilt remains counterfactual and subjective.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He thinks greater strength that night might have prevented Saber's dark corruption.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou's guilt remains counterfactual and subjective.

contexts.japanese: あの夜、俺がもっと強かったなら—彼女をあんな、黒く濁った姿にはしなくて済んだのだと、思ってしまった。
contexts.english: I can't help but think that if I had been stronger that night, she might never have been warped into that dark version of herself.

counterexamples.description: Rin recalls Shirou to the present paired threats.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Shadow approaches while Assassin's skull mask smiles.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin recalls Shirou to the present paired threats.

contexts.japanese: —目前にはヒタヒタと近寄ってくる“黒い影”と、髑髏の面を笑いに歪めたアサシンがいる。
contexts.english: Right now, we're facing the creeping black Shadow and the Assassin with the skull mask locked into a smile.

counterexamples.description: Shirou takes Illya's hand and flees.
counterexamples.sourceReading: This begins the escape leading to the later rear-guard sequence.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou takes Illya's hand and flees.

contexts.japanese: イリヤの手を取って走り出す。
contexts.english: I take Illya's hand and run.

counterexamples.description: The town's lifelessness is observed at about eight or nine.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The time is estimated and the absence includes human warmth.
counterexamples.explanation: The town's lifelessness is observed at about eight or nine.

contexts.japanese: まだ八時か九時あたりだろうに、人気もなければ、人が住んでいる熱気さえも消えていた。
contexts.english: It's still only eight or nine o'clock, but not only is there no one outside, the town doesn't even have the warmth of people living in it.

counterexamples.description: Pain begins after Shirou is alone and climbing.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He wonders whether released tension allowed it to surface.
counterexamples.explanation: Pain begins after Shirou is alone and climbing.

contexts.japanese: 一人になって緊張が解けたのか、坂道を登り始めてから左腕が痛み出したのだ。
contexts.english: Maybe I stopped being as tense once I was alone, but my left arm's been hurting since I started up the hill.

counterexamples.description: Pain runs from shoulder into chest when heat exceeds normal temperature.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The event recurs as the arm heats while walking.
counterexamples.explanation: Pain runs from shoulder into chest when heat exceeds normal temperature.

contexts.japanese: それが平熱を大きく逸脱した瞬間、ズシャ、と肩口から胸に痛みが突き刺さる。
contexts.english: Whenever it gets too far away from my normal body temperature, fresh pain stabs into my chest from the tip of my shoulder.

counterexamples.description: Shirou models the arm as dumping excess heat into his body.
counterexamples.sourceReading: This is his explanation, not neutral verified mechanics.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou models the arm as dumping excess heat into his body.

contexts.japanese: それが左腕の中で溜まりきって一杯になった時、処理しきれない熱を体側に逃がす。
contexts.english: Once enough heat builds up in the arm, it gets dumped into my body.

counterexamples.description: Heat and foreign intrusion are joined in a cutting sensation.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The injected foreignness feels sharper than ordinary heating.
counterexamples.explanation: Heat and foreign intrusion are joined in a cutting sensation.

contexts.japanese: 熱の挿入感は鋭利で、加熱というより斬撃に近い。
contexts.english: I have the acute sensation of something foreign being injected, and it feels more like being cut than heated.

counterexamples.description: Earlier Berserker and Rider injuries are invoked as comparison.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Shirou contrasts familiar catastrophic wounds with rejection by his own attached arm.
counterexamples.explanation: Earlier Berserker and Rider injuries are invoked as comparison.

contexts.japanese: バーサーカーに腹を根こそぎ持っていかれた事も、ライダーに肋を砕かれかけた事もある。
contexts.english: Berserker's torn my stomach open before, and Rider's caved my rib cage in.

counterexamples.description: Being pierced by his own arm uniquely horrifies Shirou.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The paradox matters beyond raw severity.
counterexamples.explanation: Being pierced by his own arm uniquely horrifies Shirou.

contexts.japanese: そんなダメージを経験してさえ、自分の腕に自分の体が“貫かれる”のは寒気がした。
contexts.english: Even though I've experienced damage like that before, the thought of my own arm "stabbing" my body gives me chills.

counterexamples.description: Twenty minutes have passed since parting from Rin and Illya.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The elapsed time frames the delayed return.
counterexamples.explanation: Twenty minutes have passed since parting from Rin and Illya.

contexts.japanese: 遠坂たちと別れてからもう二十分。
contexts.english: It's already been twenty minutes since I parted ways with Tohsaka and Illya.

counterexamples.description: Shirou intends to hide the arm's abnormality from Sakura.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The decision is initially private and deliberate.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou intends to hide the arm's abnormality from Sakura.

contexts.japanese: ……左腕の異常は俺一人の内に留めておくべきものだ。
contexts.english: ...I should keep my left arm's problems to myself.

counterexamples.description: The transplanted arm is immobile and iron-hard.
counterexamples.sourceReading: It cannot twitch under the red wrapping.
counterexamples.explanation: The transplanted arm is immobile and iron-hard.

contexts.japanese: 左腕はぴくりとも動かず、鉄のように硬い。
contexts.english: My left arm can't so much as twitch, and it's as hard as iron.

counterexamples.description: He waits until sweat and breathing settle.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The pause is concealment preparation, not recovery of the arm.
counterexamples.explanation: He waits until sweat and breathing settle.

contexts.japanese: 汗も引いたし呼吸も整った。
contexts.english: I'm not sweating anymore, and my breathing is regular.

counterexamples.description: Sakura waiting continuously is Shirou's supposition.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He finds her at the entrance and infers she may have waited.
counterexamples.explanation: Sakura waiting continuously is Shirou's supposition.

contexts.japanese: ずっと待っていたのか、玄関には桜の姿があった。
contexts.english: Sakura's already at the entrance, like she's been waiting here the whole time.

counterexamples.description: Shirou initially postpones the report until after tea.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He wants bodily rest first.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou initially postpones the report until after tea.

contexts.japanese: 桜に今日の出来事を報告するのは居間に戻って、お茶を一杯飲んでからにしよう。
contexts.english: I'll go to the living room and have a cup of tea before I tell Sakura what happened today.

counterexamples.description: Rin's imminent arrival makes prior explanation urgent.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Shirou fears Sakura will be wary without context.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin's imminent arrival makes prior explanation urgent.

contexts.japanese: その前に事の顛末を説明しておかないと、桜が遠坂を警戒してしまう。
contexts.english: If I don't explain the situation first, Sakura will be on guard against Tohsaka.

counterexamples.description: Shirou wrongly assumes Sakura lacks the circumstances.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He thinks only the wrapping alerts her.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou wrongly assumes Sakura lacks the circumstances.

contexts.japanese: 事情を知らない桜でも、一目で何かあったと気付くってもんだ。
contexts.english: Sakura may not know what happened, but anyone would notice that.

counterexamples.description: Shirou explicitly lies that the arm moves normally and is minor.
counterexamples.sourceReading: This reassurance contradicts the prior immobility.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou explicitly lies that the arm moves normally and is minor.

contexts.japanese: 「うん、ちょっと怪我した。けど問題なく動くし、もうなんともない。ホントはこんな布も邪魔なだけなんだけど、言峰のヤツが外すなってうるさくてさ。
contexts.english: "Yeah, I got a little hurt. But I can move it just fine, so it's no big deal. This wrap is actually in the way, but Kotomine kept telling me not to take it off.

counterexamples.description: Patting the wrapped arm is only a reassurance gesture.
counterexamples.sourceReading: It shows his performance of being fine, not finger mobility.
counterexamples.explanation: Patting the wrapped arm is only a reassurance gesture.

contexts.japanese: ぽん、と左腕を叩いて無事を報せる。
contexts.english: I pat my left arm to show that I'm okay.

counterexamples.description: Sakura knows the arm is not his original and fingers barely move.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Her knowledge directly defeats his assumptions.
counterexamples.explanation: Sakura knows the arm is not his original and fingers barely move.

contexts.japanese: 「か、掠り傷のワケないじゃないですか……！　もう先輩の腕ですらないんですよ！？　指先だって満足に動かないのに、どうしてそんなコト言うんですかっ……！
contexts.english: "Th-that isn't a scratch at all! It isn't even your own arm! How can you say that when you can't even move your fingers!?

counterexamples.description: Shirou condemns his own stupidity.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He realizes he ignored her day-long solitary waiting.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou condemns his own stupidity.

contexts.japanese: ……自分の馬鹿さかげんに言葉を失う。
contexts.english: ...I'm speechless at my own stupidity.

counterexamples.description: Sakura apologizes while asking Shirou to value himself.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She fears her outburst blamed him.
counterexamples.explanation: Sakura apologizes while asking Shirou to value himself.

contexts.japanese: 「あ……ご、ごめんなさい先輩。せ、責めるつもりじゃなかったんです。……わ、わたしはただ、先輩があんまりにも無茶をして、先輩自身のことを大事にしてあげないのが、あの」
contexts.english: "Ah... I-I'm sorry. I don't mean to blame you for it. I just...want you to take better care of yourself, and, um..."

counterexamples.description: Shirou says he was surprised and reflected, not angered.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Her serious anger is new to him.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou says he was surprised and reflected, not angered.

contexts.japanese: 俺、怒鳴られて怒ったわけじゃない。……その、真剣に怒った桜を見たのは初めてだから、驚いて、反省した」
contexts.english: I'm not upset because you yelled at me. Um, I'm surprised and sorry because this is the first time I've seen you sincerely angry."

counterexamples.description: Shirou admits vanity beneath reassurance.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He did not want Sakura to see him look uncool, so he bluffed.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou admits vanity beneath reassurance.

contexts.japanese: 「ああ。たしかに強がるのはよくない。それが桜なら尚更だ。……きっと、俺は桜に格好わるいところを見せたくなかったんだ。だから強がって平気なフリをした。
