contexts.japanese: 「ええ。サクラがそれを望むのなら、私の手で楽にしようとは考えています。ですが士郎。私は、彼女の生存を望んでいる」
contexts.english: "Yes. If Sakura wishes it, I will put an end to her suffering myself. But Shirou, I want her to live."

counterexamples.description: Rider challenges Shirou's surprise that she has emotions.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The exchange corrects his assumption rather than narratorly flattening her.
counterexamples.explanation: Rider challenges Shirou's surprise that she has emotions.

contexts.japanese: 「ええ。意外ですか士郎。私が感情を持つ事が」
contexts.english: "Yes. Does that surprise you that I have emotions of my own, Shirou?"

counterexamples.description: Rider presents summoning affinity as her explanation.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She cites Shirou and Saber as similar souls.
counterexamples.explanation: Rider presents summoning affinity as her explanation.

contexts.japanese: けれど士郎。サーヴァントは自分に近いモノに喚ばれるのです。貴方がセイバーを召喚したのは偶然ではなく、その魂の在り方が近いからでしょう」
contexts.english: But, Shirou—a Master summons a Servant that is similar to them. It is no coincidence that you summoned Saber. Your souls must have been similar, somehow."

counterexamples.description: Warmth becomes audible in Rider's voice.
counterexamples.sourceReading: This corrects Shirou's cold appearance-based assumption.
counterexamples.explanation: Warmth becomes audible in Rider's voice.

contexts.japanese: ……そう言うライダーの声には、確かに温かい感情が流れていた。
contexts.english: ...Rider's voice takes on a clearly warm tone.

counterexamples.description: Rider's gentleness remains Shirou's new impression.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He wonders rather than declares a complete personality replacement.
counterexamples.explanation: Rider's gentleness remains Shirou's new impression.

contexts.japanese: 外見からつい酷薄な性格を想像してしまったけど、ライダー、本当はすごく淑やかな性格をしてるんじゃないだろうか。
contexts.english: From her appearance, I imagined her to be more cold and ruthless, but now I'm wondering if she's a truly gentle soul.

counterexamples.description: Shirou has heard what happened but refuses to claim lived understanding.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Information and understanding are separated.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou has heard what happened but refuses to claim lived understanding.

contexts.japanese: いや、言峰の口からどんなものだったかはとっくに聞いている。
contexts.english: Though, I've already heard from Kotomine's lips what happened to her.

counterexamples.description: Shirou rejects saying he understands easily.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Even plausible imagination does not authorize the claim.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou rejects saying he understands easily.

contexts.japanese: だが—それは俺が、容易く“解る”なんて口にしてはいけない事だ。
contexts.english: Still...I could never claim to understand what Sakura's been through.

counterexamples.description: Rider's hypothetical killing is tied to glib claimed understanding.
counterexamples.sourceReading: No present attack occurs.
counterexamples.explanation: Rider's hypothetical killing is tied to glib claimed understanding.

contexts.japanese: 「でしょうね。サクラは貴方に知られないように努めてきた。その貴方がここで解るなどと口にすれば、私は貴方を殺している」
contexts.english: "Indeed. Sakura has been trying not to let you know. If you claimed that you understood it, then I would have killed you."

counterexamples.description: Rider trusts Shirou's core despite immaturity.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Her approval is qualified rather than wholesale praise.
counterexamples.explanation: Rider trusts Shirou's core despite immaturity.

contexts.japanese: 貴方は未熟で不器用ですが、その芯にあるものは信用に足ります。だからこそ、サクラにとって貴方は救いだったのでしょう」
contexts.english: You are clumsy and inexperienced, but trustworthy at your core. That is how you have saved Sakura."

counterexamples.description: Pain and suffering remain the largest restored emotions.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The paradox coexists with Shirou as salvation.
counterexamples.explanation: Pain and suffering remain the largest restored emotions.

contexts.japanese: その中で最も大きかったのは痛みと苦しみですが、それでも諦めるだけだった彼女にとって、貴方は唯一確かな救いだったのです」
contexts.english: Pain and suffering were the greatest among them, but to someone who has only ever known despair, you were her one and only salvation."

counterexamples.description: Shirou cannot relate to Sakura's suffering or explain her love.
counterexamples.sourceReading: His epistemic humility continues.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou cannot relate to Sakura's suffering or explain her love.

contexts.japanese: 桜が何を思い、何に苦しんできたかを共有できない俺には、俺を好きになってくれた理由さえ判らない。
contexts.english: I don't know why she came to love me, when she's suffered on a level that I could never possibly relate to.

counterexamples.description: Rider speaks with quiet sadness and gratitude.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The affect complicates her message about happiness.
counterexamples.explanation: Rider speaks with quiet sadness and gratitude.

contexts.japanese: 静かな悲しみと感謝を込めてそう言った。
contexts.english: Her voice contains quiet sadness and gratitude.

counterexamples.description: Rider claims Sakura wants nothing beyond Shirou's presence.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The claim remains Rider's speech, not neutral omniscient fact.
counterexamples.explanation: Rider claims Sakura wants nothing beyond Shirou's presence.

contexts.japanese: サクラの幸福は、貴方が生きて傍にいてくれる、という事。それ以外に彼女が望むものなどない」
contexts.english: What makes Sakura happy is having you by her side. She does not wish for anything else."

counterexamples.description: Shirou recognizes his fighting threatens Sakura's happiness.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The contradiction is explicit before he grips his arm.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou recognizes his fighting threatens Sakura's happiness.

contexts.japanese: 間桐桜にとって、衛宮士郎が戦うという事自体が、彼女の幸福を脅かしている。
contexts.english: To Sakura Matou, Shirou Emiya fighting this war is a threat to her happiness.

counterexamples.description: Shirou insists he must fight if still capable.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Condition and bodily cost remain.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou insists he must fight if still capable.

contexts.japanese: どんな身体だろうとまだ戦えるのなら、戦わないといけない。
contexts.english: If I can still fight, then I have to, no matter what shape I'm in.

counterexamples.description: His motive has shifted from ending war to Sakura alone.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The identity crisis follows this chosen commitment.
counterexamples.explanation: His motive has shifted from ending war to Sakura alone.

contexts.japanese: 戦いを止める為ではなく、桜の為だけに戦うと決めてしまった。
contexts.english: I decided that I'd fight for her sake now, not to end the war.

counterexamples.description: Neither party answers during the long silence.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rider closes her mouth and Shirou looks down.
counterexamples.explanation: Neither party answers during the long silence.

contexts.japanese: ライダーは口を閉ざし、俺は俯いたまま答えがない。
contexts.english: Rider stops talking, and I stare at the ground, not answering.

counterexamples.description: Rider's question includes whatever may happen.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The condition is deliberately broad and ominous.
counterexamples.explanation: Rider's question includes whatever may happen.

contexts.japanese: この先に、たとえ何があったとしても」
contexts.english: No matter what happens from now on?"

counterexamples.description: Shirou thinks he ought to nod firmly.
counterexamples.sourceReading: This is obligation/intention, not a completed nod.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou thinks he ought to nod firmly.

contexts.japanese: なら、迷いもなく頷いてライダーに応えなくてはいけない。
contexts.english: I have to nod firmly.

counterexamples.description: Shirou cannot say the answer aloud.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He partly understands the condition's implication.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou cannot say the answer aloud.

contexts.japanese: そう解っていても、はっきりと気持ちを口に出来なかった。
contexts.english: I know that, but I can't say it out loud.

counterexamples.description: Rider leaves by blending into darkness.
counterexamples.sourceReading: No attack or further answer occurs.
counterexamples.explanation: Rider leaves by blending into darkness.

contexts.japanese: 闇に溶ける様にライダーは立ち去った。
contexts.english: Rider virtually blends into the darkness as she departs.

counterexamples.description: The black Shadow remains unidentified.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Shirou lists it among unresolved forces.
counterexamples.explanation: The black Shadow remains unidentified.

contexts.japanese: 未だ正体の掴めない黒い影。
contexts.english: The black Shadow that I still don't understand.

counterexamples.description: The Grail is imagined capable of other wishes.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Sakura's happiness is set apart in the damaged next entry.
counterexamples.explanation: The Grail is imagined capable of other wishes.

contexts.japanese: 聖杯を手に入れれば、他のどんな望みも叶う。
contexts.english: With the Holy Grail, I could make any other wish come true.

counterexamples.description: The shared view places Shirou and Illya about five meters from Rin and Archer.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The spatial tableau precedes the Shadow expansion.
counterexamples.explanation: The shared view places Shirou and Illya about five meters from Rin and Archer.

contexts.japanese: そこから五メートルほど離れた場所に、銀髪の少女と、手を繋いで立ち尽くす衛宮士郎の姿があった。
contexts.english: Five meters away from them stands a silver-haired girl holding hands with Shirou Emiya.

counterexamples.description: Only Shirou's protruding left arm misses the sheltering luck.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The sentence anticipates the loss without describing voluntary sacrifice.
counterexamples.explanation: Only Shirou's protruding left arm misses the sheltering luck.

contexts.japanese: ただ、窪みから出ていた左腕だけは、その幸運に与れずに—
contexts.english: But his exposed left arm was not so lucky...

counterexamples.description: Sakura had shared Rider's perception from the Emiya house.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The preceding images are a real remote view, not an unreal dream.
counterexamples.explanation: Sakura had shared Rider's perception from the Emiya house.

contexts.japanese: 衛宮邸からでも様子が判るようにと、サーヴァントと視界を共有していた間桐桜は、その光景で現実に引き戻された。
contexts.english: Sakura had been sharing her Servant's perception so that she could keep an eye on things from the Emiya house. The shocking scene jolted her back to reality.

counterexamples.description: Shirou protected the silver-haired girl and lost the left arm.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The viewpoint does not confuse Illya with Sakura.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou protected the silver-haired girl and lost the left arm.

contexts.japanese: 衛宮士郎は銀髪の少女を庇って、左腕を影に呑まれた。
contexts.english: Shirou Emiya protected the silver-haired girl, and the Shadow swallowed his arm.

counterexamples.description: Sakura recognizes incapacitating injury would solve nothing.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The fantasy is repudiated before causation is misstated.
counterexamples.explanation: Sakura recognizes incapacitating injury would solve nothing.

contexts.japanese: そんなコトはなんの解決にもならない。
contexts.english: It wouldn't solve anything.

counterexamples.description: The actual wound threatens Shirou's life.
counterexamples.sourceReading: It exceeds confinement to the house.
counterexamples.explanation: The actual wound threatens Shirou's life.

contexts.japanese: 外に出られないどころか、命に関わる傷を負った。
contexts.english: His life was in danger, never mind his ability to leave the house.

counterexamples.description: Sakura admits with rapture that Shirou can no longer fight.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Relief survives guilt and bodily punishment.
counterexamples.explanation: Sakura admits with rapture that Shirou can no longer fight.

contexts.japanese: 「—でもこれで、もう先輩は戦えない」
contexts.english: "...Now Senpai can't fight anymore."

counterexamples.description: Sakura's wish for Shirou's safety is explicitly sincere.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Her concern is genuine despite the damaged contradictory smile entry.
counterexamples.explanation: Sakura's wish for Shirou's safety is explicitly sincere.

contexts.japanese: 彼女は本気で、一点の偽りもなく、衛宮士郎の無事を願う。
contexts.english: She sincerely and earnestly wishes for his safety.

counterexamples.description: Insects remain a comparison for invasive heat.
counterexamples.sourceReading: They are not identified as Sakura's crest worms.
counterexamples.explanation: Insects remain a comparison for invasive heat.

contexts.japanese: 肩の付け根から侵入する熱は、細胞を食う極小の蟲のようだ。
contexts.english: The heat seeping in from my shoulder joint is like thousands of microscopic bugs eating my cells.

counterexamples.description: The sealed-pan image threatens Shirou with charring.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Relaxing vigilance risks being burned black.
counterexamples.explanation: The sealed-pan image threatens Shirou with charring.

contexts.japanese: じゅうじゅうと音をたてて、気を抜けばいつのまにか真っ黒焦げになっている。
contexts.english: There's a sizzling sound. If I relax, I might find myself burned black.

counterexamples.description: Heat melts Shirou's mind rather than body.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The dream threatens identity and cognition.
counterexamples.explanation: Heat melts Shirou's mind rather than body.

contexts.japanese: 熱は、体ではなく心を溶かす。
contexts.english: The heat melts my mind, not my body.

counterexamples.description: Shirou wonders whether the nightmare will end.
counterexamples.sourceReading: No recovery is certified before waking.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou wonders whether the nightmare will end.

contexts.japanese: ……その、悪い夢がついに終わるのか。
contexts.english: ...Will this nightmare finally end?

counterexamples.description: Foreign flesh seals the shoulder opening.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The transplant is experienced as alien blockage.
counterexamples.explanation: Foreign flesh seals the shoulder opening.

contexts.japanese: その入り口—連中を外に出すべき穴が、自分以外の肉片で塞がれた—！
contexts.english: The entrance—the hole they should leave through is blocked by flesh that isn't my own...!

counterexamples.description: Unknown combat knowledge enters Shirou.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Experience and information are distinguished from ordinary memory.
counterexamples.explanation: Unknown combat knowledge enters Shirou.

contexts.japanese: 知るはずのない知識が入ってくる。
contexts.english: Knowledge I shouldn't have enters my brain.

counterexamples.description: Archer's Noble Phantasm is not simply the paired blades.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The denial precedes the forging/Projection account.
counterexamples.explanation: Archer's Noble Phantasm is not simply the paired blades.

contexts.japanese: 一対の短剣が、ではない。
contexts.english: Not those short swords.

counterexamples.description: Seen and understood objects can be reproduced.
counterexamples.sourceReading: This is experienced knowledge within the dream.
counterexamples.explanation: Seen and understood objects can be reproduced.

contexts.japanese: 目に見たもの、理解したものならばいくらでも複製する。
contexts.english: He could reproduce anything he saw and understood.

counterexamples.description: The ability is Projection rather than ordinary copying.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The terminology distinction is explicit.
counterexamples.explanation: The ability is Projection rather than ordinary copying.

contexts.japanese: それは複製ではなく投影。
contexts.english: It wasn't reproduction, but Projection—

counterexamples.description: The invasive heat demands mastery.
counterexamples.sourceReading: This is internal coercive sensation, not calm instruction.
counterexamples.explanation: The invasive heat demands mastery.

contexts.japanese: それを—使いこなせと、心を燃やす熱が言った。
contexts.english: The heat burning my heart demands that I master it.

counterexamples.description: Shirou fears the shortcut will destroy his body.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He rejects easy access as dangerous.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou fears the shortcut will destroy his body.

contexts.japanese: そんな近道は必ずこの身を破滅させる。
contexts.english: This shortcut is definitely going to destroy my body.

counterexamples.description: Shirou insists he and Archer are unrelated strangers.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The denial coexists with compatibility revealed later.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou insists he and Archer are unrelated strangers.

contexts.japanese: なによりそれだけの力がなくおまえと俺は赤の他人で何の接点もないんだから体が馴染む筈がない、いや、仮に馴染んだところでどうなる耐えられる筈がない、
contexts.english: I'm not strong enough to do it, you and I are complete strangers with nothing in common, so there's no way this will take. No, even if it does, I couldn't possibly endure it.

counterexamples.description: Consciousness returns slowly into an unfamiliar room.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The dream ends before Illya is recognized.
counterexamples.explanation: Consciousness returns slowly into an unfamiliar room.

contexts.japanese: ……ゆっくりと意識が戻る。
contexts.english: ...My consciousness slowly returns.

counterexamples.description: Illya's safety brings genuine relief before self-assessment.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Shirou remains confused about his own condition.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya's safety brings genuine relief before self-assessment.

contexts.japanese: 状況は掴めないが、イリヤが無事なのは本当に嬉しい。
contexts.english: I don't know what's going on yet, but I'm really happy that Illya is all right.

counterexamples.description: Illya rushes directly into Shirou's arms.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Her relief is physical and immediate.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya rushes directly into Shirou's arms.

contexts.japanese: イリヤはまっすぐに突っ込んでくる。
contexts.english: Illya dives into my arms.

counterexamples.description: Illya's replacement offer is prospective.
counterexamples.sourceReading: No second procedure has occurred.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya's replacement offer is prospective.

contexts.japanese: 「怪我は痛まない？　少しでもおかしいなって思ったら、すぐ代わりの物をつけさせるから！」
contexts.english: "Do your injuries hurt? If anything feels off at all, let me know and I'll get you a replacement right away!"

counterexamples.description: Shirou denies pain immediately before the attack.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The contradiction dramatizes delayed onset.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou denies pain immediately before the attack.

contexts.japanese: 「……？　ああ、別に痛いところなんてないよ。それよりイリヤ、あれからどうなったのか説明—」
contexts.english: "...? No, it doesn't really hurt anywhere. Anyway, Illya, can you explain what—"

counterexamples.description: The right hand scratches Shirou's chest during pain.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The usable side remains explicit.
counterexamples.explanation: The right hand scratches Shirou's chest during pain.

contexts.japanese: 痛みに耐えかねて、右腕で胸を掻き毟る。
contexts.english: I'm unable to bear the pain, my right hand scratching at my chest.

counterexamples.description: Illya tells Shirou to suppress the left arm rather than endure.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The instruction concerns containment.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya tells Shirou to suppress the left arm rather than endure.

contexts.japanese: 「シロウ……！？　落ち着いて、我慢するんじゃなくて左腕を抑えつけるの……！」
contexts.english: "Shirou...!? Try to relax. You need to suppress the left arm, not just put up with it...!"

counterexamples.description: Shirou builds a barrier preventing alien mixture.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The action produces temporary control, not cure.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou builds a barrier preventing alien mixture.

contexts.japanese: 要は関を作って、異物が本体に混ざらないよう努めればいいだけだ。
contexts.english: I just need to build a barrier to prevent the alien parts from mixing with my own body.

counterexamples.description: Illya judges that mutual rejection has temporarily stopped.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Her assessment remains cautious.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya judges that mutual rejection has temporarily stopped.

contexts.japanese: 「うん、わたしにも判るよ。どうなる事かと思ったけど、とりあえず反発しあう事はないみたい」
contexts.english: "Good, I can tell, too. I was worried what might happen, but you don't seem to be rejecting it."

counterexamples.description: Illya looks away because explanation is difficult.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Kirei then takes over.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya looks away because explanation is difficult.

contexts.japanese: 言いにくそうに視線を逸らす。
contexts.english: She looks away uncomfortably.

counterexamples.description: Illya refuses to leave Shirou alone with Kirei.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She says she will leave with Shirou and challenges the priest's harmlessness.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya refuses to leave Shirou alone with Kirei.

contexts.japanese: 「……ふん、どうだか。わたしはシロウと一緒に外に出るの。アナタが本当に何もしないのなら、わたしがここにいても問題はないでしょう？」
contexts.english: "...Hmph, sure you will. I'm going to leave with Shirou. If you really aren't going to do anything to him, then there shouldn't be a problem if I stay."

counterexamples.description: Shirou immediately recognizes the left arm as not his.
counterexamples.sourceReading: This occurs through the wrapping, without unwrapped inspection.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou immediately recognizes the left arm as not his.

contexts.japanese: そこにある腕は、衛宮士郎の腕ではなかった。
contexts.english: This arm doesn't belong to Shirou Emiya.

counterexamples.description: The attached arm is framed as a natural-law-defying foreign body.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Its wrongness is perceptible despite cloth.
counterexamples.explanation: The attached arm is framed as a natural-law-defying foreign body.

contexts.japanese: それは本来在ってはならないモノ、自然の摂理を押し曲げてまで取り付けた“異物”だった。
contexts.english: It's something alien that defies the laws of nature, that should never be attached to me.

counterexamples.description: Kirei says the arm came from Archer by Archer's intent.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Donation and source side are explicit.
counterexamples.explanation: Kirei says the arm came from Archer by Archer's intent.

contexts.japanese: 「アーチャーの左腕だ。アーチャー本人の意思を尊重し、彼の遺体からおまえに移植した」
contexts.english: "Archer's left arm. I honored his last wishes and transplanted it from his corpse."

counterexamples.description: Archer disappears only after transplantation is complete.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Independent Action lets him endure until then.
counterexamples.explanation: Archer disappears only after transplantation is complete.

contexts.japanese: 「移植が済んだ後、消滅した。ここに運ばれた時点で死に体だったのだが、よくも終わるまで保ったものだ。アーチャーの持つ単独行動故だろうがな」
contexts.english: "After the transplant, he disappeared. He was already on the verge of death when he brought you here. I'm surprised he lasted so long. It must be thanks to his Independent Action ability."

counterexamples.description: Shirou questions why a vanished Servant's arm remains.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The continuity problem is raised directly.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou questions why a vanished Servant's arm remains.

contexts.japanese: 「……待て。アーチャーは消えたんだろう。なら、あいつの腕が残っているのはおかしくないか」
contexts.english: "...Wait. You said Archer disappeared. Then how is his arm still here?"

counterexamples.description: The arm was detached and connected while Archer remained in the world.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Shirou's circuits and energy sustain it as flesh.
counterexamples.explanation: The arm was detached and connected while Archer remained in the world.

contexts.japanese: 「移植が終わる前に消滅したのなら、その左腕も消えていただろう。だがおまえのソレはアーチャーが現世に留まっているうちに切り離し、おまえの体に植え付けたものだ。衛宮士郎の魔術回路と繋げ、おまえ自身の魔力で現世に受肉させている英霊の肉。
contexts.english: "If he had passed on before the transplant was complete, then the arm would have gone as well. But your new arm was amputated and transplanted while he was still in the mortal world. It is the incarnated flesh of a Heroic Spirit, connected to Shirou Emiya's Magic Circuits and incarnated by your own magical energy.

counterexamples.description: Completed surgery makes the arm Shirou's body before Archer vanishes.
counterexamples.sourceReading: This explains persistence.
counterexamples.explanation: Completed surgery makes the arm Shirou's body before Archer vanishes.

contexts.japanese: ……その手術が成った時点で、ソレはおまえの肉体となった。その後ならばアーチャーが消えようと左腕は残る。その左腕は既におまえの腕なのだからな」
contexts.english: ...It became a part of your body once the surgery was complete. Afterward, Archer disappeared, leaving his left arm behind. It is now your arm."

counterexamples.description: Both Archer and Shirou were near death.
counterexamples.sourceReading: A broken spiritual core and catastrophic tissue loss motivate the operation.
counterexamples.explanation: Both Archer and Shirou were near death.

contexts.japanese: 「そうだ。あのままではおまえもアーチャーも長くはなかった。アーチャーはこの世に留まる霊核を壊されており、おまえも半死半生の手負いで、傷口より生命活動に必要な中身を損ねていた。
contexts.english: "Yes. At the time, neither you nor Archer had much time left to live. Archer's spiritual core keeping him in this world was destroyed, and you were critically wounded, lacking vital life-sustaining tissues.

counterexamples.description: Archer supplies an intact body part so Shirou can live.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Donation is lifesaving rather than power enhancement.
counterexamples.explanation: Archer supplies an intact body part so Shirou can live.

contexts.japanese: 幸い、アーチャーの体に傷は少なかったからな。彼はおまえに唯一無事な肉体を提供する事で、死にゆくおまえを生かしたのだ」
contexts.english: Fortunately, Archer's body was only lightly damaged. He gave you the only unscathed part of his body so that you might live."

counterexamples.description: Shirou concludes Archer saved him after the forest collapse.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The realization follows physical evidence.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou concludes Archer saved him after the forest collapse.

contexts.japanese: その後、アーチャーに救われたのか。
contexts.english: Then, Archer saved my life.

counterexamples.description: Kirei says soul restoration is beyond magecraft.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He expected physical success followed by shock death.
counterexamples.explanation: Kirei says soul restoration is beyond magecraft.

contexts.japanese: 霊体……魂の蘇生、復元は魔術では扱えない神秘である。故に今回も、形だけ成功した後でショック死すると思ったのだが—」
contexts.english: The resurrection and restoration of spiritual bodies...of souls is a Mystic beyond the scope of magecraft. That is why I expected it to work only in shape, and that you would die of shock afterward..."

counterexamples.description: Illya knows Shirou and Archer are exceptional.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She withholds the reason.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya knows Shirou and Archer are exceptional.

contexts.japanese: 「……シロウとアーチャーは特別よ。わたしもさっき判った。この二人なら、繋がりさえすれば持ち直すって」
contexts.english: "...But you and Archer are special. I just realized that earlier, too. If it was you two, you'd be able to bounce back."

counterexamples.description: Kirei knows compatibility exceeds twins but not why.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The explanation remains withheld.
counterexamples.explanation: Kirei knows compatibility exceeds twins but not why.

contexts.japanese: 「ほう。まあ、その理由は知らん。私に判るのはおまえたちの相性がよかった、という事だけだ。手術を始めた時は驚いたぞ。双子でもここまで瓜二つではなかろう、とな」
contexts.english: "Oh? Well, I don't know the reason. I just know that you were highly compatible. I was surprised once the operation began. Even identical twins aren't so similar."

counterexamples.description: The left arm has no useful movement.
counterexamples.sourceReading: No recovery is claimed immediately after surgery.
counterexamples.explanation: The left arm has no useful movement.

contexts.japanese: 何をどうやっても動かない。
contexts.english: I can't move it no matter what I do.

counterexamples.description: The arm feels like a lump of iron.
counterexamples.sourceReading: This is alien immobility, not a literal metal prosthesis.
counterexamples.explanation: The arm feels like a lump of iron.

contexts.japanese: ……左腕は、ただの鉄くれになっていた。
contexts.english: ...My left arm is just a lump of iron now.

counterexamples.description: Tin-man comparison follows iron sensation.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The metaphor expresses bodily constraint.
counterexamples.explanation: Tin-man comparison follows iron sensation.

contexts.japanese: ブリキになった人間がいるとすれば、それはこんな不自由さなのかもしれない。
contexts.english: Maybe this is what being a tin man would feel like.

counterexamples.description: Kirei predicts adaptation in days and ordinary-life recovery.
counterexamples.sourceReading: This is a prognosis, not current function.
counterexamples.explanation: Kirei predicts adaptation in days and ordinary-life recovery.

contexts.japanese: 「無茶を言うな。繋げたばかりではそれが限界だ。数日経てば馴染む。先ほども言ったが、おまえたちの相性は実にいい。この分であれば、通常の生活をこなせるほどには回復しよう」
contexts.english: "Don't force it. It's only just been attached. Your body will be accustomed to it in a few days. As I said earlier, you two were exceptionally compatible with each other. You should be able to recover enough even to resume normal life."

counterexamples.description: Compatibility applies to circuits only.
counterexamples.sourceReading: It does not make Heroic Spirit power safe for a human.
counterexamples.explanation: Compatibility applies to circuits only.

contexts.japanese: 「だが注意しろ。私が言っているのは、あくまで回路が合う、というだけの話だ。
contexts.english: "But be warned. I am only saying that your circuits were compatible.

counterexamples.description: A single use activates Archer's Magic Circuits.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The trigger is use, not gradual ordinary aging.
counterexamples.explanation: A single use activates Archer's Magic Circuits.

contexts.japanese: 「霊格として、衛宮士郎の肉体はアーチャーの腕には到底及ばん。一度でもその腕を使えば、アーチャーの魔術回路が起動する。
contexts.english: "Archer's arm is far beyond Shirou Emiya's spiritual core to sustain. If you use the arm even once, it will activate Archer's Magic Circuits.

counterexamples.description: Kirei rejects lifespan loss per use.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The correction is explicit.
counterexamples.explanation: Kirei rejects lifespan loss per use.

contexts.japanese: いいか、使う度に寿命が減っていく、のではない。
contexts.english: Hear me—I am not saying that each use will shorten your life span.

counterexamples.description: Using the arm starts a time bomb.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The triggered countdown is distinct from baseline invasion.
counterexamples.explanation: Using the arm starts a time bomb.

contexts.japanese: その腕を使えば、おまえの体に植え付けられた時限爆弾にスイッチが入るのだ」
contexts.english: Once you use the arm, you will have lit the fuse on a time bomb."

counterexamples.description: Shirou understands one imitation as fatal.
counterexamples.sourceReading: This is his reading of the warning.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou understands one imitation as fatal.

contexts.japanese: 要するに一度でもアーチャーの真似事をすれば、俺は絶対に死ぬって事じゃないか。
contexts.english: Is he basically saying that if I try to copy what Archer does even once, I'm as good as dead?

counterexamples.description: The wrapping separates left-arm circuits from Shirou's spellcasting.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Magecraft elsewhere does not activate it as part of him.
counterexamples.explanation: The wrapping separates left-arm circuits from Shirou's spellcasting.

contexts.japanese: 「ああ、その為の封印だ。それを巻いているかぎり、左腕は魔術回路を発現しない。おまえが魔術を使おうと、その左腕だけは別の物として扱われる。
contexts.english: "Yes, they are a seal. So long as your left arm stays wrapped, its Magic Circuits will not manifest. Even if you use magecraft, the left arm won't act as a part of you.

counterexamples.description: The shroud suppresses invasion only to an extent.
counterexamples.sourceReading: It is not a complete cure.
counterexamples.explanation: The shroud suppresses invasion only to an extent.

contexts.japanese: その布を巻いている限り、左腕からの侵食はある程度抑えられる筈だ」
contexts.english: As long as the shroud stays on, it will hinder the arm's invasion of your body, to an extent."

counterexamples.description: The arm ultimately invades whether used or not.
counterexamples.sourceReading: This slow baseline danger differs from activation-triggered collapse.
counterexamples.explanation: The arm ultimately invades whether used or not.

contexts.japanese: 「抑えられん。……そうだな、アーチャーの腕を使おうと使うまいと、結局はその腕に侵食される。
contexts.english: That is impossible... I suppose whether you use Archer's arm or not, it will ultimately consume you.

counterexamples.description: Growth into a mage able to resist the arm is proposed as solution.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Kirei's assessment remains prospective.
counterexamples.explanation: Growth into a mage able to resist the arm is proposed as solution.

contexts.japanese: 長生きがしたいのなら、腕と拮抗するほどの魔術師に成長しろ。そうなれば聖骸布を巻かずとも左腕の封印は出来る」
contexts.english: If you want to live longer, then grow into a mage that can resist the arm. Then you may be able to keep it sealed even without the aid of the shroud."

counterexamples.description: Kirei estimates ten years before consumption.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The duration is approximate and tied to his assessment.
counterexamples.explanation: Kirei estimates ten years before consumption.

contexts.japanese: 「なに、私の見立てでは左腕に食い潰されるまでにあと十年。それだけの猶予があるのだ。一人前になって左腕を御するか、成れずに自滅するか。そう急な話ではあるまい」
contexts.english: "I give it about ten years until the arm devours you completely. That is how much time he bought you. You can become capable enough to control the arm on your own, or fail and die. Either way, it is hardly an urgent matter."

counterexamples.description: Shirou recognizes he would have died in the forest.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Acceptance of the operation begins from this counterfactual.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou recognizes he would have died in the forest.

contexts.japanese: 本来なら、俺はあの森で死んでいた。
contexts.english: I would have died in that forest.

counterexamples.description: The left arm remains immobile while Shirou drapes on the coat.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Dressing is partial, not recovery.
counterexamples.explanation: The left arm remains immobile while Shirou drapes on the coat.

contexts.japanese: 左腕は動かないので、とりあえず羽織っただけだ。
contexts.english: My left arm can't move, so I just slip on a coat.

counterexamples.description: Unwrapping and using Archer's arm remains Shirou's choice.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Kirei refuses to guarantee survival.
counterexamples.explanation: Unwrapping and using Archer's arm remains Shirou's choice.

contexts.japanese: 選択肢は常におまえにある。アーチャーの力を使うのは自由だが、使えば命の保証はせん。
contexts.english: The choice is always up to you. You're free to use Archer's arm, but I cannot guarantee your safety if you do.

counterexamples.description: Rin's toxin cleansing and Shirou's transplant are identified as completed treatments.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Completion does not erase future risk.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin's toxin cleansing and Shirou's transplant are identified as completed treatments.

contexts.japanese: チャーの左腕を移植され、凛は毒素を洗浄された。なにか、これ以上の要求はあるか？」
contexts.english: was transplanted to Shirou Emiya, and Rin has been detoxified. Do you have any further requests?"

counterexamples.description: Sakura cannot oppose Zouken in Kirei/Shirou's current assessment.
counterexamples.sourceReading: This is why victory appears decided.
counterexamples.explanation: Sakura cannot oppose Zouken in Kirei/Shirou's current assessment.

contexts.japanese: ……本来なら残った二人が戦うべきなのだが、桜は臓硯に逆らえない。そういった意味で、勝敗はもう決まっているようなものだった。
contexts.english: ...Normally, the last survivors would fight, but Sakura can't disobey Zouken. In that sense, he's already won.

counterexamples.description: Kirei predicts Zouken will retrieve or dispose of Sakura.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He says prevention is difficult and offers no duty/benefit.
counterexamples.explanation: Kirei predicts Zouken will retrieve or dispose of Sakura.

contexts.japanese: 「間桐臓硯としては間桐桜を取り戻すか、始末するかのどちらかだろう。これを防ぐのは難しく、おまえたちには防ぐ義務もない。なにしろ間桐臓硯を倒したところで、おまえたちに益はないからな」
contexts.english: "Zouken Matou will likely decide to either retrieve Sakura Matou, or dispose of her. It would be difficult to prevent this, and neither of you are obligated to do so. After all, you have nothing to gain from defeating Zouken."

counterexamples.description: Shirou interprets Zouken's victory as failure to save Sakura.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The causal rescue premise remains his thought.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou interprets Zouken's victory as failure to save Sakura.

contexts.japanese: 臓硯が勝ったところで桜は救われない。
contexts.english: If Zouken wins, then we can't save Sakura.

counterexamples.description: Shirou recognizes Rin wants to help her younger sister.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Her concern is visible beneath strategy claims.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou recognizes Rin wants to help her younger sister.

contexts.japanese: もう聖杯を手に入れられない遠坂は、なんだかんだ言って妹である桜を助けたがっている。
contexts.english: Tohsaka can't actually obtain the Holy Grail anymore, but she still wants to help her little sister.

counterexamples.description: Shirou also chooses to continue fighting Zouken.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He has a goal but no finished plan.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou also chooses to continue fighting Zouken.

contexts.japanese: 「ああ、戦いは止めない。俺だって目的はある。このまま臓硯の好きにはさせない」
contexts.english: "Yeah. I won't stop fighting. I have my own goal, too. I can't let Zouken do as he pleases."

counterexamples.description: Shirou thinks he and Rin may find a method together.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Possibility remains uncertain.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou thinks he and Rin may find a method together.

contexts.japanese: 俺一人じゃそんなもの見つからないが、遠坂と二人なら、臓硯を倒す方法ぐらい見つかるかもしれない—
contexts.english: I can't see any way to do it alone, but with Tohsaka, we might just find a way to defeat Zouken.

counterexamples.description: Illya says the castle and attendants remain available.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Homelessness is not her problem.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya says the castle and attendants remain available.

contexts.japanese: 「？　城はまだあるし、セラもリズも呼べば出てくるから帰る場所はあるけど……どうしてそんなコト訊くの、シロウ？」
contexts.english: "Hm? I still have my castle. Sella and Leys will come out if I call for them, so I still have a place to go home too... Why are you asking?"

counterexamples.description: Illya refuses Shirou's house because the woman is there.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The unnamed reference remains pointed.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya refuses Shirou's house because the woman is there.

contexts.japanese: 「いいけど、行かない。シロウのとこにはあの女がいるもの」
contexts.english: "Okay, but I'm not coming. That woman is at your house."

counterexamples.description: Illya refuses Kirei and asserts control of her lodging.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The three parties reject his custody for their own reasons.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya refuses Kirei and asserts control of her lodging.

contexts.japanese: 「お断りするわ。わたし、自分の居場所は自分で決められるもの」
contexts.english: "No thanks. I'll decide where I'm going to stay."

counterexamples.description: Illya protests that Rin's accusations are not her words.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin is deliberately paraphrasing to provoke her.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya protests that Rin's accusations are not her words.

contexts.japanese: わたしそんなコト一言も—」
contexts.english: I never said..."

counterexamples.description: Illya says she must stay away from Shirou.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The underlying reason remains incomplete.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya says she must stay away from Shirou.

contexts.japanese: 「……それは、そうだけど……けど、わたしが城に戻るのは、シロウから離れないといけないからで—」
contexts.english: "That's true, but... But I need to go back to the castle because I should stay away from Shirou..."

counterexamples.description: Illya emphatically denies disliking Shirou.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She says something else is the problem.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya emphatically denies disliking Shirou.

contexts.japanese: 「そ、そんなコトないっ！　わたし、シロウがイヤだなんて言ってないもん！　わたしがイヤなのは、もっと別のコトなんだから……！」
contexts.english: "Th-that's not true! I never said that I don't like Shirou! There's something else that I don't like...!"

counterexamples.description: Rin separates temporarily to collect belongings.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She sends Shirou ahead and plans to rejoin him.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin separates temporarily to collect belongings.

contexts.japanese: 「じゃ、一旦ここでお別れね。家に戻って荷物を持ってくるから、士郎は先に行ってて」
contexts.english: "All right, let's split up for now. I'm going home to get my things. You can go on ahead, Shirou."

counterexamples.description: Shirou's house is chosen as shared base for practical reasons.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Illya rejects Rin's house and Sakura already lives with Shirou.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou's house is chosen as shared base for practical reasons.

contexts.japanese: 「当たり前でしょう。これから共同戦線を張るんだから、一緒にいなくてどうするのよ。うちはイリヤが嫌がるし、そっちには桜もいるし、どう考えても本拠地は貴方の家でしょ」
contexts.english: "Obviously. We're going to be fighting together, so we need to actually be together. Illya doesn't like my house, and Sakura's already at your place, so that makes your house our base of operations."

counterexamples.description: Rin's suggestion she chose badly remains teasing.
counterexamples.sourceReading: It follows Shirou's belated realization and does not withdraw cooperation.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin's suggestion she chose badly remains teasing.

contexts.japanese: 「……まったく。堂に入ってると思ったらなんか抜けてるし。ちょっと選択あやまったかなー」
contexts.english: "...Good grief. Just when I think you're getting the hang of this, you space out. Maybe I made a mistake after all..."

counterexamples.description: Illya accompanies Rin because Rin requested help.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She will come to Shirou's house afterward.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya accompanies Rin because Rin requested help.

contexts.japanese: 「ん、ちょっとね。リンが手を貸してほしいって言うから助けてあげるの。終わったらすぐ行くから、シロウは先に帰っていて」
contexts.english: "I'll just be a bit. Rin said she needed my help with something. I'll come over as soon as we're finished, so go on home first, Shirou."

counterexamples.description: Shirou repeats unfamiliar name fragments in confusion.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He does not recognize the figure or object.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou repeats unfamiliar name fragments in confusion.

contexts.japanese: 「………きしゅあ？　ぜる？　しゅばいんおーぐ？」
contexts.english: "...Kissher? Zel? Shavineorg?"

counterexamples.description: Shirou introduces Illya as rescued and staying in the house.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Berserker's defeat and the new arrangement remain.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou introduces Illya as rescued and staying in the house.

contexts.japanese: バーサーカーはやられちまったけど、なんとかイリヤだけは助けられた。遠坂同様、これからうちで預かるけど仲良くしてやってくれ」
contexts.english: Her Berserker got taken out, but we managed to save her. She's going to be staying with us like Tohsaka, so try to get along."

counterexamples.description: Shirou retracts the dinner-as-storm image.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Oppressive calm better describes it.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou retracts the dinner-as-storm image.

contexts.japanese: ……ああいや、嵐と言うには語弊がある。
contexts.english: ...Okay, to call it a storm would be misleading.

counterexamples.description: The meal is dominated by tension.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Stillness does not mean comfort.
counterexamples.explanation: The meal is dominated by tension.

contexts.japanese: ともかく、恐ろしい緊張感に支配された夕食だったのだ。
contexts.english: Anyway, it was a dinner fraught with tension.

counterexamples.description: Rin cooks alone and outclasses Shirou.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Sakura may barely match her in Western food.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin cooks alone and outclasses Shirou.

contexts.japanese: 遠坂はそう言って夕飯を一人で作り、その味は悔しいが惨敗であり、かろうじて桜が得意とする洋食なら互角かも、というものだった。
contexts.english: With that, Tohsaka starts cooking on her own, and I'm forced to admit that she's better at it than me. Sakura's Western-style cooking might barely measure up.

counterexamples.description: Excellent food is not enjoyable under anxiety.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Quality and subjective pleasure remain distinct.
counterexamples.explanation: Excellent food is not enjoyable under anxiety.

contexts.japanese: 結果、あれだけ上等だった遠坂の手料理を美味いとは感じられず、ただただ遠坂凛が攻守ともに隙なしの優等生と思い知らされた一時間だったのだ。
contexts.english: As a result, I couldn't enjoy Tohsaka's excellent cooking, and spent the hour being reminded of what a flawless overachiever Rin Tohsaka is.

counterexamples.description: Rin postpones detailed discussion until morning.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Tonight is for rest.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin postpones detailed discussion until morning.

contexts.japanese: 詳しい話は明日の朝にするから、今夜はもう休みなさい」
contexts.english: We can hash out the details tomorrow morning. Get some rest, everyone."

counterexamples.description: Whether Illya's forest remark targets Sakura remains uncertain.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Shirou raises it as a question.
counterexamples.explanation: Whether Illya's forest remark targets Sakura remains uncertain.

contexts.japanese: ……屋敷にいた桜へのあてつけなのか、イリヤは桜を見ずにそんなことを言って席を立つ。
contexts.english: I don't know if that was a dig at Sakura, but Illya leaves without looking at her.

counterexamples.description: Shirou's lineage theory remains speculative.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He says maybe Illya ranks Rin and Sakura below her.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou's lineage theory remains speculative.

contexts.japanese: その中で最も大きな権利を持っていたのがアインツベルンらしいから、イリヤとしちゃあ遠坂も桜も格下扱いなんだろうけど。
contexts.english: Apparently, the Einzberns had the most authority, so maybe Illya thinks of Tohsaka and Sakura as beneath her.

counterexamples.description: Sakura begins tipping backward without replying.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The fall is interrupted before the floor.
counterexamples.explanation: Sakura begins tipping backward without replying.

contexts.japanese: うつらうつらと揺れる頭は、そのまま無造作に後ろに倒れかけ—
contexts.english: I watch her head waver, until she falls limply backward—

counterexamples.description: Sakura did not notice her own lapse.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She looks back as though nothing happened.
counterexamples.explanation: Sakura did not notice her own lapse.

contexts.japanese: ……桜は気付いていない。
contexts.english: ...Sakura didn't even realize it.

counterexamples.description: Shirou calls it nothing as reassurance.
counterexamples.sourceReading: The narration later recognizes danger.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou calls it nothing as reassurance.

contexts.japanese: 「—いや。別に、大したコトじゃない」
contexts.english: "...No, it's nothing."

counterexamples.description: Sakura apologizes for having fallen asleep.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Her own explanation remains limited.
counterexamples.explanation: Sakura apologizes for having fallen asleep.

contexts.japanese: 「……すみません。ちょっと疲れてたから、眠っちゃってました」
contexts.english: "...I'm sorry. I was a little tired, so I fell asleep."

counterexamples.description: Recovery by tomorrow is only Sakura's expectation.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Breakfast has not occurred.
counterexamples.explanation: Recovery by tomorrow is only Sakura's expectation.

contexts.japanese: 「そ、そうですね、じゃあお言葉に甘えちゃいます。今晩ぐっすり眠れば、きっと明日には元気になってますし。
contexts.english: "R-right. I'll take you up on that, then. I should feel better tomorrow if I get a good night's sleep.

counterexamples.description: Sakura walks steadily after the lapse.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Shirou uses this to respect her performance.
counterexamples.explanation: Sakura walks steadily after the lapse.
